In addition, the average response time is reduced to approximately 147 ms, resource utilization increases to 71–83%, and the success ratio improves from 93% to 97%, resulting in improved end-to-end reliability. The cumulative reward stabilizes at around 16.0, with convergence observed within 300 training episodes, and the achieved throughput reaches 118–121 entangled pairs per second, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed framework in dynamic NISQ network scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向分布式 NISQ 量子通信网络中链路波动、资源受限和纠缠退相干导致的可靠路由与调度难题，提出深度强化学习量子通信优化框架 DRL-QCOF。框架联合处理路由和调度，并引入基于 Bi-LSTM 的量子保真度预测，以适应时变和不确定的链路条件。相较仅依赖历史权重或静态优先级的传统方法，该思路旨在降低端到端延迟并提高量子资源利用效率。

articles.title: Noise suppression via pulsed all-optical magnetometry with nitrogen-vacancy ensembles
articles.title_zh: 基于氮-空位色心系综的脉冲全光磁力计噪声抑制
articles.abstract: All-optical (AO) microwave-free magnetometry using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond simplifies experimental design and broadens sample compatibility. While continuous-wave (cw) detection of AO photoluminescence (PL) changes is commonly employed, its performance is susceptible to systematic fluctuations such as optical intensity noise. To address these challenges, we introduce a pulsed AO protocol that employs two PL measurements within an optical pulse to suppress common-mode noise. At near-zero magnetic field, we experimentally demonstrate that the pulsed AO protocol resolves AO-PL contrast features arising from NV-NV cross-relaxation, achieving up to 10× improvement in the low-frequency noise floor compared to conventional cw AO techniques. We further investigate the dependence of AO-PL contrast on PL readout timing and the dark time duration τ between optical pulses, with the optimal τ varying based on NV concentrations. These findings provide insights into optimizing NV-diamond samples for effective AO operation across diverse applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种用于金刚石 NV 色心全光、无微波磁测的脉冲协议，在单个光脉冲内进行两次光致发光测量，以抑制光强噪声等共模扰动。实验在近零磁场下解析出由 NV–NV 交叉弛豫产生的全光 PL 对比特征，并相较传统连续波全光技术使低频噪声底最多降低约 10 倍。作者还研究了读出时序和脉冲间暗时间对信号对比度的影响，为不同 NV 浓度样品的全光磁测优化提供依据。

articles.title: Room-temperature gas mixture identification with a single magnetic-field-assisted metal oxide sensor
articles.title_zh: 单个磁场辅助金属氧化物传感器实现室温混合气体识别
articles.abstract: Metal oxides have long been considered unsuitable for the accurate quantification of complex gas mixtures, owing to their non-negligible cross-sensitivity to interfering gases. Here, we demonstrate that magnetic-field modulation can overcome this limitation by via synergistic modulation of electron spins and lattice vibrations in ZnO/Co3O4 heterostructures, enabling highly selective identification of H2S, SO2, and NH3. Under a magnetic field of 157.6 mT, the sensor achieves a 1 ppb detection limit for H2S and exhibits magnetic-field-enhanced responses to H2S, SO2, and NH3 by factors of 4.11, 1.75 and 1.64, respectively. The field further imprints gas-specific reversibility fingerprints—field-induced for H2S, intrinsic for NH3, and absent in the case of SO2—allowing simultaneous quantification of ternary mixtures at room temperature. Density functional theory and Raman spectroscopy reveal that the magnetic field modulates gas adsorption/desorption, Co-O vibrational modes, and sulfidation thermodynamics. These findings establish a magnetic-field-induced spin-lattice (MSL)synergistic mechanism at the Co sites, providing a transformative strategy for selective gas sensing without sensor arrays or machine learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作展示了通过磁场调制 ZnO/Co3O4 异质结构中电子自旋和晶格振动，可克服金属氧化物气敏材料对混合气体交叉敏感的限制。传感器在 157.6 mT 磁场下对 H2S 达到 1 ppb 检测限，并显著增强对 H2S、SO2 和 NH3 的响应，同时产生气体特异的可逆性指纹，从而支持室温三元混合气体定量。密度泛函理论和拉曼光谱表明，磁场调控吸附/脱附、Co–O 振动模式及硫化热力学，揭示了 Co 位点处磁场诱导的自旋–晶格协同机制。

articles.title: Mobility risk and desorption irreversibility of glyphosate and aminomethylphosphonic acid in highly weathered tropical soils of Sri Lanka
articles.title_zh: 斯里兰卡高度风化热带土壤中草甘膦和氨甲基膦酸的迁移风险与解吸不可逆性
articles.abstract: Glyphosate (GLY) and its primary metabolite aminomrthylphosphonic acid(AMPA) are among the most used and reported residues in the vicinity of application, yet the environmental dissipation behaviours in mineral-rich weathered tropical soils, particularly the mobility risk, are insufficiently studied. Sorption- desorption hysteresis of GLY and AMPA was characterised across 15 wet-zone tea estate soils in Sri Lanka using single-point Freundlich isotherms, with the objective of evaluating the site-specific mobility risk. Sorption experiments were conducted based on the batch equilibrium method, and residual glyphosate was analysed by LC-MS/MS. Adsorption was confirmed to follow pseudo-second-order kinetics and the Freundlich isotherm in all soils, consistent with a hybrid chemisorption process on heterogeneous surfaces and metal oxides-dominated surfaces. In contrast, desorption was slow and partial, exhibiting a significant hysteresis attributed to inner-sphere complexation at Fe and Al surfaces. A negative hysteresis with values greater than unity in 73% (GLY) and 27% (AMPA), but a crossover hysteresis pattern in log curves- in which the desorption isotherm exceeded the adsorption isotherm at low concentrations but converged at higher loadings- was observed for the same, indicating concentration -dependent irreversibility. Therefore, two novel indices-the Hysteresis Control (HCI) and the normalised Mobility Risk Index (MRIn,100) were introduced to integrate the hysteresis behaviour, desorption potential, and mineralogical buffering capacity into a unified risk framework. Alkaline, sandy-textured soils with low Fe and Al oxide content demonstrated very high risk (MRIn,100 = 100), while acidic, mineral-rich, high-clay tropical soils with less desorption effectively immobilise both compounds (MRIn100 <0.02) with less bioavailability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察斯里兰卡湿区 15 个茶园高度风化土壤中草甘膦及其主要代谢物 AMPA 的吸附–解吸滞后行为，以评估地点特异的迁移风险。批量平衡实验和 LC-MS/MS 分析表明，吸附符合准二级动力学和 Freundlich 等温模型，指向发生在非均质、富 Fe/Al 氧化物表面的混合化学吸附过程。解吸则缓慢且不完全，明显滞后主要归因于草甘膦和 AMPA 与 Fe、Al 表面的内层络合，说明其在热带矿物土壤中的残留与迁移行为具有较强不可逆性和空间差异。
authors: Dissanayake Arachchilage Thanuja Warnaka Kumari Dissanayake

articles.title: Ising Dirac fermions across a topological phase transition
articles.title_zh: 拓扑相变中的 Ising Dirac 费米子
articles.abstract: Dirac fermions have attracted significant interest due to their relativistic dispersions and close connections to topological physics, yet they are generally expected to be gapped in two-dimensional systems with strong Ising spin–orbit coupling, making their realization in such materials an outstanding challenge. Here we report the emergence of six-fold degenerate Dirac fermions in an Ising moiré system across a quantum spin Hall transition in twisted WSe₂. In a 3.65° device, we observe a quantum spin Hall phase at high electric fields with nearly quantized resistance h/(2e² ), and a Dirac semimetal phase over a broad range of electric fields near zero field. Magnetotransport measurements of the Dirac phase exhibit a half-integer Landau fan sequence, characteristic of Dirac fermions, with six-fold degeneracy on the hole-doped side and two-fold degeneracy on the electron-doped side. Temperature dependence shows weakly metallic behavior consistent with a semimetallic state. Our twist-angle-dependent transport measurements map out a complete phase diagram and identify a critical twist angle of θ ≈ 3.3°, establishing the phase boundary between the quantum spin Hall and Dirac semimetal regimes. Our work establishes a new route to realizing Dirac fermions in strongly spin–orbit-coupled moiré systems through a topological phase transition, providing a promising platform for high-mobility spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道在扭转 WSe2 的 Ising 莫尔体系中，跨越量子自旋霍尔相变时出现六重简并 Dirac 费米子。3.65° 器件在高电场下表现出接近 h/(2e²) 的量子自旋霍尔相电阻，而在近零电场的宽范围内呈现 Dirac 半金属相；磁输运显示半整数朗道扇形序列，空穴侧为六重简并、电子侧为二重简并。角度依赖输运进一步给出相图，并确定约 θ≈3.3° 的临界扭角，界定量子自旋霍尔相与 Dirac 半金属相的边界。

articles.title: Multipolar Meta surface Antennas for Enhanced Radiation Performance
articles.title_zh: 用于增强辐射性能的多极超表面天线
articles.abstract: In this paper, the design and investigation of a novel meta-surface antenna with SRRs featuring an asymmetric configuration, developed on a silicon substrate, is discussed. With the introduction of asymmetry in the form of a 2° tilt angle in the arms of the resonators, we can efficiently stimulate and combine the higher order magnetic and toroidal modes along with the fundamental electric dipole mode. Our proposed antenna, studied using the RF module in the COMSOL Multiphysics software, shows accurate control over the resonant frequency, which lies in the range of 0.375 to 0.575 THz with a maximum transmission value of 0.3899 at 0.471 THz. With thorough multipolar analysis, the scattering from the different dipoles, i.e., the electric, magnetic, and toroidal dipoles, is estimated, and we find that the radiation characteristics of the antenna are mainly due to electric dipole stimulation, along with the influence of toroidal dipoles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文设计并研究了一种基于硅衬底、含非对称开口谐振环的太赫兹超表面天线。通过在谐振器臂中引入2°倾角非对称性，器件可激发并耦合高阶磁偶极和环形偶极模式，同时保留基本电偶极模式。COMSOL射频模块仿真显示其谐振频率可在0.375至0.575 THz范围内调控，并在0.471 THz处获得最大透射值0.3899；多极分析表明辐射特性主要来自电偶极激发，同时受环形偶极影响。

articles.title: A Unified Numerical-to-Experimental Method for the Two-Dimensional Dirac Oscillator
articles.title_zh: 二维狄拉克振子的数值到实验统一方法
articles.abstract: We formulate a unified method for progressing from a classical numerical model to an exper- imentally testable quantum simulation of the 2 + 1 dimensional Dirac oscillator. The method is organized around a single platform-independent control Hamiltonian. Its coeficients are com- piled into either optical Raman sidebands or microwave-gradient sidebands, while the same calibrated coeficients are used in a numerical digital twin. The protocol contains six connected operations: analytic speci�cation, numerical verification, hardware calibration, control compila- tion, chiral and full two-mode experiments, and measurement-informed model updating. The reduced chiral Hamiltonian and the bulk of the Cartesian two-mode Hamiltonian reproduce √the analytic ladder En ± = ±mc2 1 + 4ξn to machine precision. Finite Lamb-Dicke effects are evaluated using measured-rate-normalized Laguerre-polynomial first-sideband matrix elements; the full Cartesian calculation retains both physical modes and their possible spectator leakage. The decisive two-dimensional test is a phase-reversal experiment that exchanges the active and spectator circular modes and reverses the measured circulation. A minimum-viable 171 Yb+ op- tical prototype is specified with two radial modes, counterpropagating 355-nm Raman beams and conservative 5-kHz sideband rates, together with explicit observables, control experiments, uncertainty requirements and acceptance criteria. The microwave-gradient route is retained as a Phase-II adapter to the same calibrated control Hamiltonian.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种从经典数值模型推进到可实验检验的2+1维狄拉克振子量子模拟的统一流程，核心是平台无关的控制哈密顿量。其系数可编译为光学拉曼边带或微波梯度边带，并同时用于数值数字孪生校准。方案涵盖解析设定、数值验证、硬件标定、控制编译、手征与完整双模实验以及由测量反馈更新模型；关键二维检验是通过相位反转交换主动与旁观圆偏振模式并反转测得的环流。

articles.title: Monolithic Integration of Piezo-Optomechanical Photonics and CMOS Electronics
articles.title_zh: 压电-光机械光子学与CMOS电子学的单片集成
articles.abstract: Next-generation photonic architectures for AI, sensing, and quantum computing require thousands to millions of reprogrammable photonic devices on a chip1. The monolithic integration of Electronically-backed Photonic Integrated Circuits (EPICs) allows for very high density electrical interconnection and electronic drivers that can scale with photonics. Piezo-optomechanical photonic integrated circuits (POMPICs) offer low power consumption, high speed modulation, cryogenic compatibility and broadband optical transparency from ultraviolet to infrared wavelengths2,3, but have not been demonstrated with monolithically integrated CMOS electronics. Here, we show a fully monolithic, all-CMOS fabricated platform for POMPICs co-fabricated with commercial control electronics. 200 millimeter photonic wafers are constructed directly on completed CMOS driver wafers by back-end-of-line processing, connecting integrated piezoelectric actuators under broadband silicon nitride waveguides to a high-density digital backplane comprising >2 million electrical connections per die with 6.4×6.4 micron electrode pitch. We introduce segmented POMPIC components as Photonic Digital-to-Analog converters (PDACs) that convert low-voltage digital electronic signals to multi-bit analog optical phase and amplitude modulation, and we demonstrate parallel control of optical phase shifters, Mach-Zehnder interferometers, optical routing trees, and tunable ring resonators using a standard HDMI interface to program CMOS electronics. We test multiple reticles and perform electronic and photonic characterization across the entire wafer to establish uniformity and yield, demonstrating wafer-scale integration of POMPICs on an electronic backplane and enabling dense, scalable electronic control of piezo-optomechanical circuits. This architecture provides a path to tightly integrated, high-channel-count control of quantum and classical piezo-optomechanical photonic integrated circuits, supporting applications in linear optical quantum computing, hybrid quantum systems with solid-state emitters, photonic neural networks, quantum networking, and display technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作展示了在商业CMOS控制电子学上单片共制备压电-光机械光子集成电路的平台，面向AI、传感和量子计算中大规模可重构片上光子器件。作者利用后道工艺在已完成的CMOS驱动晶圆上构建200毫米光子晶圆，将硅氮波导下方的压电执行器连接到高密度数字背板。文中还提出分段式POMPIC器件作为光子数模转换器，用于提升大规模电子-光子协同控制的集成密度与可扩展性。

articles.title: Recovering the Standard Model Gauge Group from Loop Quantum Gravity: A Unified Relative-Entropy, Flux-Gauge Network, and Geometric-Engineering Construction
articles.title_zh: 从圈量子引力恢复标准模型规范群：相对熵、通量-规范网络与几何工程的统一构造
articles.abstract: We give a single, self-contained construction in which the Standard Model gauge group SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1) arises alongside gravity from an enlarged connection built on the Ashtekar variables of loop quantum gravity (LQG). The paper unifies, into one logical development, three previously separate lines of work: (I) a relative-entropy renormalization-group (RG) toolkit, built from the data-processing inequality, that is unconditionally monotone under lattice and spin-network coarse-graining; (II) a flux-gauge network model in which a confining gauge connection is the sole microscopic substrate, geometry and the graviton are coarse-grained derived quantities, and SU(N) matter content is generated at ADE-orbifold degenerations of an internal fiber; and (III) an explicit application of both toolkits to the Ashtekar connection, in which the matter sector is fixed to su(5) by a rank-4 A4 singularity and broken to the Standard Model by the network’s own adjoint vertex-Higgs mechanism. Every group-theoretic step of part (III) is proved as a theorem with complete proof and verified constants: a conservativity theorem showing the enlargement leaves the LQG kinematical Hilbert space an exact tensor product with the unchanged geometric sector; the Borel–de Siebenthal classification identifying su(3) ? su(2) ? u(1) as the unique maximal-rank subalgebra of su(5) with the Standard Model rank profile; the exact adjoint branching with hypercharges from root data and the resulting sin2 ?W = 3/8 matching relation; the Li vacuum-alignment theorem fixing the open region of quartic couplings for which the network’s vertex scalar breaks SU(5) to the Standard Model rather than to SU(4)×U(1); the resulting X/Y boson mass; and the global form of the unbroken group, S(U(3)×U(2)) ~= (SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1))/Z6, from which Standard Model hypercharge and electric-charge quantization follow as corollaries rather than inputs. We report the numerical tests carried out for parts (I)–(II) — exact confirmation of the relative-entropy monotonicity under block-summing coarse-graining, an independently measured percolation threshold consistent with the known three-dimensional value, and a suggestive (not conclusive) correlation between the growth of the half-dissipation scale and the percolation crossover — and we state precisely, in a unified status ledger, what the whole construction proves, what it imports from established results elsewhere in the literature, and what remains open: the dynamical selection of the singularity rank and the sign of the alignment coupling, and, entirely outside this paper’s scope, fermion content, chirality, generation number, Yukawa structure, and unification phenomenology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一个自洽构造，试图从基于Ashtekar变量的扩展联络中同时得到引力与标准模型规范群SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1)。文章统一了三条思路：基于数据处理不等式的相对熵重整化群工具、以禁闭规范联络为微观基底的通量-规范网络模型，以及将这些工具应用于圈量子引力Ashtekar联络的具体方案。作者声称通过A4奇点将物质扇区固定为su(5)，再由网络内禀的伴随顶点-Higgs机制破缺到标准模型，并给出相应群论步骤的定理化证明。

articles.title: Kinetic magnetism and stripe order in the antiferromagnetic bosonic t−J model
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁玻色t−J模型中的动能磁性与条纹序
articles.abstract: Author(s): Timothy J. Harris, Ulrich Schollwöck, Annabelle Bohrdt, and Fabian Grusdt How can particle statistics influence the competition between charge motion and magnetic order in doped antiferromagnets? Here, the authors use large-scale numerical calculations to establish the T = 0 phase diagram of the 2D antiferromagnetic bosonic t - J model. They show that mobile bosonic holes stabilize partially filled stripes at low doping, akin to those in high- T c cuprate superconductors, and drive transitions to polarized ferromagnetic phases via Nagaoka polaron formation. These predictions provide clear targets for future experiments in ultracold-atom quantum simulators. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L051105] Published Wed Jul 15, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究用大规模数值计算建立二维反铁磁玻色t−J模型在零温下的相图，考察粒子统计如何影响掺杂反铁磁体中电荷运动与磁序的竞争。结果表明，可动玻色空穴在低掺杂下可稳定部分填充的条纹态，类似高温铜氧化物中的条纹结构。随着掺杂或参数变化，Nagaoka极化子形成可驱动体系向极化铁磁相转变，为超冷原子量子模拟实验提供了明确检验目标。
authors: Timothy J. Harris, Ulrich Schollwöck, Annabelle Bohrdt, and Fabian Grusdt

Most of the studies on electrical transport so far have focused on the cases where the magnetic moments are well approximated by class… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 036301] Published Wed Jul 15, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注手性磁态中的非互易电输运响应，并将问题推进到局域磁矩不能简单视为经典自旋的量子情形。作者研究近藤效应如何影响非线性电流、磁手性二色性等由手性磁结构引发的输运现象。摘要未给出具体模型和定量结果，但主题指向强关联量子杂质物理与非互易输运之间的联系。

Mehraeen, and Robert-Jan Slager Nonlinear odd viscoelastic effects arise from higher-order quantum geometric tensors in magnetic three-dimensional topological phases in response to distortion fields. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 036302] Published Wed Jul 15, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出非线性奇黏弹性效应，指出其来源于磁性三维拓扑相在畸变场响应中的高阶量子几何张量。奇黏弹性通常与时间反演对称性破缺和无耗散横向力学响应相关；本文将其推广到非线性响应层级。该结果为通过应变或声学探针表征拓扑量子几何提供了新的理论方向。

articles.title: Regression to the mean can explain saturation of geomagnetic storms
articles.title_zh: 向均值回归可解释地磁暴饱和现象
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 15 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10757-4 The saturation of geomagnetic activity with solar wind strength can be explained by a regression to the mean effect, suggesting that the impact of extreme geomagnetic storms can be twice as large as previously thought
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，地磁活动随太阳风强度增强而出现的饱和现象可由统计上的向均值回归效应解释。若这一解释成立，既有方法可能低估了极端地磁暴的实际影响。文章进一步提示，极端事件造成的地磁扰动可能达到此前估计的约两倍，因而对空间天气风险评估具有重要意义。

articles.title_zh: 70Zn中低能增强的磁性特征
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 15 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10758-3 The low-energy enhancement in the γ-ray strength function of 70Zn is due to magnetic dipole transitions between nuclear states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究70Zn原子核γ射线强度函数中的低能增强现象，并指出其来源于核能级之间的磁偶极跃迁。该结论有助于澄清低能γ强度增强的微观性质，对核结构和核反应率建模具有意义。摘要未提供实验细节，具体测量方法和谱学分析需查阅原文。

articles.title: Blue LEDs made from perovskite material shine bright thanks to hydrogen bonds
articles.title_zh: 氢键助力钙钛矿蓝光LED实现高亮发光
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 15 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02161-9 Blue light-emitting diodes (LEDs) are needed for high-definition displays with wide colour range. Efficient, stable and colour-saturated blue LEDs containing emitters made of perovskites have now been fabricated by adding isomeric molecules that generate a network of hydrogen bonds, stabilizing the octahedral structure of the perovskite crystal.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了利用钙钛矿发光体制备高效、稳定且色纯度高的蓝光LED的进展。研究通过加入可形成氢键网络的异构分子，稳定钙钛矿晶体中的八面体结构，从而改善蓝光发射性能。该方向对宽色域高清显示所需的蓝光器件具有潜在应用价值。

articles.title: Faster quantum computers can learn from their own mistakes

articles.abstract: Quantum computers promise to solve problems that would take even the fastest conventional supercomputers a vast amount of time, but the quantum information they store and process is extremely sensitive to even tiny disturbances from their surroundings. To keep these systems operating reliably, they need to be constantly recalibrated—interrupting their calculations in the process.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻围绕量子计算机的自校准与误差抑制展开，指出量子信息对环境扰动极其敏感，现有系统常需中断计算以重新校准。文章介绍的方向旨在让量子处理器在运行中利用自身错误信息进行学习和调整，从而减少停机校准并提升计算效率；具体方法和性能需查阅原文。

articles.title: Cyclome930: Large-scale replica-exchange dynamics of 930 cyclic peptide reveal thermal stability and critical metal-binding likelihood
articles.title_zh: Cyclome930：930 种环肽的大规模副本交换动力学揭示热稳定性与潜在金属结合可能性
articles.abstract: Cyclic peptides provide low entropy, thermostable scaffolds resistant to proteolytic degradation. Till date, systematic analysis and prediction of residue-level reorganization to distribute thermal stress is limited by fragmented data resources, and the lack of cyclicity-aware predictive frameworks. Here, we present Cyclome930, the largest curated and consistently featurized resource of cyclic peptides to date, integrating 930 experimentally annotated cyclic peptides from four independent repositories with associated topology, sequence, structural coordinates, and organismal metadata, thereby expanding annotated cyclic peptide coverage by approximately 3.4-fold. We provide a novel cyclic sequence alignment algorithm that explicitly accounts for rotational symmetry and knot topology, enabling more accurate scoring of sequence similarity than conventional linear alignments. To characterize peptide thermo-stability, we performed an exhaustive all-atom replica-exchange molecular dynamics simulations (100 ns REMD; 298–400 K) for all 930 cyclic peptides. REMD trajectories reveal temperature-dependent conformational transitions and thermal-stress tensor evolution. These physics-derived descriptors inform a machine learning model to predict cyclic peptide melting points from sequence and topology. We leverage this knowledgebase to build CritiCL, a multi-classifier model to predict critical mineral metal-binding likelihood across Cyclome930. All data/ tools are available open-source (cyclome930.structf.studio) serving as a foundational resource and cloud-workbench for computational design of use-inspired cyclic peptide libraries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本构建了 Cyclome930 数据资源，整合 930 种实验注释环肽的拓扑、序列、结构坐标和来源信息，并显著扩展了已有注释覆盖。作者提出考虑旋转对称性和结拓扑的环状序列比对算法，并对全部环肽进行全原子副本交换分子动力学模拟，以分析温度依赖构象转变和热应力重分布。该数据集和物理模拟特征旨在支持环肽热稳定性与残基级重组规律的系统预测，并探索关键金属结合可能性。

articles.title: Multiband 3D Texture-based Change Detection for Monitoring Cultural Heritage
articles.title_zh: 用于文化遗产监测的多波段三维纹理变化检测
articles.abstract: This study presents a semi-automated workflow for detecting conservation changes in Cultural Heritage using multi-temporal, multiband photogrammetry. All datasets acquired at different epochs and with different non-invasive techniques (Visible Light, Ultraviolet Reflectance/Luminescence, Near Infrared Reflectography) are co-registered within a shared 3D photogrammetric model and projected onto a common mesh/uv space, enabling intrinsically aligned texture comparisons. Change detection is performed using a combination of PCA, K-means clustering, and pixel-wise spectral analysis, enabling automated segmentation and quantification of material alterations over time once the conservator has validated the clusters. The method is validated on controlled degradation mock-ups and compared against expert conservators’ condition reports. Results show high classification accuracy and demonstrate the potential of the approach as a robust, scalable tool for conservation monitoring. The workflow bridges a key gap between high-resolution 2D digital documentation and long-term heritage diagnostics by enabling change detection directly on complex 3D surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种半自动流程，利用多时相、多波段摄影测量检测文化遗产保护状态变化。不同时间和不同无损成像技术获取的可见光、紫外反射/发光、近红外反射数据被共配准到同一三维摄影测量模型及网格/UV空间中，从而实现天然对齐的纹理比较。变化检测结合PCA、K-means聚类和逐像素光谱分析，在修复人员验证聚类后可自动分割并量化材料随时间的变化；在受控退化样品上的验证显示其与专家病害报告具有较高一致性。

articles.title: Sensitive measurements uncover dual superconducting states in atom-thin NbSe₂ and TaS₂
articles.title_zh: 高灵敏测量揭示原子级薄NbSe₂和TaS₂中的双重超导态
articles.abstract: A new study reveals that two widely studied ultrathin superconducting materials are more sophisticated than they appear. Although they seem to behave like simple superconductors with a single energy gap, they actually contain two strongly interacting superconducting states that work together and disguise themselves as one. This finding resolves a long-standing mystery about how these materials behave, providing new insight into superconductivity that could help scientists design better superconducting materials for future technologies such as quantum computers, ultra-efficient electronics and advanced sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了一项关于超薄NbSe₂和TaS₂超导性的研究，指出这些材料虽表观上类似单能隙简单超导体，实际包含两个强相互作用的超导态。该发现有助于解释长期存在的异常行为，并为理解低维超导和设计面向量子计算、高效电子学及传感应用的超导材料提供线索。

articles.title: Analytical solution of the Eliashberg equations for strong-coupling superconductivity in hydrides
articles.title_zh: 氢化物强耦合超导Eliashberg方程的解析解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12213v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent discovery of room-temperature superconductivity in hydrogen-rich materials under extreme pressures has renewed interest in phonon-mediated pairing mechanisms described by the Eliashberg theory, which generalizes the BCS framework by incorporating phonon retardation effects. In this article, we present an analytical solution to the isotropic Eliashberg equations for the superconducting critical temperature, formulated within the Debye model. This solution exhibits good agreement with fully selfconsistent numerical calculations across both weak- and strong-coupling regimes, correctly reproducing the exponential and square-root dependences on the electron-phonon coupling parameter. We further apply the solution to YH6, benchmarking against experiment and the McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula. More broadly, across a diverse set of hydride superconductors, the predicted critical temperature shows scaling consistency with ab initio calculations and experimental data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文在Debye模型下给出各向同性Eliashberg方程中超导临界温度的解析解，用于描述氢富材料中的强电子-声子耦合超导。该解在弱耦合和强耦合区间均与自洽数值计算符合良好，并正确再现临界温度对电子-声子耦合常数的指数型和平方根型依赖。作者进一步将其应用于YH₆，并与实验、McMillan-Allen-Dynes公式以及多种氢化物的从头算和实验数据进行标度比较。

articles.title: Engineering Two-Dimensional Hybrid-Order Topological Insulators via Trilayer Coupling
articles.title_zh: 通过三层耦合工程实现二维混合阶拓扑绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose an interlayer-engineering scheme to realize a two-dimensional hybrid-order topological insulator, characterized by the coexistence of first-order and second-order topological phases, in a coupled trilayer Chern system. Starting from three quantum anomalous Hall layers with Chern numbers C₁/₂/₃=+1/-1/+1 in the decoupled limit, interlayer tunneling hybridizes their edge states into a single chiral edge mode, while simultaneously opening a gap that supports corner states. Consequently, the system exhibits the coexistence of one-dimensional chiral edge states and zero-dimensional corner states within the same bulk gap, a hallmark of the hybrid-order topology. Furthermore, we map out the topological phase diagram, and show that the hybrid-order phase is robust against mass-type disorder. Our results identify interlayer hybridization as a minimal and broadly applicable strategy for engineering coexisting edge and corner states within a topological platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出利用层间耦合在三层陈绝缘体体系中实现二维混合阶拓扑绝缘体。三个量子反常霍尔层在解耦极限下陈数为+1/-1/+1，层间隧穿使边缘态杂化为单一手性边缘模，同时打开支持角态的能隙。由此体系在同一体能隙中同时具有一维手性边缘态和零维角态，并且该混合阶拓扑相对质量型无序具有稳健性。
authors: Lizhou Liu, Cheng-Ming Miao, Qing-Feng Sun

articles.title: From stable periodic orbits to many-body chaos: doubly tunable prethermalization via engineering of an emergent band structure
articles.title_zh: 从稳定周期轨道到多体混沌：通过涌现能带结构工程实现双重可调预热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12355v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We uncover a family of many-body periodic orbits in a periodically driven (Floquet) spin system away from the high-frequency limit. While linear stability analysis predicts that perturbed many-body trajectories remain close to stable periodic orbits, thermodynamic principles dictate that Floquet heating will ultimately set in. Our work aims to resolve the tension between these two expectations. In particular, we show that perturbations away from the stable periodic orbits feature a description akin to a quasiparticle band structure. A long-lived prethermal regime appears when modes around the gapless point are slowly populated. The dispersion determines the prethermal lifetime, and we show how band engineering leads to a "doubly tunable" parametric dependence of the prethermal lifetime R⁻W, with R the width in momentum space of the quasiparticle distribution and W the exponent of the dispersion around the gapless point. Our results not only establish a powerful route toward stabilizing non-equilibrium phases of matter in driven many-body systems but also establish a conceptual bridge between periodic orbits in 'low-dimensional' nonlinear systems and many-body chaos.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在非高频极限的周期驱动Floquet自旋系统中发现一族多体周期轨道，并探讨其线性稳定性与最终Floquet加热之间的张力。作者指出，偏离稳定周期轨道的扰动可用类似准粒子能带结构描述，当无能隙点附近模缓慢占据时会形成长寿命预热化区域。预热寿命由色散关系控制，并可通过能带工程实现对动量分布宽度和无能隙点附近色散指数的双参数调控。
authors: Jianan Wang, Yang Hou, Andrea Pizzi, Johannes Knolle, Roderich Moessner, Hongzheng Zhao

articles.title: Measurement-induced phase transition in space
articles.title_zh: 空间中的测量诱导相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Measurement-induced phase transitions (MIPTs) in monitored quantum circuits are usually characterized by preparing steady states at different uniform measurement probabilities. Here we introduce a spatial realization of the MIPT by imposing a deterministic measurement gradient in a single monitored Clifford chain. The resulting steady state contains coexisting volume-law, critical, and area-law regions, with the point p(x)=p_c acting as a spatial critical cut. By scanning entanglement observables across this profile, we show that the transition is organized by a spatial scaling form. Although this structure is analogous to finite-time scaling in temporally driven MIPT, the spatial protocol has no Kibble-Zurek dynamics. Instead, the physical bounds 0łe płe 1 impose a finite linear window, producing cutoff-controlled asymptotic regimes whose fitted exponents provide direct access to the correlation-length exponent ν. Our results establish spatially inhomogeneous measurements as a controlled route to engineer and probe measurement-induced criticality within a single steady state.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种测量诱导相变的空间实现方式：在单个受监测Clifford链中施加确定性的测量概率梯度。所得稳态同时包含体积律、临界和面积律纠缠区域，其中满足p(x)=p_c的位置构成空间临界切口。通过扫描纠缠观测量，作者建立空间标度形式，并指出该协议不同于时间驱动情形中的Kibble-Zurek动力学，可在单一稳态中探测测量诱导临界性及相关长度指数。
authors: Jia-Qiang Li, Liang-Jun Zhai, Shuo Liu, Shuai Yin

articles.title: Quantized Photocurrents in Gapless Topological Matter
articles.title_zh: 无能隙拓扑物质中的量子化光电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum Hall effect in gapped systems represents a defining signature of nontrivial topology. Realizing this principle in gapless matter has remained a central challenge in quantum materials. Chiral topological semimetals provide a unique platform to achieve this aim via symmetry-protected multifold crossings that act as Berry-curvature monopoles. When optical transitions are confined to a single multifold node, the resulting circular photogalvanic effect is predicted to be quantized in terms of the topological charge of the node. In real materials, however, this phenomenon remains experimentally elusive, obscured by trivial band transitions, the energy separation between the node pairs, and their relative positions with respect to the Fermi level. Here we observe a quantized circular photogalvanic effect in the chiral topological semimetal Rh0.95Ni0.05Si. Ni substitution opens a photon-energy window dominated by interband optical transitions at the Γ-point multifold node. This allows circularly polarized near- to mid-infrared pulses to drive a helicity-odd terahertz response that manifests three hallmarks of quantization: a sharp onset, a wavelength-independent plateau governed by the magnitude of monopole charge, and an abrupt cutoff imposed by Pauli blocking. Our work establishes an all-optical analogue for the quantum Hall effect and a new paradigm for topological quantization in gapless matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究手性拓扑半金属中由多重简并点拓扑荷决定的圆偏振光电流量子化。作者在Rh₀.₉₅Ni₀.₀₅Si中通过Ni替代引入适合的光子能量窗口，使Γ点多重节点的带间跃迁占主导，从而观测到圆偏振近/中红外脉冲驱动的螺旋度奇异太赫兹响应。摘要显示该响应呈现量子化的关键特征，旨在把类似量子霍尔效应的拓扑响应推广到无能隙体系。
authors: Byunghoon Kim, Tenzin Norden, Mohammad Yahyavi, Kaustuv Manna, Tyler A. Cochran, Zi-Jia Cheng, Xian P. Yang, Yu-Xiao Jiang, Xiangyu Luo, Payman Kazemikhah, Areeq Hasan, Vladimir N. Strocov, Sergey Shilov, Ilya Belopolski, Claudia Felser, Md Shafayat Hossain, Rohit P. Prasankumar, Guoqing Chang, M. Zahid Hasan, Prashant Padmanabhan

articles.title: Solitary waves of attracting SU(N) fermions
articles.title_zh: 吸引相互作用SU(N)费米子的孤立波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the formation, dynamics, and disorder robustness of bound states in attractively interacting SU(N) fermions on a one-dimensional ring lattice. Using exact diagonalization in fixed-momentum sectors and Bethe ansatz exact results as a guide, we resolve the many-body spectrum into bands related to the possible partitions of the particles into bound composites, and characterize their internal structure also through density-density and N-body correlations. A pinning quench protocol reveals a transition from dispersive spreading to dynamical localization as the attractive interaction increases relative to the single-particle hopping. We find that the bound state dynamics for one-particle per component occurs as a many-body quantum walk similar to that of a single particle with a re-normalized effective mass. Such a property, that is the quantum version of the shape-preserving motion of classical solitons, can provide the dynamical signature of the fermionic solitary waves. We probe the robustness of the fermionic bound-state dynamics under on-site disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察一维环形晶格上具有吸引相互作用的SU(N)费米子中束缚态的形成、动力学及其对无序的稳健性。作者结合固定动量扇区精确对角化和Bethe ansatz结果，将多体谱解析为与不同束缚复合体分割对应的能带，并通过密度-密度及N体关联表征其内部结构。钉扎淬火协议显示，随吸引作用相对跃迁增强，体系由弥散扩展转向动力学局域；每组分一个粒子的束缚态表现为具有重整化有效质量的多体量子行走，可作为费米孤立波的动力学标志。
authors: Aysha Alsubaihi, Wayne J. Chetcuti, Frederic Chevy, Juan Polo, Luigi Amico

articles.title: Many-body interactions in the dielectric theory of stopping power of solids for classical and quantum projectiles
articles.title_zh: 经典与量子入射粒子在固体阻止本领介电理论中的多体相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We take account of the many-body dynamic interactions by including the wave-vector and frequency-dependent exchange and correlations (xc) kernel fₓc(qv,ømega) in the framework of the dielectric theory of the stopping power of crystals for moving charges. The cases of classical and quantum projectiles are considered. We find that (I) the role of the xc effects in slowing of charges in crystalline solids is more pronounced than it is within the jellium model and (II) For velocities below the stopping maximum, inclusion of xc leads to the improvement of the comparison of the theory with experiment over a range of solid targets. On the other hand, in the high-velocity regime, the role of the dynamic xc proves negligible, which does not contradict experiment, and which we substantiate analytically within the jellium model of the target. The input to our theory is the microscopic dielectric matrix ϵGᵥ Gᵥ'(qv,ømega) within the random phase approximation (i.e., with neglect of fₓc), the calculation of which matrix is implemented in the existing solid-state codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者在晶体中运动电荷阻止本领的介电理论框架内，引入依赖波矢和频率的交换-关联核，以刻画多体动力学相互作用，并同时讨论经典与量子入射粒子。结果表明，晶体中交换-关联效应对电荷减速的影响比均匀电子气模型更显著；在低于阻止峰的速度区间，纳入该效应可改善多种固体靶材上的理论—实验符合。高速度区间动态交换-关联贡献很小，作者还在均匀电子气模型中给出解析论证；该方法以随机相近似下的微观介电矩阵作为输入，便于与现有固体计算程序衔接。
authors: Vladimir U. Nazarov, Vyacheslav M. Silkin

articles.title: Geometric Spin-Orbit Coupling Resolves the Contradictory CISS Effect in Chiral Single Molecules
articles.title_zh: 几何自旋轨道耦合解释手性单分子中相互矛盾的CISS效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Some studies have reported clear chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect in four classes of chiral single molecules with remarkable spin polarization. In contrast, a recent high-precision measurement involving nearly a thousand individual tests failed to detect significant CISS signals in the same molecular systems (J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2025, 147, 25043). These conflicting results cast doubt on whether CISS truly occurs in these chiral systems at the single-molecular level. To resolve this discrepancy, we develop a theoretical framework incorporating geometric spin-orbit coupling and environmental decoherence, enabling systematic study of the CISS in four chiral single molecules with distinct geometries and sizes. Our calculations show that the CISS effect is completely suppressed in both strong-coherence and strong-decoherence regimes, but becomes pronounced in the intermediate-decoherence regime, where observable spin polarization emerges. In the strong-coherence regime, both electron-electron interaction and electron-vibration coupling enhance the CISS effect: the former is more effective in large molecules, whereas the latter plays a more significant role in smaller ones. Increasing temperature further enhances spin polarization. The proposed mechanism unifies contradictory experimental observations and reveals how the CISS effect evolves from regular helical (helical symmetric) to irregular helical (point-symmetric or axially symmetric) chirality. This framework thus provides a basis for unifying CISS phenomena across single-molecule systems, regardless of their specific molecular configurations or symmetry classes.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对同类手性单分子体系中CISS效应实验结论相互矛盾的问题，作者建立了包含几何自旋轨道耦合与环境退相干的理论框架，系统研究四类不同几何和尺寸的手性单分子。计算显示，强相干和强退相干极限都会完全抑制CISS，而在中等退相干区间可出现显著自旋极化。强相干区间中，电子-电子相互作用和电子-振动耦合均可增强CISS，其中前者在大分子中更有效。
authors: Shu-Zheng Zhou, Xi Sun, Kai-Yuan Zhang, Hua-Hua Fu

articles.title: Emergence of drifted diffusion in quantum walks with subspace restart
articles.title_zh: 带子空间重启的量子行走中漂移扩散的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Restart of a quantum process is typically modeled as a global reinitialization that erases the system's entire history. Here we introduce subspace restart, a protocol that periodically resets only the internal degrees of freedom while preserving the spatial distribution, as a tunable knob for the quantum-to-classical crossover. Using the discrete-time quantum walk as an example, we show that this selective reset drives the walker into an engineered drifted-diffusion regime. This phenomenon can be understood by a Huygens-Fresnel mechanism, where each restart fragments the wave function into a set of independent secondary sources to screen long-range correlations and isolate a robust classical backbone, whose drift and diffusivity are set by the geometric orientation of the initial coin and the restart period. Residual quantum interference, confined to effective light cones, survives only as a short-range correction that renormalizes these coefficients and imprints periodic modulations on the cumulants. Our results establish subspace restart as a route to controlling the quantum-to-classical crossover in synthetic lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出“子空间重启”协议：周期性重置内部自由度而保留空间分布，并以离散时间量子行走展示其可作为调控量子—经典交叉的旋钮。该选择性重置可将行走者驱动到可设计的漂移扩散区间，其漂移和扩散率由初始币态几何取向与重启周期决定。作者用惠更斯—菲涅耳式机制解释该现象：重启把波函数分裂为独立次级源，从而屏蔽长程关联并保留稳健的经典骨架；残余量子干涉仅作为短程修正存在。
authors: Liwei Qiao, Ruoyu Yin, Wei Zhang

articles.title: Emergent s+id Superconductivity from the Interplay between Electronic Correlations and Electron-Phonon Coupling in R₁₋ₓSrₓNiO₂
articles.title_zh: R₁₋ₓSrₓNiO₂中电子关联与电声耦合相互作用诱导的s+id超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent tunneling measurements on infinite-layer nickelates have revealed spatially varying superconducting symmetries, whose microscopic origin remains unclear. Motivated by this observation, we investigate the interplay between electron correlations and electron-phonon interactions in infinite-layer nickelates by combining first-principles calculations with the fluctuation-exchange-Migdal-Eliashberg theory. Our calculations show that spin fluctuations yield robust d-wave superconductivity on the Ni dₓ^₂₋y^₂ orbital, whereas electron-phonon coupling induces s-wave pairing on an interstitial orbital, leading to an s+id superconducting state. The emergence of the s-wave component is strongly carrier-density dependent: an intermediate electron-phonon coupling of łambda=0.4 stabilizes the s+id state at n=0.9 but not at n=0.8. These results imply that local oxygen defects tune the local electron density and form finite-size domains with distinct pairing symmetries, offering a compelling explanation for the spatially inhomogeneous superconducting symmetries observed in experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 受无限层镍酸盐隧穿实验中空间变化超导对称性的启发，作者结合第一性原理计算与涨落交换-Migdal-Eliashberg理论，研究电子关联和电声相互作用的协同效应。结果表明，自旋涨落在Ni dₓ²₋y²轨道上产生稳健d波配对，而电声耦合在间隙轨道上诱导s波配对，两者共同形成s+id超导态。s波分量强烈依赖载流子密度：中等电声耦合λ=0.4可在n=0.9稳定s+id态，但在n=0.8不能；这提示局域氧缺陷可通过调节局域电子密度形成不同配对对称性的有限尺寸畴。
authors: Zi Yuan, Jun Zhan, Xianxin Wu, Shaozhi Li

articles.title: Self-Healing Coordination in Cognitive Swarm Agents with Bloch-Type Perceptual Memory
articles.title_zh: 具有Bloch型感知记忆的认知群体智能体中的自修复协同
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11960v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reactive flocking models usually map current local observations directly to motion, leaving limited room for internal perceptual state to shape recovery after disruption. Building on a non-Markovian collective-motion model based on self-regulated perceptual dynamics, we ask whether the Bloch-type slow-fast architecture can support self-healing coordination in cognitive swarm agents. Each agent carries a bounded Bloch-type perceptual register coupled to a slow regulatory state. The slow state is not treated as a standalone memory store; here, perceptual memory is used operationally to denote history-dependent cue resolution within the closed slow-fast loop. The Bloch update is a positivity-preserving effective dynamics for internal perceptual alternatives, not a microscopic quantum claim. We evaluate the architecture in a non-periodic, obstacle-rich drone migration task with finite speed, bounded turning, collision avoidance, altitude regulation, and a fixed migratory drive. Multi-seed ablations compare the full slow-fast architecture with memoryless and partial-feedback baselines using recovery time, largest-cluster restoration, polar order, local coherence, collision risk, and path efficiency. Results show that the main functional impact is on self-healing: after obstacle-induced fragmentation, the closed slow-fast loop accelerates restoration of spatial connectedness, whereas an uncoupled slow trace behaves like a memoryless controller.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究具有Bloch型慢—快感知架构的认知群体智能体是否能在扰动后实现自修复协同，而非仅将当前局域观测直接映射为运动。每个智能体携带有界Bloch型感知寄存器并耦合慢调节态，其中“感知记忆”指闭合慢—快回路中的历史依赖线索分辨，而非微观量子过程。作者在非周期、障碍丰富的无人机迁移任务中进行多随机种子消融比较，评估完全慢—快架构相对于无记忆和部分反馈基线在恢复时间、最大团簇重建等指标上的表现。

articles.title: Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking from Wormholes in Holography
articles.title_zh: 全息中由虫洞导致的强到弱自发对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12022v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) at finite temperature and its implications in holography. SWSSB is a novel critical phenomenon that arises only in mixed states. We demonstrate SWSSB with the BTZ black hole and show that, in the bulk, it is realized through wormhole geometries connecting the two copies in the thermofield-double construction. We point out that SWSSB can be recast as an emergence of global symmetries under ensemble averaging. We further examine the interplay between SWSSB and the swampland program, and propose a new swampland conjecture for quantum-gravity theories involving ensemble averages.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究有限温下强到弱自发对称性破缺及其在全息中的含义，这是一种只在混态中出现的新型临界现象。论文以BTZ黑洞展示该机制，指出在体相中它由热场双态构造中连接两份体系的虫洞几何实现。作者还将该现象重述为系综平均下全局对称性的涌现，并讨论其与沼泽地计划的关系，提出涉及系综平均量子引力理论的新沼泽地猜想。
authors: Taishi Kawamoto, Kenya Tasuki, Masahito Yamazaki

articles.title: Peak-Decomposition-Free Inverse Metrology of Hyperspectral Moiré Photoluminescence
articles.title_zh: 无需峰分解的超光谱莫尔光致发光逆向计量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12325v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hyperspectral photoluminescence (PL) of moiré transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers encodes spatially varying exciton landscapes, but extracting that information is hampered by the ambiguity of multi-peak spectral decomposition. Here we develop a peak-decomposition-free inverse framework for quantitative optical metrology of effective disorder coordinates. From the raw cube I(x,y,E) we construct physically motivated descriptor maps -- centroid energy, dominant emission energy, spectral width, low/high spectral-weight ratio, and dominant--centroid offset. Their spatial autocorrelation hierarchy and covariance structure form a robust descriptor fingerprint of multi-scale disorder-sensitive spectral statistics. By matching these descriptor summary statistics to a minimal smooth-plus-trap generative model through a grid-Bayesian inverse, we infer effective disorder coordinates Θeff=Ws,ξs,Wt,nt with explicit uncertainties. Using synthetic PL cubes generated from controlled multi-scale landscapes, we recover the well-identified smooth-disorder coordinates and constrain the trap sector up to a strength--density degeneracy. We report this degeneracy explicitly as an intrinsic identifiability limit rather than a deficiency of the method, and map four canonical disorder regimes onto a disorder-coordinate diagram. The descriptor statistics are stable against shot noise and pixel pitch, and behave predictably under optical-resolution and energy-window changes. The same pipeline ingests experimental cubes without modification, making it directly applicable to two-dimensional and moiré materials. Our results establish descriptor-based hyperspectral PL as a practical, minimal-assumption route to optical disorder diagnostics and provide the validated core of a reusable analysis workflow (textttHyperPL-Diag) for moiré exciton systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对莫尔过渡金属二硫属化物异质双层超光谱光致发光中多峰谱分解存在歧义的问题，作者提出一种无需峰分解的逆向框架，用于定量提取有效无序坐标。该方法从原始光谱立方体构造质心能量、主发射能量、谱宽、低/高能谱权重比和主峰—质心偏移等物理描述符，并利用其空间自相关层级和协方差结构形成无序敏感指纹。通过与最小“平滑无序+陷阱”生成模型进行网格贝叶斯匹配，作者可推断有效无序参数及不确定度；合成数据测试显示平滑无序参数可较好恢复，而陷阱部分存在强度—密度简并。

articles.title: Entropy Transport in Programmable Quantum Junctions
articles.title_zh: 可编程量子结中的熵输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12581v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that driven qubit junctions enable programmable control of physical entropy transport, with entropy conductance governed by quantum dynamics rather than by reservoir parameters alone. By comparing two simple quantum architectures -- a driven single-qubit junction and a driven two-qubit junction -- we find that the two-qubit junction enhances entropy transfer while requiring substantially lower driving power than its single-qubit counterpart. We further reveal two non-intuitive effects in both junctions: a sizable coherent contribution to the entropy current that emerges only under resonant driving, and negative differential entropy conductance, where increasing the thermal bias suppresses entropy flow into the probe reservoir. These results identify quantum logic architectures as programmable devices for entropy transport and suggest routes toward quantum feedback control, reservoir protection and refrigeration in driven quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者表明，受驱动量子比特结可实现对物理熵输运的可编程控制，其熵导由量子动力学而不只由热库参数决定。通过比较受驱动单量子比特结和双量子比特结，研究发现双量子比特结构可增强熵转移，同时所需驱动功率显著更低。两类结中还出现两个反直觉效应：仅在共振驱动下出现的显著相干熵流贡献，以及热偏压增大反而抑制流入探针热库熵流的负微分熵导。
authors: Radhika Joshi, Yuli V. Nazarov, Mohammad H. Ansari

articles.title: Thermally Activated Long-Range Entanglement from Non-Abelian Conservation Laws
articles.title_zh: 由非阿贝尔守恒律热激活的长程纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12710v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Thermal noise ordinarily suppresses quantum entanglement. We show that a strong non-Abelian conservation law can convert local thermal fluctuations into an unbounded operational resource. For a broad class of finite-range SU(2)-invariant spin chains restricted to the global-singlet sector, an explicit representation-space protocol yields Y_N=frac12łog₂ N+O_β(1), and hence ED≥ Y_N, throughout a finite high-temperature interval. Local thermal fluctuations produce subsystem spins jsimsqrt N, whose globally locked irreducible representations contain łog₂₍₂ⱼ₊₁₎simfrac12łog₂N ebits. An exactly solvable dimer chain exhibits a sharper effect: its zero-temperature state is unentangled across the cut, whereas every fixed T>0 produces ED=frac12łog₂ N+C(T)+o(1), with crossover scale T_*(N)simΔ/łn N. Exact diagonalization of a nonintegrable chain is consistent with the predicted scaling. Thus heating can activate system-size-diverging distillable entanglement across a macroscopic bipartition when thermalization is confined by a non-Abelian conservation law.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者指出，强非阿贝尔守恒律可将局域热涨落转化为无界的操作性纠缠资源，从而反转通常热噪声抑制纠缠的图像。对限制在全局单态扇区的一大类有限程SU(2)不变自旋链，显式表示空间协议给出随系统尺寸对数增长的可蒸馏纠缠下界。精确可解的二聚体链显示更鲜明效应：零温态在切割处无纠缠，而任意固定非零温度均产生随系统尺寸发散的可蒸馏纠缠；非可积链的精确对角化结果也与该标度一致。

articles.title: The Infraparticle Edge
articles.title_zh: 红外粒子谱边
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13001v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: I derive the charged-particle spectral edge from the quantum instrument of soft QED. I use two projections of that instrument. Tracing over unresolved photons gives the reduced hard-sector channel. Pushing the outcomes to total energy gives the inclusive energy distribution. Its Laplace exponent is fixed by the diagonal soft intensity. For m̊ d Nₕ₍ømega)=ηₕm̊ dømega/ømega+m̊ d Nₕ,ᵣₑg(ømega), I obtain h̊oᵢₙc(s)sim Cθ(s-m²⁾⁽s-m²⁾⁻¹⁺ηₕ. I retain the coherence kernel and derive hard-sector dephasing and the spectral edge from two contractions of one soft environment. The diagonal coefficient κₐₐ fixes the endpoint exponent, while frac12(κₐₐ+κbb-2øperatornameReκbₐ) fixes the dephasing exponent between hard alternatives. I then classify infrared energy marginals, derive the finite-resolution residue Z(μ)=(μ/Łambda)ηₕ, prove stability under infrared-integrable perturbations, and separate the bath exponent from a hard threshold exponent. For the one-electron spectral measure, the hard threshold factor is regular. The resulting edge has the local power law of a gapped unparticle spectrum, while its exponent remains a response coefficient of the unresolved photon sector.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者从软QED的量子仪器出发推导带电粒子的谱边，并分别考察迹掉未分辨光子得到的硬扇区约化信道，以及投影到总能量得到的包容能量分布。其拉普拉斯指数由对角软辐射强度决定，在含红外对数发散的光子数谱下得到阈值附近的幂律谱边。论文保留相干核，说明同一个软环境的不同收缩同时给出硬扇区退相干和谱边指数，并进一步分类红外能量边缘、给出有限分辨率残重及其对红外可积扰动的稳定性。

articles.title: High-fidelity entanglement of polar molecules by dynamic geometric control
articles.title_zh: 通过动态几何控制实现极性分子的高保真纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13008v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In quantum information systems made of optical tweezer arrays of ultracold molecules, thermal motion of molecules degrades the coherence of their interactions, which limits entanglement fidelity and the concomitant scientific applicability of these systems. We show that by controlling the geometry of the dipolar interaction, even when a molecule occupies many motional states in the tweezer, coherence can be preserved. We characterize several geometries that suppress sensitivity to thermal fluctuations. We further use programmable, coherence-preserving motion of the molecules during entanglement to refocus dephasing from relative positional jitter of the tweezers, which is relevant even on the 10 nm scale. These methods yield substantially improved dipolar coherence and enable generation of two-molecule entanglement with a Bell state fidelity of F= 0.976⁺⁰.⁰⁰⁸₋₀.₀₁₁ in directly laser-cooled molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 在超冷分子光镊阵列量子信息平台中，分子热运动会降低相互作用相干性并限制纠缠保真度。作者证明，通过控制偶极相互作用的几何结构，即使分子占据多个光镊运动态，也能保持相干性，并识别出若干可抑制热涨落敏感性的几何配置。进一步地，作者在纠缠过程中利用可编程、保相干的分子运动来重聚焦由光镊相对位置抖动导致的退相干，最终在直接激光冷却分子中实现Bell态保真度约为0.976的双分子纠缠。
authors: Scarlett S. Yu, Avikar Periwal, Jiaqi You, Zirui Liu, Qinshu Lyu, Youngju Cho, Loïc Anderegg, Eunmi Chae, John M. Doyle

articles.title: Fermionic parton theory of Rydberg Z₂ quantum spin liquids
articles.title_zh: Rydberg Z₂量子自旋液体的费米子部分子理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.17219v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Programmable quantum simulators based on neutral atom arrays today offer powerful platforms for studying strongly correlated phases of quantum matter. Here, we employ the projective symmetry group framework to describe the symmetry fractionalization patterns in a topologically ordered Z₂ quantum spin liquid (QSL) synthesized in such a Rydberg array on the ruby lattice. By systematically comparing the static structure factors of all possible mean-field Ansätze against density-matrix renormalization group calculations, we identify a promising candidate for the precise Z₂ QSL realized microscopically. We also present detailed analyses of the dynamical structure factors as a reference for future experiments and showcase how these spin correlations can differentiate between varied QSL Ansätze.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用投影对称群框架，描述中性原子Rydberg阵列在ruby晶格上合成的拓扑有序Z₂量子自旋液体中的对称性分数化模式。通过将所有可能平均场Ansätze的静态结构因子与密度矩阵重整化群结果系统比较，论文识别出一个有望对应微观实现态的Z₂自旋液体候选。作者还给出动力学结构因子的详细分析，为未来实验判别不同量子自旋液体Ansätze提供参考。
authors: Atanu Maity, Yasir Iqbal, Rhine Samajdar

articles.title: Geometric origin of supercurrents in Berry phase: Formula for computing currents from wavefunctions with correlation and particle number variation
articles.title_zh: 贝里相中超电流的几何起源：从含关联与粒子数变化的波函数计算电流的公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.16258v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The complexity of itinerant and many-body nature in Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) wavefunctions has traditionally led to the use of coarse-grained order parameters for describing currents in superconductors (SC), rather than directly utilizing wavefunctions. In this work, we introduce a phase-based formula that enables the direct computation of currents from microscopic wavefunctions, accounting for correlation and particle number variations. Interestingly, the formulation draws parallels with insulators, suggesting a unified framework for understanding (intra-band) charge transport across two extremes of conductivity. A group velocity current Jbₐₙdproptofrac1hbarpartialₖE(k) is derived from Berry phase, independent of wave package dynamics, robust against correlation. Additionally, we identify a correlation-driven contribution, Jcₒᵣᵣ, which reveals that the pairing correlations łanglecₖc₋ₖångle among dancing partners provide a current component beyond the velocity operator.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种基于相位的公式，可直接从微观波函数计算超导体中的电流，并显式纳入电子关联和粒子数涨落。作者从贝里相推导出与波包动力学无关、对关联稳健的能带群速度电流，并指出配对关联还会产生超出传统速度算符贡献的关联电流。该框架暗示绝缘体与超导体中带内电荷输运可用统一的几何语言描述。
authors: B. Q. Song, J. D. H. Smith, J. Wang

articles.title: The Sound of Electrons Shattering: Current Noise Composition Laws for Electron Fractionalization
articles.title_zh: 电子碎裂之声：电子分数化的电流噪声组合律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.25322v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a theory of the non-equilibrium current response for metallic systems near quantum critical points where electronic quasiparticles fractionalize, such as systems near continuous metal-insulator transitions or composite Fermi liquid to Fermi liquid transitions. Applying a generalized response theory within a Keldysh path integral framework, we derive a non-perturbative current noise composition law, wherein the total noise is the sum of the noise of each fractionalized constituent (bosonic holons and fermionic spinons), weighted by their respective resistivities. We demonstrate that the formally derived composition relations can be interpreted in terms of a simple analogy with resistors in series. We leverage this composition rule near certain quantum critical points to show that the shot noise can be suppressed in long nanowires as compared to Fermi liquid expectations due to the collusion of quantum criticality with fractionalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究量子临界金属中电子准粒子分数化时的非平衡电流响应，适用于连续金属-绝缘体转变或复合费米液体到费米液体转变附近的体系。作者在 Keldysh 路径积分框架下推导出非微扰电流噪声组合律：总噪声由玻色 holon 与费米 spinon 的噪声按各自电阻率加权叠加。该组合关系可类比为串联电阻，并预言在长纳米线中量子临界性与分数化共同作用可抑制散粒噪声。
authors: Adarsh S. Patri, Josephine J. Yu, Yi-Ming Wu, T. Senthil, Hart Goldman

articles.title: The exceptional origin of the strange metal and the LFL-HFL transition
articles.title_zh: 奇异金属与 Landau-Fermi 液体—Hubbard-Fermi 液体转变的例外代数起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31810v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose an algebraic framework for the strange metal regime of strongly correlated electrons. We show that the exceptional superconformal algebra D(2,1;α) admits two distinct contractions of its conformal sector: one to a pair of canonical fermions, the underlying degrees of freedom of the Landau--Fermi liquid (LFL), and one to the algebra of Hubbard operators, which characterise a distinct metallic regime, the Hubbard--Fermi liquid (HFL). We argue that competition between these two metallic states drives the emergence of the strange metal as a 0+1D superconformal bath. We analyse the resulting thermodynamics, and at leading order obtain a parameter-free prediction, 4π²γ⁻¹ =ḩiₛ⁻¹ + ḩi_c⁻¹, relating the Sommerfeld coefficient to the static spin and charge susceptibilities. We further show that the LFL-HFL transition is discontinuous at low temperature, forced by an algebraic constraint on the Hubbard contraction, and map out the resulting phase diagram. We connect the framework to microscopic lattice models and to the phenomenology of correlated insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一个基于例外超共形代数 D(2,1;α) 的强关联电子奇异金属代数框架。该代数的共形部分存在两种收缩，分别对应 Landau-Fermi 液体的正则费米子自由度和 Hubbard-Fermi 液体的 Hubbard 算符，由二者竞争产生可视为 0+1 维超共形浴的奇异金属。文章给出 Sommerfeld 系数与静态自旋、荷电磁化率之间的无参数领先阶关系，并指出低温下 LFL-HFL 转变因 Hubbard 收缩的代数约束而呈不连续。

articles.title: Nanoparticle Arrays for Efficient Organic Light-Emitting Diode Emission Management
articles.title_zh: 用于高效有机发光二极管发射管理的纳米颗粒阵列
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12635v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: OLEDs are increasingly applied in illumination and displays because they offer excellent color quality, are mechanically flexible, and are self-emissive. However, their usage is limited by low external quantum efficiency (EQE) and efficiency roll-off at high driving voltages. These limitations, together with demands for smaller pixels and device sizes in emerging technologies, motivate innovations that increase efficiency and allow replacing external optical elements with embedded solutions. Here, we demonstrate enhanced outcoupling as well as directional and polarization control of OLED emission, based on collective surface lattice resonances of plasmonic nanoparticle arrays that are embedded in the active layers of four different state-of-the-art OLED structures. Both square arrays and more complex lattices producing flat bands are demonstrated to guide the light to directions and polarizations determined by their optical modes. We show that by the design of the array geometry and the OLED structure, spectral and angular enhancement of the electroluminescence (EL), up to 30 %, can be achieved. Our results verify that surface lattice resonances of nanoparticle arrays offer a robust and versatile embedded solution for tailoring the OLED emission, as well as exciting prospects for efficiency increase if combined with narrow-spectrum emitters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将等离激元纳米颗粒阵列嵌入四类先进 OLED 有源层，利用集体表面晶格共振提升出光并调控发射方向与偏振。作者展示了方形阵列以及产生平带的更复杂晶格均可按其光学模式引导电致发光。通过阵列几何和 OLED 结构设计，可实现光谱与角度选择性的电致发光增强，最高约 30%，表明嵌入式纳米光子结构可替代部分外部光学管理元件。
authors: Aron J. J. Dahlberg, Matas Gužauskas, Malek Mahmoudi, Joel Lehikoinen, Dmytro Volyniuk, Manish Kumar, Anton Matthijs Berghuis, Hassan A. Qureshi, Rasa Keruckiene, Michael A. Papachatzakis, Evgeny A. Mamonov, Rebecca Heilmann, Henri Lyyra, Olli Siltanen, William L. Barnes, Jaime Gómez Rivas, Konstantinos S. Daskalakis, Juozas Vidas Gražulevičius, Päivi Törmä

articles.title: Traceable In Situ Microwave Power Measurement at the Cryogenic Device Plane in a Dilution Refrigerator
articles.title_zh: 稀释制冷机中低温器件平面的可溯源原位微波功率测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12751v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate knowledge of the microwave power delivered to a cryogenic device under test (DUT) is essential for the characterization and operation of superconducting quantum circuits. However, this information is difficult to obtain inside dilution refrigerators because of distributed attenuation, impedance mismatch, switch-path repeatability, and temperature-dependent microwave components. This paper presents an in situ measurement method for RF power at the cryogenic device plane. The method uses a custom variable temperature stage (VTS) as a cryogenic thermal-transfer element. The TVS is alternately heated by a four-wire DC heater and by microwave power dissipated in a 20 dB pass-through attenuator. By fitting the thermal transients and comparing the corresponding steady-state temperatures, the absorbed microwave power is inferred from a directly measured DC electrical power through an AC/DC substitution procedure. The finite reflection and transmission of the attenuator are then accounted for by cryogenic two-port scattering-parameter measurements based on a switch-assisted Short--Open--Load--Reciprocal calibration, so that the result is referred to the DUT reference plane. The system is demonstrated in a dilution refrigerator with powers between -43 and -58 dBm at the DUT input plane. The demonstrated relative standard uncertainty ranges from about 2% at -43.9 dBm to about 40% at -57.6 dBm. The proposed approach combines thermal RF power transfer, cryogenic S-parameter correction, and uncertainty evaluation in a measurement architecture compatible with quantum-device experiments, providing a practical route toward traceable microwave-power calibration at millikelvin stages.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种在稀释制冷机低温器件平面原位测量射频/微波功率的方法，面向超导量子电路表征中功率不确定的问题。方法使用可变温级作为低温热传递元件，将四线直流加热与耗散在 20 dB 贯通衰减器中的微波加热进行 AC/DC 替代比较，并通过热瞬态拟合和稳态温度确定吸收微波功率。进一步结合低温二端口散射参数校准修正衰减器有限反射和透射，使结果可溯源到直接测量的直流电功率。
authors: Paolo Panetta, Andrea Celotto, Alessandro Alocco, Bernardo Galvano, Luca Fasolo, Emanuele Palumbo, Luca Callegaro, Luca Oberto, Patrizia Livreri, Emanuele Enrico

articles.title: A Unified Gradient Theory for Frame-Indifferent Rates of Tensorial Internal Variables
articles.title_zh: 张量内变量客观率的统一梯度理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a thermodynamically consistent framework for weakly nonlocal continua with tensor-valued internal variables. Let boldsymbolL=øperatornamegradboldsymbolv, with stretching tensor boldsymbolD=øperatornamesymboldsymbolL and spin tensor boldsymbolW=øperatornameskwboldsymbolL. We introduce the generators boldsymbolΓα=boldsymbolW+αboldsymbolD, αin0,1, which unify corotational and upper-convected transport. The resulting kinematic structure induces canonical frame-indifferent evolutions of both the internal variable and its spatial gradient, thereby providing a closure for gradient-dependent theories. Starting from the balances of linear momentum and microforces, together with an internal power expenditure depending on the internal variable and its gradient, we derive a local free-energy imbalance for incompressible isothermal processes. Under isotropy and inherited symmetry assumptions, this imbalance admits a canonical decomposition into contributions associated with boldsymbolD, øperatornamegradboldsymbolL, the generator-induced rate mathfrakDαboldsymbolJ, and its gradient mathfrakDⁿablaα(øperatornamegradboldsymbolJ). This decomposition yields explicit constitutive restrictions ensuring thermodynamic consistency and identifies the induced higher-order stress contributions arising from gradient dependence. Finally, we construct a coupled gradient theory combining viscoelasticity and constrained orientational order, in which distinct internal variables evolve under different transport mechanisms. The framework extends classical theories with tensorial internal variables, including Oldroyd-B and Landau-de Gennes-type models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作构建了一个热力学一致的弱非局域连续介质理论，适用于张量值内变量及其空间梯度。作者引入生成元 Γα=W+αD，将共旋输运与上随体输运统一起来，并由此给出内变量及其梯度的客观演化闭合形式。在动量平衡、微力平衡和含梯度内功率的基础上，推导了不可压等温过程的局域自由能不等式，并在各向同性与继承对称假设下分解出与形变率、速度梯度、生成元诱导率及其梯度相关的耗散贡献。

articles.title: A Quantum Computing Approach to Track Reconstruction in Strip-Type Detectors
articles.title_zh: 用于条型探测器径迹重建的量子计算方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This study investigates the use of quantum annealing for particle track reconstruction in strip-type gaseous detectors. In such detectors, ghost hits and multiple hit combinations can turn pattern recognition into a combinatorial optimization problem. We formulate two reconstruction subproblems as quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problems. The first subproblem selects detector hits associated with a single photon track inside a localized candidate region. The second subproblem selects cluster triplets from different detector layers so that multiple track candidates can be handled within a single quantum processing unit(QPU) submission. The proposed formulations are tested using simulated DAMSA detector events. For the single track hit selection task, the QPU based reconstruction gives position and angular resolutions close to those obtained with a Kalman based reconstruction. In the simultaneous association task, valid cluster triplets are first extracted from the QPU samples and then connected using an association rule based on graph connectivity to construct track candidates. The DAMSA event topology studied here has low pileup and is dominated by the two photon signal from axion-like particle(ALP) decay. In this setting, the results show that the QUBO formulations can reproduce local reconstruction decisions. This provides a practical basis for further studies of reconstruction methods that combine quantum and classical computing in more complex tracking environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探索用量子退火解决条型气体探测器中的粒子径迹重建问题，其中伪击中和多重击中组合会导致组合优化复杂性。作者将单光子候选区域内击中选择和跨探测层簇三元组选择两个子问题表述为二次无约束二进制优化问题。基于模拟 DAMSA 探测器事件的测试表明，单径迹任务中量子处理器重建的位置和角分辨率接近 Kalman 方法；多候选任务中则从量子样本提取有效三元组并用图连通规则构建径迹。
authors: Seungyeob Jwa, Hyunyong Kim, Jangho Kim, Minseok Oh

articles.title: Entanglement, loss, and quantumness: When balanced beam splitters are best
articles.title_zh: 纠缠、损耗与量子性：何时平衡分束器最优
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.03423v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum optics routinely uses beam splitters to generate entanglement, including in pioneering experiments conducted by Hanbury-Brown and Twiss and Hong, Ou, and Mandel. The quantum interference at beam splitters lies at the heart of what makes boson sampling hard to emulate by classical computers and is a vital component of quantum computation with light. Yet, despite overwhelming positive evidence, the conjecture that beam splitters with equal reflection and transmission probabilities generate the most entanglement for any state interfered with the vacuum has remained unproven for almost two decades [Asbóth et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 94, 173602 (2005)]. We prove this conjecture for ubiquitous entanglement monotones including mixed-state generalizations of entanglement entropy and purity by uncovering monotonicity and convexity with respect to photon loss for these monotones. At the same time, we highlight an infinite class of lesser-used monotones for which the conjecture fails. Because beam splitters are so fundamental, our results yield numerous corollaries for quantum optics, including proof of a recent conjecture for the evolution of a measure of quantumness through loss and a more efficient computational strategy for optimizing entanglement generation over linear optics. These results justify the value of seeking mathematical rigour behind commonly accepted facts and the danger of trusting them unconditionally.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文证明了一个长期猜想：对大量常用纠缠单调量而言，当任意输入态与真空在分束器上干涉时，反射率与透射率相等的平衡分束器产生的纠缠最大。证明基于这些纠缠单调量相对于光子损耗的单调性与凸性，涵盖混态纠缠熵和纯度的推广形式。作者同时指出存在一类较少使用的纠缠单调量不满足该猜想，并由此给出量子光学中若干相关推论。
authors: Noah Lupu-Gladstein, Anaelle Hertz, Khabat Heshami, Aaron Z. Goldberg

articles.title: Controller-decoder system requirements derived by implementing Shor's algorithm with surface code
articles.title_zh: 通过表面码实现 Shor 算法推导控制器-译码器系统需求
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.00289v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum Error Correction (QEC) is regarded as the most promising path to quantum advantage. The success of QEC relies on achieving quantum gate fidelities below the error threshold of the QEC code, while accurately decoding errors through classical processing of the QEC stabilizer measurements. In this paper, we uncover the critical system-level requirements from a controller-decoder system (CDS) necessary to successfully execute the next milestone in QEC: a non-Clifford circuit. Using a representative non-Clifford circuit, of Shor factorization algorithm for the number 21, we convert the logical-level circuit to a QEC surface code circuit and finally to the physical level circuit. By taking into account realistic implementation aspects using typical superconducting qubit processor parameters, we reveal a broad range of core requirements from any CDS aimed at performing error corrected quantum computation. Our findings indicate that the controller-decoder closed-loop latency must remain within tens of microseconds, achievable by distributing decoding data into several decoders while ensuring fast communication between decoders and with the controller. By extending existing simulation techniques, we simulate the complete fault-tolerant factorization circuit at the physical level, demonstrating that near-term hardware performance in the scale of 0.1% physical error rates and 1000 qubits, are sufficient for a successful circuit execution. Overall, the requirements outlined here set the stage for near- and medium-term experimental realizations of non-Clifford QEC circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作以分解 21 的 Shor 算法作为代表性非 Clifford 电路，逐级转换为逻辑层、表面码量子纠错层和物理层电路，以评估容错量子计算对控制器-译码器系统的要求。研究纳入典型超导量子处理器参数和实际实现约束，给出了误差校正量子计算所需的系统级指标。结果表明，控制器-译码器闭环延迟需保持在数十微秒量级，可通过将译码数据分配给多个译码器并保证译码器间快速通信来实现。
authors: Yaniv Kurman, Lior Ella, Nir Halay, Oded Wertheim, Yonatan Cohen

articles.title: Qubit-Efficient Quantum Search for Hyperdimensional Decomposition via Logarithmic Encoding
articles.title_zh: 基于对数编码的超维分解量子比特高效量子搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) represents symbols using high-dimensional hypervectors of dimension D. In hypervector decomposition, the objective is to recover F constituent hypervectors, each drawn from a codebook of size N, from a bound target hypervector. This requires searching over N^F candidate tuples, making the task computationally prohibitive at scale. Recent quantum approach provides a quadratic search advantage, but typically rely on qubit-inefficient O(D)-qubit hypervector representations. We propose a qubit-efficient quantum framework for HDC decomposition that reduces the representation cost to O(łog D). The framework introduces logarithmic hypervector and binding encodings, together with a reversible hypervector lookup operator for circuit-level manipulation of dense hypervectors. Combined with a modified Dürr-Høyer search procedure, the method preserves O(sqrtN^F) search complexity while substantially reducing qubit usage. Experimental results validate correct similarity computation, accurate decomposition in executable regimes, and significantly improved qubit scaling over baselines based on explicit D-qubit hypervector encodings, achieving up to 2,000× fewer qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向超维计算中的超向量分解问题，即从绑定目标超向量中恢复来自码本的多个构成超向量，传统搜索规模随 N^F 增长。作者提出量子比特高效的量子框架，用对数超向量与绑定编码将表示成本从 O(D) 降至 O(log D)，并设计可逆超向量查找算符以支持电路级稠密超向量操作。结合改进的 Dürr-Høyer 搜索，该方法保持 O(sqrt(N^F)) 搜索复杂度，同时显著降低量子比特需求，并在可执行规模实验中验证了相似度计算和分解正确性。
authors: Sanggeon Yun, Hyunwoo Oh, Ryozo Masukawa, Raheeb Hassan, Mohsen Imani

articles.title: Dynamic Online Processor-Native Inference for State Estimation
articles.title_zh: 用于状态估计的动态在线处理器原生推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12095v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sensor-rich data-driven applications increasingly use Bayesian approaches to infer latent states of dynamic systems from noisy sensor measurements and physical models. Yet the computation of the likelihood remains an essential bottleneck for accurate posteriors and performant inference. This paper presents a Bayesian filtering technique that uses processor-native uncertainty tracking for both uncertainty propagation and inference. The technique implements deterministic hierarchical importance restructuring through a native operation, giving deterministic latency and bounded memory use for arbitrary models written as program code. Benchmarks across three nonlinear state-space systems compare the approach against particle filters and Monte-Carlo-based likelihood estimators. The technique enables deterministic approximate filtering with as high as 805× average speedup against direct Monte Carlo work at matched result quality for model evaluation, and Pareto-dominant accuracy-latency trade-offs for posterior inference while remaining competitive in RMSE with baseline particle filters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种贝叶斯滤波技术，利用处理器原生的不确定性跟踪同时完成不确定性传播和推理，缓解动态系统状态估计中似然计算的瓶颈。方法通过原生操作实现确定性的分层重要性重构，使任意以程序代码表达的模型具有确定性延迟和有界内存使用。三个非线性状态空间系统基准显示，在相近结果质量下，该方法相对直接 Monte Carlo 模型评估平均加速最高达 805 倍，并在后验推理中取得更优的精度-延迟折中。

articles.title: A First-Principles Study of Hydrostatic Pressure-Driven Semiconductor-to-Semimetal Transitions, Dynamic Stability, Thermodynamic and Optical Properties in phases (α and γ) of 2D SnTe Monolayer and Bilayer structure
articles.title_zh: 二维 SnTe 单层与双层 α、γ 相中静水压力驱动半导体-半金属转变、动力学稳定性、热力学和光学性质的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: This work presents a comprehensive first-principles investigation of pressure-driven electronic, vibrational, thermodynamic, and optical properties of α- and γ-phase of SnTe in monolayer and bilayer forms, demonstrating how crystal polymorphism combined to control over semiconductor-to-semimetal transitions. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations, complemented by phonon and quasi-harmonic Debye analyses, reveal that both α- and γ-SnTe monolayers undergo pressure-induced band gap closure and evolve into topological nodal-line Dirac semimetals (NLDMs) at high critical pressures of 15 GPa and 18.5 GPa, respectively. In contrast, their bilayer counterparts exhibit dramatically reduced critical pressures, with α-SnTe and γ-SnTe bilayers achieving NLDM behavior at only 0.8 GPa and 5 GPa, highlighting the decisive role of interlayer van der Waals coupling in accelerating semimetallic phase formation and stabilizing topological states within technologically accessible pressure ranges. Phonon dispersion calculations demonstrate that monolayers exhibit initial dynamical instabilities and require substantial compression to eliminate imaginary modes, while bilayers display earlier or even ambient-pressure dynamical stability with hardened acoustic branches and suppressed anharmonicity. Thermodynamic calculations indicate pressure-enhanced heat capacity and Debye temperature, with bilayers consistently exhibiting stiffer vibrational frameworks than monolayers. Optical response analyses further reveal that monolayers provide highly pressure-tunable dielectric, absorptive, and plasmonic characteristics suitable for dynamic optoelectronic and plasmonic switching, whereas bilayers offer optically strong, pressure-insensitive behavior ideal for stable device operation. Overall, these results establish pressure-engineered α- and γ-SnTe mono/bilayers as versatile 2D platforms for realizing tunable topological semimetal phases and designing next-generation quantum, spintronic, thermoelectric, and optoelectronic devices operating in practical pressure regimes.

articles.title: GTAttn-XC: Physically constrained attention for nonlocal density functionals
articles.title_zh: GTAttn-XC：用于非局域密度泛函的物理约束注意力模型
articles.abstract: Machine-learning-based nonlocal density functional approximations have demonstrated substantial potential in advancing the applicability of electronic density functional theory. However, most existing approaches rely on handcrafted local or nonlocal descriptors, which limits their scalability in modeling long-range electronic responses. In this work, we propose a novel exchange–correlation functional approximation model—GTAttn-XC, which introduces a learnable attention mechanism to enable unsupervised modeling of long-range electronic responses. By coupling a multiscale real-space grid graph representation with attention operators, the proposed method achieves a unified description of local accuracy and nonlocal interactions, while avoiding the computational overhead associated with explicit high-order correlation terms. Evaluations on multiple benchmark datasets, including MGCDB84, demonstrate that the model consistently delivers high accuracy across a range of tasks, such as weak interactions, reaction energies, barrier heights, and thermochemical energies. These results establish a new technical pathway toward high-accuracy nonlocal exchange–correlation approximations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出机器学习交换-相关泛函近似模型 GTAttn-XC，通过可学习注意力机制在无监督意义上刻画长程电子响应。该方法结合多尺度实空间网格图表示和注意力算子，在兼顾局域精度与非局域相互作用的同时避免显式高阶关联项的高计算开销。多个基准数据集测试显示，其在弱相互作用、反应能、势垒高度和热化学能等任务上均具有较高精度。
