authors: Kamran Hussain, Hamza Labiad, Anna L. Marchant, Jonathan N. Tinsley, Tristan Valenzuela, Jonathon Coleman, David Newbold, Mark G. Bason

articles.title: Characterization and Design of 3D Printed Composite Insole Fabricated by Dual-Nozzle 3D Printer Using CB-PLA and Fe-PLA Filaments
articles.title_zh: 基于 CB-PLA 与 Fe-PLA 双喷嘴 3D 打印复合鞋垫的设计与表征
articles.abstract: Purpose of this study is to develop 3D printed integrated insoles fabricated using a dual-nozzle fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printing process. Polylactic acid (PLA) was employed as the sheath and insole material, while carbon black-filled PLA (CB-PLA) and iron-filled PLA (Fe-PLA) served as core materials. Initially, composite sheath-core structures were fabricated in both assembled and integrated forms with core diameters of 1.25, 2.50, 5.00, 7.50, and 10.00 mm and a thickness of 5.00 mm. Based on the performance evaluation of the composite structures, the integrated structure was selected for insole fabrication for its stable electrical, higher magnetic, and mechanical properties. The integrated insoles were subsequently produced with core diameters of 2.50, 5.00, 7.50, and 10.00 mm and thicknesses of 1.0, 2.5, and 5.0 mm. The 3D printed structures were characterized in terms of printing time, weight, electrical conductivity, magnetic field strength, and mechanical properties. The developed smart insole incorporated six sensing regions distributed across the primary plantar pressure zones, including the metatarsal, midfoot, and heel areas. The results demonstrated that larger core diameters and thinner insole structures enhanced electrical conductivity, with the integrated PLA/CB-PLA insole containing a 10.00 mm core and 1.0 mm thickness exhibiting the highest current of 0.10 A at 24 V. In contrast, the integrated PLA/Fe-PLA insole with the same geometry achieved a maximum magnetic field strength of 351 ± 8.84 Gs. These findings suggest that the structure, core diameter, and thickness significantly influence the electrical, magnetic, and mechanical performance for fabricating integrated insoles.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用双喷嘴 FDM 3D 打印制备集成式智能鞋垫，以 PLA 作为外壳和鞋垫基体，碳黑填充 PLA 与铁填充 PLA 作为芯材。作者先比较不同芯径、相同厚度下组装式与集成式鞘芯复合结构的电学、磁学和力学表现，并选择稳定性更好的集成结构用于鞋垫制造。随后制备不同芯径和厚度的鞋垫，系统表征打印时间、重量、电导率、磁场强度和力学性能。所设计鞋垫包含 6 个分布于跖骨区、中足区和足跟区等主要足底压力区域的传感单元，目标是实现结构与传感功能的一体化。

articles.title: Fungi enhance chlorine resistance via binding metal ions in drinking water systems: A novel phenomenon and underlying mechanisms
articles.title_zh: 真菌通过结合金属离子增强饮用水系统中的耐氯性：新现象及机制
articles.abstract: While drinking water disinfection strategies primarily target bacteria and viruses, pathogenic fungi represent an emerging yet underestimated threat, causing severe opportunistic infections that are difficult to treat and exhibiting inherently higher chlorine resistance than bacterial pathogens. This resistance enables fungi to penetrate disinfection barriers and enter distribution networks where they actively complex with metals (e.g., Cu, Fe) from pipe corrosion and other sources. Here, we show that fungal spore complexation with environmental metal ions substantially enhances chlorine resistance through integrated multilayered defenses. Fungal spores exhibit strong adsorption affinity for metal ions, binding up to 11.27 pg Cu(II), 7.86 pg Fe(II), 0.97 pg Mn(II), and 4.72 pg Co(II) per spore. Metal-complexed spores exhibit 42-61% reduced log inactivation within 20 minutes and >40% faster chlorine decay. At Cu(II) saturation, lag phase extends 7.5-fold and inactivation rate constants decline by 21.1%, demonstrating that metal complexation by fungal spores governs chlorine tolerance. Multi-omics and physicochemical analyses reveal that metal ions function at both extracellular and intracellular levels: altered surface properties drive spore aggregation, cell wall chemical consumption and metal deposition create physical barriers, intracellular antioxidant activation, metabolic pathway remodeling, and reactive site redistribution enhance defense capacity. These coordinated mechanisms establish a hierarchical protection framework integrating physical obstruction, chemical consumption, and molecular regulation that collectively impedes chlorine-mediated structural and functional damage. Our findings demonstrate that active metal complexation by fungal spores is a critical but overlooked resistance mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，饮用水消毒长期主要针对细菌和病毒，而病原真菌因本征耐氯性较高，可能穿透消毒屏障并进入管网。作者发现真菌孢子可与环境金属离子如 Cu、Fe、Mn、Co 强烈络合，每个孢子可结合皮克量级金属离子，并显著增强耐氯性。金属络合孢子在 20 分钟内的对数灭活降低 42–61%，同时使氯衰减加快超过 40%；在 Cu(II) 饱和条件下，滞后期延长 7.5 倍、灭活速率常数下降 21.1%。多组学与物化分析表明，金属离子通过胞外和胞内多层防御共同调控真菌孢子的氯耐受。

articles.title: A Comparative Study on the Efficiency of an SnO2/n-Si Photodetector Using a Planar Un-scratched and a CNC Mechanically Scratched Wafer
articles.title_zh: 平面未划伤与 CNC 机械划伤晶片制备的 SnO2/n-Si 光探测器效率比较
articles.abstract: The efficiency of an SnO2/n-Si photodetector was increased using regular mechanical micro-scratches performed by a precise CNC machine operating according to a program written in G-code. A 7×6 matrix pattern was engraved on an n-type silicon wafer. Then, using a vacuum thermal evaporation system, Sn was deposited and the wafer was oxidized in a furnace; SEM and XRD examinations showed an increase in surface area and an improvement in the polycrystalline nature of the film, and optically, the mechanical scratches acted as light traps that broadened the absorption range (Vis-NIR). The optoelectronic performance (I-V) of the p-Si heterojunction photodetector was substantially enhanced via mechanical texturing. Under 70 mW/c broadband illumination, the scratched Si substrate generated a net photocurrent (2.85 mA), marking a 163.8% performance boost over the planar device (1.74 mA}). Consequently, the external quantum efficiency EQE rose from 8.64% to 14.13%, and responsivity (R) jumped from 59.2 to 96.9 mA/W. This improvement is physically driven by the CNC-induced micro-grooves, which suppress surface reflectance and maximize light-trapping within the silicon absorber. Conversely, a trade-off occurred in specific detectivity (D*), which decreased from Jones due to elevated dark current (resulting from the increased effective surface area and induction). "Charge transport analysis (∅ = 0.93) proved the dominance of the monomolecular recombination mechanism compared to the unscratched detector (∅ = 0.5), demonstrating high efficiency in charge separation. The transient photoresponse showed that the scratched detector possesses a superior response speed, recording a rise time of 480 ns compared to 560 ns for the unscratched detector. This fundamental difference is evident in the fall time, where the unscratched detector took a significantly long time (87.20 µs) to return to the dark state, confirming the dominance of the 'trap-assisted recombination' mechanism, which traps charges and hinders their discharge. In contrast, the scratched detector exhibited a rapid recovery with a fall time not exceeding 17.2 µs, proving the efficiency of the scratched detector's surface structure in providing trap-free pathways and confirming the dominance of the monomolecular recombination mechanism, which ensures ultra-high speed in charge separation and extraction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过精密 CNC 机械微划痕提升 SnO2/n-Si 光探测器性能，在 n 型硅片上加工 7×6 矩阵图案后沉积 Sn 并热氧化形成 SnO2。SEM 与 XRD 表明，机械划痕增加了表面积并改善薄膜多晶特征；光学上，微沟槽起到陷光作用，拓宽可见—近红外吸收。与平面器件相比，划伤衬底在 70 mW/cm² 宽带照明下净光电流由 1.74 mA 提升至 2.85 mA，外量子效率由 8.64% 增至 14.13%，响应度由 59.2 增至 96.9 mA/W。性能提升主要归因于 CNC 诱导微沟槽降低表面反射并增强硅吸收层内的光俘获。

articles.title: Frequency combs due to the magnetic square well scheme and dissipative exchange flows in one-dimensional ferromagnetic channels
articles.title_zh: 一维铁磁通道中磁方势阱方案与耗散交换流导致的频率梳
articles.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the formation of frequency combs as a result of non-local interactionbetween supersonic spin-polarized currents at two different injection sites along a one-dimensionalferromagnetic channel. This injections scheme, which we termed magnetic square well (’well’), allowsfor dissipative exchange flows (DEFs), where DEFs are large-amplitude boundary value solutionsto ferromagnetic channels. In the low-injection limit, DEFs reduce to spin superfluids while inthe strong injection limit nonlinearities dominate close to the injection site and a contact solitonis formed. This spin superfluid and nonlinearity allows for this non-local interaction, resulting ininteresting and novel magnetic textures, including frequency combs. Here, we numerically investigatea perturbed and unperturbed magnetic square well solutions in the high injection regime, wheresoliton dynamics are excited when two injection regions are separated by a certain distance, allowingfor non-local interaction that we termed DEF-interaction. This interaction results in magnetictextures with the properties of frequency combs inside and outside the well.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究一维铁磁通道中两个不同注入位置的超声速自旋极化电流发生非局域相互作用时的频率梳形成。作者将该注入构型称为磁方势阱，它允许耗散交换流作为铁磁通道的大振幅边值解出现；低注入极限下退化为自旋超流，强注入极限下非线性在注入点附近占主导并形成接触孤子。数值结果表明，在高注入 regime 中，当两个注入区域相隔一定距离时可激发孤子动力学并产生所谓 DEF 相互作用。该相互作用在势阱内外形成具有频率梳特征的新型磁织构。

articles.title: MHD Mixed Convection Control in an Actuated Vertically Rectangular Vented Cavity with a Rotating Core Cylinder
articles.title_zh: 带旋转中心圆柱的受驱竖直矩形通风腔中 MHD 混合对流控制
articles.abstract: This study employs the Galerkin FE approach to assess the impact of magnetic field (Lorentz force) on the MHD mixed convection dynamics of CuO-water nanofluid flow within a vented vertical cavity. The system incorporates a centrally positioned rotating cylinder with an entry port at the lower-left corner and a discharge port at the upper-right boundary. A comprehensive parametric investigation was conducted by systematically varying key dimensionless parameters: the Hartmann number (0 ≤ Ha ≤ 100), the Reynolds number (10 ≤ Re ≤ 500), the cylinder’s rotational speed (ω = 0 to 50), and the nanoparticle volume fractions (0% ≤ ϕ ≤ 6%). The resulting fluid behaviour and thermal characteristics were evaluated through detailed visualizations of streamlines and isotherms, alongside quantitative tracking of average temperature and the overall Nusselt number (Nu). The computational results demonstrate that higher Re significantly intensifies heat transfer rates especially when the cylinder undergoes counter-clockwise rotation. Furthermore, adjusting Ha and ϕ proves vital for optimizing thermal efficiency. Notably, severe magnetic field suppression (Ha =100) induces approximately 47.90% reduction in heat transfer compared to the non-magnetic baseline for Re = 500. Conversely, introducing an anticlockwise rotation boosts localized heat transfer near the bottom ends by nearly 13.09% relative to the stationary configuration (ω = 0). For clockwise cylinder rotation (ω = 10) yields a massive 195.74% increase in the local Nusselt number as Re escalates from 10 to 500. These insights establish a robust design framework for high-efficiency thermal management systems, with direct implications for advanced compact radiators, electronic thermal controllers, and next-generation energy conversion technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用 Galerkin 有限元方法，分析洛伦兹力对通风竖直腔内 CuO-水纳米流体 MHD 混合对流的影响。系统包含位于中心的旋转圆柱、左下角入口和右上边界出口，并系统改变 Hartmann 数、Reynolds 数、圆柱转速和纳米颗粒体积分数。作者通过流线、等温线、平均温度和整体 Nusselt 数评估流动与传热特征。计算结果表明，提高 Reynolds 数显著增强传热，尤其在圆柱逆时针旋转时更明显；Hartmann 数和颗粒体积分数的调控对热效率优化关键，而强磁场抑制会显著降低传热表现。

articles.title: Lyapunov Integrability Test (LIT): a numerical framework for exploring integrability in continuous dynamical systems
articles.title_zh: Lyapunov 可积性测试：探索连续动力系统可积性的数值框架
articles.abstract: We introduce the Lyapunov Integrability Test (LIT), a new numerical framework for exploring integrability in nonlinear dynamical systems. The main idea is inspired by the role of the Mandelbrot set in complex dynamics: instead of identifying parameter values associated with stable periodic orbits, the LIT seeks parameter regions that may correspond to integrable dynamics. The method is based on a global analysis of Lyapunov exponents across parameter space and provides a simple and efficient way to visualize candidate integrable regimes. Its performance is demonstrated on several benchmark systems, including the ABC flow, the heavy top, quantum dots, a helically symmetric Hamiltonian system with three degrees of freedom, and the classical double pendulum. The results demonstrate that the LIT is an effective and computationally efficient framework for the global exploration of parameter space and the identification of candidate integrable regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Lyapunov 可积性测试（LIT），用于在非线性动力系统中数值探索可积性。其思想受复动力学中 Mandelbrot 集启发：不是寻找对应稳定周期轨道的参数，而是基于参数空间中 Lyapunov 指数的全局分析，定位可能对应可积动力学的区域。该方法提供了一种简单且计算效率较高的方式来可视化候选可积 regime。作者在 ABC 流、重陀螺、量子点、具有螺旋对称性的三自由度 Hamilton 系统和经典双摆等基准系统上展示了其有效性。

articles.title: Large language models do not replace chemists in a closed-loop catalysis experiment
articles.title_zh: 大语言模型不能在闭环催化实验中取代化学家
articles.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping scientific research and laboratory automation1. Large language models (LLMs) can perform aspects of scientific reasoning, which could in principle reduce human decision-making as a rate-limiting step in closed-loop automated experiments2-7. Yet the reasoning performance of LLMs compared with human experts in complex, noisy, long-running laboratory experiments is largely unexplored. Here we benchmarked LLM reasoning head-to-head against a team of human domain experts for a noisy 25-dimensional closed-loop colloidal catalysis problem8 explored using a mobile robot9. The LLM (GPT-5.1) navigated the available chemical space across a 528-experiment campaign, using background information and experimental data to propose an anionic surfactant that gave the largest single gain in catalyst activity, also adapting to a mid-campaign change in the measurement set-up. In a like-for-like final phase of 160 experiments, the human experts found a catalyst formulation that was, on average, more active than the best two formulations found in independent LLM runs. At the same time, the LLM reasoned 35 times faster and was estimated to be around 1,900 times less expensive than human reasoning. Inspection of the LLM reasoning traces found them mostly sound, but with some costly silent errors, logical inconsistencies, and apparent memory limitations, suggesting that LLMs are not out-of-the-box replacements for expert reasoning in problems of this complexity10. This points to a need to design closed-loop systems that combine the speed of machine reasoning with expert oversight.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在一个由移动机器人执行、含噪声且维度达 25 的闭环胶体催化问题中，将大语言模型与人类领域专家进行正面对比。GPT-5.1 在 528 次实验中利用背景知识和实验数据导航化学空间，提出了带来最大单次催化活性增益的阴离子表面活性剂，并能适应实验中途测量装置的变化。在最终 160 次同条件实验阶段，人类专家找到的催化剂配方平均活性高于两次独立 LLM 运行得到的最佳配方。与此同时，LLM 推理速度约快 35 倍、成本估计低约 1900 倍，说明其适合加速探索但尚不能替代专家化学判断。

articles.title: Solving a 30-year-old puzzle about a mysterious superconducting material
articles.title_zh: 破解一种神秘超导材料的 30 年谜题
articles.abstract: A material made from yttrium, barium and copper oxide (better known as YBCO) has intrigued scientists since its discovery in 1987, largely because it retains its superconductive properties at a higher-than-normal temperature. However, it is extremely brittle, which makes it tricky to put to practical use.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻围绕钇钡铜氧化物 YBCO 这一高温超导材料展开。YBCO 自 1987 年发现以来因能在相对较高温度下保持超导性而备受关注，但其脆性很强，限制了工程应用。报道强调研究者正试图理解并解决长期困扰该材料实际利用的关键问题，具体机制和进展需查阅原文。

articles.title: World's first superconducting quantum heat engine offers path to larger quantum computers
articles.title_zh: 世界首个超导量子热机为更大规模量子计算机提供路径
articles.abstract: Recent improvements in our understanding of how the principles of thermodynamics apply in the quantum realm could give a boost to quantum technology, and a clearer picture of quantum thermodynamics could in turn enhance our understanding of classical thermodynamics. Now, Aalto University researchers have demonstrated the first cyclic quantum heat engine inside a superconducting circuit.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道 Aalto 大学研究人员在超导电路中演示了首个循环量子热机。该成果基于近年来对量子尺度热力学规律的理解进展，可能为量子技术和量子计算硬件的发展提供新思路。研究同时表明，量子热力学实验不仅有助于器件设计，也可能反过来加深对经典热力学的理解。

articles.title: Exact Lindbladian Dynamics from Conformal Embeddings and Topological Defects in Conformal Field Theory
articles.title_zh: 共形场论中由共形嵌入与拓扑缺陷给出的精确 Lindblad 动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Analyzing the dynamics of physical observables in open quantum many-body systems is a fundamental but highly challenging task that has yielded very few exact results. In this work, we identify intrinsic conformal structures that restore exact solvability in (1+1)D conformal field theories. For N Majorana fermions with linear mode jumps, the adjoint Lindbladian is triangular on reduced even Majorana monomials, yielding recursive exact Heisenberg evolution. In Wess-Zumino-Witten models admitting conformal Majorana embeddings, this hierarchy gives exact dynamics of affine-current products realized as Majorana bilinears, including regimes where the Kac-Moody current algebra alone does not close. In diagonal rational conformal field theories, Verlinde topological defect lines furnish jump operators whose primary-sector dynamics is exactly diagonal: topological-charge probabilities are conserved, while intersector coherences dephase at rates fixed by the modular S matrix and nonnegative measurement strengths. These examples show that intrinsic conformal structures, such as conformal embeddings and modular data, can organize exactly solvable open conformal dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究开放量子多体系统中可观测量动力学的精确可解结构，指出一维共形场论中的内禀共形结构可恢复可解性。对于具有线性模跳跃算符的 Majorana 费米子体系，伴随 Lindbladian 在约化偶 Majorana 单项式上呈三角结构，从而可递归求得 Heisenberg 演化。作者还将该层级结构用于具有共形 Majorana 嵌入的 WZW 模型，并在有理共形场论中利用 Verlinde 拓扑缺陷线构造跳跃算符，使初级场扇区动力学可精确对角化。

articles.title: Fermion-mediated Casimir effect on mesoscopic rings implementing non-Clifford SWAPα gates
articles.title_zh: 介观环中的费米子介导 Casimir 效应及非 Clifford SWAPα 门实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Casimir effect is typically governed by intrinsic material properties and lacks in situ tunability. We show that, in mesoscopic rings, both the magnitude and sign of the fermion-mediated Casimir interaction can be controlled via the Aharonov-Bohm effect. The resulting interplay between the Aharonov-Bohm phase and the Casimir interaction provides a route to engineer long-range interactions. In particular, this mechanism enables the implementation of non-Clifford SWAPα gates between spatially separated spin qubits, thereby reducing the overhead for universal quantum computation and quantum error correction in spin-qubit architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出，在介观环中费米子介导的 Casimir 相互作用可通过 Aharonov–Bohm 效应原位调控其大小和符号。Aharonov–Bohm 相位与 Casimir 相互作用的耦合提供了工程化长程相互作用的新途径。作者进一步指出，该机制可用于在空间分离的自旋量子比特之间实现非 Clifford SWAPα 门，从而降低自旋量子计算和量子纠错中的资源开销。
authors: Liang Du, Qing-Dong Jiang, Yijia Wu

articles.title: Hybrid DiffractGPT-Rietveld Refinement Framework for Automated X-ray Diffraction Analysis
articles.title_zh: 用于自动 X 射线衍射分析的混合 DiffractGPT–Rietveld 精修框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08890v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: X-ray diffraction (XRD) is fundamental to structural materials characterization, yet transforming a raw powder pattern into a refined crystal structure still demands considerable domain expertise. We present AGAPI-XRD, a hybrid framework integrating DiffractGPT generative structure prediction, database pattern matching against JARVIS-DFT and COD, and automated Rietveld refinement and ALIGNN-FF relaxation through a unified API at https://atomgpt.org/xrd. First, we used the AGAPI-XRD pipeline to evaluate the crystal structure of a variety of minerals in the RRUFF database that were experimentally characterized using powder x-ray diffraction. Next, we benchmarked the lattice parameter prediction fidelity of the AGAPI-XRD pipeline using a subset of the Alexandria PBE-hull dataset and the subset of RRUFF minerals that have known lattice parameters. AGAPI-XRD returns valid lattice parameters for 79.7% of the RRUFF benchmark minerals and for 94.8--98.1% of the Alexandria subset, while identifying a candidate structure for 93.8% of RRUFF minerals. For this benchmark, pattern matching delivers the highest accuracy for known phases, while DiffractGPT extends structure generation to complex materials absent from existing databases. Together, AGAPI-XRD advances accessible, end-to-end automated crystal structure determination from powder XRD data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 AGAPI-XRD，一个结合 DiffractGPT 生成式结构预测、JARVIS-DFT 与 COD 数据库图谱匹配、自动 Rietveld 精修以及 ALIGNN-FF 结构弛豫的 XRD 自动分析框架。作者用 RRUFF 矿物数据库和 Alexandria PBE-hull 子集评估其晶体结构识别与晶格参数预测能力。结果显示，该流程可为大部分基准样品给出有效晶格参数并识别候选结构，其中已知相的图谱匹配精度最高。
authors: Charles Rhys Campbell, Justin Ely, Jaehyung Lee, Frank M. Abel, Kamal Choudhary

articles.title: Negligible current-induced torque from the bulk and interface of Al
articles.title_zh: Al 体相与界面对电流诱导力矩的贡献可忽略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The light metal Al was predicted to have strong orbital Hall and Rashba effects from its bulk and interface, respectively. In this letter, we report experimental evidence that neither the bulk nor the interface of the Al contributed a detectable torque on adjacent Co and FePt layers with significant spin Hall effect, spin-orbit coupling, and resistivity mismatch with Al. These results suggest minimal orbital-spin conversion in Al and negligible orbital transport and spin-vorticity torque in Co/Al, Al/Co, and Al/FePt bilayers. Our findings suggest poor generality and/or effectiveness of torque contributions by the orbital Hall effect, the interfacial orbital Rashba effect, and the spin-vorticity coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验工作检验轻金属 Al 中预期较强的体相轨道 Hall 效应和界面 Rashba 效应是否能对相邻磁性层产生可探测力矩。结果表明，无论在 Co 还是 FePt 相邻层中，Al 的体相和界面均未贡献可分辨的电流诱导力矩，尽管这些体系具有显著自旋 Hall 效应、自旋轨道耦合或与 Al 的电阻率失配。作者据此认为 Al 中轨道—自旋转换很弱，Co/Al、Al/Co 和 Al/FePt 双层中的轨道输运与自旋涡旋力矩可忽略。
authors: Taiyang Zhang, Lujun Zhu, Zhihao Yan, Lijun Zhu

articles.title: Topological phase transition driven by Hatsugai-Kohmoto interaction on the Kagome lattice
articles.title_zh: Kagome 晶格中 Hatsugai–Kohmoto 相互作用驱动的拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09182v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between band topology and strong correlations is central to modern condensed matter physics, but exact solutions are rare. Here, we present an exactly solvable model on the Kagome lattice by combining a Kane-Mele-type spin-orbit coupling with the Hatsugai-Kohmoto interaction. At 1/3 filling, we uncover a continuous topological quantum phase transition driven by electron interaction. A weakly correlated Z₂ topological insulator gives way to a strongly correlated insulator that, while Z₂₋ₜᵣᵢᵥᵢₐₗ, hosts a nontrivial spin Chern number Cₛ₌₂. The transition exhibits critical scaling consistent with the universality class of two-dimensional Dirac fermions. At half-filling, the same model yields a non-Fermi-liquid to Mott-insulator transition, demonstrating that correlation-driven topological and Mott transitions can be unified within a single solvable framework. Our results establish the Kagome Hatsugai-Kohmoto model as a valuable benchmark for interacting topological systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作构造了一个精确可解的 Kagome 晶格模型，将 Kane–Mele 型自旋轨道耦合与 Hatsugai–Kohmoto 相互作用结合，用于研究拓扑与强关联的相互作用。在 1/3 填充处，作者发现电子相互作用驱动的连续拓扑量子相变：弱关联 Z₂ 拓扑绝缘体转变为 Z₂ 平庸但具有非平庸自旋 Chern 数 Cs=2 的强关联绝缘体。该相变的临界标度与二维 Dirac 费米子普适类一致；在半填充处，同一模型还给出非费米液体到 Mott 绝缘体的转变。

articles.title: Observation of a Rydberg-atom time crystal with an ultralong lifetime
articles.title_zh: 超长寿命 Rydberg 原子时间晶体的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous time crystals (CTCs) represent a nonequilibrium quantum phase that spontaneously breaks time-translation symmetry without periodic external driving, manifesting as persistent, long-lived oscillations under steady pumping. The lifetime is constrained by the instability of the limit cycle phase, balanced between nonlinear feedback and energy dissipation, which have rarely been studied in experiments before. Here, we report an observation of an ultralong-lived Rydberg-atom CTC in a driven-dissipative many-body atomic system. By harnessing long-range interactions and engineering a dissipative environment that stabilizes the limit-cycle dynamics, we suppress heating and decay effects that typically destroy time-crystalline order. The key factor underlying the ultralong-lived CTC is the closing of the Liouvillian gap and the near-zero real part of the system's Liouvillian eigenspectrum. Through systematic optimization, we achieve an oscillatory lifetime exceeding 16.95 hours-orders of magnitude longer than previous CTC realizations. Our work establishes a robust platform for exploring long-lived autonomous nonequilibrium phases and paves the way for applications in quantum sensing and continuous-time quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在受驱耗散的多体 Rydberg 原子体系中观测到超长寿命连续时间晶体，其在稳态泵浦下自发破缺连续时间平移对称性并表现为持久振荡。作者通过利用长程相互作用并工程化耗散环境来稳定极限环动力学，从而抑制通常会破坏时间晶体序的加热与衰减。其关键机制与 Liouvillian 能隙闭合及 Liouvillian 本征谱实部接近零有关，优化后振荡寿命超过 16.95 小时。
authors: Qi-Feng Wang, Tian-Yu Han, Ya-Jun Wang, Dong-Yang Zhu, Chao Yu, Yu Ma, Yi-Ming Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Bang Liu, Li-Hua Zhang, Dong-Sheng Ding, Bao-Sen Shi

articles.title: Is the Eyring Plot Misleading? A Case for Arrhenius Analysis of Activation Parameters
articles.title_zh: Eyring 图是否具有误导性？关于用 Arrhenius 分析活化参数的论证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A common view in physical chemistry literature is that the Eyring representation, in which a linear fit of łn(k/T) versus 1/T is attempted, is more fundamental than the Arrhenius representation, łn(k) versus 1/T. This perception is typically motivated by its derivation from statistical mechanics and quantum mechanics, and by the interpretation of the intercept in terms of the activation entropy Δ S^ddagger, whereas the Arrhenius equation and its prefactor are often regarded as purely phenomenological. However, harmonic approximation models yield exact linearity in Arrhenius plots but not in Eyring plots, although for real experimental data both generally appear equally linear within typical experimental accuracy. Furthermore, the impression that the Eyring formulation is inherently quantum mechanical arises from the presence of the Planck constant in the prefactor, whereas this term results from normalization conventions in the partition function. This also highlights an interpretational issue in Δ G^ddagger, which is based on partition functions of different dimensionality between reactant and transition state. This dimensional mismatch can be reformulated in an alternative representation that improves interpretability and reduces to an Arrhenius-type expression in which the prefactor is directly related to an entropy of activation. In this framework, both activation enthalpy and entropy obtained from an Arrhenius fit are arguably more physically relevant than the corresponding Eyring fit values.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作质疑物理化学中将 Eyring 表示视为比 Arrhenius 表示更基本的常见观点。作者指出，在谐近似模型中 Arrhenius 图可严格线性，而 Eyring 图并非如此；实际实验数据中二者通常在误差范围内都近似线性。文章还讨论了 Eyring 公式中 Planck 常数来源于配分函数归一化约定，而非必然体现量子力学本质，并指出由不同维度配分函数构造活化自由能时存在解释上的不匹配。

articles.title: Coherent dynamics of individual excitons in a quantum dot embedded in a nanopost
articles.title_zh: 嵌入纳米柱的量子点中单个激子的相干动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We measured coherent ultrafast dynamics of exciton complexes in a single strongly-confined InAs quantum dot embedded in a GaAs nanopost. Such a photonic structure combines a wave guiding with a cavity effect and assures an enhanced light-matter coupling. Coherence properties of an exciton-biexciton system hosted by a quantum dot are assessed with four-wave mixing microscopy. Our results show that this broad-band photonic structure is an excellent asset to probe coherent couplings in a small set of solid state quantum systems and to investigate the coherence dynamics within the level structure of their excited states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作测量了嵌入 GaAs 纳米柱中的强限域 InAs 单量子点内激子复合体的相干超快动力学。该光子结构同时具有波导和腔效应，可增强光—物质耦合。作者利用四波混频显微技术表征激子—双激子体系的相干性质，表明这种宽带光子结构适合探测少数量子固态体系中的相干耦合及其激发态能级结构动力学。
authors: Maxime Gaignard, Karolina Ewa Polczynska, Niels Gregersen, Daniel Wigger, Jean-Philippe Poizat, Jean-Michel Gérard, Julien Claudon, Jacek Kasprzak

articles.title: Effective theories for many-body systems with nonuniform symmetries
articles.title_zh: 具有非均匀对称性的多体系统有效理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The low-energy dynamics of many-body systems is governed by gapless modes whose properties are dictated by symmetry. Their existence follows from Goldstone's theorem, while their effective description at zero temperature is determined by the pattern of symmetry breaking. At finite temperature, an analogous role is played by hydrodynamics, which describes the universal behavior of many-body systems over long times and large distances. These principles are well understood for uniform symmetries, which act homogeneously in spacetime and lead to a correspondence between massless Goldstone modes and broken generators, as well as gapless hydrodynamic modes and conserved charges. However, this simple picture changes in the presence of nonuniform symmetries, whose generators do not commute with spacetime translations. The low-energy implications of these symmetries remain less understood, as they do not introduce additional gapless modes but instead constrain the dynamics of the existing degrees of freedom. In this thesis, we develop a unified framework for many-body systems with nonuniform symmetries and show that their effects can be understood in terms of additional fields that are not independent at low energies and can be eliminated, leading to kinematic constraints that reshape the infrared dynamics. In systems with spontaneous symmetry breaking, this mechanism modifies the effective theory and often softens the dispersion relations of the remaining modes. At finite temperature, it manifests in hydrodynamics as constraints on macroscopic currents. As a result, nonuniform symmetries give rise to qualitatively new physical phenomena, including modified spectra of collective excitations, exemplified by transverse Tkachenko oscillations in quantum vortex crystals, and unconventional transport phenomena, such as anomalously slow diffusion and softened sound modes in dipole-conserving systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究非均匀对称性对多体系统低能动力学的约束，其中相应生成元不与时空平移对易。不同于均匀对称性中破缺生成元与 Goldstone 模、守恒荷与流体模之间的直接对应，非均匀对称性通常不引入额外无能隙模，而是限制已有自由度的动力学。作者发展了统一的有效理论框架，用于描述零温及有限温下这类对称性对低能有效场论和流体动力学的影响。

articles.title: Level statistics in the fractal phase of generalized Rosenzweig--Porter models
articles.title_zh: 广义 Rosenzweig–Porter 模型分形相中的能级统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Rosenzweig--Porter (RP) random matrix ensemble has emerged as a minimal model for the integrability-to-chaos crossover in quantum many-body systems. Its phase diagram features a region with fractal eigenstates, exhibiting intermediate spectral and localization properties between the fully localized and fully delocalized regimes. In this work, we explore several generalizations of the RP model and determine their level statistics at the scale of the Thouless energy E_T, which characterizes the crossover. Using tools from free probability theory and the replica method, we compute the full counting statistics in the limit of large system size, and show that it takes a simple, universal scaling form around E_T, shared across all variations of the model. We validate our analytical predictions using exact numerical diagonalization of large samples, and large-deviation algorithms that resolve the full counting statistics down to probabilities as low as 10⁻⁴⁰. We also contrast our predictions with measurements on the quantum random energy model, which is the simplest model displaying many-body localization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究广义 Rosenzweig–Porter 随机矩阵模型在分形本征态区域的能级统计，重点关注 Thouless 能量尺度附近的交叉行为。作者结合自由概率论和 replica 方法，在大系统极限下计算完整计数统计，并发现其在 Thouless 能量附近呈现跨模型变体共享的简单普适标度形式。解析结果通过大规模精确对角化和可探测低至 10⁻⁴⁰ 概率的大偏差算法验证，并与量子随机能量模型的测量结果进行比较。
authors: Victor Delapalme, Leticia F. Cugliandolo, Alexander K. Hartmann, Marco Tarzia, Davide Venturelli

articles.title: Strongly correlated quantum matter: t--J model, real-space pairing, spin-dependent masses, and atomicity in chemical bond and nanosystems
articles.title_zh: 强关联量子物质：t–J 模型、实空间配对、自旋依赖质量以及化学键和纳米体系中的原子性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I critically overview my research on strongly correlated fermion systems for almost five decades. It concentrated on: (i) the first derivation of what is now called the t--J model, comprising both the limit of Anderson kinetic exchange of spin--spin interaction in the Mott--Hubbard insulator and taking into account real-space pairing, subsequently applied to high-temperature superconductivity; (ii) the concept of spin-dependent heavy mass of quasiparticles in heavy-fermion systems, and (iii) the first nontrivial model of statistical thermodynamics of the Mott--Hubbard transition. Those three features, together with the specific quantum critical phenomena provide, in my view, fundamental components of the theory of strongly correlated fermions established in the 1960s. Some related questions such as introduction of atomicity in the chemical bonding (iv), and specific properties of correlated nanosystems within the rigorous EDABI (v) approach are also briefly elaborated at the end.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文是作者近五十年强关联费米子体系研究的批判性综述，核心包括 t–J 模型的早期推导、Mott–Hubbard 绝缘体中的 Anderson 动力学交换极限及实空间配对思想，并讨论其与高温超导的联系。文章还回顾了重费米子体系中准粒子自旋依赖重质量概念，以及 Mott–Hubbard 转变的统计热力学模型。最后简要讨论了化学键中的原子性引入和基于 EDABI 方法的关联纳米体系性质。

articles.title: Quantum Chaos with a Macroscopic Zero-Mode Sector
articles.title_zh: 具有宏观零模扇区的量子混沌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chaotic many-body spectra are expected to densely fill their energy window. We show that constrained spin chains with chiral symmetry evade this expectation by hosting an exponentially large manifold of symmetry-protected exact zero modes separated from the surrounding spectrum by a sharp gap at zero energy. The gap is generated by chaotic level repulsion, with width set by the number of zero modes times the mean level spacing. We verify this mechanism in an East-West kinetically constrained chain, develop a minimal random-matrix description, and show how the gap can be detected through linear-response spectroscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作指出，具有手征对称性的受限自旋链可偏离通常混沌多体谱致密填充能窗的预期，产生指数数量的对称性保护精确零模。零模与周围能谱之间出现尖锐的零能隙，该能隙由混沌能级排斥产生，其宽度由零模数目与平均能级间距共同决定。作者在 East–West 动力学受限链中验证该机制，建立最小随机矩阵描述，并提出可通过线性响应谱学探测该能隙。
authors: Cheryne Jonay, Kun W. Kim, Frank Pollmann, Alexander Altland

articles.title: Majorana parity qubit in coupled minimal Kitaev chains
articles.title_zh: 耦合极简 Kitaev 链中的 Majorana 奇偶校验量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Majorana zero modes provide a route to fault-tolerant qubits by encoding information non-locally in fermion parity. Their sensitivity to noise is expected to decrease exponentially with increasing separation between the Majoranas, a suppression known as topological protection. Kitaev chains engineered in quantum dot-superconductor arrays provide a tunable platform in which separated Majorana zero modes can emerge at the ends of the chain, even in two-site chains. These minimal-chain modes are known as poor man's Majoranas and retain characteristic Majorana properties, including near-zero energy and equal electron-hole character, but have only limited protection. A key outstanding challenge is to move beyond identifying such modes in electrical transport measurements and achieve coherent qubit control in the time domain. Here, we demonstrate a Majorana parity qubit by realizing coherent coupling between two-site Kitaev chains. Since total fermion parity is conserved, the system separates into global even and odd parity manifolds. We observe coherent parity oscillations in both manifolds with equal oscillation frequencies at the Majorana sweet spot, as predicted for isolated Majorana zero modes. We further show that the oscillation frequency and coherence depend systematically on inter-chain coupling and quantum-dot detunings, in close agreement with our model for short, partially protected chains. Our results establish the first coherent control of a Majorana qubit, encoded in the fermion parity of Majorana zero modes in minimal Kitaev chains.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在量子点-超导体阵列中耦合两条两站点 Kitaev 链，演示基于 Majorana 零模的费米子奇偶校验量子比特。体系总费米子奇偶性守恒，因此可分解为全局偶、奇两个奇偶性流形；作者在两个流形中均观测到相干奇偶振荡，且振荡频率相同。结果将“穷人的 Majorana”从输运谱识别推进到时域相干操控，但其拓扑保护仍受极简链长度限制。
authors: Francesco Zatelli, Bart Roovers, Nick van Loo, Antonio Lombardi, Juan D. Torres Luna, Sebastian Miles, Vincent P. M. Sietses, Florian J. Bennebroek Evertsz', Pablo Cova Fariña, Alberto Bordin, Ghada Badawy, Erik P. A. M. Bakkers, Michael Wimmer, Leo P. Kouwenhoven

articles.title: Confinement drives valley splitting above 4K in buried silicon quantum wells
articles.title_zh: 限制势驱动埋置硅量子阱中的谷劈裂超过 4 K 能标
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09570v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling the energy scales of a quantum system is essential for defining robust qubits. In silicon spin qubits, the nearly degenerate conduction-band valleys create a leakage channel from the single-spin computational basis, posing a challenge to scaling and to shuttling-based architectures. Here, we measure the relevant energy scales of single-electron spin qubits in buried silicon quantum wells co-designed for low disorder and high valley splitting. Across a linear array of four quantum dots with an average orbital energy of 2.4(2) meV, we report an average single-electron valley splitting of 0.40(6) meV and an average two-electron singlet-triplet splitting of 0.24(7) meV. In three dots, we observe a strong correlation between valley splitting and orbital energy, with an average linear coefficient of approx 0.22 (meV/meV), demonstrating that electrostatic confinement can increase the valley splitting by several hundred microelectronvolts. In contrast, the remaining dot exhibits the highest valley splitting of 0.76(2) meV and low correlation, suggesting excellent characteristics for spin-qubit operation. Our findings demonstrate that strong confinement can be exploited in buried quantum wells to effectively enhance the valley splitting, thereby establishing a viable path toward the realization of shuttling and sparse-occupation-based architectures in low-disorder heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作测量了面向低无序和高谷劈裂设计的埋置硅量子阱中单电子自旋量子比特的关键能标。在四量子点线性阵列中，平均轨道能量为 2.4(2) meV，平均单电子谷劈裂为 0.40(6) meV，平均双电子单重态-三重态劈裂为 0.24(7) meV。三个量子点中谷劈裂与轨道能量强相关，线性系数约 0.22 meV/meV，表明电静限制可将谷劈裂提高数百微电子伏；另一个量子点达到 0.76(2) meV 且相关性低，显示出优良的自旋量子比特工作特性。
authors: Davide Degli Esposti, Emma Catherine Brann, Asser Elsayed, Davide Costa, Mark Friesen, Giordano Scappucci

articles.title: Fluctuation theorems for thermally isolated driven quantum systems: nonadiabaticity, excess work and strong inequalities
articles.title_zh: 热隔离受驱量子系统的涨落定理：非绝热性、过剩功与强不等式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We expand on the ideas developed by C. Jarzynski in Physica A 552, 122077 (2020), where an integral fluctuation theorem was derived with the aim of obtaining thermodynamic inequalities stronger than those implied by the Jarzynski equality. Restricting ourselves to the quantum setting, we derive the corresponding detailed fluctuation theorem and additional detailed and integral fluctuation theorems; we also provide a clear physical interpretation of the stochastic quantities defined in the previous reference. Furthermore, we show that their averages are given by the nonadiabaticity parameter (i.e., the relative entropy between the final state after a finite-time driving protocol and the corresponding adiabatically evolved state) and the excess work (also known as inner friction). We elaborate on the inequalities derived from the fluctuation theorems and discuss their connection to irreversibility and formulations of the Second Law.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将 Jarzynski 关于强于传统 Jarzynski 等式的热力学不等式思想推广到量子情形，推导相应的详细涨落定理以及额外的详细和积分涨落定理。作者澄清了相关随机量的物理含义，并证明其平均值分别对应非绝热性参数，即有限时间驱动后末态与相应绝热演化态之间的相对熵，以及过剩功或内摩擦。文章进一步讨论这些涨落定理导出的不等式与不可逆性和热力学第二定律表述之间的联系。
authors: J. V. M. Steimetz, M. Campisi, M. V. S. Bonança

articles.title: Silicon-Germanium Heterostructures with Enhanced Valley Splitting for Spin Qubits
articles.title_zh: 用于自旋量子比特的增强谷劈裂硅锗异质结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving valley splittings well in excess of the thermal energy of electrons and avoiding valley excitations is essential for the consistent initialization, operation and readout of gate-defined Si spin qubits. In this work, we present a device-level optimization strategy for pushing valley splittings to between 1 and 5 meV, well beyond values reported in nearly all previous theoretical studies. Using device-scale simulations that incorporate atomistic alloy disorder through a 1D tight-binding theory, we demonstrate that our proposed approach yields large valley splittings with a tight distribution across disorder realizations, a key requirement for reproducible qubit performance at scale. The approach rests on an unorthodox Si/SiGe heterostructure design combining a narrow quantum well, a small Ge spike, and a pure-Ge cap. We corroborate these predictions with targeted atomistic density functional theory calculations. These results offer a clear path forward for scalable Si/SiGe spin qubit devices and, if realized experimentally, effectively eliminate valley splitting as an existential problem for large scale SiGe-based quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种器件级优化策略，将 Si/SiGe 栅定义自旋量子比特的谷劈裂提高到 1–5 meV，显著高于多数既有理论研究。作者采用含原子级合金无序的一维紧束缚器件尺度模拟，表明由窄量子阱、小 Ge 尖峰和纯 Ge 盖层组成的非常规异质结构可产生大且分布集中的谷劈裂，有利于大规模器件的一致性。针对性的原子级密度泛函理论计算进一步支持了这些预测；若实验实现，该方案有望基本消除 SiGe 量子处理器中的谷劈裂瓶颈。
authors: David W. Kanaar, Efrain Martinez, Peihong Zhang, Mark F. Gyure

articles.title: Non-Local Magic from the Entanglement Spectrum
articles.title_zh: 来自纠缠谱的非局域魔性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07808v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Non-local magic has recently emerged as a fundamental resource for characterizing genuinely non-local non-stabilizer correlations. However, its direct calculation is an intractable numerical problem, except for small systems, and its understanding remains limited. We derive a representation of non-local magic in terms of the Walsh--Hadamard autocorrelations of the entanglement spectrum. Our representation makes the underlying harmonic structure explicit and enables a systematic analysis of its behaviors for various scenarios. We prove that non-local magic can be upper-bounded by an entanglement entropy and we derive exact analytical results for broad classes of quantum states, characterizing the scaling of non-local magic for volume-law states, as well as ground states of one-dimensional gapped and critical systems. Our results identify the spectral organization of the entanglement spectrum as the key ingredient governing non-local magic and provide a framework for further systematic analytical investigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将非局域魔性表示为纠缠谱的 Walsh–Hadamard 自相关，从而显式揭示其谐波结构并便于系统分析。作者证明非局域魔性可由纠缠熵给出上界，并对体积律态、一维有能隙和临界体系基态等广泛量子态给出解析结果。研究表明，纠缠谱的谱组织方式是决定非局域魔性的关键因素，为该资源的进一步解析研究提供了框架。
authors: Gianpaolo Torre, Fabio Franchini, Salvatore Marco Giampaolo

articles.title: Stochastic Similarity Renormalization Group
articles.title_zh: 随机相似重整化群
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08830v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: By integrating the quantum Monte Carlo technique into the similarity renormalization group (SRG), we have developed a stochastic SRG framework (SRGQMC) capable of both free-space two-body and in-medium many-body evolutions. This approach circumvents the combinatorial tensor-space explosion of many-body flow equations by mapping continuous unitary transformations onto an ensemble of signed random walkers. We benchmark the SRGQMC against deterministic free-space SRG evolutions of realistic nucleon-nucleon (NN) interactions, as well as against in-medium SRG (IMSRG) many-body calculations with the Richardson pairing model at two- and three-body levels [IMSRG(2)/(3)]. While a deterministic extension to the four-body level [IMSRG(4)] remains unfeasible due to prohibitive computational costs, we have achieved the first IMSRG(4) calculation by using the stochastic technique, demonstrating a substantial improvement toward the full configuration-interaction limit. This stochastic framework provides a practical pathway to higher-order IMSRG calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者将量子蒙特卡洛技术并入相似重整化群，建立随机 SRG 框架 SRGQMC，可处理自由空间二体演化和介质中多体演化。该方法把连续幺正变换映射为带符号随机行走者系综，从而绕开多体流方程中张量空间组合爆炸问题。基准测试涵盖现实核子-核子相互作用的确定性自由空间 SRG 以及 Richardson 配对模型中的 IMSRG(2)/(3)；进一步利用随机技术实现了首个 IMSRG(4) 计算，并较全组态相互作用极限取得明显改进。
authors: Rongzhe Hu, Xin Zhen, Furong Xu, Junchen Pei

articles.title: Seeing inside a Plasmonic Nanogap: Few-molecule Orientation and Preferential Adsorption
articles.title_zh: 看入等离激元纳米间隙：少分子取向与择优吸附
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08922v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Molecule-surface interactions are central to many research and technological areas, spanning from heterogeneous catalysis and polymer science to electrochemistry. Of particular relevance are metallic nanogaps used in molecular electronics and near-field spectroscopy. Due to the buried nature of these double interfaces, few methods exist to monitor side-specific interactions and relative molecular orientation inside the gap. In this work, we introduce plasmon-enhanced nonlinear vibrational spectroscopy as an efficient tool to investigate surface molecular adsorption within metallic nanojunctions. By exploiting simultaneous vibrational sum- and difference-frequency generation in dual-resonant nanocavities, we resolve molecular orientation and preferential binding to one of the two gold surfaces, with few-molecule sensitivity. We also discover that the non-resonant (electronic) second-order nonlinear response is not an intrinsic property of the metal surface, but is instead governed by the molecule-surface interaction. Our findings provide a powerful analytical tool, easily implementable as an add-on to Raman spectroscopy, thanks to commercially available mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出等离激元增强非线性振动光谱，用于探测金属纳米结中埋藏双界面的分子吸附。通过双共振纳米腔中的振动和频与差频产生，作者以少分子灵敏度分辨分子取向以及其对两侧金表面之一的择优结合。研究还发现非共振电子二阶非线性响应并非金属表面的固有属性，而是由分子-表面相互作用主导；该方法可作为拉曼光谱的扩展工具用于纳米间隙界面表征。
authors: Francesco Ciccarello, Nobuaki Oyamada, Thwahira Shirin Alampara, Konstantin Malchow, Christophe Galland

articles.title: Quantum field nucleating and Wigner functions
articles.title_zh: 量子场成核与 Wigner 函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09233v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a novel real-time framework for the decay of metastable states in quantum field theories using Wigner functions. The framework introduces a nonperturbative nucleation rate formula that captures both quantum tunneling and over-the-barrier nucleation, alongside steps to evaluate it perturbatively. We apply it to a simple thermal example with direct relevance to current analog experiments. Our derived one-loop nucleation rate fundamentally differs from the widely cited high-temperature result by Linde: The prefactor contains quantum effects and also asymptotes to a differing form at high temperatures, where the quantum effects become negligible. Rather, the result is a generalization of Affleck's rate formula to quantum field theories, asymptoting to the effective field theory approach, and Langer's rate, at high temperatures. The example also reveals that the high-temperature side of the ``quantum-to-classical'' transition of thermal vacuum decay is still inherently quantum mechanical, even though the bounce background possesses the classical, O(d)× S¹, symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出利用 Wigner 函数描述量子场论中亚稳态衰变的实时间框架，并给出同时涵盖量子隧穿和越垒成核的非微扰成核率公式及其微扰求值步骤。作者将方法应用于一个与当前类比实验相关的简单热示例，得到的一圈成核率与 Linde 的高温经典结果在前因子和高温渐近形式上存在根本差异。该结果更接近 Affleck 速率公式向量子场论的推广，并在高温下渐近联系到有效场论方法和 Langer 速率，显示热真空衰变的高温“量子到经典”一侧仍具有内禀量子性。

articles.title: Superconducting singlet-triplet qubits
articles.title_zh: 超导单重态-三重态量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09508v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hybrid devices integrating quantum dots with Josephson junctions are gaining interest because they combine spin-based quantum computing with circuit quantum electrodynamics (circuit QED) methods. In particular, Andreev spin qubits have shown significant experimental progress including strong two-qubit coupling, and are predicted to exhibit all-to-all connectivity. Here we propose superconducting singlet-triplet (SST) qubits that rely on parallel-aligned double quantum dots in Josephson junctions. While Andreev spin qubits require spin-orbit interaction to unlock the spin degree-of-freedom, SST qubits do not require spin-orbit interaction, making the advantages of hybrid devices available to a wider range of materials. Similar to Andreev spin qubits, the qubit states couple to the superconducting phase across the junction, which allows for control and readout using circuit QED, and supports all-to-all connectivity. Only N flux lines are required to perform any single- and two-qubit gate among N qubits, and thus the overhead of control lines is small. Finally, linear protection from charge or flux noise makes these qubits interesting candidates for a future quantum processor.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种基于 Josephson 结中平行排列双量子点的超导单重态-三重态量子比特。与 Andreev 自旋量子比特通常需要自旋-轨道相互作用来解锁自旋自由度不同，该方案不依赖自旋-轨道耦合，因而适用于更广泛材料。量子比特态与结两端超导相位耦合，可用电路 QED 进行控制和读出，并支持全连接；N 个量子比特只需 N 条磁通线即可实现任意单、双比特门，且对电荷或磁通噪声具有一阶保护潜力。
authors: Anatoliy Lotkov, Maria Spethmann, Daniel Loss

articles.title: Complete measurement of tunnel- and valley-coupling parameters in a silicon double quantum dot
articles.title_zh: 硅双量子点中隧穿与谷耦合参数的完整测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09638v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tunneling is essential in the initialization, measurement, and control of quantum dot qubits. In silicon, such tunneling connects not only the qubit states but also valley minima in the conduction band on opposite sides of the Brillouin zone, with large consequences for the quantum dot behavior. Here we present a full characterization of the intravalley and intervalley tunnel couplings, including their complex phases -- the valley phases. These phases are shown to control measurable parameters, including the ratios of the gaps at anticrossings between quantum states of a double quantum dot. The valley phases themselves evolve as a function of the quantum dot gate voltages and depend on the underlying atomic structure of the quantum well. Knowledge of the valley phases completes the picture and fills a key gap in our understanding of sample-wide variations of valley couplings and the physical parameters that depend on them, including spin-orbit coupling, valley-orbit mixing, and Landé g-factors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作完整表征了硅双量子点中的谷内和谷间隧穿耦合，包括其复相位即谷相位。作者表明谷相位控制可观测量，例如双量子点量子态反交叉能隙之间的比值，并且谷相位会随量子点栅压变化，同时依赖量子阱底层原子结构。对谷相位的测定补全了硅量子点中谷耦合样品尺度变化的图像，并有助于理解自旋-轨道耦合、谷-轨道混合和 Landé g 因子等相关物理参数。
authors: Daniel J. King, Minyoung Kim, J. Reily, Jonathan C. Marcks, Mark Friesen, Benjamin D. Woods, M. A. Eriksson

articles.title: Operation of a high-frequency, phase-slip qubit
articles.title_zh: 高频相滑移量子比特的运行
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.07043v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Aluminum-based Josephson junctions are currently the main sources of nonlinearity for control and manipulation of superconducting qubits. A constriction-based junction provides an alternative source of nonlinearity that promises new types of protected qubits and the possibility of high-temperature and high-frequency operation through the use of superconductors with larger energy gaps. Junctions made from such superconductors have been challenging to incorporate into superconducting qubits because of difficulty controlling junction parameters and have had extremely low lifetimes, which limited their utility. Here we demonstrate that junctions made using titanium nitride (TiN) are a promising and controllable qubit platform. We use TiN junctions to build superconducting qubits based on quantum phase slips through the junction. We operate the qubit at zero flux where the qubit frequency (~17 GHz) is mainly determined by the inductance of the qubit. We perform readout and coherent control of the superconducting qubit, and measure qubit lifetimes >60 μs. Finally, we demonstrate operation of the qubit at temperatures exceeding 300 mK. Our results add the TiN-based junction as a tool for superconducting quantum information processing and opens avenues for new classes of superconducting qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作展示了基于氮化钛收缩结的超导相滑移量子比特，作为传统铝 Josephson 结非线性之外的可控平台。器件在零磁通下运行，量子比特频率约 17 GHz，主要由量子比特电感决定；作者实现了读出和相干控制，并测得超过 60 μs 的寿命。该量子比特还可在高于 300 mK 的温度下工作，显示出高频、高温运行以及受保护量子比特设计的潜力。
authors: Cheeranjeev Purmessur, Kaicheung Chow, Bernard van Heck, Angela Kou

articles.title: Variational Monte Carlo Optimization of Topological Chiral Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 拓扑手性超导体的变分蒙特卡洛优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.18582v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We perform the variational Monte Carlo calculation for recently proposed chiral superconducting states driven by strong Coulomb interactions. We compare the resulting energetics of these electronic phases for the electron dispersion relation Eₖ = c₂ k²⁺c₄ k⁴. Motivated by the recent discovery of chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene systems, we apply our analysis to relevant parameter regimes. We demonstrate that topological chiral superconducting phases (including a spin-unpolarized state) can be energetically favored over the spin-valley polarized Fermi liquid above the density of Wigner crystal phase. Our results show that the preference for chiral superconductivity is strongest when c₂ lies between zero and a negative value corresponding to a Fermi sea on the verge of forming a hole pocket around k=0. This finding suggests that superconductivity can arise from pure repulsive Coulomb interactions in systems with an almost flat band bottom, without relying on the pairing instability of a Fermi surface. This mechanism opens a new pathway to superconductivity beyond the conventional BCS mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者对由强库仑相互作用驱动的若干手性超导态进行变分蒙特卡洛计算，并在色散关系 Eₖ = c₂k² + c₄k⁴ 下比较其能量。面向菱方石墨烯相关参数区间，结果表明在高于维格纳晶体相密度时，拓扑手性超导相，包括自旋未极化态，可能比自旋-谷极化费米液体更稳定。当 c₂ 位于零与一个负值之间、体系接近在 k=0 附近形成空穴口袋时，手性超导倾向最强，提示近乎平坦带底体系中纯排斥库仑相互作用也可诱导超导。
authors: Minho Luke Kim, Abigail Timmel, Xiao-Gang Wen

articles.title: Universal valley filtering via uniform dissipation and velocity contrast
articles.title_zh: 通过均匀耗散与速度反差实现普适谷过滤
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.19588v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Valley, as a ubiquitous degree of freedom in lattices, has found wide applications in both electronic and classical-wave devices in recent years. However, achieving valley-polarized states, a prerequisite for valley-based operations, still remains challenging. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a universal non-Hermitian mechanism for valley filtering using only uniform background dissipation, which creates a propagation length contrast between valleys through their intrinsic group velocity differences. We implement this concept in an acoustic crystal, observing switchable and robust valley polarization of sound through large-scale field mapping. Remarkably, our approach is solely based on uniform loss, without the need for any special lattice structures, tailored excitations, or external fields. We further provide designs of our non-Hermitian valley filter on photonic and electronic platforms. Our results offer a simple and effective solution to valley-polarized state generation and may advance the development of novel valley-based devices in both classical and quantum regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出并实验验证了一种非厄米谷过滤机制：仅利用均匀背景损耗，借助不同谷本征群速度差异产生传播长度反差，从而获得谷极化。作者在声学晶体中通过大尺度场映射观测到可切换且稳健的声谷极化。该方法不依赖特殊晶格结构、定制激发或外场，并进一步给出光子和电子平台上的非厄米谷过滤器设计。
authors: Sijie Yue, Wentao Xie, Kai Shao, Hong-yu Zou, Bingbing Wang, Hong-xiang Sun, Y. X. Zhao, Wei Chen, Haoran Xue

articles.title: Fermi-surface-sheet dependent electron-phonon coupling in a borocarbide superconductor YNi₂B₂C
articles.title_zh: 硼碳化物超导体 YNi₂B₂C 中依赖费米面片的电子-声子耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.01700v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We performed de Haas-van Alphen (dHvA) oscillation measurements and band-structure calculations for YNi₂B₂C. Our improved band structure successfully explained the origins of the large dHvA frequencies β and ζ, which were inexplicable in previous works. By comparing experimental effective masses with band masses, we determined the electron-phonon coupling for each orbit. The results showed a clear Fermi-surface-sheet dependence of the electron-phonon coupling strength, especially highlighting that the coupling for the band-28 sheet is very weak, almost absent for the orbit with B parallel c. This finding is consistent with previous observations of dHvA oscillations from this orbit in the mixed state down to very low fields. Amidst growing interest in high-temperature superconductivity driven by electron-phonon coupling in hydrides under high pressure, this study provides foundational data pivotal to precisely understanding electron-phonon coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者结合 de Haas–van Alphen 振荡测量与能带结构计算研究 YNi₂B₂C，并通过改进能带解释了以往难以归属的大 dHvA 频率 β 和 ζ。通过比较实验有效质量与能带质量，逐轨道提取电子-声子耦合强度，发现其具有显著费米面片依赖性。尤其是 band-28 费米面片在 B 平行 c 的轨道上耦合极弱，几乎不存在，这与该轨道在混合态低场下仍可观测 dHvA 振荡相一致。
authors: Taichi Terashima, Hiroyuki Takeya, Hisatomo Harima

articles.title: Formation Dynamics of Quantum Droplets for Homonuclear and Heteronuclear Mixtures
articles.title_zh: 同核与异核混合物中量子液滴的形成动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.18541v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Significant efforts have been devoted to studying the properties of quantum droplets, an ultra low-temperature phase of bosonic quantum matter that emerges as a consequence of the Lee-Huang-Yang fluctuating correction. However, the temporal dynamics of droplet formation for heteronuclear bosonic mixtures is only partially understood. Here, we numerically analyze the droplet formation process for homonuclear and heteronuclear binary bosonic mixtures in one dimension, using a tight-binding model and real-time evolution with a novel, highly robust integration algorithm. We proceed with a systematic scan of interaction intensities, mass ratios, and initial conditions that allows us to characterize quantitative criteria for droplet formation and equilibrium prospects. Noticeably, most droplets readily form across the entire parameter space, although only a small fraction achieves a stable equilibrium configuration within the simulation horizon. We attribute this equilibrium deficiency to damping from a breathing mode, which we extract directly from the width oscillations at late times. Within the balanced subset of results, the Lee-Huang-Yang contribution dominates the binding energy, while the density profile at late times is better described by a soliton-like shape rather than the flat-topped profiles characteristic of larger droplets. Heteronuclear droplets achieve deeper bindings and exhibit larger breathing oscillations in comparison to their homonuclear counterparts, which is consistent with the role of mass-imbalanced kinetic terms. Our analysis distinguishes physical results from artifacts of incomplete relaxation and provides a methodological framework for interpreting real-time quantum droplet simulations in the constrained dissipation regime characteristic of one-dimensional geometries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作数值研究一维同核和异核二组分玻色混合物中量子液滴的形成过程，采用紧束缚模型和一种稳健的实时演化积分算法。作者系统扫描相互作用强度、质量比和初始条件，以刻画液滴形成及达到平衡的定量判据。结果显示多数参数区间中液滴可快速形成，但在模拟时间内只有少部分达到稳定平衡，作者将这种平衡不足归因于呼吸模阻尼，并从后期宽度振荡中提取相关信息。

articles.title: Microscopic screening theory for excitons in two-dimensional materials: A bridge between effective models and ab initio descriptions
articles.title_zh: 二维材料中激子的微观屏蔽理论：连接有效模型与从头算描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.10966v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a computational approach for exciton calculations in two-dimensional (2D) materials within the Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) framework, employing an atomistic description with point-like orbitals. Unlike widespread efficient calculations that rely on classical or effective interaction models, such as the Rytova-Keldysh model, our method incorporates quantum screened interactions. By explicitly computing the 2D dielectric function at the random-phase approximation level, we capture screening effects beyond such approximations with an accuracy akin to first-principles methods. Consequently, we can realistically estimate excitonic binding energies with a bearable computational cost. A detailed account of the various convergence parameters sheds light on a possible cause of the large dispersion of binding energies reported in the literature using first-principles GW/BSE implementations. This work thus provides an alternative pathway towards efficient and faithful dielectric screening and exciton computations in low-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种用于二维材料 Bethe–Salpeter 方程激子计算的原子级点轨道方法，引入量子屏蔽相互作用而非仅依赖 Rytova–Keldysh 等经典或有效模型。通过在随机相近似下显式计算二维介电函数，该方法以接近第一性原理的精度捕捉屏蔽效应，同时保持可承受的计算成本。文中还系统讨论收敛参数，指出其可能解释文献中 GW/BSE 激子束缚能结果分散较大的原因。
authors: P. Ninhos, A. J. Uría-Álvarez, C. Tserkezis, N. A. Mortensen, J. J. Palacios

articles.title: Stochastic Quantum Information Geometry and Speed Limits at the Trajectory Level
articles.title_zh: 轨迹层面的随机量子信息几何与速度极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.12475v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In quantum metrology, precision is typically characterized by an ensemble-averaged quantity, the quantum Fisher information (QFI), which averages over the fluctuations of individual measurement records. Here we introduce the conditional quantum Fisher information (CQFI), a trajectory-level version of the QFI that generalizes the classical stochastic Fisher information to the quantum domain. Defined through the symmetric logarithmic derivative and conditioned on a measurement outcome, the CQFI is a random variable whose average recovers the QFI. Using it, we derive a trajectory-level quantum speed limit, illustrated by the quantum-jump unraveling of a driven thermal qubit. Moreover, the CQFI decomposes into incoherent (population) and coherent (basis-rotation) contributions, together with an interference cross-term. This cross-term vanishes on average but can take negative values along single trajectories, providing a local witness of destructive interference between classical and quantum information channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作引入条件量子 Fisher 信息，作为量子 Fisher 信息在单条测量轨迹层面的推广，并将经典随机 Fisher 信息扩展到量子情形。该量由对称对数导数定义并以测量结果为条件，是一个随机变量，其平均值恢复通常的量子 Fisher 信息。作者据此推导轨迹层面的量子速度极限，并以受驱热量子比特的量子跳跃展开为例；同时将条件量子 Fisher 信息分解为非相干、相干及干涉交叉项，其中交叉项平均为零但单轨迹上可为负。
authors: Pedro B. Melo, Pedro V. Paraguassú, Sílvio M. Duarte Queirós, Fernando Iemini, Mauro Paternostro, Welles A. M. Morgado

articles.title: Chiral switching of elastic spin via dynamic encirclement of exceptional points
articles.title_zh: 通过动态环绕例外点实现弹性自旋的手性切换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dynamically encircling exceptional points (EPs) enables chiral state conversion in classical wave systems. However, whether this mechanism can be extended to chiral spin conversion has remained elusive. Here we demonstrate chiral switching of elastic spin via dynamic encirclement of EPs in a non-Hermitian micropolar (Cosserat) metamaterial. The interplay between micropolar chirality and anisotropic loss generates EPs with a nontrivial Riemann-sheet topology. Encircling these EPs converts the elastic spin, with the final spin sign dictated solely by the handedness of the encircling trajectory. Our results establish a fundamental route for the selective manipulation of elastic spin, opening avenues for non-Hermitian spin phononics and broader applications in other wave systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者证明在非厄米微极性 Cosserat 超材料中，动态环绕例外点可实现弹性自旋的手性切换。微极性手性与各向异性损耗相互作用产生具有非平庸黎曼面拓扑的例外点，环绕这些例外点会转换弹性自旋。最终自旋符号仅由环绕路径的手性决定，为选择性操控弹性自旋和非厄米自旋声子学提供了机制。

articles.title: A Scalable Approach to Solve the Carleman Linearized Burgers' Equation on a Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 在量子计算机上求解 Carleman 线性化 Burgers 方程的可扩展方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08976v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Efficiently solving nonlinear ordinary and partial differential equations using a quantum computer is a major challenge due its inherent linearity. To circumvent this challenge, the Carleman linearization method has been proposed to transform a nonlinear ordinary differential equation into a linear system of equations, the primary advantage being that existing quantum linear systems algorithms may then be applied to obtain a solution. However, this methodology also brings forth several major challenges that must be addressed to attain a quantum advantage. Herein, we address several of these challenges enabling us to solve the Carleman linearized one-dimensional Burgers' equation on real and simulated quantum hardware. All simulations were performed on BlueQubit's platform allowing for quantum circuits to be run on GPU or QPU's seamlessly. We first demonstrate that the Carleman linearized Burgers' equation can be efficiently loaded onto a quantum computer using the linear combination of non-unitaries method, an alternative to the linear combintaiton of unitaries approach. Once loaded, the linear system is then solved using the variational quantum linear solver. Since a naive implementation of this solver is hindered by the barren plateau phenomenon, we introduce a multigridding method to solve the problem in a series of stages with the solution of the previous stage acting as a warm start for the next stage. This approach is found to significantly improve the accuracy of the solution compared with a naive cold start. Finally, circuits with a combined number of spatial and temporal discretization points totaling up to 2⁸⁰ approx 10²⁴ are transpiled onto real quantum hardware demonstrating that the proposed methodology could feasibly produce a quantum advantage on future hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向量子计算求解非线性微分方程的难题，采用 Carleman 线性化将一维 Burgers 方程转化为可由量子线性系统算法处理的线性系统。作者针对获得量子优势所需的若干关键瓶颈提出处理方案，并在真实与模拟量子硬件上进行实现。文中还展示了可用非酉算符线性组合方法高效加载 Carleman 线性化后的 Burgers 方程，随后用变分量子线性求解流程处理该系统。
authors: Reuben Demirdjian, Yvan Quinn, Vincent P. Su, Hrant Gharibyan, Hayk Tepanyan

articles.title: Quantum Scattering Model of Dual Parallel Mach Zehnder Electro Optic Modulators: General Formalism, Impairments, and Applications to Frequency-Bin Photonic Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 双并联 Mach–Zehnder 电光调制器的量子散射模型：一般形式、非理想因素及频率-bin 光子量子态应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09198v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a quantum mechanical model of dual parallel Mach Zehnder electro-optic modulators (DPMZMs), derived using the quantum scattering formalism [1,2]. We obtain the complete, unrestricted transformation of single-photon and coherent input states through the DPMZM architecture, including independent radiofrequency drive conditions on each internal modulator, and recover the symmetric push pull operating point as an exact special case. We numerically evaluate the resulting frequency comb structure, quantify the device sensitivity to bias error, modulation-index imbalance, and RF noise, and use the model to design a DP-MZM-based frequency-bin qubit source, reporting its fidelity as a function of these impairments.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者基于量子散射形式建立双并联 Mach–Zehnder 电光调制器的量子力学模型，给出单光子态和相干输入态通过该架构的完整变换。模型允许各内部调制器具有独立射频驱动条件，并将对称推挽工作点作为严格特例恢复。作者数值分析所得频率梳结构，量化偏置误差、调制指数不平衡和射频噪声的影响，并用于设计基于 DPMZM 的频率-bin 量子比特源及评估其保真度。
authors: Mar Yuste, Carlos R. Fernández Pousa, Javier Fraile Peláez, José Capmany

articles.title: Ab initio quantum embedding at finite temperature with density matrix embedding theory
articles.title_zh: 基于密度矩阵嵌入理论的有限温度从头算量子嵌入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.01641v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a finite-temperature extension of density matrix embedding theory (FT-DMET) for realistic crystalline systems. We describe a practical framework for constructing extended bath orbitals, solving the embedding problem, and performing DMET self-consistency at finite temperature. To reduce computational cost, we introduce strategies based on mutual-information-guided bath truncation, controlled treatment of the thermal electron number without explicit optimization, and the use of low-temperature impurity solvers and one-shot FT-DMET in the low-temperature regime. We apply this approach to periodic hydrogen chains and square lattices to characterize their finite-temperature phases. We observe the Pomeranchuk-like effect in one dimension and enhanced stability of long-range order in two dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出适用于真实晶体体系的有限温度密度矩阵嵌入理论扩展，涵盖扩展浴轨道构造、嵌入问题求解和有限温度 DMET 自洽流程。为降低计算成本，作者引入互信息引导的浴截断、无需显式优化的热电子数控制、低温杂质求解器以及低温区的一次性 FT-DMET 策略。应用于周期氢链和方格体系后，作者刻画了有限温度相行为，并观察到一维中的类 Pomeranchuk 效应及二维中长程有序稳定性增强。
authors: Laurence Giordano, Y. Stanley Tan, Zhi-Hao Cui, Chong Sun

articles.title: Quantum Circuits in Diffusion Models: A Fair-Comparison Study and a Mechanistic Analysis of Angle-Embedding Failures
articles.title_zh: 扩散模型中的量子线路：公平比较研究与角度嵌入失效机制分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the integration of variational quantum circuits (VQCs) into diffusion models through a squeeze-and-excitation (SE) channel-modulation scaffold that isolates the quantum contribution. Using a role-matched classical control and multi-seed significance testing across DDPM and latent diffusion on MNIST and CIFAR-10, with a score-based NCSN study on MNIST, we find that quantum cores achieve comparable mean FID to the classical control across DDPM and latent diffusion, while paired sampling-seed tests for EfficientSU2 detect no statistically significant difference. Although the quantum cores use 4.5--9× fewer core parameters than the role-matched control, parameter-matched classical controls attain comparable mean FID, so the experiments do not establish a quantum parameter-efficiency advantage. We further identify a structural failure in score-based NCSN: the unbounded score target, proportional to 1/σ, drives angle-embedding inputs far beyond the 2π period of rotation gates, causing phase aliasing and collapse of the quantum modulator. A bounding transformation, θ łeftarrow π tanh(ḑot), maps inputs to the non-aliasing domain and substantially improves both quantum cores. Since all circuits are classically simulated at a few-qubit scale, we do not claim quantum advantage. Instead, the study provides a fair-comparison protocol for quantum-enhanced generative models and a mechanistic account of when and why angle embeddings fail.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究将变分量子线路通过 squeeze-and-excitation 通道调制结构嵌入扩散模型，并用角色匹配的经典对照在 MNIST、CIFAR-10 的 DDPM 和潜空间扩散模型中进行多随机种子显著性检验。结果显示量子核心在平均 FID 上与经典对照相近，EfficientSU2 的配对采样种子检验未发现统计显著差异；尽管量子核心参数更少，参数匹配经典对照也能达到类似性能，因此未证明量子参数效率优势。作者还指出在基于分数的 NCSN 中，无界分数目标会使角度嵌入超出旋转门 2π 周期而发生相位混叠，并提出有界变换缓解该塌缩问题。

articles.title: GenVid2Robot: From Video Generation to Robot Manipulation via Rigid-Geometric Consistency
articles.title_zh: GenVid2Robot：通过刚体几何一致性将视频生成转化为机器人操作
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09191v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generated videos provide useful visual motion priors for robot manipulation, but their visual plausibility does not imply physical executability. A generated video usually lacks metric geometry, grasp grounding, robot kinematic feasibility, and execution-time feedback, which makes direct trajectory replay unreliable in real-world manipulation. This paper presents GenVid2Robot, a rigid-geometric consistency framework that converts generated video motion into executable real-robot manipulation trajectories. Given an initial RGB-D observation and a task instruction, GenVid2Robot samples task-relevant semantic anchors from the real first frame, tracks these anchors through generated video candidates, and verifies whether the resulting 2D motion can be explained by first-frame RGB-D anchors under a sparse relative SE(3) model. In this way, generated videos are treated as uncertain visual motion hypotheses rather than direct robot demonstrations. Only geometrically consistent motion is transferred to the robot. The accepted relative motion is then applied to the real grasp-time TCP pose selected by mask-constrained grasping, producing a grasp-conditioned execution trajectory that is consistent with both the visual motion prior and the physical grasp configuration. To reduce execution mismatch caused by RGB-D noise, calibration residuals, and small contact-induced displacement, a bounded depth-compensation module corrects local depth-direction errors without assuming full online replanning. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that GenVid2Robot improves the reliability of generated-video-guided manipulation by grounding visual motion priors with sparse metric geometry, grasp constraints, robot feasibility checking, and bounded execution feedback.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 GenVid2Robot，将生成视频中的视觉运动先验转化为真实机器人可执行的操作轨迹，同时避免直接回放因缺乏度量几何、抓取定位、运动学可行性和执行反馈而不可靠的问题。方法从初始 RGB-D 观测和任务指令出发，在真实首帧中采样任务相关语义锚点，跟踪其在候选生成视频中的运动，并检验二维运动是否可由首帧 RGB-D 锚点下的稀疏相对 SE(3) 模型解释。只有通过几何一致性验证的运动会被迁移到机器人，并结合受掩膜约束的抓取选择生成真实抓取时 TCP 位姿上的相对运动。
authors: Haohui Huang, Xi Yuan, Panpan Liao, Tao Teng, Chenguang Yang, Jing Guo, Yi Guo

articles.title: QAgent: An LLM-based Multi-Agent System for Autonomous OpenQASM programming
articles.title_zh: QAgent：基于大语言模型的自主 OpenQASM 编程多智能体系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.20134v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Programming quantum circuits at the OpenQASM level is essential for achieving hardware-aware optimization and reliable execution on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices, yet it remains challenging due to the need for domain-specific planning, iterative code synthesis, and low-level calibration. In this paper, we present QAgent, the first autonomous multi-agent framework for end-to-end OpenQASM code generation. QAgent integrates schema-aware task planning, example- and tool-driven code synthesis, and hardware-aware calibration within a unified planning-synthesis-calibration workflow. The system leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to access structured kernel knowledge, examples, and backend constraints, and employs coordinated multi-agent reasoning with iterative execution feedback to ensure correctness. We evaluate QAgent on 12 representative quantum kernels and their compositions across five large language models (LLMs). Results show that QAgent improves Pass@1 accuracy by 47-70% on single-kernel tasks and achieves over 88% accuracy on multi-kernel workflows for large models, substantially outperforming existing baselines. Furthermore, under realistic hardware frequency drift, QAgent maintains near-unit execution fidelity through automated calibration, whereas SDK-based LLM methods suffer significant degradation. These results demonstrate that integrating planning, synthesis, and calibration is critical for reliable quantum program generation. The implementation of QAgent is open-sourced at https://github.com/fuzhenxiao/QAgent

articles.title: Centriole Elimination as a Gateway to a New Differentiation State
articles.title_zh: 中心粒清除作为进入新分化状态的通道
articles.abstract: No one has tested whether a somatic cell stripped of its centrioles can be pushed to a more plastic state. A systematic search of the literature — sixty verified PMIDs — turns up nothing. The closest experiment, by Renzova and colleagues (2018), showed that removing centrioles from already-pluripotent stem cells triggers their differentiation. What happens in the opposite direction — removing centrioles from a fibroblast, then adding Yamanaka factors — has simply never been tried. The CEDAR hypothesis makes a specific, falsifiable claim about this gap. The centriole, it holds, is a physical barrier to reprogramming. Over time the organelle accumulates polyglutamylation on its tubulin — a form of structural entropy — and the proteins at its appendages remodel into a Centrosome-Associated Memory Complex, or CAMC. CEDAR argues that CAMC actively maintains the differentiated state. If the hypothesis is right, eliminating centrioles before OSKM exposure should raise reprogramming efficiency, not lower it. The claim seems counterintuitive only if one thinks of the centriole as a spindle-organizer. If it is instead a hub for fate-determining signals — ODF2, AKNA, NANOG — removing it removes a lock. The evidence that centrioles matter for cell fate is broad. In C. elegans, 88% of somatic cells eliminate their centrioles during embryogenesis on a rigid, cell-type-specific schedule. In planarians, stem cells lack centrioles entirely; the organelles appear de novo only when a cell commits to differentiation. In Drosophila, Polo kinase drives centriole elimination during oogenesis — block it, and the flies are sterile. In mammals, the older mother centrosome segregates asymmetrically at division and helps determine whether a daughter becomes an effector T-cell or a memory T-cell, a neuron or a progenitor. This paper describes a thirteen-group experiment that pits five competing hypotheses against one another. Chemical elimination with centrinone preserves CAMC on existing centrioles; physical ablation with a laser removes everything. If the two methods give different results, CAMC is real. If they give the same result, the centriole’s microtubules — not its signaling surface — carry the relevant information. Every possible outcome is informative. The experiment is technically feasible with off-the-shelf reagents, a three-year timeline, and a budget under three million euros. Whatever it finds, it will settle a question at the intersection of centrosome biology, stem cell reprogramming, and the biology of aging.

articles.title: The Ultrafast Dynamics of Two-dimensional Bi2TexSe3-x Nanosheets

articles.abstract: In this paper, this essay suggests a method for quantitative comparison of the dominant mechanism transform in topological insulator Bi2TexSe3-x nanosheets or other similar materials, which is beneficial to their photoelectric applications.The ultrafast dynamics properties of Bi2TexSe3-x nanosheets are investigated by time-resolved photoluminescence (PL) and pump-probe techniques in visible wavelength range(ps or ns duration).The pump probe results in near-infrared wavelength (1550 nm) also gave a side proof. The steady state PL peaks of three nanosheets are asymmetric, because of strong spin-orbit coupling. All the PL lifetimes in 400 nm are around 0.2 ns, dominanted by the carrier recombination and nonradiation channels (traps, defects);all the PL lifetimes in 500 ~ 550 nm range are around 1.2 ns, which were caused by the thermal effects. But in 450nm, with the increase of Se atoms, the ratio of these two effects changes from 2:8 to 6:4, meaning an obvious reverse of dominant mechanism. The electron-phonon relaxation lifetime, measured by pump-probe in near-infrared wavelength (1550 nm), is changed from 1.49 ps to 0.85 ps with the value of x from 3 to 0. It observation indirectly indicates that increasing the number of Se atoms caused enhanced the thermal effect.
