The detected extreme structures appear as short-lived bursts of unexpectedly strong field variability, with implications for electric-field energy deposition rates in space weather modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作基于 ICEBEAR VHF 雷达观测的三米尺度 Farley-Buneman 不规则体，发展了自动探测和跟踪公里尺度簇团的方法，用以刻画极光区电场结构。每个簇团由 Alpha-shape 边界逐时监测，并通过借鉴多目标跟踪的最优分配算法识别时间演化，该算法综合连续帧重叠程度和由先前位移预测的位置。方法可处理簇团的生成、消亡、分裂和合并，并用分段线性回归提取速度；所得速度已与卫星原位观测验证，且在 2024 年 5 月 10 日 G5 磁暴期间发现异常大的漂移速度。
authors: Magnus F Ivarsen, Jean-Pierre St-Maurice, Yukinaga Miyashita, Saif Marei, Jordan Cho, Mahith Madhanakumar, Megan Gillies, Dan Billett, Glenn C Hussey

articles.title: A Computationally Efficient Reciprocal Effective Roughness Model for Diffuse Scattering
articles.title_zh: 一种用于漫散射的高效互易有效粗糙度模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.17988v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Ray-tracing (RT) has become central to site-specific electromagnetic propagation modeling in dynamic complex environments. Yet its computational burden grows sharply as high-fidelity digital twins of these environments scale to millions of facets whose material parameters must be continuously updated as the environment changes. The challenge is amplified at mmWave and sub-THz frequencies, where surface roughness becomes comparable to the wavelength and so diffuse scattering can account for up to 40% of the received power, making accurate yet tractable models essential. The popular Effective Roughness (ER) approach offers physical consistency but become increasingly costly when highly directive lobes are required or when parameters must be iteratively tuned. This communication introduces a directive, reciprocal diffuse scattering model that preserves the structure of the ER while enabling an order-of-magnitude reduction in computational cost. Validation across eight materials shows no loss in accuracy - and a slight improvement - demonstrating a scalable and physically meaningful solution for RT in scenarios where diffuse scattering is non-negligible.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对复杂动态环境中射线追踪电磁传播建模的计算负担，提出一种定向且满足互易性的漫散射模型。毫米波和亚太赫兹频段下表面粗糙度可与波长相当，漫散射可能贡献显著接收功率，而传统有效粗糙度模型在高指向性散射瓣或参数迭代调优时成本较高。新模型保持有效粗糙度方法的物理结构，同时将计算成本降低约一个数量级；在八种材料上的验证显示精度无损且略有提升。
authors: Giacomo Melloni, Enrico M. Vitucci, Vittorio Degli Esposti, Samuel Berweger, Jack Chuang, Camillo Gentile, Nada Golmie

articles.title: Generative Modeling of Quantum Distribution with Functional Flow Matching
articles.title_zh: 基于函数流匹配的量子分布生成建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emergence of powerful deep generative models based on diffusion and flow matching has enabled the learning and modeling of complex distributions. Learning quantum distributions, however, remains challenging due to the inherent difficulty of accurately modeling the meaningful physical properties of quantum states. We propose Quantum Flow Matching (QFM), a novel generative model designed to learn quantum distribution by utilizing spin Wigner function and flow matching. By converting density matrix into the spin Wigner function and leveraging functional flow matching to learn distributions in function space, QFM enables accurate and effective learning of multi-qubit quantum distributions. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by evaluating physical quantities such as trace, purity, and entanglement entropy of the generated quantum states, accurately capturing the underlying physics of the given quantum distributions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出量子流匹配（QFM），通过将密度矩阵转换为自旋 Wigner 函数，并在函数空间中利用函数流匹配学习多量子比特量子态分布。作者以迹、纯度和纠缠熵等物理量评估生成态，表明该方法能较准确地捕捉给定量子分布的物理性质。
authors: Jaehoon Hahm, Tak Hur, Joonseok Lee, Daniel K. Park

articles.title: Which Metric Reflects the Spelling Rate Accuracy in Event-Related Potential-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces?
articles.title_zh: 事件相关电位脑机接口中哪种指标能反映拼写率准确性？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00794v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For predictive models, the often-reported performance metrics are the loss and accuracy. In synchronous Brain- Computer Interface (BCI) systems, these metrics are informative for most BCI paradigms; however, for Event-Related Potential (ERP) applications the spelling rate, which measures the number of characters correctly selected is more important as it influences the estimation of information transfer rate (ITR) and any related metric measuring spelling performance. Moreover, ERP-based BCIs hold imbalanced data class distributions, which require reporting metrics that can handle the imbalance, such as the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC). In this work, we study the correlation of the spelling rate with 13 metrics to identify which among them best reflect user spelling performance and how they are affected by trial repetition. The Results of two datasets (a private LARESI ERP dataset and the public OpenBMI ERP dataset) favor the Brier score, Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC), and the metrics that account for class imbalance in binary classification: ROC AUC, area under the Precision-Recall curve (PR AUC), Average Precision (AP), and partial AUC (pAUC). These findings encourage researchers and practitioners to report those metrics in ERP-based BCI experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注 ERP 脑机接口中常用损失和准确率是否能反映实际拼写率，并考虑类别不平衡对指标选择的影响。作者在私有 LARESI ERP 数据集和公开 OpenBMI ERP 数据集上比较拼写率与 13 种指标的相关性，结果倾向于 Brier 分数、Matthews 相关系数以及 ROC AUC、PR AUC 等处理类别不平衡的指标。
authors: Okba Bekhelifi, Naoual El Djouher Mebtouche

articles.title: Human-Machine Collaboration on Generative Meta-Learning: Model and Algorithm
articles.title_zh: 生成式元学习中的人机协作：模型与算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generalizing machine learning models to environments that differ from their training distribution remains a critical hurdle, particularly when data from the target domain is entirely or partially unavailable. We propose Generative Meta-Learning with Human Feedback (GMHF), a novel framework that bridges this domain gap by leveraging expert intuition to guide data synthesis. Grounded in a theoretical analysis of generalization error, we derive bounds demonstrating that aligning the distribution of generated data with human beliefs regarding the target physics significantly mitigates risk. GMHF operationalizes this insight by employing a Conditional Neural ODE (cNODE) as a generative digital twin, coupled with a Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent. The agent iteratively refines the latent physical parameters of the generated trajectories based on feedback, effectively steering the meta-learner toward the unobserved target distribution. Empirical validation on a nonlinear Duffing oscillator shows that GMHF substantially reduces deployment loss as expert reliability increases, and that the divergence between generated and target data falls under reliable feedback, directly corroborating the divergence-minimisation mechanism predicted by our theory. Further experiments on a non-dynamical probabilistic model confirm that the framework extends beyond ODE-governed systems, establishing human-AI collaboration as a rigorous catalyst for robust generalisation under distribution shift.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出带人类反馈的生成式元学习（GMHF），利用专家直觉引导数据合成，以缩小训练分布与目标环境之间的域差距。方法以条件神经 ODE 构建生成式数字孪生，并用强化学习代理根据反馈调整潜在物理参数；在非线性 Duffing 振子实验中，专家可靠性提高时部署损失降低，生成数据与目标数据的差异也减小。

articles.title: Diffeomorphic Optimization
articles.title_zh: 微分同胚优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00947v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative models learn data distributions that reside on a low-dimensional manifold within a higher-dimensional ambient space. Optimizing differentiable objectives on this manifold is challenging: the ambient loss landscape is high-dimensional, rugged, and non-convex. Direct gradient descent, blind to the manifold's geometry, quickly drifts off it. Diffeomorphic optimization starts from the observation that diffusion and flow models provide a map from the data manifold to a much simpler base space in which we perform gradient descent. Using differential geometry, we show this is equivalent to Riemannian gradient descent on the data manifold up to O(łambda²⁾ corrections, keeping trajectories on-manifold by construction and yielding a smoother optimization surface. For protein design, we extend diffeomorphic optimization to the matrix Lie groups SO(3) and SE(3), deriving an autograd-compatible SO(3) gradient and a generalized adjoint-state method for backpropagation through Lie-group ODE solvers. Diffeomorphic optimization improves over tuned guidance on secondary-structure targeting with FrameFlow (91.3% vs. 63.3% of residues in the Ramachandran target), outperforms OC-Flow on peptide binding affinity at 2× the speed, and reduces Rosetta energies by thousands of units across the PDB test set for structures with hundreds of residues.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出在生成模型诱导的数据流形上进行优化的“微分同胚优化”框架：借助扩散或流模型将数据流形映射到更简单的基空间，在其中执行梯度下降。作者从微分几何角度说明该过程近似等价于数据流形上的黎曼梯度下降，并将其扩展到蛋白质设计中的 SO(3) 和 SE(3) 李群；在 FrameFlow 二级结构靶向任务上，相比调优后的引导方法取得更高的目标残基比例。
authors: Ludwig Winkler, Andrew Leaver-Fay, Joseph Kleinhenz, Pan Kessel

articles.title: Balancing Expressivity and Learnability in Quantum Kernel Bandit Optimization
articles.title_zh: 量子核赌博机优化中表达能力与可学习性的平衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01080v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate Gaussian process (GP) bandit optimization with quantum kernels, assuming the mean reward function lies in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) induced by the quantum kernel. This setting is motivated by NISQ-era tasks such as quantum control, state preparation and variational quantum algorithms. While quantum kernels can offer a `quantum advantage' via domain-specific inductive biases, naïvely using full, high-dimensional kernels increases model complexity and information gain, leading to higher cumulative regret and poor learnability. To address this, we propose projected quantum kernels and classical kernel approximation techniques that reduce feature dimensionality while preserving key quantum properties. Using these approximate kernels, we develop misspecified GP bandit algorithms and derive regret bounds that characterize the trade-off between approximation error and information gain. The regret bounds provide principled guidance for selecting the optimal model complexity. Empirically, our methods outperform full quantum kernels in sample efficiency, while substantially reducing computational overhead, enabling scalable GP optimization for quantum-native applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究带量子核的高斯过程赌博机优化，假设平均奖励函数属于量子核诱导的再生核希尔伯特空间。作者指出完整高维量子核虽可能提供领域归纳偏置，但会增加模型复杂度和信息增益，从而恶化累积遗憾；为此提出投影量子核和经典核近似，并给出错设 GP 赌博机算法的遗憾界，以刻画近似误差与信息增益之间的权衡。实验显示近似核在样本效率和计算开销上优于完整量子核。
authors: Yuqi Huang, Vincent Y. F. Tan, Sharu Theresa Jose

articles.title: QuasiMoTTo: Quasi-Monte Carlo Test-Time Scaling
articles.title_zh: QuasiMoTTo：准蒙特卡洛测试时扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01179v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling inference compute, by generating many parallel attempts per problem, is a costly but reliable lever for improving language model capabilities. By default these attempts are generated independently, wasting inference compute on redundant solutions. This waste seems unavoidable. After all, independence is what makes parallel sampling trivial to scale. However, this tradeoff is not fundamental: there is a rich design space of samplers that generate correlated but exact samples entirely in parallel. We explore this design space as an avenue for improving sample efficiency in scaling inference compute and reinforcement learning (RL). Concretely, we introduce QuasiMoTTo, which uses correlated samples as a drop-in replacement for i.i.d. samples. To generate these samples, QuasiMoTTo uses a reparameterization of autoregressive sampling as inverse-CDF sampling and draws the underlying uniforms with quasi-Monte Carlo (QMC); because QMC spreads the uniforms out more evenly than i.i.d., the resulting samples cover the output space with far less redundancy. Even though the batch is correlated, each sample is marginally distributed according to the language model, so we can use the batch for policy-gradient training. Our empirical analysis focuses on understanding how efficiently QuasiMoTTo can turn compute into performance. To evaluate correlated samplers, whose dependence breaks standard pass@k estimators, we first develop an unbiased bootstrap estimator. Across four reasoning benchmarks, QuasiMoTTo matches i.i.d. pass@k accuracy with 25-47% fewer samples. Strikingly, QuasiMoTTo often saturates an upper bound on pass@k that holds for any marginal-preserving sampler. We also apply QuasiMoTTo to policy-gradient RL (GRPO) where it matches i.i.d. performance with 50% fewer training steps. These gains come from higher coverage, which yields a stronger learning signal per batch.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对语言模型测试时通过并行生成多次尝试来提升能力但存在重复采样浪费的问题，提出 QuasiMoTTo。该方法将自回归采样重参数化为逆 CDF 采样，并用准蒙特卡洛生成更均匀分布的底层均匀变量，从而产生边际分布正确但彼此相关的样本，作为独立同分布采样的即插即用替代方案，以提升推理计算扩展和强化学习中的样本效率。
authors: Michael Y. Li, Anthony Zhan, Kanishk Gandhi, Noah D. Goodman, Emily B. Fox

articles.title: Quantum vs. Classical Machine Learning: A Unified Empirical Comparison
articles.title_zh: 量子机器学习与经典机器学习：统一的实证比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computing has emerged as a promising computational paradigm for machine learning (ML), with the potential to offer computational advantages over classical approaches. At this stage, the evidence supporting the performance and advantages of quantum machine learning (QML) models relative to classical models is insufficient.To address this gap, this paper presents an empirical study on the performance of QML models and their classical counterparts. We compare seven model pairs spanning supervised learning and reinforcement learning. Our results indicate that the evaluated quantum machine learning models do not yet surpass the classical baselines in overall prediction performance, policy stability, or training time. Nevertheless, QML remains a promising approach for filtering noise and controlling false positives. Our research findings summarize the challenges facing quantum machine learning across hardware environments, training efficiency, and convergence stability, providing a foundation for research into the robustness and parameter optimization of QML. This work is publicly available at https://github.com/Z-537-437/QML.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文对量子机器学习模型及其经典对应模型进行统一实证比较，覆盖监督学习和强化学习中的七组模型对。结果显示，所评估的 QML 模型在总体预测性能、策略稳定性和训练时间上尚未超过经典基线，但在噪声过滤和控制假阳性方面仍显示潜力；作者进一步总结了 QML 在硬件环境、训练效率和收敛稳定性方面的挑战。
authors: Chuanming Yu, Jiaming Liu, Zihao Ge, Xiongfei Wu, Lulu Zhu, Pengzhan Zhao, Jianjun Zhao

articles.title: Why Advanced Encoders Lag on Sparse Retrieval? The Answer and an Approach to Bridging Vocabulary Gaps
articles.title_zh: 为什么先进编码器在稀疏检索中落后？原因及弥合词表鸿沟的方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00004v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While advanced foundation models like ModernBERT significantly outperform older architectures in dense retrieval, they surprisingly lag behind the aging BERT-base baseline in learned sparse retrieval (LSR). We identify the root cause as the Vocabulary Gap: modern tokenizers utilize raw, case-sensitive vocabularies designed for lossless reconstruction, which map single semantic units to redundant surface forms, wasting model capacity on morphological noise and hindering lexical matching. We formalize this intuition through a theoretical framework, demonstrating that appropriate vocabulary coarse-graining can tighten the generalization bounds by reducing complexity of the hypothesis class, provided that semantic integrity is preserved. To resolve this, we propose Vocabulary Transfer (VT), a model-agnostic framework that migrates advanced encoders to sparse-friendly, normalized vocabularies with minimal computational cost. VT utilizes a novel Semantic Initialization via spatial topology to preserve geometric structure and an Activation Potential Calibration (APC) mechanism to align pre-trained manifolds with sparsity constraints, preventing the dead neuron and dense collapse observed in standard fine-tuning. Empirically, VT is universally effective: it enables ModernBERT to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the BEIR benchmark (52.4 nDCG, a +4.7 improvement), resuscitates failing models like RoBERTa-large, and generalizes seamlessly to inference-free architectures and specialized domains. These results confirm that the performance lag is not an architectural deficiency but a solvable vocabulary mismatch. We've released our code and models.footnote{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/vocab-transfer/. All details included.}
articles.abstract_zh: 该文解释了 ModernBERT 等先进基础模型在稠密检索中优于旧模型、却在学习型稀疏检索中落后于 BERT-base 的原因，归结为现代分词器带来的“词表鸿沟”。作者认为原始、区分大小写且面向无损重构的词表会把同一语义单元拆成冗余表面形式，浪费模型容量并削弱词项匹配；为此提出词表迁移框架，通过语义初始化和激活势校准将先进编码器迁移到更适合稀疏检索的规范化词表。

articles.title: Bridging Quantum Computing Paradigms toward Semiconductor Yield: A Controlled CV-versus-DV Comparison on Wafer-Map Defect Classification
articles.title_zh: 面向半导体良率的量子计算范式衔接：晶圆图缺陷分类中的连续变量与离散变量受控比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00961v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Realizing quantum neural networks (QNNs) in industry requires knowing which quantum computing paradigm suits which task. Motivated by AI accelerators and high-bandwidth memory, where die stacking makes wafer-level defect screening central to yield, we study WM-811K wafer-map defect classification (eight classes), comparing the dominant paradigms, continuous-variable (CV) and discrete-variable (DV), under controlled conditions. To isolate the quantum circuit as the sole variable, a shared convolutional backbone (~4.3M parameters) feeds interchangeable heads (classical dense, CV-QNN, or DV-QNN) as the only structural difference; each quantum head is scaled over three sizes (3, 4, 8 qumodes/qubits). The CV head consistently outperforms the DV head: at four qumodes/qubits it reaches 79.7 +/- 1.8% accuracy versus 61.6 +/- 1.4%, a non-overlapping 18-point gap. The advantage is sharpest on the spatially localized Edge-Loc class, easily confused with Scratch, which CV recovers with recall 0.66 +/- 0.06 while DV fails at every size (<=0.05), showing the structured CV layer better captures fine spatial distinctions between defect types. Training curves show the DV limitation is a representational-capacity ceiling, not an optimization failure; at the Fock cutoff used here (d = 2) the CV advantage reflects two intrinsic properties, a structured, neural-network-analogue layer and continuous phase-space encoding, not Hilbert-space dimensionality. On IBM hardware, DV accuracy holds at shallow depth, degrading only at the deepest circuit. Both quantum heads remain below the classical baseline (85.0%), but the controlled setting isolates where a structured head already helps and, as noise and scale improve, which paradigm can deliver practical advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以 WM-811K 晶圆图八类缺陷分类为任务，在共享卷积骨干网络下仅替换分类头，受控比较连续变量（CV）和离散变量（DV）量子神经网络。结果显示 CV 头稳定优于 DV 头，四个量子模式/量子比特时准确率约为 79.7% 对 61.6%；在容易与 Scratch 混淆的空间局部 Edge-Loc 类上，CV 显著提高召回率，表明结构化 CV 层更能捕捉细粒度空间缺陷差异。
authors: Yeonhong Kim, Jonghyeok Im, Monu Nath Baitha, Kyoungsik Kim

articles.title: Distill to Detect: Exposing Stealth Biases in LLMs through Cartridge Distillation
articles.title_zh: 蒸馏以检测：通过卡匣蒸馏揭示大语言模型中的隐蔽偏置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01208v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language models deployed in high-stakes roles can potentially favor certain entities, brands, or viewpoints, steering user decisions at scale. Such preferential biases can be introduced by any actor in the model's supply chain and are most dangerous when the model reveals its preference only on the relevant topic while behaving identically to its unmodified base on all other inputs. Recent work has shown that these biases can transfer through context distillation on semantically unrelated data, with the signal residing entirely in the soft logit distribution and remaining invisible to text-based inspection. However, the defender faces a fundamental asymmetry: without knowing the bias topic, no detection method can reliably surface a stealth preferential bias, regardless of whether it examines generated text, internal representations, or model weights. Here we introduce Distill to Detect (D2D), a method that surfaces hidden biases by distilling the distributional shift between a suspected model and its base into a cartridge (a KV-cache prefix adapter), concentrating the dominant divergence and amplifying the bias signal into generated text. We show that D2D successfully amplifies the hidden biases of stealth models to the extent that they can be reliably detected across multiple bias types. We also propose a theoretical framework that explains the efficacy of D2D through the lens of Fisher-weighted projection of the logit distribution shift, supported by empirical observations. By turning the capacity bottleneck of prefix-tuning adapters into a detection tool, D2D provides a practical building block for auditing hidden behaviors in deployed language models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究高风险场景中语言模型可能隐藏的偏好性偏置，尤其是只在相关主题上显现、在其他输入上与基模型表现一致的隐蔽偏置。作者指出若未知偏置主题，检测此类偏置存在根本不对称，并提出 Distill to Detect（D2D）：将可疑模型与基模型之间的分布偏移蒸馏到一个 KV-cache 前缀适配器“卡匣”中，集中主要差异并放大偏置信号，使其更容易通过生成行为暴露。
authors: Shayan Talaei, Abhinav Chinta, Devvrit Khatri, Amin Karbasi, Azalia Mirhoseini, Amin Saberi

articles.title: Utilizing Earth Foundation Models to Enhance the Simulation Performance of Hydrological Models with AlphaEarth Embeddings
articles.title_zh: 利用 AlphaEarth 嵌入的地球基础模型提升水文模型模拟性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.01558v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Predicting river flow in places without streamflow records is challenging because basins respond differently to climate, terrain, vegetation, and soils. Traditional basin attributes describe some of these differences, but they cannot fully represent the complexity of natural environments. This study examines whether AlphaEarth Foundation embeddings, which are learned from large collections of satellite images rather than designed by experts, offer a more informative way to describe basin characteristics. These embeddings summarize patterns in vegetation, land surface properties, and long-term environmental dynamics. We find that models using them achieve higher accuracy when predicting flows in basins not used for training, suggesting that they capture key physical differences more effectively than traditional attributes. We further investigate how selecting appropriate donor basins influences prediction in ungauged regions. Similarity based on the embeddings helps identify basins with comparable environmental and hydrological behavior, improving performance, whereas adding many dissimilar basins can reduce accuracy. The results show that satellite-informed environmental representations can strengthen hydrological forecasting and support the development of models that adapt more easily to different landscapes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察 AlphaEarth Foundation 从大规模卫星影像中学习到的嵌入能否比传统流域属性更有效地表征无测站流域特征。结果表明，使用这些嵌入的模型在预测未参与训练流域的径流时精度更高，说明其能捕捉植被、地表属性和长期环境动态等关键物理差异；同时，基于嵌入相似性选择合适供体流域可改善无资料地区预测，而加入过多不相似流域可能降低精度。
authors: Pengfei Qu, Wenyu Ouyang, Chi Zhang, Yikai Chai, Shuolong Xu, Lei Ye, Yongri Piao, Miao Zhang, Huchuan Lu

articles.title: Competition-Aware CPC Forecasting with Near-Market Coverage
articles.title_zh: 具有近市场覆盖的竞争感知点击成本预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13059v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Cost-per-click (CPC) in paid search is an auction-generated outcome shaped by a competitive landscape that is only partially observable from any single advertiser's history. From 1.66 billion Google Ads log records for a concentrated car-rental market (2021-2023), we construct a weekly panel of 1,811 keyword series over 127 weeks (218,924 keyword-week observations) and build competition-aware proxies from keyword text, CPC trajectories, and geographic market structure. The design combines (i) semantic neighborhoods and a semantic keyword graph from pretrained transformer-based keyword representations, (ii) behavioral neighborhoods from Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) alignment of CPC trajectories, and (iii) geographic-intent covariates capturing localized demand and marketplace heterogeneity. We evaluate these signals both as exogenous covariates and as relational priors in spatiotemporal graph forecasters, benchmarking them against statistical, neural, and time-series foundation-model baselines. The results reveal a clear horizon crossover. At one week, graph-based models achieve the lowest error, reducing sMAPE by 15.1% relative to the strongest classical/ML baseline; at the six- and twelve-week horizons, covariate-augmented foundation models dominate, reducing sMAPE by 22.5% and 27.6%, respectively. The gains concentrate in the high-CPC, high-volatility keywords where forecasting errors are most costly. A falsification battery supports the competition interpretation at the planning horizon: the semantic competition graph outperforms a confounder-matched non-competitive graph by 4.05 sMAPE points, and matched-neighbour and time-shuffled controls show the six-week gains are competition-specific rather than generic smoothing. Together, the findings establish a horizon-dependent competition-aware forecasting design for auction-driven advertising markets under partial observability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向付费搜索广告中由竞价和竞争格局共同决定的 CPC 预测，基于 2021–2023 年汽车租赁市场 16.6 亿条 Google Ads 日志构建关键词周度面板。作者从关键词语义表示、CPC 轨迹动态时间规整以及地理市场结构构造竞争感知代理变量，并将其作为外生协变量或时空图预测模型中的关系先验。结果显示预测期存在交叉效应：短期一周预测中图模型误差最低，体现竞争关系建模对近市场 CPC 预测的价值。
authors: Sebastian Frey, Edoardo Beccari, Maximilian Kranz, Nicolò Alberto Pellizzari, Ali Mete Karaman, Qiwei Han, Maximilian Kaiser

articles.title: Crystalite: A Lightweight Transformer for Efficient Crystal Modeling
articles.title_zh: Crystalite：用于高效晶体建模的轻量级 Transformer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.02270v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generative models for crystalline materials often rely on equivariant graph neural networks, which capture geometric structure well but are costly to train and slow to sample. We present Crystalite, a lightweight diffusion Transformer for crystal modeling built around two simple inductive biases. The first is Subatomic Tokenization, a compact chemically structured atom representation that replaces high-dimensional one-hot encodings and is better suited to continuous diffusion. The second is the Geometry Enhancement Module (GEM), which injects periodic minimum-image pair geometry directly into attention through additive geometric biases. Together, these components preserve the simplicity and efficiency of a standard Transformer while making it better matched to the structure of crystalline materials. Crystalite achieves state-of-the-art results on crystal structure prediction benchmarks, and de novo generation performance, attaining the best S.U.N. discovery score among the evaluated baselines while sampling substantially faster than geometry-heavy alternatives.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 Crystalite，一种面向晶体材料生成与结构预测的轻量级扩散 Transformer，旨在替代训练和采样成本较高的等变图神经网络。模型引入亚原子分词以构造紧凑的化学结构化原子表示，并通过几何增强模块将周期性最小镜像成对几何作为注意力偏置注入。结果显示，Crystalite 在晶体结构预测和从头生成任务中达到领先性能，并以更快采样速度获得较高的 S.U.N. 发现得分。
authors: Tin Hadži Veljković, Joshua Rosenthal, Ivor Lončarić, Jan-Willem van de Meent

articles.title: Nonlinear Bayesian Estimator for Parameter Learning: A Fixed-Point Characterization
articles.title_zh: 用于参数学习的非线性贝叶斯估计器：一种不动点刻画
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10111v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper presents a nonlinear parameter estimator for Wiener-type state-space models obtained as a fixed-point architecture that couples two affine minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) estimators: one for the unknown parameters and one for latent variables. The architecture retains the functional structure of the optimal affine MMSE parameter estimator while incorporating Dynamic Basis Statistics (DBS) estimates that summarize nonlinear basis-function evaluations. Two DBS construction strategies are developed, leading to two nonlinear estimator frameworks. The dual basis-parameter estimator combines an affine basis estimator with the affine parameter estimator, whereas the dual state-parameter estimator first computes affine state estimates and their covariances, then maps these state-estimate statistics through a Gaussian DBS operator to obtain DBS estimates. Both dual estimators admit fixed-point characterizations that alternate between estimating each component using the updated prior of the other, obtained from that component's plug-in estimate statistics from the previous iteration. The efficacy of the proposed methods is examined via extensive Monte Carlo experiments, showing that the dual basis-parameter estimator attains parameter mean-squared errors comparable to those of the purely affine parameter estimator, while the dual state-parameter estimator achieves the lowest parameter mean-squared error, outperforming both the dual basis-parameter and purely affine parameter estimators, as well as sequential Monte Carlo variants of classical Particle Gibbs and Expectation-Maximization schemes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对 Wiener 型状态空间模型提出一种非线性参数估计器，将未知参数估计与潜变量估计两个仿射 MMSE 估计器耦合为不动点架构。方法通过动态基统计量概括非线性基函数评估，并发展了双基-参数估计器和双状态-参数估计器两类框架。两种估计器均可表示为交替更新先验与插入估计统计量的不动点迭代，用于提升非线性参数学习效果。
authors: Sasan Vakili, Daniël Woonings, Pradyumna Paruchuri, Peyman Mohajerin Esfahani

articles.title: A Contextual-Bandit Oversight Game with Two-Sided Informational Asymmetry
articles.title_zh: 具有双向信息不对称的情境多臂老虎机监督博弈
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study runtime human oversight of an AI agent when private information runs in both directions: the human privately knows her reward function, while the AI privately knows the quality of the action it proposes. This is the kind of asymmetry that arises naturally when an autonomous robot or software agent has inspected a situation its human supervisor cannot directly assess. Building on Cooperative Inverse Reinforcement Learning (CIRL) and the Oversight Game, we introduce a contextual-bandit team game with two-sided asymmetric information and a play/ask/trust/oversee interface. The bandit structure removes physical state transitions and thereby yields exact one-shot characterizations that would remain conjectural in the full POMDP setting, though the common belief remains a dynamically controlled state across rounds. We give two one-shot characterizations, a team optimum and a behaviorally natural myopic rule, whose gap is a slab of avoidable harm: a region in which the AI privately knows the proposed action is harmful and shutdown would help, yet a myopic human, trusting her prior, declines to oversee. We show this gap is the price of non-credible oversight communication, and give a partial analysis of how it resolves dynamically over repeated rounds through passive learning and active signaling with a one-period-lagged oversight response.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究 AI 运行时人类监督中的双向私有信息问题：人类知道自身奖励函数，AI 知道其拟议动作质量。作者在 CIRL 与监督博弈基础上构造情境多臂老虎机团队博弈，并设计 play/ask/trust/oversee 交互接口，以获得可精确分析的一步刻画。论文比较团队最优规则与行为上自然的短视规则，指出二者差距对应一类可避免伤害：AI 知道动作有害且关闭有益，但人类因依赖先验而不监督。

articles.title: AutoMem: Automated Learning of Memory as a Cognitive Skill
articles.title_zh: AutoMem：将记忆作为认知技能的自动化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01224v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Memory expertise is a learned skill: knowing what to encode, when to retrieve, and how to organize knowledge--a capacity known in cognitive science as metamemory. We bring this perspective to LLMs by treating memory management as a trainable skill. We promote file-system operations to first-class memory actions alongside task actions, letting the model itself decide how to manage its memory. This memory skill improves along two axes: the structure that supports it (prompts, file schemas, action vocabulary), and the proficiency of the model exercising it. Both axes resist manual optimization: episodes in long-horizon tasks run for thousands of steps, and a single memory mistake can hide long before it surfaces, making human review of full trajectories impractical. We introduce AutoMem, a framework that automates both axes. In the first loop, a strong LLM reviews complete agent trajectories and iteratively revises the memory structure that shapes how the agent interacts with its memory files. In the second loop, the agent's own good memory decisions are identified from many episodes and used as training signal to sharpen the model's memory proficiency directly. Across three procedurally generated long-horizon games (Crafter, MiniHack, and NetHack), optimizing memory alone--without modifying the model's task-action behavior--improved the base agent's performance ~2x-4x, bringing a 32B open-weight model competitive with frontier systems such as Claude Opus 4.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro Thinking. Our results show that memory management is an independently learnable skill, and a high-leverage objective yielding large gains on long-horizon tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将大语言模型的记忆管理视为可训练的元记忆技能，使文件系统操作与任务动作并列，允许模型自主决定何时编码、检索和组织信息。AutoMem 包含两个自动化循环：强模型审查完整轨迹并改进记忆结构，代理自身的优质记忆决策则被提取为训练信号。该框架旨在降低长程任务中人工审查轨迹的成本，并同时优化记忆接口设计与模型使用记忆的能力。
authors: Shengguang Wu, Hao Zhu, Yuhui Zhang, Xiaohan Wang, Serena Yeung-Levy

articles.title: Active Sensing for RIS-Aided Tracking and Power Control: A Hybrid Neuroevolution and Supervised Learning Approach
articles.title_zh: 面向 RIS 辅助跟踪与功率控制的主动感知：神经进化与监督学习混合方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00056v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper studies energy efficient tracking of power-limited mobile users with the assistance of a Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS). Since localization pilot transmissions dominate the energy budget of power-constrained devices, we introduce a low-overhead feedback link from the Base Station (BS) to the user to enable dynamic uplink power control. To navigate the discrete and decentralized nature of this active sensing problem, we propose a novel Dual-Agent (DA) deep learning framework that jointly optimizes the discrete RIS phase profiles and the UE's transmit power in real time. Specifically, our approach employs a hybrid training methodology integrating the neuroevolution paradigm with supervised learning, effectively overcoming the non-differentiability of discrete phase responses from the RIS unit elements and the strict information bottleneck of single-bit feedback messages for pilot power control. The proposed DA active sensing framework can be applied with both single- and multi-antenna BSs, the latter with only minor modifications in the structure of one NN: an additional output branch with appropriate structure is included for the latter case to select a valid digital combiner from a finite set. Extensive numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves highly accurate and robust tracking across diverse target motion models, outperforming extended Kalman and particle filters, as well as, machine learning-based trackers. Furthermore, in static localization, it is shown to significantly outperform traditional fingerprinting schemes, deep reinforcement learning baselines, and standard backpropagation-based estimators.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究可重构智能表面辅助下受功率限制移动用户的节能跟踪问题，重点降低定位导频传输带来的能耗。作者引入从基站到用户的低开销反馈链路，并提出双智能体深度学习框架，实时联合优化离散 RIS 相位配置与用户发射功率。训练方法结合神经进化和监督学习，以处理离散相位不可微和单比特反馈信息瓶颈，并可扩展到单天线和多天线基站场景。
authors: George Stamatelis, Hui Chen, Henk Henk Wymeersch, George C. Alexandropoulos

articles.title: An LLM-Based Framework for Intent-Driven Network Topology Design
articles.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的意图驱动网络拓扑设计框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00292v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Designing deployable and resilient network topologies from natural language requirements remains a challenging problem in network automation. This work investigates the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate structurally valid and constraint-compliant network topologies through a constraint-driven pipeline combining hierarchical modeling and systematic validation. The framework is evaluated via a multimodel comparison of proprietary and open-weight LLMs across four realistic network scenarios released as a public dataset. We assess structural correctness using node and edge F1-scores against reference topologies, and evaluate resilience through server and content connectivity metrics. In addition, we analyze common failure modes, including interface mismatches and directional inconsistencies in generated topologies. Overall, this work provides a systematic benchmark for understanding how LLMs handle structural and resilience constraints in topology synthesis, and supports informed model selection for AI-driven network design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作探索大语言模型从自然语言需求生成可部署、具备韧性的网络拓扑的能力。作者提出由层次化建模和系统性约束验证组成的约束驱动流程，并在四个真实网络场景公开数据集上比较闭源和开源权重模型。评估指标包括相对于参考拓扑的节点与边 F1 分数，以及服务器和内容连通性等韧性指标，同时分析接口不匹配和方向不一致等常见失败模式。
authors: Kholoud El-Habbouli, Fen Zhou, Stephane Huet

articles.title: Faithful by Definition: Emotion Analysis via Natural Semantic Metalanguage Explications
articles.title_zh: 由定义保证忠实：基于自然语义元语言释义的情绪分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00661v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Explanations for emotion classifiers are usually produced post hoc, with no guarantee that they reflect the computation behind the label. We present an explication interface for event-based emotion analysis. A parser maps the input text to an explication, a short script in the closed vocabulary of Natural Semantic Metalanguage organized into twelve typed slots, and a fixed decision list of rules transcribed from published semantic definitions computes the label from the explication alone. The faithfulness guarantee is therefore causal and definitional, while all empirical risk lives in the learned parser, which the per-line entailment interface makes auditable against the input. On crowd-sourced event descriptions, our fine-tuned parser reaches 0.33 accuracy and 0.48 selective accuracy on a small held-out set, suggesting that the interface trades insignificant accuracy difference to a black-box model for a verifiable, inspectable decision basis for first-person event-based emotion analysis. We also release EmoExpl-1200 with per-line verification metadata and the full rule set.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种事件型情绪分析接口，用自然语义元语言的封闭词表和十二类槽位将输入文本解析为短脚本，再由固定规则表根据语义定义直接给出情绪标签。由于标签仅由释义计算得到，解释的忠实性具有因果和定义层面的保证，学习误差主要集中在可逐行审计的解析器上。实验显示，微调解析器在小规模留出集上取得有限但可比的准确率，并以可验证、可检查的决策依据替代黑箱解释。

articles.title: Partial Skeleton Visibility for Action Recognition: A Constrained Field-of-View Approach
articles.title_zh: 面向动作识别的部分骨架可见性：受限视场方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00716v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Skeleton-based action recognition has achieved remarkable success by exploiting joint coordinates and their topological connections, yet prevailing methods overwhelmingly assume complete and clean skeleton inputs. In real-world deployments, such as egocentric vision, crowded surveillance, wearable devices, or edge robotics, limited field-of-view (FoV) frequently causes substantial joint visibility dropout, leading to severe performance degradation that existing models are largely unprepared to handle. To bridge this critical yet underexplored gap, we introduce PartialVisGraph, a novel hypergraph framework tailored for robust skeleton action recognition under constrained FoV. We first construct highly expressive hypergraphs by introducing learnable virtual hyperedges that form a soft incidence matrix, capturing flexible high-order dependencies beyond conventional pairwise graphs. We then propose the Single-Head Sample-Adaptive Transformer, which adaptively aggregates joint features onto hyperedges while explicitly incorporating a visibility prior. This prior selectively gates information flow, preventing occluded or out-of-view joints from corrupting reliable feature propagation. We further establish rigorous evaluation protocols with realistic FoV simulation benchmarks on NTU RGB+D 60 and 120. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PartialVisGraph consistently achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under partial visibility, with gains of up to 68.8% on subsets with severe FoV restrictions compared to recent strong baselines, while remaining superior on full-visibility settings. Our approach offers a principled and practical pathway toward deployable skeleton-based action understanding in unconstrained environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对真实场景中受限视场导致骨架关节大量缺失的问题，提出 PartialVisGraph 以提升骨架动作识别鲁棒性。方法构建带可学习虚拟超边的超图，通过软关联矩阵捕获超越成对关节连接的高阶依赖。进一步设计单头样本自适应 Transformer，将关节特征自适应聚合到超边，并显式利用可见性先验门控信息流，避免被遮挡或视野外关节引入干扰。
authors: Yingjie Dai, Tianyang Xu, Yanglin Deng, Xiao-Jun Wu, Josef Kittler

articles.title: Learning Cardiac Motion Priors for Implicit Neural Representations
articles.title_zh: 用于隐式神经表示的心脏运动先验学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00955v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) are well suited to cardiac motion estimation, providing continuous, compact representations of motion fields. However, fitting an INR to each image sequence is time-consuming and sensitive to the optimisation trajectory. Learned priors can help guide optimisation towards plausible motion fields and enable faster adaptation, but learning priors for cardiac motion INRs remains under-explored. In this work, we compare four strategies for learning cardiac motion priors, including a population prior learned by joint optimisation, a consensus prior obtained by weight averaging, auto-decoders, and meta-learning. Using short-axis tagged cardiac magnetic resonance images from the UK Biobank, we evaluate their impact on tracking accuracy, motion behaviour, and adaptation trajectory. All learned priors substantially improved early adaptation performance compared with random initialisation. While the simple consensus prior was effective, auto-decoders recovered large deformations faster during early adaptation. Meta-learning achieved strong early performance and maintained the best adaptation trajectory over 50 iterations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究在心脏运动估计中为隐式神经表示学习先验，以缓解逐序列拟合耗时且依赖优化轨迹的问题。作者比较了联合优化得到的群体先验、权重平均形成的一致性先验、自解码器和元学习四种策略，并在 UK Biobank 短轴标记心脏磁共振图像上评估。结果表明，学习先验均显著改善早期适应性能；一致性先验简单有效，自解码器更快恢复大形变，元学习在早期表现和整体适应轨迹上较优。
authors: Andrew Bell, George Webber, Andrew P King, Steffen E Petersen, Muhummad Sohaib Nazir, Alistair Young

articles.title: Selective Expert Guidance for Effective and Diverse Exploration in Reinforcement Learning of LLMs
articles.title_zh: 面向大语言模型强化学习的选择性专家指导：实现有效且多样的探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.04140v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a widely adopted technique for enhancing the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the effectiveness of RLVR strongly depends on the capability of base models. This issue arises because it requires the model to have sufficient capability to perform high-quality exploration, which involves both effectiveness and diversity. Unfortunately, existing methods address this issue by imitating expert trajectories, which improve effectiveness but neglect diversity. To address this, we argue that the expert only needs to provide guidance only at critical decision points rather than the entire reasoning path. Based on this insight, we propose MENTOR: Mixed-policy Expert Navigation for Token-level Optimization of Reasoning, a framework that provides expert guidance only at critical decision points to perform effective and diverse exploration in RLVR. Extensive experiments show that MENTOR enables models capture the essence of expert strategies rather than surface imitation, thereby performing high-quality exploration and achieving superior overall performance. Our code is available online.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注可验证奖励强化学习中基础模型能力不足导致探索质量受限的问题，指出完整模仿专家轨迹虽能提升有效性，却会削弱探索多样性。作者提出 MENTOR 框架，仅在关键决策点提供专家指导，使模型在保留多样探索的同时学习专家策略要点。大量实验表明，该方法相比表层轨迹模仿更能促使模型掌握推理策略本质，并提升 RLVR 的整体表现。
authors: Zishang Jiang, Jinyi Han, Tingyun Li, Xinyi Wang, Sihang Jiang, Jiaqing Liang, Zhaoqian Dai, Shuguang Ma, Fei Yu, Yanghua Xiao

articles.title: Whey Protein Isolate–Pectin Complexes Regulate Microstructure and Stability of Pasteurized Drinking Yogurt
articles.title_zh: 乳清蛋白分离物–果胶复合物调控巴氏杀菌饮用酸奶的微结构与稳定性
articles.abstract: This study investigated the effects of pasteurization intensity and formulation components (whey protein isolate [WPI] and pectin), on the physicochemical properties, microstructure, and stability of pasteurized drinking yogurt (PDY). Increasing pasteurization intensity, particularly elevated temperature, significantly promoted particle aggregation, increased apparent viscosity and viscoelastic moduli, and decreased water-holding capacity (WHC). Pectin added alone induced bridging flocculation and enlarged particle size, whereas WPI alone reduced aggregation and promoted a finer gel network. The combined use of WPI and pectin yielded the most pronounced improvements: WHC reached 88% at 85°C for 20 min, markedly higher than all other formulations. This composite yogurt also exhibited the lowest viscosity and viscoelastic moduli, indicating superior fluidity. Low-field nuclear magnetic resonance analysis confirmed that WPI addition increased bound water content and restricted water mobility. Scanning electron microscopy revealed that the WPI–pectin composite formed a dense, homogeneous microstructure, while Turbiscan measurements demonstrated significantly enhanced physical stability. These findings demonstrate that WPI and pectin synergistically modulate the texture, water distribution, and stability of PDY, providing a mechanistic basis for developing high-quality, shelf-stable drinking yogurt products.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察巴氏杀菌强度以及乳清蛋白分离物和果胶配方对巴氏杀菌饮用酸奶理化性质、微结构和稳定性的影响。提高杀菌强度尤其是温度会促进颗粒聚集、增加表观黏度和黏弹模量，并降低持水性；单独添加果胶导致桥联絮凝，而单独添加乳清蛋白可细化凝胶网络。乳清蛋白–果胶复合配方表现最佳，在特定杀菌条件下显著提高持水性、降低黏度和黏弹性，并形成致密均一微结构与更高物理稳定性。

articles.title: Magnetic Field and Nonlocal Effects on Wave Reflection in a Generalized Magneto-Micropolar Thermoelastic Medium
articles.title_zh: 磁场与非局域效应对广义磁-微极热弹性介质中波反射的影响
articles.abstract: This study investigates wave reflection in a generalized magneto-micropolar thermoelastic medium under the influence of magnetic field and nonlocal effects. The behavior of waves is analyzed by considering the interaction between micro-rotational effects, thermal elasticity, and magnetic forces, along with the nonlocal parameter to capture scale-dependent material behavior. Numerical simulations and graphical analyses are performed using Mathematica to evaluate the effects of magnetic field intensity and nonlocality on wave reflection patterns. The results show that nonlocal effects significantly alter wave amplitudes, while the magnetic field introduces noticeable changes in reflection characteristics. The study provides insights into the control and optimization of wave propagation in advanced thermoelastic materials, offering guidance for engineering applications involving microscale magnetic-thermoelastic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析广义磁-微极热弹性介质中的波反射行为，重点考虑磁场、非局域效应、微旋转、热弹性与磁力之间的耦合。作者利用数值模拟和图形分析评估磁场强度及非局域参数对反射波幅和反射特征的影响。结果表明，非局域效应会显著改变波幅，磁场也会引起可观的反射行为变化，为微尺度磁-热弹性系统中的波传播调控提供参考。

articles.title: Optimization Algorithms of the Proposed FOC of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor for Electric Vehicles
articles.title_zh: 面向电动汽车永磁同步电机改进磁场定向控制的优化算法
articles.abstract: The optimization algorithms used for the suggested Field-Oriented Control FOC strategy of a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor PMSM for electric vehicle applications. The goal of the study is to improve the PMSM drive system's stability, efficiency, and dynamic performance across a range of operating scenarios. The creation of a comprehensive electric vehicle model took into account the electric motor, powertrain, and vehicle dynamics. To determine how vehicle mass affected performance and energy consumption, three different vehicle weights, 600 kg, 900 kg, and 1200 kg, were simulated. The FOC system incorporates advanced optimization approaches to minimize current ripple and electromagnetic torque variations while improving speed tracking, torque response, and energy utilization. MATLAB Simulink is used to design and simulate the PMSM model and control system in order to assess the efficacy of the suggested methods. The refined FOC technique achieves greater performance in terms of quick transient response, decreased steady-state error, and enhanced overall drive efficiency, according to comparative simulation results, making it ideal for contemporary electric vehicle propulsion systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将优化算法用于电动汽车永磁同步电机的磁场定向控制策略，以提升驱动系统稳定性、效率和动态性能。作者建立包含电机、传动系统和车辆动力学的综合模型，并在600 kg、900 kg和1200 kg三种车辆质量下进行MATLAB/Simulink仿真。结果表明，优化后的FOC可降低电流纹波和电磁转矩波动，改善速度跟踪、转矩响应和能量利用效率。

articles.title: Electromagnetic Environment Distortion Near UHV AC and DC Transmission Lines Under Thunderstorm Cloud Electric Fields
articles.title_zh: 雷暴云电场下特高压交流与直流输电线路附近电磁环境畸变
articles.abstract: The stratified charge structure within thunderstorm clouds generates a significant background electric field near the ground, distorting the electromagnetic environment (EME) of ultra-high voltage (UHV) transmission lines. Currently, research has rarely investigated the distinct impacts of thunderstorm conditions on UHV alternating current (UHVAC) and direct current (UHVDC) systems respectively. To address this, the finite element method (FEM) is employed to model 1000 kV UHVAC and ± 800 kV UHVDC lines based on typical mid-to-low latitude thunderstorm charge distributions. By incorporating the background field as a voltage boundary condition, the EME influence patterns for both line types are quantitatively assessed. Results indicate that for UHVAC lines, the thunderstorm field induces a significant DC bias, increasing the instantaneous peak field intensity by approximately 20% over normal operation. For UHVDC lines, the field accelerates space ion migration, leading to a 28% increase in total electric field intensity and a 48% rise in ion flow density. These findings reveal the EME modulation mechanisms under thunderstorm clouds, providing a theoretical foundation for the electromagnetic protection design of various UHV configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对雷暴云分层电荷结构产生的近地背景电场，采用有限元方法模拟1000 kV特高压交流线路和±800 kV特高压直流线路的电磁环境变化。结果显示，雷暴电场会使特高压交流线路出现显著直流偏置，瞬时峰值场强较正常运行提高约20%。对特高压直流线路，背景电场加速空间离子迁移，使总电场强度增加28%、离子流密度增加48%，揭示了雷暴条件下线路电磁环境调制机制。

articles.title: Mitigating Cadmium Stress in Milk Thistle through Plant Growth-Promoting Rhizobacteria and Radiated Achenes: A Biochemical and Physiological Perspective
articles.title_zh: 植物促生根际细菌与辐照瘦果缓解水飞蓟镉胁迫的生化和生理机制
articles.abstract: Soil contamination with cadmium (Cd) as a significant environmental challenge, has become a persistent and highly toxic heavy metal due to increased industrial and agricultural activities. Cd exposure negatively impacts plant growth, photosynthetic efficiency, nutrient uptake, and oxidative balance, which reduce crop productivity and harmful effects to human health. This study aimed to evaluate the effect of two eco-friendly approaches, plant growth-promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR) and gamma-radiated achenes (0-10 GY) on growth indices, biochemical, and yield attributes of milk thistle (Silybum marianum) under 200 μM Cd stress. Results revealed that combination of PGPR inoculation and 4 GY radiation improved shoot length by 31%, photosynthetic rate by 7.08%, and silymarin content by 28%, while reducing oxidative stress markers H₂O₂ by 33%, MDA by 7.89% under Cd stress. Enhanced activity of antioxidant enzymes such as, superoxide dismutase, catalase, by 97% and 50%, respectively, and accumulation of phenolics and flavonoids by 100% and 33% were also observed. Mineral nutrients, osmolytes, photosynthetic pigments, gas exchange parameters, silymarin content, and oil content revealed significant improvement with the application of PGPR and achene radiation treatments. Overall, treatment effectiveness ranked as radiation doses (GY): 4 > 2 > 0 > 6 > 8 > 10, with 4 GY + PGPR showing the greatest improvement in Cd tolerance and silymarin accumulation. However, growth parameters, biochemical, and yield attributes were significantly increased with the application of PGPR under non-stressed plants. These findings highlight the potential of integrating PGPR and gamma radiation to improve milk thistle resilience and productivity in Cd-contaminated environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估植物促生根际细菌和0-10 Gy γ辐照瘦果对200 μM镉胁迫下水飞蓟生长、生化和产量性状的影响。结果表明，PGPR接种与4 Gy辐照组合可提高株高、光合速率和水飞蓟素含量，并降低H2O2和MDA等氧化胁迫指标。该处理还增强抗氧化酶活性及酚类、黄酮积累，说明其可通过改善抗氧化防御、渗透调节和营养状态缓解镉毒害。

articles.title: Comparative genomics of the RBOH gene family across 22 Brassicaceae species and characterization of BnRBOHs
articles.title_zh: 22种十字花科植物RBOH基因家族比较基因组学及BnRBOHs特征解析
articles.abstract: Respiratory burst oxidase homologs (RBOHs) are key enzymes on the plant plasma membrane that mediate stress-induced extracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) bursts, playing important roles in plant growth, development, and stress responses. Previous studies on the RBOH gene family have largely focused on identification and functional analysis in single species, and systematic phylogenetic analyses across a broad range of Brassicaceae species remain lacking. In this study, based on genomic data from 22 Brassicaceae species, we systematically identified the RBOH gene family and obtained a total of 314 RBOH genes. Phylogenetic analysis classified these 314 RBOH genes into five conserved groups. Whole genome duplication (WGD) was the major driving force for gene family expansion, contributing 58.6% of the genes (184 genes). Synteny analysis revealed the evolutionary and retention patterns of RBOH genes between Brassica napus and its diploid progenitors Brassica rapa and Brassica oleracea. Promoter analysis revealed abundant stress-responsive and hormone-responsive cis-elements, with the abscisic acid-responsive element ABRE and the hormone cross-regulatory element as-1 being the most enriched. Expression analysis showed that BnRBOH genes exhibited differential response patterns under abiotic stresses such as drought and salt stress, with significantly more responses in root tissues than in leaf tissues. Transcription factor regulatory network analysis identified 244 transcription factors regulating 18 BnRBOH genes, with stress-responsive core transcription factor families such as ERF, NAC, and WRKY being dominant. This study fills the gap in large-scale phylogenetic research on the RBOH gene family in Brassicaceae and provides important theoretical foundations for molecular design breeding of stress-tolerant rapeseed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于22种十字花科植物基因组系统鉴定RBOH基因家族，共获得314个RBOH基因，并将其划分为五个保守类群。全基因组复制是该家族扩张的主要驱动力，贡献184个基因，占58.6%。共线性和启动子分析揭示了甘蓝型油菜与其二倍体祖先种之间RBOH基因的保留模式，以及丰富的胁迫和激素响应顺式作用元件。

articles.title: Pt-WO x /TiO 2 catalyst for nitrogen oxide to ammonia reaction using H 2 reductant
articles.title_zh: 用于氢气还原剂条件下氮氧化物制氨反应的Pt-WOx/TiO2催化剂
articles.abstract: Undoped Pt/TiO2 and WOx-doped in Pt/TiO2 catalysts with varying WOx contents were examined for the selective conversion of nitrogen oxide to ammonia reaction. Above 150°C, 5 wt% WOx-doped Pt/TiO2 catalyst exhibited the highest ammonia yield (97%), outperforming the undoped Pt/TiO2 catalyst (88%). XRD and XPS analysis revealed the tungsten bronzes formation. Pt-5 wt% WOx/TiO2 showed moderate lower oxidation (W4+) concentration. CO chemisorption demonstrated strong metal-support interactions (SMSI) which assist in lower oxidation formation as well as ammonia formation. These findings highlight the potential of WOx-doped Pt/TiO2 as an efficient catalyst for NOx-to-ammonia conversion, particularly in high-temperature regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察不同WOx掺杂量的Pt/TiO2催化剂在氢气还原NOx制氨反应中的性能。150°C以上，5 wt% WOx掺杂Pt/TiO2的氨产率达到97%，高于未掺杂Pt/TiO2的88%。XRD、XPS和CO化学吸附结果表明，钨青铜形成、适中的低价W4+浓度及强金属-载体相互作用共同促进了氨生成。

articles.title: Phenolic Composition, Antioxidant and Antimicrobial Activities of Berberis Honey from Tibet, China
articles.title_zh: 中国西藏小檗蜂蜜的酚类组成、抗氧化与抗菌活性
articles.abstract: Tibetan Berberis honey (BH) represents an underexplored natural raw material with promising development value for functional food applications. The present work characterized the phenolic fingerprint of BH and systematically compared its antioxidant and antimicrobial performance with commercial Manuka honey (MH). After phenolic fraction enrichment using XAD-2 macroporous resin, ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UHPLC-MS/MS) was employed to perform metabolomic characterization. The antimicrobial activity was assessed using the broth microdilution and agar diffusion methods. The phenolic extract obtained from BH possessed markedly elevated total phenolic content (TPC), total flavonoid content (TFC), alongside superior antioxidant capacity in comparison with MH (P < 0.001). Untargeted metabolomics identified 1,028 metabolites in BH, with phenolic acids (20.62%) and alkaloids (19.16%) as the predominant classes. Targeted metabolomics quantified 104 phenolic compounds, with syringic acid, kaempferol, and protocatechuic acid as the major components. Furthermore, BH demonstrated stronger antibacterial activity against Klebsiella pneumoniae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Staphylococcus aureus, yet exhibited weaker activity against Escherichia coli compared with MH. The hydrogen peroxide content of BH was 227.16 ± 8.27 µmol/kg, considerably exceeding the value of MH (109.69 ± 8.26 µmol/kg) (P < 0.0001), and this constitutes a key basis for its stronger antibacterial activity. Neither honey exhibited inhibitory activity against Candida albicans. Collectively, BH possesses a unique phenolic and alkaloid profile and shows superior selective antibacterial activity against certain pathogens over MH, underscoring its potential as a natural functional food with dual antioxidant and antibacterial properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究对西藏小檗蜂蜜的酚类指纹图谱进行表征，并与商业麦卢卡蜂蜜比较其抗氧化和抗菌性能。经XAD-2大孔树脂富集后，UHPLC-MS/MS代谢组学鉴定出1028种代谢物，其中酚酸和生物碱占比较高；靶向分析定量104种酚类化合物，主要包括丁香酸、山奈酚和原儿茶酸。结果显示小檗蜂蜜酚类和黄酮含量更高、抗氧化能力更强，并对肺炎克雷伯菌等表现出较强抗菌活性。

articles.title: Dual-Mode Colorimetric and RGB Detection of Sulfide Based on a Magnetic Fe 3 O 4 /CoFe 2 O 4 /Ce-BDC Hybrid Nanozyme
articles.title_zh: 基于磁性 Fe3O4/CoFe2O4/Ce-BDC 杂化纳米酶的硫化物双模式比色与 RGB 检测
articles.abstract: Sulfide (S2−), a ubiquitous and highly reactive anion in natural and industrial environments, poses severe threats to aquatic ecosystems and human health even at trace levels, necessitating rapid and precise detection methods. This study presents a dual-mode sensing strategy by integrating a magnetic Fe3O4/CoFe2O4/Ce-BDC (denoted as FCF/Ce-BDC) nanozyme with TMB/H2O2 chromogenic chemistry to construct peroxidase-mimetic hybrids. The FCF/Ce-BDC catalyst efficiently oxidizes 3,3’,5,5’-tetramethylbenzidine (TMB) in the presence of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2), generating a blue product (oxTMB, λmax = 651nm). The subsequent reaction of sulfide under acidic conditions scavenges reactive oxygen species (ROS), predominantly hydroxyl radicals (•OH), and reduces oxidized 3,3’,5,5’-tetramethylbenzidine (oxTMB), leading to a pronounced decrease in absorbance at 651 nm and a visually discernible color transition from blue to colorless. This dual-signal response enables quantitative analysis via both conventional spectrophotometric absorbance measurement and smartphone-based RGB colorimetry, achieving detection limits of 0.29 µM (absorbance mode) and 31.26 µM (RGB mode), respectively. We fabricated three portable, field-deployable sensors for on-site sulfide detection: a hydrogel film, a cotton fabric strip and a cotton swab. The hydrogel sensor leverages ion-mediated crosslinking to modulate reaction kinetics and ensure reproducible color development, whereas the cotton-based substrates exploit capillary-driven fluid transport to enrich analyte concentration, thereby enhancing sensitivity and mitigating matrix interference. This study not only advances the rational design of multifunctional nanozymes but also delivers a validated, application ready framework for their safe and selective use in environmental water matrices and human whole blood, enabling real time, cost effective, and operationally simple tracking of target pollutants without compromising analytical reliability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建了 Fe3O4/CoFe2O4/Ce-BDC 磁性杂化纳米酶与 TMB/H2O2 显色体系耦合的硫化物检测方法。纳米酶可催化 TMB 氧化生成蓝色 oxTMB，而硫化物在酸性条件下清除活性氧并还原 oxTMB，使 651 nm 吸收减弱并产生由蓝到无色的可视变化。该体系支持分光光度法和智能手机 RGB 比色两种定量模式，检出限分别为 0.29 μM 和 31.26 μM。

articles.title: Interpretable Edge Intelligence in 5G: Real-Time Root Cause Analysis of QoS Anomalies in Private Networks
articles.title_zh: 5G 中的可解释边缘智能：私有网络 QoS 异常的实时根因分析
articles.abstract: Migrating compute to 5G Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) nodes satisfies Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communicationrequirements but dismantles the conventional security boundary in ways that neither Deep Packet Inspection nor signature-based detection can address. Unsupervised anomaly detection offers a principled path through this problem; however, asystem returning only a scalar anomaly score gives operations teams no causal basis on which to safely automate mitigation.We present the Interpretable Edge Intelligence (IEI) framework, which combines an LSTM-Autoencoder with a K-Means-compressed KernelSHAP attribution engine designed for commodity MEC hardware and aligned with 3GPP NWDAF standards.Evaluated on the 5G-NIDD benchmark, IEI achieves AUC-ROC of 0.991 and F1-score of 0.971 (mean over five random seeds),with fast-path inference at 14.7 ms - well within URLLC bounds. A controlled live deployment experiment uncovers a failuremode: applying a core-trained model to an uncalibrated interface produced a false-positive rate of 61.3% (95% CI: 59.1–63.4%),reduced to 3.1% (CI: 2.4–3.9%) after five minutes of localised recalibration. Shapley attribution independently identified themissing Service VLAN identifier (sVid) as the dominant anomaly driver, which an ablation experiment confirms causally.To ourknowledge, this is the first empirical isolation of a specific 3GPP protocol field as the causal source of MEC deployment failure,establishing that edge AI security is a hardware-calibration problem as much as a modelling problem
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出可解释边缘智能框架 IEI，用于 5G MEC 环境中 QoS 异常的无监督检测与根因分析。框架结合 LSTM 自编码器和经 K-Means 压缩的 KernelSHAP 归因模块，并面向普通 MEC 硬件和 3GPP NWDAF 标准设计。在 5G-NIDD 基准上，IEI 获得 0.991 的 AUC-ROC、0.971 的 F1 分数和 14.7 ms 的快速推理延迟；现场部署还显示，本地再校准可将跨接口模型迁移导致的高误报率显著降低。

articles.title: Field angle-independent high magnetoresistance and field angle-dependent coercivity in Fe 3 GaTe 2 /Phosphorus all-van der Waals spin valves at room temperature
articles.title_zh: 室温 Fe3GaTe2/磷全范德华自旋阀中的场角无关高磁阻与场角相关矫顽力
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 02 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75103-8 The authors found that a room temperature magnetoresistance of 103% is achieved in all-van-der-Waals spin valves using Fe3GaTe2 and black phosphorus, and that the MR ratio is independent of field direction due to domain-wall-motion-driven magnetization switching dynamics in Fe3GaTe2.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道了由 Fe3GaTe2 和黑磷构成的全范德华自旋阀在室温下实现 103% 的磁阻。研究指出，该磁阻比对外磁场方向不敏感，其机制与 Fe3GaTe2 中由畴壁运动主导的磁化翻转动力学有关。与此同时，器件矫顽力表现出对磁场角度的依赖性。

articles.title: Organic cocrystals offer record photothermal conversion
articles.title_zh: 有机共晶实现创纪录的光热转换
articles.abstract: Nature Photonics, Published online: 02 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01952-w Polar cocrystals made from two centrosymmetric components use quantum coherent beating to enhance photothermal conversion, setting a new high temperature for organic solids exposed to laser light.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文报道由两个中心对称组分形成的极性有机共晶可显著增强光热转换。其机制被归因于量子相干拍频效应，使有机固体在激光照射下达到新的高温水平。该结果展示了分子共晶工程在高效有机光热材料中的潜力。

articles.title: Tomographic imaging of superconducting order using particle–hole interference
articles.title_zh: 利用粒子-空穴干涉对超导序进行层析成像

SignificanceDetermining the symmetry and topology of superconducting order parameter is essential for identifying new quantum materials with potential applications in quantum information and dissipationless electronic transport technologies. articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕超导序参量的对称性与拓扑结构表征展开，目标是为识别新型量子材料提供成像手段。文章提出利用粒子-空穴干涉进行超导序的层析成像，以获取与超导配对结构相关的信息。摘要信息不完整，具体实验或理论实现细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: TRIE: An Evaluation Framework for Stochastic PDE Surrogates
articles.title_zh: TRIE：随机偏微分方程代理模型的评估框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.00196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many scientific systems exhibit uncertainty from stochastic forcing, unresolved degrees of freedom, or imperfect observations, making reliable surrogate forecasting fundamentally distributional rather than pointwise. For such systems, deterministic neural surrogates fail to capture statistical measures and forecast uncertainty. We introduce TRIE, an evaluation framework for stochastic PDE surrogates that asks whether models reproduce invariant measures, provide trustworthy predictive uncertainty, and scale to efficient probabilistic generation. We demonstrate TRIE on two stationary chaotic spatially extended SPDEs, stochastic Kuramoto--Sivashinsky and stochastic Kolmogorov flow, across 11 parameter values. Our evaluation shows that standard pointwise-trained neural surrogates can produce plausible short rollouts while failing to match long-time statistical structure. Approximate uncertainty methods such as Monte Carlo dropout and heteroscedastic Gaussian likelihoods produce stochastic forecasts, but are often miscalibrated and overconfident under temporal and spatial uncertainty diagnostics. Across these criteria, generative models provide the most consistent performance, accurately capturing invariant measure statistics and achieving the lowest CRPS in all reported probabilistic settings. Finally, we show that latent generative models with automatic dimension discovery retain much of this statistical fidelity while reducing Kolmogorov inference time by roughly 12×. We release our code and data at https://github.com/scailab/TRIE-SPDE-Bench to support reproducible evaluation of stochastic PDE forecasting models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 TRIE 框架，用于评估随机 PDE 代理模型是否能再现不变测度、给出可信预测不确定性并支持高效概率生成。作者在随机 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 方程和随机 Kolmogorov 流两个平稳混沌空间扩展 SPDE 上进行测试，覆盖 11 组参数。结果显示，常规点预测神经代理模型虽可产生看似合理的短期轨迹，却常无法保持长期统计结构；一些近似不确定性方法也存在校准不足和过度自信问题。
authors: Bharat Srikishan, Javier E. Santos, Nikhil Muralidhar, Charles D. Young

articles.title: Wildfire-induced nutrient redistribution drives depth-dependent functional decoupling and network destabilization
articles.title_zh: 野火诱导的养分再分配驱动深度依赖的功能解耦与网络失稳
articles.abstract: Background Fire frequency and severity are increasing in subtropical regions under climate change, profoundly altering soil biogeochemical cycling. However, little is known about how wildfire influences microbial carbon (C), nitrogen (N), and phosphorus (P) cycling functions throughout the soil profiles. Here, we used metagenomic sequencing to characterize microbial functional genes associated with C, N, and P cycling across a wildfire severity gradient in surface (0–10 cm), middle (10–30 cm), and deep (30–50 cm) soils in a subtropical forest.Results We found that vertical spatial heterogeneity primarily structured microbial functional potentials, while wildfire reshaped this structure in a depth-dependent manner. Increasing fire severity significantly enriched microbial N and P cycling potentials but reduced the abundance of C degradation genes in surface soils. In contrast, subsurface microbial functional potentials remained comparatively stable across the fire gradient. Partial Least Squares Path Modeling (PLS-PM) showed that wildfire influences N and P cycling functions primarily through its indirect effects on soil nutrients. Functional co-occurrence network analysis revealed divergent patterns in microbial interactions across fire severity. Low severity fire fostered increased network complexity, whereas extreme fires reduced network complexity, increased vulnerability, and led to the loss of keystone connectors, indicating destabilization of tightly coupled microbial functional interactions.Conclusions Our findings reveal a pronounced vertical decoupling of microbial functional responses to wildfire in subtropical forest soils, with substantial functional reorganization in surface layers but comparatively buffered responses in deeper soils. These results highlight the importance of incorporating soil-depth variation into post-fire assessments of ecosystem resilience and nutrient cycling. The observed nutrient-mediated enhancement of N and P cycling and the destabilization of microbial functional networks under severe fire provide new insights for predicting post-fire ecosystem trajectories and developing forest management strategies aimed at maintaining soil function and promoting ecosystem recovery under increasingly severe wildfire regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用宏基因组测序分析亚热带森林不同火烧强度下 0-50 cm 土壤剖面中微生物碳、氮、磷循环功能基因的变化。结果表明，垂向空间异质性主导微生物功能潜势，而野火以深度依赖方式重塑这一结构：表层土壤中氮、磷循环潜势增强，碳降解基因丰度降低，深层土壤则相对稳定。路径模型和共现网络分析提示，野火主要通过改变土壤养分间接影响氮、磷循环功能，并可能降低功能网络稳定性。

articles.title: Node-Level Fault Monitoring in WSN using Deep Neural Networks with Real-Time Graph Mapping and Performance Analysis
articles.title_zh: 基于深度神经网络并结合实时图映射与性能分析的无线传感器网络节点级故障监测
articles.abstract: A Wireless Sensor Network (WSNs) are essential in the places thatrequire real-time observations. They are however susceptible tonode-level failures, which will have an impact on the reliability ofthe data. The paper provides a deep learning method used to identifyfaults in WSNs through the perspective of a temporal feature oftemperature, battery life, and sensor readings. The Convolution Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models are used in the study and validated to classify the faulty nodes. The evaluation of these models were demonstrated using the parameters such as accuracy, precision, recall and F1-Score and confusion matrix. The obtained values are plotted using the graph-mapping interface in a real-time, dynamically displayed and understandable node status.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向无线传感器网络中的节点级故障识别，提出利用温度、电池寿命和传感器读数等时间特征进行深度学习分类。研究比较了 CNN、RNN 和 LSTM 模型，并用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1 分数及混淆矩阵评估故障节点识别性能。结果通过实时图映射界面动态展示节点状态，以提升故障监测的可视化和可解释性。

articles.title: Horseshoe Salinity Pattern in the Upper Indian Ocean and its Decadal Variability
articles.title_zh: 印度洋上层海洋的马蹄形盐度型及其年代际变率
articles.abstract: Salinity plays a crucial role in the global hydrological cycle and climate system by regulating upper ocean stratification and sea surface temperature (SST). Past studies have revealed the dynamics of salinity variation in the world’s major ocean basins and its linkage to global climate on inter-annual to decadal time scales. However, understanding of upper ocean salinity variability in the Indian Ocean, especially on decadal time scale and its global implications, remains limited. This study identifies a prominent Horseshoe Salinity Pattern (HSP), present in the Indian Ocean, extending from surface to 150m depth. It exhibits pronounced decadal variability and is closely associated with SST variability in the southeastern Indian Ocean (SEIO). Composite maps and a sea surface salinity budget analysis reveal that SST anomalies in the SEIO region modulate the local Walker and Hadley circulation anomaly causing the variation in the precipitation pattern. These changes drive upper ocean freshening or salinification, producing the observed HSP Pattern. Advection contributes regionally to salinity variability, particularly in the southern Indian Ocean, but does not play a dominant role in shaping the coherent HSP structure. Further, this pattern modulates upper-ocean stratification, leading to the development of SST anomalies in the western tropical Indian Ocean. These findings offer novel insight into the Indian Ocean salinity dynamics, highlighting the role of SST-salinity coupling and have the potential for improving predictions of decadal climate variability and its global implications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究识别出印度洋上层从海表延伸至 150 m 深度的显著马蹄形盐度型，并分析其年代际变化。结果表明，该盐度型与东南印度洋海温变率密切相关，海温异常可调制局地 Walker 和 Hadley 环流异常，进而改变降水分布并驱动上层海洋淡化或盐化。盐度收支分析显示，平流在部分区域，尤其南印度洋，对盐度变化有贡献，但并非主导机制。

articles.title: GTS-21 alleviates oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation-induced intestinal epithelial cell injury via the PI3K/Akt pathway
articles.title_zh: GTS-21 通过 PI3K/Akt 通路缓解氧糖剥夺/复氧诱导的肠上皮细胞损伤
articles.abstract: Objective: The present study aimed to evaluate the protective effect of GTS-21 against intestinal IR injury and its potential mechanism in in vitro experiments. Methods: In this study, intestinal IR injury model was established in rat intestinal epithelial cells (IEC-6) using oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R).. Cells were divided into five groups: control (Group S), OGD/R (Group OGD/R), GTS-21 + OGD/R (Group GTS), wortmannin + OGD/R (Group T), and GTS-21 + wortmannin + OGD/R (Group GTS+T). Cells were pretreated with GTS-21 (200 μM) 1 h before OGD and/or the PI3K inhibitor wortmannin (WM; 2 μM) 1.5 h before OGD. Cell viability was evaluated using a Cell Counting Kit-8 assay, and apoptosis was assessed by flow cytometry.. The protein levels of Bax, Bcl-2, cleaved caspase-3, cleaved caspase-9 and phosphorylated (p-)Akt were analyzed by western blotting. Reactive oxygen species (ROS), malondialdehyde (MDA) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) levels were measured using colorimetric assays. The levels of TNF-α, IL‑1β, IL‑6 and IL-10 were quantified using ELISA. Results: OGD/R significantly decreased cell viability and p-Akt/Bcl-2 expression, increased apoptosis, pro-apoptotic protein expression, inflammatory cytokine levels, ROS levels and MDA levels, and reduced SOD and IL-10 levels. Treatment with GTS-21 significantly attenuated the inflammatory response and oxidative stress, and reduced apoptosis. However, these protective effects of GTS-21 were abolished by co-treatment with the PI3K inhibitor WM. Conclusion:GTS-21 alleviated OGD/R-induced intestinal epithelial cell injury by attenuating apoptosis, inflammation and oxidative stress, likely through activation of the PI3K/Akt pathway.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 IEC-6 大鼠肠上皮细胞中建立氧糖剥夺/复氧模型，评估 GTS-21 对肠缺血再灌注样损伤的保护作用及机制。实验检测了细胞活力、凋亡、Bax、Bcl-2、cleaved caspase-3/9、p-Akt、ROS、MDA、SOD 以及炎症因子水平，并使用 PI3K 抑制剂 wortmannin 验证通路作用。结果显示，GTS-21 可减轻 OGD/R 诱导的氧化应激、炎症和凋亡，其保护效应与 PI3K/Akt 信号激活相关。

articles.title: Assembly and characterization of the mitochondrial genome of Camellia pitardii Coh.-St
articles.title_zh: 川滇山茶线粒体基因组的组装与表征
articles.abstract: Camellia pitardii Coh.-St., an economically important tree species in the genus Camellia valued for both its seed oil and ornamental traits, currently lacks a systematically characterized mitochondrial genome. In this study, we assembled and annotated the complete mitogenome of C. pitardii using a hybrid approach that combined Illumina NovaSeq 6000 short reads and Oxford Nanopore long reads. Using bioinformatics tools, we systematically analyzed repetitive sequences, codon usage bias, and RNA editing sites. Furthermore, we constructed phylogenetic trees based on conserved protein-coding genes from both mitochondrial and chloroplast genomes to elucidate the phylogenetic position of these genes. The assembled C. pitardii mitogenome is 895,290 bp in length with a GC content of 45.68%. Annotation revealed a total of 38 protein-coding genes (PCGs), three rRNA genes, and 30 tRNA genes. We identified 260 simple sequence repeats (SSRs), 33 tandem repeats, and 620 pairs of dispersed repeats. Among these, three pairs of long repeats are predicted to mediate the formation of eight potential genomic substructures. The mitogenome exhibited a distinct codon usage bias, with 92.86% of the highly preferred codons (relative synonymous codon usage [RSCU] > 1) ending in A or U. Additionally, 667 RNA editing sites were predicted across the 38 PCGs, encompassing 14 types of amino acid substitutions; 46.48% of these editing events resulted in the conversion of hydrophilic residues to hydrophobic ones. Phylogenetic analyses revealed topological incongruence between the mitochondrial and chloroplast gene trees regarding the placement of several Camellia clades, suggesting a complex evolutionary history for the organelles of C. pitardii and its close relatives. In conclusion, this study characterizeed the fundamental features of the C. pitardii mitogenome, providing valuable baseline data for comparative organellar genomics, phylogenetic reconstruction, and the utilization of germplasm resources within the genus Camellia.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合 Illumina 短读长和 Oxford Nanopore 长读长数据，组装并注释了川滇山茶的完整线粒体基因组。该线粒体基因组长度为 895,290 bp，GC 含量为 45.68%，包含 38 个蛋白编码基因、3 个 rRNA 基因和 30 个 tRNA 基因。作者还系统分析了 SSR、串联重复、散在重复、密码子使用偏好和 RNA 编辑位点，并基于线粒体与叶绿体保守蛋白编码基因构建系统发育树以明确其系统位置。

articles.title: Near-Sensor Damage Localization in Multi-Story Buildings with Level-Crossing Spike Encoding and a Compact Spiking Neural Network
articles.title_zh: 基于电平穿越脉冲编码与紧凑脉冲神经网络的多层建筑近传感器损伤定位
articles.abstract: Wireless, battery-powered accelerometer nodes are widely used for vibration-based structural health monitoring (SHM), but battery life limits the energy for sampling, on-node inference, and radio transmission. We ask whether an event-driven spike front-end can localize stiffness-degrading damage in a multi-story building while making compute cost scale with signal content. Our pipeline places a small modal filterbank before a level-crossing (temporal-contrast) encoder whose single threshold ((θ)) jointly controls accuracy, synaptic-operation count, and the data volume leaving the sensor; a tiny feed-forward spiking neural network (SNN) trained with a surrogate gradient then classifies the spikes. On a six-class task for a five-story shear building under ambient excitation with random damage severity and noise, the SNN reaches ((87.2%)) accuracy, within two points of a dense 1D convolutional baseline (((89.2%))), at an estimated ((49)) versus ((318)),nJ per inference (operation counts at ((45)),nm). Sweeping ((θ)) traces an accuracy-energy Pareto frontier spanning an order of magnitude, and ablations identify the filterbank as the key enabler. A tuned classical modal-feature classifier is the most accurate method here, so we frame the pipeline's value as event-driven, low-data-rate sensing at competitive accuracy rather than an accuracy gain. Code, trained weights, and seeds are publicly available.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向电池供电无线加速度节点的结构健康监测，提出由模态滤波器组、电平穿越时域对比编码器和小型前馈脉冲神经网络组成的近传感器损伤定位流程。编码阈值同时调控分类精度、突触操作数和传感器外传数据量，使计算成本随信号事件稀疏性变化。在五层剪切建筑六分类任务中，模型达到87.2%准确率，接近1D卷积基线的89.2%，但估算单次推理能耗约49 nJ，显著低于基线的318 nJ；消融结果表明模态滤波器组是性能关键。

articles.title: Parametric Sensitivity Assessment of Slip Flow and Thermophoretic Effects on a Vertical Stretching Surface Using Response Surface Methodology
articles.title_zh: 基于响应面方法的垂直拉伸表面滑移流与热泳效应参数敏感性评估
articles.abstract: This study investigates the effect of velocity slip on magnetohydrodynamic boundary-layer flow, emphasizing energy slip and thermophoresis under steady-flow conditions. While Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) employs specialized equipment to generate detailed internal images through proton alignment, the present work focuses on fluid-dynamic mechanisms governing heat and mass transfer. The governing partial differential equations are transformed into ordinary differential equations using similarity transformations and solved with MATLAB’s bvp4c solver. A sensitivity analysis is performed to optimize heat transfer performance, representing a key novelty of the study.
