articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a standard tool for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, yet its training dynamics are still described empirically: reward trajectories are fit with low-parameter functional forms whose constants carry no mechanistic meaning, and hyperparameter choices remain a matter of trial and error. We develop a first-principles reduced-order model of these dynamics. The reduction has three consequences. First, it subsumes the empirical single-exponential saturation law as its overdamped limit, recasting the fitted plateau, timescale, and size exponent as the fixed point, inverse stiffness, and curvature-scaling exponent of the underlying potential, and adding, through the retained inertial term, the slow-start phase the single exponential cannot represent. Second, it yields predictions tied to independently measurable quantities rather than fitted ones: group-size invariance of the deterministic trajectory with a 1/G stationary fluctuation, a sharp stability threshold in the refresh interval, and an overdamped-to-oscillatory transition. Third, it furnishes diagnostics that separate failure modes a reward curve alone conflates -- reward hacking, advantage degeneracy, policy concentration, and dynamical instability. Across three models and two group sizes, the closed-form trajectory fits training reward to R² ≥ 0.91 and the predicted group-size invariance holds on both the reward curve and out-of-distribution transfer to eight math benchmarks. The stability and oscillatory predictions are exercised in a controlled exact-reduction setting where the mean-field assumption holds exactly: a softmax-bandit reduction reproduces the predicted overdamped-to-oscillatory transition and locates the refresh-interval stability threshold at the independently measured stiffness, with a deep-network demonstration left to future work.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对大语言模型推理能力训练中常用的 Group Relative Policy Optimization，提出一阶原理的降阶动力学模型，以替代经验拟合式描述。模型在过阻尼极限下包含单指数饱和律，并将平台值、时间尺度和尺寸指数解释为底层势的固定点、反刚度和曲率标度指数，同时通过惯性项刻画单指数模型无法表示的慢启动阶段。该框架还给出与可独立测量量相关的预测，包括确定性轨迹的组大小不变性、1/G 平稳涨落、刷新间隔稳定性阈值以及从过阻尼到振荡的转变。
authors: Rajat Ghosh, Datta Nimmaturi, Aryan Singhal, Vaishnavi Bhargava, Henry Wong, Johnu George, Debojyoti Dutta

articles.title: Partition-Guided Distance Saliency: Bridging Decision and Objective Spaces in Many-Objective Optimization
articles.title_zh: 分区引导距离显著性：连接多目标优化中的决策空间与目标空间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Explainability in Many-Objective Optimization (MaO) is currently hindered by the escalating complexity of the Pareto front, which renders the relationship between high-dimensional decision variables and objective outcomes increasingly opaque. As the number of objectives exceeds the limits of traditional visualization, decision-makers encounter a ``cognitive drought'' in identifying relevant trade-offs or specifying target regions without a priori knowledge. To bridge this interpretability gap, we introduce the {Partition-Guided Distance Saliency (PGDS)} framework, a novel XAI approach designed for continuous optimization landscapes. Our framework automates the explanation process through a three-stage pipeline that prioritizes geometric intuition over abstract rules. First, we employ a surrogate model that learns how geometric distances in the decision space map to proximity in the objective space. Second, to address the difficulty of manual target selection in high dimensions, the framework automatically partitions the objective landscape into distinct regions and identifies local ``Dominating Points'' to serve as automated targets for improvement. Third, we quantify how sensitive a solution's position is to each decision variable by measuring the distance shifts induced by perturbations to each variable. This allows PGDS to categorize features as either ``Drivers'' which facilitate convergence toward preferred regions, or ``Blockers'' which represent geometric constraints hindering further progress. Validation on 10-objective benchmarks and a physics-informed engineering problem (Welded Beam) demonstrates that PGDS provides differentiated, actionable insights that traditional visualization and rule-based XAI methods fail to provide.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Partition-Guided Distance Saliency 框架，用于提升多目标优化中高维决策变量与目标结果关系的可解释性。该方法首先训练代理模型，学习决策空间几何距离如何映射到目标空间邻近性；随后自动划分目标景观并识别局部支配点作为解释目标，减少人工选择高维目标区域的困难。整体框架强调几何直觉而非抽象规则，面向连续优化景观中的可解释分析。
authors: Cláudio Lúcio do Val Lopes, Flávio Vinícius Cruzeiro Martins, Elizabeth Fialho Wanner

articles.title: Physics-informed Conditional Normalizing Flows for Angles-only Cislunar Orbit Determination
articles.title_zh: 用于仅测角地月空间轨道确定的物理约束条件归一化流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative Astrodynamics is advanced in this work by extending generative modelling to an orbit determination problem in the cislunar environment. The task is formulated as conditional density estimation, aiming to infer the probability distribution of the initial state from angles-only measurements over short observation arcs. A normalising flow is trained on perturbed topocentric observations from Near Rectilinear Halo Orbits, enabling a flexible and potentially multimodal posterior representation. Given new measurements, the learned density is sampled to generate statistically consistent and physics-informed state hypotheses. These estimates are refined via nonlinear least-squares minimisation, providing a competitive warm start for classical algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将生成式建模扩展到地月空间轨道确定问题，把短观测弧上的仅测角数据反演初始状态表述为条件密度估计。作者在受扰动的近直线晕轨道地心观测数据上训练条件归一化流，以表示灵活且可能多峰的后验分布。给定新测量后，模型采样生成统计一致且含物理信息的状态假设，并通过非线性最小二乘进一步精化，为经典轨道确定算法提供有效初值。

articles.title: Revisiting the Volume Hypothesis
articles.title_zh: 重新审视体积假说
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31282v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern deep neural networks often contain far more parameters than needed to fit their training data, yet they achieve impressive generalization. A common explanation for this success is the implicit bias of stochastic gradient descent (SGD). An alternative volume hypothesis posits that, within low training-loss regions, loss-landscape basins leading to strong generalization occupy much larger regions of weight space than basins that generalize poorly, and therefore SGD is simply more likely to land in the former. Recent experimental explorations of this idea present seemingly contradictory results. While in one set of experiments randomly sampling the network weights until achieving zero training error yielded poor generalization, molecular dynamics density estimates supported the volume hypothesis. We observe that these experiments were performed at different dataset size regimes, and explore an intermediate regime using the Replica Exchange Wang-Landau algorithm to estimate the joint density of states over training and test accuracies in binary networks. Across several architectures and datasets, we show that the generalization advantage of gradient learning over random sampling training generally diminishes as the training data size grows, suggesting a resolution of the paradox.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究深度网络泛化中的“体积假说”：在低训练损失区域内，泛化良好的盆地是否比泛化差的盆地占据更大的权重空间体积。作者指出既有实验结论看似矛盾，可能源于数据集规模不同，并用 Replica Exchange Wang-Landau 算法估计二值网络中训练精度与测试精度的联合态密度。结果表明，在多种架构和数据集上，泛化优势与权重空间体积分布之间存在依赖于数据规模的关系。
authors: Ari Pakman, Lior Kreimer, Yakir Berchenko

articles.title: Beyond the Expressivity-Trainability Paradox: A Dynamical Lie Algebra Perspective on Navigating Barren Plateaus in Quantum Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 超越表达能力-可训练性悖论：从动力学李代数视角理解量子机器学习中的贫瘠高原规避
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31536v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As Quantum Machine Learning (QML) transitions toward practical implementation, the field faces a critical architectural bottleneck that challenges the fundamental assumptions of classical statistical learning theory. In classical deep learning, increasing model capacity typically risks overfitting. However, this study advances a counter-intuitive paradigm: unstructured contemporary QML architectures suffer from a profound state of quantum underfitting, driven by the "expressivity-trainability paradox." We demonstrate that the vast Hilbert space capacity of Parameterized Quantum Circuits (PQCs)-traditionally chased as the source of quantum advantage is the direct mathematical cause of Barren Plateaus (BPs), where gradient landscapes become exponentially flat. By synthesizing recent breakthroughs in Dynamical Lie Algebras (DLAs) and Geometric QML, we establish a comprehensive framework linking the algebraic dimension of circuit generators to their optimization dynamics. Furthermore, we empirically validate this framework on a non-linear binary classification task, illuminating a uniquely quantum manifestation of the bias-variance tradeoff: while unstructured architectures achieve near-perfect training accuracy via unscalable parameterization (quantum overfitting), embedding group-theoretic geometric priors acts as a structural regularizer. By restricting the DLA growth to a polynomial regime, our symmetry-preserving approach sacrifices raw memorization capacity to guarantee scalable, gradient-rich training landscapes, offering a robust roadmap for "Trainability-by-Design" in scalable quantum neural networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论量子机器学习中参数化量子线路的架构瓶颈，强调无结构高表达线路可能导致严重的量子欠拟合而非经典意义上的过拟合。作者将 Hilbert 空间容量、贫瘠高原和线路生成元的动力学李代数维数联系起来，提出一个刻画表达能力与优化动力学关系的框架。文中还在非线性二分类任务上进行经验验证，用以说明量子场景下偏差-方差权衡的特殊表现。

articles.title: Low-dimensional topology of deep neural networks
articles.title_zh: 深度神经网络的低维拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study layered models, including feedforward networks, ResNets, and transformers, by limiting each layer to a width of d = 3, i.e., R³ as representation space. This allows us to track how a neural network changes low-dimensional topological invariants through its layers. Just about any topological structure may be simplified or even trivialized by simply increasing dimension; e.g., any knot is equivalent to an unknot in R⁴. By restricting to R³, we not only isolate the effects of activation and depth from that of width, we work in a space that lends itself to easy visualization. We focus on linking number here, deferring other invariants like link groups, Milnor's barμ-invariants, knot types, ambient cobordisms, to a sequel. We provide full proofs and empirical experiments to justify the following insights: When measured by their power to effect changes in linking numbers, the layer-skipping feature in ResNets is as powerful as the attention mechanism in transformers; both ResNets and transformers are strictly more powerful than feedforward neural networks with monotonic activations, which are in turn more powerful than invertible and flow-based models; but replacing monotonic activation with a nonmonotonic one elevates a feedforward network into the same expressivity class as ResNets and transformers. These results suggest that low-dimensional topology can be a useful tool to guide designs of AI architectures. We also generalize our results from d = 3 to arbitrary d > 3.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将前馈网络、ResNet 和 Transformer 的每层表示空间限制在三维，以追踪网络层间如何改变低维拓扑不变量。作者重点研究环绕数，并通过证明和实验比较不同架构改变拓扑结构的能力。结果显示，以改变环绕数的能力衡量，ResNet 的跳连机制与 Transformer 的注意力机制同样强，而二者均强于带单调激活的前馈网络。

articles.title: Interface-Aware Neural Newton Preconditioning for Robust Cohesive Zone Model Simulations
articles.title_zh: 面向稳健黏聚区模型模拟的界面感知神经牛顿预条件方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cohesive Zone Models (CZMs) are widely used to simulate interface fracture, delamination, adhesive failure, and fiber--matrix debonding in aerospace composite structures. In implicit quasi-static finite element analyses, cohesive softening may introduce negative interface tangents, solution jumps, and Newton-basin mismatch, so the previous converged state can become a poor initial guess for the next increment. This may lead to stagnation, wrong-branch convergence, or repeated step cuts. Existing remedies, including viscous regularization, path following, dynamic relaxation, and manual Newton--Raphson (NR) modification, either alter the effective response, increase cost, or rely on hand-crafted interface rules. This work proposes an Interface-Aware Neural Newton Preconditioner (IA-NNP) for difficult CZM increments. IA-NNP recasts manual NR modification as rule-based interface lifting and generalizes it into a learned, state-dependent interface correction. The method acts only on active interface variables and preserves the original traction--separation law, residual assembly, tangent evaluation, history update, and dissipation checks. Two realizations are developed: IA-NNP-Init for learned initial-guess lifting and IA-NNP-NL for iteration-level nonlinear right preconditioning. Interface graph features encode opening, traction, tangent, damage/history variables, mode mixity, residuals, and neighboring states. The correction is bounded, confidence-gated, and accepted only through the original CZM Newton solve. A root-equivalence property shows that IA-NNP changes the path to convergence but not the discrete CZM solution set. Tests on horizontal, circular, two-interface, and active-front benchmarks show improved difficult-increment convergence, better branch recovery, and fewer failures than standard NR and manual NR modification, while preserving the force--displacement response.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向黏聚区模型在隐式准静态有限元分析中的收敛困难，包括界面软化导致的负切线、解跳跃和牛顿吸引域错配。作者提出界面感知神经牛顿预条件器，将人工修改 Newton-Raphson 迭代的经验规则推广为依赖状态的学习型界面修正。该方法只作用于活跃界面变量，并保持原有牵引-分离律、残差组装、切线计算、历史变量更新和耗散检查不变。

articles.title: FedLAB: Traceable Semantic Codebooks for Federated Multimodal Graph Foundation Learning
articles.title_zh: FedLAB：用于联邦多模态图基础学习的可追踪语义码本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.32016v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal graph foundation models aim to learn reusable knowledge from graphs enriched with text, images, attributes, and relational topology, thereby supporting diverse graph-centric and modality-centric tasks. In practice, however, such multimodal graphs are often distributed across decentralized clients, where raw contents and local structures cannot be centrally shared due to privacy constraints. This motivates federated multimodal graph foundation learning, which requires not only transferable representation learning but also intrinsic semantic traceability under strict data isolation. Existing methods usually exchange or store knowledge through parameters, prototypes, embeddings, or compact codebooks, which support optimization and transfer but do not explicitly expose how modality evidence, node semantics, and topology context jointly support predictions. To bridge this gap, we propose FedLAB, a traceable semantic codebook framework that organizes multimodal graph knowledge into typed hierarchical codebooks for modality evidence, node semantics, and topology context. FedLAB further refines these trace units through federated semantic barycenter pre-training while keeping raw multimodal contents and graph structures local. Extensive experiments on 10 benchmarks and 6 downstream tasks show that FedLAB improves over state-of-the-art baselines by up to 7.53%, while preserving a native semantic trace interface.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究隐私约束下分散客户端上的多模态图基础模型学习，目标是在不能共享原始内容和局部结构的条件下实现可迁移表示与语义可追踪性。作者提出 FedLAB，将多模态图知识组织为类型化、层次化码本，分别刻画模态证据、节点语义和拓扑上下文。该框架旨在弥补现有参数、原型、嵌入或紧凑码本难以显式解释预测依据的问题。
authors: Zekai Chen, Kairui Yang, Xuaner Chen, Xunkai Li, Xun Wu, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang

articles.title: Seven-dimensional Trajectory Reconstruction for VAMOS++
articles.title_zh: VAMOS++ 的七维轨迹重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.18959v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The VAMOS++ magnetic spectrometer is characterized by a large angular and momentum acceptance and highly non-linear ion optics properties requiring the use of software ion trajectory reconstruction methods to measure the ion magnetic rigidity and the trajectory length between the beam interaction point and the focal plane of the spectrometer. Standard measurements, involving the use of a thin target and a narrow beam spot, allow the assumption of a point-like beam interaction volume for ion trajectory reconstruction. However, this represents a limitation for the case of large beam spot size or extended gaseous target volume. To overcome this restriction, a seven-dimensional reconstruction method incorporating the reaction position coordinates was developed, making use of artificial deep neural networks. The neural networks were trained on a theoretical dataset generated by standard magnetic ray-tracing code. Future application to a voluminous gas target, necessitating the explicit inclusion of the three-dimensional position of the beam interaction point within the target in the trajectory reconstruction method, is discussed. The performances of the new method are presented along with a comparison of mass resolution obtained with previously reported model for the case of thin-target experimental data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对 VAMOS++ 磁谱仪的大角度和动量接受度以及强非线性离子光学特性，发展包含反应位置坐标的七维离子轨迹重建方法。传统重建通常假设束流相互作用体积为点状，难以处理大束斑或扩展气体靶。作者使用由标准磁射线追踪程序生成的理论数据训练深度神经网络，并讨论其在大体积气体靶实验中的应用前景。

articles.title: Analysis of Atomic Charge State and Atomic Number for VAMOS++ Magnetic Spectrometer using Deep Neural Networks and Fractionally Labelled Events
articles.title_zh: 利用深度神经网络和分数标注事件分析 VAMOS++ 磁谱仪中的原子电荷态与原子序数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.07109v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The VAMOS++ magnetic spectrometer is a multi-parametric system that integrates ion optical magnetic elements with a multi-detector stack. The magnetic elements, along with the tracking and timing detectors and the trajectory reconstruction method, provide the analysis of the magnetic rigidity, the trajectory length between the beam interaction point and the focal plane of the spectrometer, and the related velocity and mass-over-charge ratio. The segmented ionization chamber provides the energy measurements necessary to analyze the atomic charge state and atomic number. However, this analysis critically suffers from inherent limitations due to the variable thickness and non-uniformity of the entrance window of the ionization chamber and other detector imperfections. Conventionally, this meticulous, detailed analysis is exceptionally tedious, often requiring several months to complete. We present a novel method utilizing deep neural networks, trained on an experimental dataset with only a small fraction of precisely labeled events for the lowest and best-resolved atomic charge states or numbers. This innovative approach enables the networks to autonomously and accurately classify the remaining events. This method drastically accelerates the acquisition of high-resolution atomic charge state and atomic number spectra, reducing analysis time from months to mere hours. Crucially, by discarding human bias, this approach ensures standardized, optimal, and reproducible results with unprecedented efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对 VAMOS++ 磁谱仪中原子电荷态和原子序数分析的困难，特别是电离室入口窗厚度变化、非均匀性和探测器缺陷带来的系统限制。传统分析高度繁琐，往往需要数月完成。作者提出用深度神经网络处理实验数据，并仅依赖少量精确标注的低电荷态或低原子序数事件进行训练，以加速和改进识别流程。

articles.title: Domain-Decomposed Randomized Neural Networks for Partial Differential Equations in Unbounded Domains
articles.title_zh: 用于无界区域偏微分方程的区域分解随机神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31342v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Partial differential equations on unbounded domains are challenging because the exterior region must be represented without excessive truncation error. Truncation-based methods often require problem-dependent artificial boundary conditions, while global spectral bases may be inefficient for localized structures, irregular geometries, or solutions with different near-field and far-field behaviors. We propose a domain-decomposed randomized neural network framework for such problems. Different randomized subnetworks are assigned to different spatial regimes: a near-field subnetwork captures local and geometric features, whereas a far-field subnetwork represents exterior decay. The subnetworks are coupled by boundary and interface conditions, and only the output-layer coefficients are solved from linear least-squares systems arising from Petrov--Galerkin or collocation formulations. We develop a Petrov--Galerkin method for semi-unbounded elliptic problems and a collocation method for fully unbounded, perforated, and time-dependent problems. A conditional bounded-parameter approximation result is proved in a broken Sobolev norm, together with an error decomposition covering approximation, empirical-consistency/quadrature, and least-squares optimization errors. Numerical experiments for Poisson and time-dependent Schrödinger equations demonstrate the accuracy and flexibility of the proposed method.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种面向无界区域偏微分方程的区域分解随机神经网络框架，以降低外部区域截断和人工边界条件带来的误差与问题依赖性。方法为近场和远场分配不同随机子网络，分别捕捉局部几何特征和外部衰减，并通过边界与界面条件耦合。作者发展了半无界椭圆问题的 Petrov-Galerkin 方法以及完全无界、穿孔和时变问题的配点方法，并给出破 Sobolev 范数下的条件逼近结果。
authors: Haixin Wang, Haoning Dang, Fei Wang, Shimin Guo

articles.title: Temperature Field Reconstruction of Tungsten Monoblock Divertor on EAST using Physics-aware Neural Operator Transformer
articles.title_zh: 基于物理感知神经算子 Transformer 的 EAST 钨单块偏滤器温度场重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31574v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate modeling of the divertor temperature field is essential for preventing material melting and damage and for extending the service life of fusion devices. However, conventional numerical methods, such as the Finite Element Method (FEM), are computationally expensive and therefore unsuitable for real-time applications. Therefore, a fast and generalizable method is required for real-time reconstruction of the divertor temperature field and subsequent real-time control. To address the above issue, we propose a Physics-aware Neural Operator Transformer (PNOT) to characterize the spatiotemporal evolution of the divertor temperature field. It models boundary heat-flux relations as a structured graph and employs graph attention to explicitly capture spatial physical dependencies. Inspired by physics-aware attention, we further develop a physics-aware neural operator module to aggregate query points with similar physical conditions via slicing and model heat diffusion, while a gradient-constrained Sobolev regularization loss enforces consistency between function values and their derivatives. Experimental results show that these physical constraints improve prediction accuracy while preserving physical consistency. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向聚变装置偏滤器温度场的实时重建需求，提出物理感知神经算子 Transformer，以替代计算代价较高的有限元模拟。模型将边界热流关系表示为结构化图，并用图注意力显式捕捉空间物理依赖；同时引入物理感知神经算子模块和梯度约束 Sobolev 正则化，以刻画热扩散并约束函数值与导数的一致性。实验结果表明，这类物理先验有助于提升温度场重建的速度和泛化能力。
authors: Zikang Yan, Xiao Wang, Qingquan Yang, Zhendong Yang, Gaoting Chen, Zehua Chen, Bo Jiang, Jin Tang, Guosheng Xu

articles.title: Self-Study Reconsidered: The Hidden Fragility of Learning from Self-Generated QA
articles.title_zh: 重新审视自学习：基于自生成问答学习的隐蔽脆弱性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.32002v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language models are increasingly taught from synthetic question--answer (QA) supervision: a model generates questions about a document, answers them from the same text, and the resulting pairs are used to fine-tune, distill, or compress knowledge into another model. We show that this generation step is not neutral preprocessing. It is an implicit policy that both selects which evidence becomes training signal and decides how that evidence is answered, and it is fragile at both stages. When choosing what to ask, generators do not scan a document uniformly. Coverage saturates early and concentrates on salient spans, diverse prompts converge on the same regions, and what looks question-worthy is driven by local presentation. As a result, salient artifacts such as poorly cleaned markup can hijack question generation across model families and scales. When answering, the model that produces the supervision tends to obey instruction-like passages embedded in the text. This compliance depends on the intent and surface form of the passage rather than its strictness, and is worst under task conflict, where larger models comply more often. These failure modes arise from choices made during QA generation, so they can be reduced without changing the training loop. Tying each question to a fixed target reduces biased selection, and filtering instruction-like spans before answering lowers mean injection compliance from 88% to 13% in our evaluation while retaining nearly all clean text.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，语言模型用文档自生成问答对进行微调、蒸馏或知识压缩时，问答生成并非中性预处理，而是隐式决定哪些证据进入训练信号以及如何被回答的策略。作者发现，问题生成会过早饱和并集中于显著片段，不同提示也常收敛到相同区域，甚至会被清洗不充分的标记等显著伪迹劫持。回答阶段还可能服从文本中类似指令的片段，尤其在任务冲突时更明显，显示自生成监督存在系统性脆弱性。
authors: Ekaterina Alimaskina, Denis Shveykin, Gleb Molodtsov, Igor Shalygin, Alexey Kadeishvili, Aleksandr Beznosikov

articles.title: Perturbation Effects on Robustness and Individual Fairness
articles.title_zh: 扰动对鲁棒性与个体公平性的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2404.01356v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Deep neural networks are vulnerable to adversarial perturbations that can simultaneously degrade prediction robustness and individual fairness across diverse application settings. However, existing evaluation protocols typically assess these dimensions in isolation, thereby obscuring critical failure modes. To bridge this gap, we formalize Robust Individual Fairness (RIF): under semantic-preserving (truth-condition-preserving) perturbations, predictions should remain both correct with respect to the ground truth and invariant across semantically equivalent individuals. To surface RIF violations in practice, we introduce RIFair, a black-box adversarial framework that leverages a decoupled perturbation strategy to construct semantically preserved yet unrobust and/or unfair instance pairs. Experiments across multiple model architectures and real-world textual datasets show that robustness-only or fairness-only metrics often miss Robust Biased and Unrobust Fair behaviors. RIFair}reliably exposes these hidden vulnerabilities, supporting RIF as a necessary criterion for trustworthy model assessment. The experimental code is publicly available at https://github.com/Xuran-LI/RIFair.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究对抗扰动如何同时破坏深度网络的预测鲁棒性和个体公平性，指出单独评估二者会掩盖关键失效模式。作者形式化提出鲁棒个体公平性，要求在保持语义和真实条件不变的扰动下，预测既应正确又应对语义等价个体保持不变。文中提出黑盒对抗框架 RIFair，用解耦扰动策略构造语义保持但不鲁棒或不公平的样本对，并在多种文本数据和模型上揭示传统指标遗漏的隐藏风险。
authors: Xuran Li, Hao Xue, Peng Wu, Xingjun Ma, Zhen Zhang, Huaming Chen, Flora D. Salim

articles.title: Learning Hamiltonian Flow Maps: Mean Flow Consistency for Large-Timestep Molecular Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 学习哈密顿流映射：用于大时间步分子动力学的平均流一致性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.22123v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Simulating the long-time evolution of Hamiltonian systems is limited by the small timesteps required for stable numerical integration. To overcome this constraint, we introduce a framework to learn Hamiltonian Flow Maps by predicting the mean phase-space evolution over a chosen time span, enabling stable large-timestep updates far beyond the stability limits of classical integrators. To this end, we impose a Mean Flow consistency condition for time-averaged Hamiltonian dynamics. Unlike prior approaches, this allows training on independent phase-space samples without access to future states, avoiding expensive trajectory generation. Validated across diverse Hamiltonian systems, our method in particular improves upon molecular dynamics simulations using machine-learned force fields (MLFF). Our models maintain comparable training and inference cost, but support significantly larger integration timesteps while trained directly on widely-available trajectory-free MLFF datasets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出学习哈密顿流映射的方法，通过预测给定时间跨度内相空间的平均演化，实现超出经典积分器稳定步长限制的大时间步更新。作者引入平均流一致性条件，使模型可在独立相空间样本上训练，而无需获取未来状态或生成昂贵轨迹。该方法在多类哈密顿系统中验证，尤其适用于机器学习力场驱动的分子动力学，在相近训练和推理成本下支持显著更大的积分时间步。
authors: Winfried Ripken, Michael Plainer, Gregor Lied, Thorben Frank, Oliver T. Unke, Stefan Chmiela, Frank Noé, Klaus-Robert Müller

articles.title: Smart charging of large fleets of Electric Vehicles: Independent Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning approaches
articles.title_zh: 大规模电动汽车车队的智能充电：独立多智能体强化学习方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31347v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electrification of transportation through electric vehicles introduces new challenges for power grid management, such as increased peak demand, voltage fluctuations, line overloads, and the integration of variable renewable energy sources. To enable efficient integration of EVs while minimizing costs for users and avoiding network overloads, implicit coordination between EVs is required. This work compares two independent multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches for optimizing such decentralized EV charging: contextual combinatorial bandits and policy gradient algorithms. Using a realistic simulation environment with autonomous agents making decisions based on local environmental information (including price signals, state-of-charge, and temporal constraints), we evaluate their performance across varying congestion levels, and mixed-strategy configurations with heterogeneous agent groups under dynamic electricity pricing derived from real photovoltaic production data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向大规模电动汽车接入带来的峰值负荷、 voltage 波动、线路过载及可再生能源波动等电网管理问题，比较两类去中心化智能充电方法：上下文组合赌博机与策略梯度算法。作者在包含价格信号、荷电状态和时间约束等局部信息的真实感仿真环境中，考察不同拥塞水平、异质智能体混合策略以及基于真实光伏数据生成的动态电价下的性能。
authors: Xavier Rate, Eloann Le Guern, Raphaël Féraud, Fatma Salem, Melissa Chiknoun, Eymeric Giabicani, Mehdi Feki, Patrick Maillé, Guy Camilleri, Anne Blavette, Hamid Benhamed

articles.title: Xiaomi-GUI-0 Technical Report
articles.title_zh: Xiaomi-GUI-0 技术报告
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents build on vision-language models to complete user tasks end-to-end in real applications through interface actions such as tapping, swiping, text entry, and navigation. However, existing GUI agents are trained and evaluated largely on offline trajectories, simulated environments, and standardized benchmarks. These differ substantially from real applications in interface layout, interaction logic, and abnormal-state distribution, and cannot faithfully characterize execution stability in real-world use, where account states, permission dialogs, payment authentication, and risk control continually reshape the state distribution and open a persistent gap between benchmark scores and real usability. To close this gap, we propose Xiaomi-GUI-0, a native multimodal GUI agent for real mobile environments, trained and evaluated within a real-device closed loop. At its core is a real-device-dominant hybrid infrastructure, where physical devices are the primary execution environment and sandboxes provide auxiliary support, so that data collection, training, rollout, and evaluation share an execution distribution close to real deployment. We construct multi-source training data spanning high-frequency head tasks, high-generalization data for long-tail intents, and capability-enhancement data for reflection and memory, and introduce an error-driven data flywheel that turns failure trajectories into corrected actions, reflective explanations, and recovery demonstrations. The model is trained through a progressive three-stage pipeline of supervised fine-tuning, step-level reinforcement learning, and agentic reinforcement learning. Evaluated on public benchmarks and our in-house RealMobile, Xiaomi-GUI-0 achieves 72.0% success on RealMobile and 78.9% on AndroidWorld, while substantially improving execution stability and abnormal-state recognition in real-world tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报告提出 Xiaomi-GUI-0，一种面向真实移动设备环境的原生多模态 GUI 智能体，旨在缩小离线轨迹、模拟环境和标准基准与真实应用可用性之间的差距。其核心是以真实设备为主、沙箱为辅的混合基础设施，使数据采集、训练、回放和评测共享更接近真实使用的执行分布，覆盖账号状态、权限弹窗、支付认证和风控等复杂状态。
authors: Wanxia Cao, Chengzhen Duan, Pei Fu, Pengzhi Gao, Niu Lian, Fazhan Liu, Hui Liu, Heng Qu, Qinzhuo Wu, Zhehao Yu, Tongbo Chen, Shiqi Cui, Anan Du, Shukai Jia, Yuanfa Li, Yike Liu, Wenchao Lu, Haoyuan Sun, Jiatong Sun, Cheng Tan, Yajie Wang, Changqiao Wu, Tao Xiong, Jiahui Yang, Yuxuan Yuan, Ruoceng Zhang, Shaojie Zhang, Jian Zhu, Jian Luan, Cong Zou

articles.title: Creating Intelligence: A Computational Foundation for AGI
articles.title_zh: 创造智能：通向 AGI 的计算基础
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31819v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work introduces a new computational theory of mind grounded in set theory and hyperdimensional computing. Whereas traditional neural networks rely on continuous weights and matrix multiplication, this framework works with sparse binary data. It represents information as discrete sets, directly modeling biological neural population codes. I demonstrate that associative memory emerges naturally from network topologies featuring a combinatorially expanded hidden layer. Learning is driven by topological plasticity rather than scalar weight adjustments. This architecture unifies auto-associative and hetero-associative learning under a single core algorithm: information retrieval via subset pattern matching and exact nearest-neighbor search. Operating with constant-time complexity, these mechanisms bridge perceptual data (sparse distributed representations) and symbols (sparse holographic representations) without continuous bottlenecks. Mapping this framework to neuroanatomy, I propose that both the cerebellum and the neocortex implement variants of this algorithm, making subset pattern matching the fundamental engine of cognition. Because it relies on discrete logic rather than matrix arithmetic, this algorithm translates directly into in-memory hardware. This opens a new route toward synthetic intelligence with human-level energy efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种基于集合论和超维计算的心智计算理论，用稀疏二值数据和离散集合替代传统神经网络中的连续权重与矩阵乘法。作者认为，组合扩展隐藏层的网络拓扑可自然产生联想记忆，学习由拓扑可塑性驱动，并通过子集模式匹配与精确最近邻搜索统一自联想和异联想学习。该框架还被映射到小脑和新皮层，主张子集模式匹配可能是认知的基础机制。

articles.title: Position: Vision-Language-Action Models Cannot Be Verified to Perform Physical Reasoning
articles.title_zh: 立场：视觉-语言-动作模型无法被验证具备物理推理能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30686v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, built on pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), have shown rapidly improving performance on robot manipulation benchmarks. These gains are commonly interpreted as evidence that semantic representations learned from internet-scale data transfer to physical execution generalization. This position paper argues that the assumption underlying this interpretation -- that semantic generalization is sufficient to support physical action decisions -- has not been independently verified and cannot be tested under current evaluation protocols. We support this claim by decomposing VLA policies into semantic mapping and physical action decision, and showing that task success rate -- the dominant evaluation metric -- cannot distinguish between these two sources of capability. As a result, improvements in benchmark performance are consistent with multiple competing explanations, including semantic matching, distributional overlap, and genuine physical generalization. We further argue that this identifiability gap has been reinforced through narrative drift, whereby successive systems inherit and strengthen prior interpretations of performance gains without isolating the underlying causal mechanism. To address this limitation, we propose a research direction based on evaluation designs that introduce controlled variation to separately measure semantic and physical generalization. Such designs make it possible to causally attribute performance without requiring access to model internals, and to empirically assess the role of VLM backbones as semantic interfaces rather than implicit sources of physical competence. Our goal is not to refute the role of VLMs in robotics, but to clarify the conditions under which claims of physical generalization can be meaningfully evaluated.
articles.abstract_zh: 该立场论文质疑将 VLA 系统在机器人操作基准上的性能提升直接解释为物理执行泛化能力的观点。作者将 VLA 策略分解为语义映射与物理动作决策，指出主流的任务成功率指标无法区分语义匹配、分布重叠和真正物理泛化等不同能力来源，因此现有评测协议存在可识别性缺口。
authors: Taozhao Chen, Ian Manchester, Huaming Chen

articles.title: LUMOS: A Semantic Operating-System Layer for Accessibility-Grounded AI Agents
articles.title_zh: LUMOS：面向可访问性锚定 AI 智能体的语义操作系统层
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30697v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Current operating systems expose interfaces optimized for human users but not for AI agents. Humans benefit from pixels, icons, windows, visual grouping, mouse movement, and keyboard shortcuts; AI agents instead need compact semantic state, grounded actions, and reliable feedback. As a result, many computer-use agents are forced to interpret screenshots, OCR output, and visual crops, introducing high token costs, visual ambiguity, latency, and coordinate uncertainty. This paper introduces LUMOS (Language Model Unified Machine-Readable Operating-System Semantics), a semantic interaction layer between AI agents and operating systems. LUMOS converts native accessibility metadata and browser UI structures into machine readable semantic blueprints with stable identifiers, roles, names, values, bounds, and action affordances. It also supports live semantic pointer grounding by querying the UI element under or near the cursor through operating-system automation APIs. An LLM then acts through an accessibility grounded observe act loop using constrained visible-UI primitives rather than application-specific scripts. LUMOS does not claim to replace visual agents; instead, it reduces dependence on screenshots when operating systems already provide semantic structure. These results suggest a path toward AI-native operating systems and machine-readable interaction layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出 LUMOS，一种位于 AI 智能体与操作系统之间的语义交互层，用机器可读的界面语义替代高成本且不稳定的截图、OCR 和坐标推断。LUMOS 将原生可访问性元数据和浏览器 UI 结构转换为包含稳定标识符、角色、名称、数值、边界和动作能力的语义蓝图，并支持基于系统自动化 API 的实时指针语义定位。

articles.title: An AI-Based Solution for Secure Service Provisioning in IoT
articles.title_zh: 一种面向物联网安全服务配置的 AI 解决方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30701v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As the Internet of Things (IoT) continues its rapid expansion, the attack surface grows accordingly, with emerging threats targeting smart objects and their interactions. In this evolving landscape, securing service provisioning is crucial to ensure the proper functioning, security, and reliability of the IoT ecosystem. Service provisioning encompasses key tasks such as device registration, configuration, authentication, authorization, and software deployment, all of which are essential for seamless and secure IoT operations. In this paper, we present a comprehensive framework designed to select the most suitable smart objects to deliver a target service within a given IoT environment while also monitoring the behavior of the entities involved during the service provisioning phase. To achieve this, we employ a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) approach in which an intelligent agent learns, through interaction with a complex, dynamic environment, how to adapt to changes while adhering to predefined security constraints. For behavioral monitoring, we leverage Federated Learning (FL) to develop a global Behavioral Fingerprinting (BF) model that is fully distributed and can analyze how IoT devices interact within the network. In addition, the BF is used to compute a reliability score for each service provider, reflecting its degree of compliance with the defined security constraints. This score is then incorporated into the service provisioning process, allowing smart objects to select providers not only according to functional suitability but also to their reliability level. Finally, we conduct an extensive experimental evaluation to assess the robustness and scalability of our approach. The results demonstrate that our solution can be effectively deployed even on resource-constrained IoT devices, making it a viable and scalable security-enhancing mechanism for modern IoT ecosystems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向物联网设备快速扩张带来的攻击面扩大问题，提出一个用于安全服务配置的综合框架，以选择合适智能对象并监测服务配置阶段各实体行为。框架采用深度强化学习使智能体在动态复杂环境中遵守安全约束并自适应决策，同时利用联邦学习构建全局行为指纹模型，以支持行为监测。
authors: Marco Arazzi, Mert Cihangiroglu, Serena Nicolazzo, Antonino Nocera, Vinod P

articles.title: Stage-Transition Dense Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 用于强化学习的阶段转移密集奖励建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31377v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon robotic manipulation is often limited by sparse and delayed rewards, while manually designing dense shaping signals is costly and brittle to changes in environments and object configurations. This work proposes Stage-Transition Dense Reward (STDR), a visual reward-learning framework that converts unstructured expert videos into logically grounded dense rewards for training RL agents from scratch. STDR leverages semantic understanding to infer a task's stage structure from demonstrations, and delivers two complementary learning signals during online training: (i) stage-transition feedback that provides goal-directed reward, and (ii) within-stage progress feedback that supplies fine-grained guidance toward completing each stage. Furthermore, an out-of-distribution (OOD) detection mechanism and a grasping regulation module are integrated to enhance robustness and prevent reward hacking. Experiments on 14 manipulation tasks across MetaWorld, ManiSkill, and Franka Kitchen show that STDR consistently improves sample efficiency and success rates over multiple baselines, and matches or surpasses handcrafted dense rewards on several challenging tasks. Real-robot evaluations further indicate that STDR assigns stable, progress-aligned rewards on successful executions while producing appropriately low rewards for failures, suggesting robustness to visual noise and better-calibrated reward assignment across settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 STDR，一种视觉奖励学习框架，用于将非结构化专家视频转化为逻辑化的密集奖励，以训练长时程机器人操作强化学习智能体。STDR 通过语义理解推断任务阶段结构，并在在线训练中同时提供阶段转移奖励和阶段内进展反馈；结合 OOD 检测和抓取调节模块后，在多个 MetaWorld、ManiSkill 和 Franka Kitchen 操作任务上提升了样本效率和成功率。
authors: Yang Yang, Bingjie Chen, Zihan Wang, Yizhe Li, Guoping Pan, Yi Cheng, Houde Liu

articles.title: Mitigating Positional Leakage in 3D Masked Autoencoders for Robust Representation Learning
articles.title_zh: 缓解 3D 掩码自编码器中的位置泄漏以实现鲁棒表征学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31570v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Masked autoencoding has emerged as a prominent paradigm for self-supervised learning on 3D point clouds, achieving competitive performance across downstream tasks. Unlike its 2D counterpart, 3D masked autoencoding directly reconstructs spatial coordinates, making it inherently susceptible to positional leakage. In this work, we identify that the decoder in existing 3D MAE frameworks tends to over-rely on positional information, which weakens semantic representation learning and leads to suboptimal feature quality. To address this issue, we propose MPL-MAE, a masked point learning framework that mitigates positional over-reliance while enhancing the utilization of encoder features. Specifically, we introduce a recalibrated positional embedding module that suppresses metric-dominant coordinate signals while preserving geometric topology, together with a gated positional interface module that dynamically regulates positional injection during reconstruction. These designs promote a more balanced interaction between spatial priors and semantic features, yielding robust and informative representations. Extensive experiments across downstream tasks demonstrate that MPL-MAE consistently achieves competitive performance, validating its effectiveness. Code is available at https://github.com/yanx57/MPL-MAE.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，3D 点云掩码自编码器因直接重建空间坐标，解码器容易过度依赖位置信息，从而削弱语义表征学习。作者提出 MPL-MAE，通过重校准位置嵌入抑制度量坐标主导信号并保留几何拓扑，同时用门控位置接口动态调节重建中的位置信息注入，以获得更稳健、更具信息量的点云表征。
authors: Xu Yan, Huiqun Wang, Chen Wang, Lei Ren, Di Huang

articles.title: Machine Learning Prediction of Early-Season Wildfire Risk in Ghana’s Guinea Savannah Using Multi-Source Data and CMIP6 Climate Scenarios
articles.title_zh: 利用多源数据和 CMIP6 气候情景预测加纳几内亚稀树草原早季野火风险的机器学习研究
articles.abstract: Wildfires in Ghana’s Guinea Savannah zone affect large areas each dry season, yet Ghana still lacks a locally calibrated early-season fire danger tool for the northern savannah. This study develops and evaluates a machine learning fire-risk prototype for November-January using a 1 km gridded dataset for 2001-2024. The dataset combines MODIS burned area, NASA FIRMS active fire detections, ERA5-Land, CHIRPS, FLDAS soil moisture, MODIS vegetation products, SRTM topography, and human-access variables. Twenty-one base predictor variables were expanded into 123 model features using monthly lags, rolling statistics, anomalies, drought indices, and seasonal indicators. Five algorithms were compared: Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, and a multilayer perceptron. On the stratified test sample, the tree-based models achieved high discrimination, with AUC values of 0.960-0.962. Because the model-development sample was deliberately balanced relative to the full cell-month population, threshold-dependent metrics such as precision, F1, MCC, and Brier score are treated as sampling-dependent and are interpreted with prevalence-adjusted estimates. The full-feature LightGBM model exceeded the monthly aggregated Canadian Fire Weather Index by an absolute AUC difference of 0.28, although this comparison reflects both algorithm choice and the richer feature set rather than machine learning alone. Feature attribution did not support a single dominant soil-moisture control. Instead, temperature range, population density, surface pressure, precipitation memory, vegetation state, and soil-moisture memory all contributed to predicted fire risk. Surface pressure and other static or near-static variables are interpreted cautiously because they may encode spatial location and elevation. Bias-corrected CMIP6 experiments suggest higher late-century fire risk under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5, but these projections are presented as illustrative because tree ensembles cannot extrapolate beyond the training envelope and human drivers were held constant. The revised index should therefore be viewed as a research prototype that can support future operational testing, not as a fully validated warning system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究为加纳北部几内亚稀树草原开发 11 月至 1 月早季火险机器学习原型，使用 2001-2024 年 1 km 网格数据，整合 MODIS、NASA FIRMS、ERA5-Land、CHIRPS、FLDAS、SRTM 及人类可达性变量等多源信息。作者将 21 个基础变量扩展为 123 个特征，并比较随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost 和多层感知机；树模型在分层测试样本上取得约 0.960-0.962 的 AUC，但阈值相关指标需结合样本平衡和流行率调整解释。

articles.title: Functionalized Carbon Nanotubes as Nanoinhibitors of Asphaltene Aggregation: A Molecular Dynamics Approach for Enhanced Oil Recovery
articles.title_zh: 功能化碳纳米管作为沥青质聚集纳米抑制剂：面向提高采收率的分子动力学研究
articles.abstract: In the scientific literature, several experimental studies have investigated the use of nanoparticles to reduce asphaltene aggregation in crude oil systems. However, experimental approaches alone cannot fully elucidate the molecular-scale mechanisms governing asphaltene adsorption and aggregation or the influence of nanoparticle surface properties on these processes. In this study, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were performed to examine the adsorption configuration of asphaltene molecules and the effect of bare and functionalized single-walled CNTs in a toluene /heptane mixture on their aggregation. The simulation results showed that CNTs adsorbed asphaltene molecules through π–π stacking and van der Waals interactions, while functionalized CNTs also formed hydrogen bonds. By comparing five systems containing CNTs both bare and functionalized with carbamoyl (CONH₂), methylcarbamoyl (CONHCH₃), hydroxymethyl (CH₂OH), and carboxylate (COO⁻) groups, radial distribution functions (RDFs), solvent-accessible surface area (SASA) analysis, cluster analysis, hydrogen bonding, and interaction energy calculations were performed to characterize the aggregation behavior. Results show that functionalized CNTs reduce asphaltene deposition more effectively than bare CNT, with carboxylate functionalized CNT exhibiting the strongest dispersing effect. This superior performance is attributed to enhanced electrostatic interactions and hydrogen bonding with polar sites of asphaltenes. These findings highlight the potential of rational CNT surface functionalization as a nanoscale strategy for mitigating asphaltene aggregation and enhanced crude oil recovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用分子动力学模拟考察甲苯/庚烷混合体系中裸露及功能化单壁碳纳米管对沥青质吸附构型和聚集行为的影响。结果表明，碳纳米管可通过 π-π 堆积和范德华作用吸附沥青质，功能化后还可形成氢键；作者比较了 CONH2、CONHCH3、CH2OH 和 COO- 等官能团，并通过 RDF、SASA、团簇、氢键和相互作用能分析揭示其抑制聚集机制。

articles.title: The Investigation of the Corrosion Protective -properties of Reinforced Epoxy Resin With Clay Nanoparticles on Mild Steel
articles.title_zh: 黏土纳米颗粒增强环氧树脂在低碳钢上的防腐性能研究
articles.abstract: This study investigated the development and optimization of clay nanoparticle-reinforced epoxy coatings for enhancing the corrosion protection and mechanical performance of mild steel in acidic environments. Epoxy nanocomposite coatings containing varying clay nanoparticle loadings (0–5 wt.%) were prepared and applied to mild steel substrates. A Central Composite Design (CCD) within the Response Surface Methodology (RSM) framework was employed to optimize the effects of clay loading and hydrochloric acid concentration on coating performance. Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS), potentiodynamic polarization, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), adhesion testing (ASTM D3359), and Rockwell hardness testing were used to evaluate the coatings. The electrochemical results showed that clay nanoparticle incorporation significantly increased polarization resistance (Rp), with coated samples exhibiting values up to 540 Ω compared with 210–234 Ω for unreinforced epoxy. Statistical analysis revealed that clay loading was the most significant factor influencing corrosion resistance (p < 0.05), while the optimization model predicted an optimum formulation at approximately 3.48 wt.% clay nanoparticles and 0.5 M HCl, corresponding to a predicted polarization resistance of 546.76 Ω. Experimental validation produced a higher Rp of 591.4 Ω, confirming the reliability of the optimization model. The optimized coating also demonstrated superior mechanical performance, achieving an ASTM D3359 adhesion rating of 3B compared with 1B for commercial coatings, and the highest Rockwell hardness of 85.9 HRC, exceeding those of Sikaflex (72.75 HRC) and Hinaz (78.25 HRC). SEM observations indicated improved coating integrity and nanoparticle dispersion, contributing to enhanced barrier properties. Overall, the optimized clay-reinforced epoxy coating exhibited significantly improved electrochemical stability, adhesion, hardness, and corrosion resistance, demonstrating its potential as a cost-effective and sustainable protective coating for mild steel in aggressive industrial environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究制备了含 0-5 wt.% 黏土纳米颗粒的环氧纳米复合涂层，并评估其在酸性环境中对低碳钢的防腐和力学增强效果。作者采用响应面法中的中心复合设计优化黏土含量和盐酸浓度影响，并结合 EIS、动电位极化、SEM、附着力和硬度测试；结果显示黏土掺入显著提高极化电阻，黏土含量是影响耐蚀性的关键因素，模型预测最佳配方约为 3.48 wt.% 黏土。

articles.title: Extraction and Characterization of Indigenous Ethiopian Violet Tree Bast Fiber
articles.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚本土紫树韧皮纤维的提取与表征
articles.abstract: Recently, there has been growing interest in sustainable consumption, mainly due to its eco-friendliness and potential as raw materials for the textile and fashion industries. This study investigated the qualities of the Ethiopian violet tree (Enjeji) and its potential for producing environmentally acceptable materials. Chemical extraction techniques using sodium hydroxide were used. Length, diameter, fineness, tenacity, moisture content, moisture regain, cellulose, hemicellulose, lignin, and ash content were the physical, mechanical, and chemical characteristics described. The findings demonstrate that the properties of the fiber are similar to those of other bast fibers utilized in the fashion and textile industries. Chemical composition analysis revealed that the Ethiopian violet tree fiber is composed of 62–66% cellulose, 18.5–25% hemicellulose, and 13.45-14% lignin. The FTIR spectra of the extracted fibers also confirmed the presence of cellulose, hemicellulose, and lignin. The dimensional characteristics of the fiber show a diameter of 14.2–30.8 lm and fineness of 4.6–13.5 tex, with fiber length ranging from 180 mm to 200 mm; moisture content and moisture regain are 10.8% and 12%, respectively. The mechanical properties of the fiber show tenacity 55cN/tex, tensile strength of 650–720 MPa, and elastic modulus1915 cN/tex, placing it close to established bast fibers such as hemp and flax. The high cellulose content, good dimensional and moisture characteristics, and good mechanical properties of banana fibers compared with conventional natural fibers indicate possible conventional and non-conventional applications in the textile and fashion industries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以埃塞俄比亚紫树 Enjeji 为对象，采用氢氧化钠化学提取方法评估其作为环保纺织和时尚原料的潜力。作者表征了纤维长度、直径、细度、强度、回潮率及纤维素、半纤维素、木质素和灰分含量，结果显示其性质接近其他已用于纺织行业的韧皮纤维；FTIR 进一步确认了纤维素、半纤维素和木质素的存在。

articles.title: Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Secure Direct Communication Based on Decoy States and Polarization--Spatial Hyperentanglement
articles.title_zh: 基于诱骗态与偏振-空间超纠缠的测量设备无关量子安全直接通信
articles.abstract: Quantum secure direct communication (QSDC) can directly transmit confidential messages without pre-distributing secret keys. In practical applications, non-ideal light sources naturally contain multiphoton components, which can easily lead to photon-number-splitting attacks and constitute a core problem restricting secure practical implementation. Existing measurement-device-independent (MDI) QSDC protocols are mostly based on ideal source assumptions and lack strict security authentication for practical multiphoton risks. This paper proposes an MDI-QSDC protocol based on decoy states and polarization--spatial hyperentanglement. The protocol lower-bounds the contribution of the two-single-pair sector through an active three-intensity decoy-state mechanism and imposes a conservative bound on the potential information leakage caused by multiphoton events, while using polarization--spatial hyperentangled encoding to increase the payload of each valid HBSA event and relying on the MDI architecture to remove the need to trust the measurement device. Compared with similar schemes, this protocol significantly improves the secure message capacity in practical scenarios while maintaining detector-side security.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种面向实际非理想光源的测量设备无关量子安全直接通信协议，针对多光子成分可能引发的光子数分裂攻击给出安全处理。协议采用主动三强度诱骗态机制估计双单光子对贡献，并对多光子事件的信息泄露作保守界定，同时用偏振-空间超纠缠编码提高每次有效超贝尔态分析事件的载荷。作者认为，该方案在保持测量设备无关安全架构的同时，可提升实际场景下的安全消息容量。

articles.title: Intrinsic transverse magnetic nonreciprocal response in a noncollinear antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 非共线反铁磁体中的本征横向磁非互易响应
articles.abstract: Nonreciprocal responses transform broken symmetries into direction-dependent functionality, while a nonreciprocal response encoded directly in static magnetic response of an ordered magnet has not been realized. Here we reveal an intrinsic transverse magnetic nonreciprocity in the noncollinear antiferromagnet Mn3Ge. Using torque magnetometry, we observe a pronounced transverse torque that is odd under magnetic-field reversal, in sharp contrast to the reciprocal response of conventional magnets. A concomitant even-in-field planar Hall response emerges at the same low temperature around 210~K, well below the Neel temperature. Together, these measurements reveal a field-reversal-even transverse magnetic response in which opposite fields select symmetry-related, rather than time-reversed, noncollinear antiferromagnetic states. We attribute this behavior to spin-orbit-coupling-induced breaking of spin space group symmetry, which locks the noncollinear spin texture and its net magnetization to the lattice. These results establish a nonreciprocal magnetic response as a distinct collective response of chiral antiferromagnets, extending nonreciprocal phenomena beyond charge-current-based transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在非共线反铁磁体 Mn3Ge 中观测到一种本征横向磁非互易性。转矩磁测量显示出对磁场反转为奇的显著横向转矩，并在约 210 K 出现相伴的偶磁场平面霍尔响应，表明相反磁场选择的是对称相关而非时间反演的反铁磁态。作者将其归因于自旋-轨道耦合诱导的自旋空间群对称性破缺，使非共线自旋织构及净磁化与晶格锁定。

articles.title: Network propagation in bipartite metabolite–reaction graphs for metabolomic data exploration
articles.title_zh: 用于代谢组数据探索的二部代谢物-反应图网络传播方法
articles.abstract: Introduction: Interpretation of metabolomic data is frequently limited by incomplete metabolite coverage and the predefined representation of biochemical organization provided by pathway-based approaches.Objectives This study aims to develop and evaluate a network propagation framework to facilitate metabolomic data exploration by diffusing statistical relevance scores across a metabolic topology.Methods A directed bipartite metabolite–reaction network was reconstructed using the KEGG database, comprising 8236 nodes with 1601 metabolites and 6635 reactions. Simulated metabolomic datasets with 75% sparsity mimicking two metabolic perturbations (oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction) and two no-effect control groups, were generated to test the strategy. Node-level statistical signal scores were distributed across the network topology using a random walk-based diffusion operator combined with a semi-supervised clamping procedure to preserve initially observed measurements.Results Network propagation redistributed statistical signals across connected biochemical regions, allowing unmeasured metabolites and reactions to accumulate topology-aware significance scores. For both OS and MD scenarios, supervised univariate analyses revealed that significantly altered nodes formed highly interconnected, non-random topological modules. Furthermore, PLS-DA demonstrated that network propagation significantly enhanced multivariate predictive performance, yielding statistically validated performance gains via permutation testing, while effectively managing background noise in null comparisons.Conclusions The proposed bipartite metabolite–reaction network propagation framework provides an exploratory tool for metabolomics. By integrating topological context with statistical relevance, this approach complements established pathway analyses for hypothesis generation in partially observed metabolic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建了基于 KEGG 的有向二部代谢物-反应网络，并提出随机游走扩散结合半监督钳制的网络传播框架，用于在代谢拓扑中传播统计相关性信号。模拟的高稀疏代谢组数据表明，该方法可使未测量代谢物和反应获得具有拓扑约束的显著性评分。该框架旨在缓解传统通路分析受代谢物覆盖不全和预定义通路结构限制的问题。

articles.title: Ecological risks Assessment of heavy metals from the Kidaro Creek, Niger Delta Nigeria
articles.title_zh: 尼日利亚尼日尔三角洲 Kidaro Creek 重金属生态风险评估
articles.abstract: This study assessed the concentrations, distribution, and ecological risks of selected heavy metals (Pb, Cd, Ni, V, Cr, and As) in surface water and sediments of Kidaro Creek, Niger Delta, Nigeria during the dry and wet seasons. Surface water and sediment samples were collected from three stations and analyzed using standard analytical procedures. The concentrations of Pb, Cd, Ni, Cr, and V in surface water ranged from 0.355–1.761, 0.119–0.258, 0.320–0.505, 0.045–0.366, and 0.029–0.359 mg/L respectively in the dry season, and 0.284–1.669, 0.008–0.025, 0.214–0.381, 0.278–0.567, and 0.045–0.366 mg/L in the wet season, exceeding World Health Organization (WHO) limits for drinking water, while As ranged from 0.006–0.014 mg/L (dry season) and 0.040–0.181 mg/L (wet season). In sediments, Pb, Cd, Ni, Cr, V, and As ranged from 12.98–47.96, 0.41–3.82, 0.600–7.49, 2.259–12.060, 0.247–5.409, and 0.005–0.129 mg/kg in the dry season and 14.62–49.98, 0.013–0.380, 0.457–9.55, 1.362–13.937, < 0.001–0.007, and 0.492–1.220 mg/kg in the wet season. Ecological risk assessment showed extremely high contamination in surface water, with contamination factors ranging from 10.63–435.0 in the dry season and 1.10–228.67 in the wet season, while sediment CF values were generally low (0.011–2.146). Surface water pollution load index (PLI) ranged from 47.72–152.38 in the dry season and 2.89–25.69 in the wet season, whereas sediment PLI ranged from 0.073–0.137 (dry season) and 0.012–0.026 (wet season). The potential ecological risk index (PERI) for surface water ranged from 11105.67–22501.33 in the dry season and 1796.33–3293 in the wet season, indicating extremely high ecological risk, while sediment PERI values ranged from 25.62–145.85 (dry season) and 4.81–16.66 (wet season), indicating generally low ecological risk. Cadmium contributed the largest share of ecological risk (86% in dry season and 53.9% in wet season in surface water; >90% in sediments). The findings indicated that Kidaro Creek is significantly impacted by heavy metal pollution, largely driven by anthropogenic inputs associated with petroleum-related activities in the Niger Delta. Continuous environmental monitoring and effective pollution management strategies are necessary to safeguard the aquatic ecosystem and surrounding communities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了 Kidaro Creek 枯水期和丰水期表层水及沉积物中 Pb、Cd、Ni、V、Cr 和 As 的浓度、分布与生态风险。结果显示，多种金属在水体中的浓度超过世界卫生组织饮用水限值，沉积物中也检出不同程度累积，并呈现明显季节差异。生态风险评估指向表层水极高污染水平，提示该溪流系统存在显著重金属生态压力。

articles.title: Trained quantum Kolmogorov--Arnold networks can dequantize, and a discrete-logarithm encoding need not: a measurement-based map of where quantum advantage can live
articles.title_zh: 训练后的量子 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络可被去量子化，而离散对数编码未必如此：量子优势位置的测量式图谱
articles.abstract: Quantum machine-learning models are only useful if a classical computer cannot cheaply imitate them. We test this directly for quantum Kolmogorov–Arnold networks (QKANs)—neural networks whose tunable “activation functions” are small quantum circuits—by asking whether each model can be contracted as an effcient tensor network (TN), the standard tool for classical quantum simulation. We make the test practical with a task-aware yardstick: the bond dimension a classical surrogate needs to copy the model’s output at the accuracy the model itself reaches. We find a clear ladder. The amplitude-encoded Chebyshev QKAN uses only logarithmically many qubits and is exactly classical. The variational QKAN, built from all-to-all controlled rotations, looks hard at random settings but, once trained to genuinely learn a smooth task (R2 = 0.30–0.62), is copied by a constant-bond-dimension surrogate at the sizes (n ≤ 10) we test. Noise pushes it toward classicality near p ≈ 0.03–0.05, echoing noisy random circuits. Every generic attempt to force hardness—a global measurement, a deeper entangler, or an interaction-based (IQP) feature map—instead destroys trainability through exponentially small gradients (a “barren plateau”). The escape is a discrete-logarithm feature map: its kernel variance is flat (0.07±0.01) from 4 to 14 qubits while a generic IQP kernel decays as 2−n , and a support-vector machine with it learns a classically hard concept to ≥ 99% accuracy while generic and classical kernels stay at chance—hardness placed in number theory stays both classically hard and shot-effciently learnable. The work provides a concrete, measurement-based criterion for when a quantum model is reproducible by a low-bond- dimension surrogate, and a design rule: seek advantage in structured, provably hard encodings rather than in deep entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文考察量子 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络是否能被经典张量网络高效模拟，并以经典替代模型达到原模型精度所需的键维数作为任务相关判据。结果显示，振幅编码 Chebyshev QKAN 本质上可经典化，随机设置下看似困难的变分 QKAN 在学习平滑任务后也可由常数键维数替代模型复制；噪声进一步推动其经典化。作者同时指出，若通过全局测量、更深纠缠或 IQP 特征映射强行制造困难，往往会因梯度指数衰减而破坏可训练性。

articles.title: Thermodynamics-Informed Graph Learning for Predicting CO2 Solubility in Water and Multicomponent Brines
articles.title_zh: 用于预测水和多组分盐水中 CO2 溶解度的热力学约束图学习
articles.abstract: Accurate prediction of CO2 solubility in saline water is essential for estimating dissolution trapping in carbon capture, utilization, and storage projects. Although recent gradient-boosting models achieve high accuracy on compiled CO2 solubility databases, most models treat brine composition as a flat vector and do not explicitly represent ion-ion, ion-water, and CO2-brine interactions. To address this limitation, this work presents a thermodynamics-informed graph learning workflow for predicting CO2 solubility in pure water, single-salt brines, and mixed brines. The model converts each brine into a chemical graph containing CO2, H2O, cations, and anions, and augments the graph descriptors with soft thermodynamic constraints for posi tivity, pressure consistency, salting-out behavior, and charge-aware composition. The workflow was tested on 3323 cleaned experimental records extracted from a published supplementary database. In a preliminary local run, tabular XGBoost gave the highest coefficient of determi nation, with R2 = 0.9856, RMSE = 0.00098, and AARD = 6.23%. Graph-descriptor XGBoost gave the lowest relative error, with AARD = 5.90%. The physics-informed graph neural model achieved R2 = 0.9741 and AARD = 6.83%, showing competitive relative-error performance but not yet outperforming boosted trees in squared-error metrics. These results show that graph based chemical descriptors can improve relative-error behavior, while high-salinity extrapolation remains the key challenge for a publishable final model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种热力学约束图学习流程，用于预测纯水、单盐盐水和混合盐水中的 CO2 溶解度。模型将盐水表示为包含 CO2、H2O、阳离子和阴离子的化学图，并加入正性、压力一致性、盐析效应和电荷感知组成等软热力学约束。在 3323 条清洗实验记录上的初步测试中，表格 XGBoost 取得最高 R2，而图描述符 XGBoost 获得较低相对误差，显示图表示对多组分盐水建模具有潜力。

articles.title: Thermal, wetting and microstructural properties of the tin (Sn)-58%bismuth (Bi) solder joint at 160 °C, 170°C and 180 °C
articles.title_zh: 160、170 和 180 °C 下 Sn-58%Bi 焊点的热学、润湿与显微组织性能
articles.abstract: The thermal, wetting and microstructural properties of tin (Sn)-58% bismuth (Bi) solder joints were investigated at three reflow temperatures of 160, 170, and 180°C to assess their performance for low-temperature assembly processes. Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) analysis revealed that the SnBi alloy exhibited a melting range between 139 and 145°C, confirming its low temperature applicability for reduced thermal processing conditions. Contact angles were measured at 78.4°, 68.95°, and 69.39° at 160, 170 and 180°C, respectively, classifying the SnBi as having moderate wettability behavior. The spreading ratios of 347.7, 333.7 and 322.8 for 160, 170 and 180°C was measured demonstrating an inverse relationship with contact angle in accordance with wetting theory. The microstructural observations from scanning electron microscopy image (SEM) at the SnBi/Cu solder joint revealed the formation of a relatively uniform Cu₆Sn₅ intermetallic compound (IMC) layer at 170 and 180°C, whereas minimal or nearly no IMC formation was observed at 160°C due to insufficient interfacial reaction. The findings indicate that SnBi solder joint at the lower reflow temperature of 160, 170, and 180°C showed acceptable wettability condition and interfacial characteristics, supporting its potential application for energy-efficient and thermally sensitive microelectronic assembly processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察 Sn-58%Bi 低温焊料在 160、170 和 180 °C 回流条件下的热学、润湿和界面显微组织特征。DSC 结果显示其熔化区间为 139-145 °C，接触角和铺展率表明其具有中等润湿性且符合润湿理论趋势。SEM 观察显示，170 和 180 °C 下 SnBi/Cu 界面形成较均匀的 Cu6Sn5 金属间化合物层，而 160 °C 下界面反应不足、IMC 形成很少或近乎没有。

articles.title: Data-Driven Full-Spectrum Mapping of the Synthesis Landscape for Plasmonic Nanoparticles with High Chiroptical Activity
articles.title_zh: 高旋光活性等离激元纳米颗粒合成空间的全谱数据驱动映射
articles.abstract: Chiral plasmonic nanoparticles hold promise for enantioselective catalysis, biosensing and nanomedicine, but achieving high chiroptical activity of these nanoparticles remains a synthetic challenge. Multiple coupled synthesis parameters within a high-dimensional chemical landscape govern nanoparticle morphology and determine their |g-factor|. Here, by analysing full g-factor spectra of plasmonic nanoparticles, rather than only g-factor peak values, we establish a data-driven framework for the synthesis of chiral gold 432 helicoids. Gryffin algorithm-driven autonomous synthesis identified reaction conditions yielding |g-factor| = 0.24, while spectral manifold learning converted 80 nanoparticle samples into a topological landscape with four structural branches. The resulting synthesis landscape revealed that gold precursor loading enables access to three high-|g-factor| clusters, whereas glutathione directs cluster selection. Analysis of the low-|g-factor| intensity spectral region revealed previously unreported chiral rhombic dodecahedra nanoparticles that bridge achiral octahedra and final 432 helicoids, redirecting machine learning from optimisation toward mechanistic understanding of nanoparticle synthesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究不只分析 g 因子峰值，而是利用完整 g 因子光谱构建手性金等离激元纳米颗粒的合成数据框架。Gryffin 算法驱动的自主合成找到 |g-factor| = 0.24 的反应条件，谱流形学习则将 80 个样品映射为包含四个结构分支的拓扑景观。结果显示金前驱体投料量可进入多个高 |g-factor| 聚类，而谷胱甘肽影响聚类选择，并揭示了此前未报道的手性菱形十二面体中间结构。

articles.title: UAV-Based Thermal Sensing for Quantifying Diurnal Land Surface Temperature Variability in a Tropical Urban Heat Island Context
articles.title_zh: 热带城市热岛背景下基于无人机热感知的昼夜地表温度变化量化
articles.abstract: Urban Heat Island (UHI) intensity is strongly influenced by surface material properties and land-cover composition, yet fine-scale diurnal thermal dynamics are often inadequately captured by conventional satellite observations. This study evaluates the potential of drone-assisted thermal imaging to characterize high resolution day–night land surface temperature (LST) variability within a mixed-use urban campus in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. Thermal data were acquired using an unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a thermal infrared sensor during three temporal epochs representing mid-day, late afternoon, and night time conditions. Radiometrically calibrated thermal orthomosaics were produced at centimetre-level spatial resolution and validated using concurrent ground-based measurements. Comparative analysis of ten surface materials, including asphalt, grass, concrete, ceramic new and old roofs, black and white car roofs, water bodies, metal and solar panel, reveals pronounced material-dependent thermal behaviour relative to ambient air temperatures. Impervious and dark-coloured surfaces exhibit extreme daytime heating and delayed nocturnal cooling, while vegetated and water-covered surfaces demonstrate consistently lower temperatures and more efficient thermal dissipation. These results underscore the critical role of surface material properties, colour, and thermal inertia in governing localized UHI dynamics. Overall, this study demonstrates the effectiveness of UAV-based thermal sensing for resolving fine-scale urban microclimate variability and provides valuable insights to support climate-resilient urban design and heat mitigation strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估无人机热红外成像在马来西亚柔佛 Bahru 混合功能城市校园中刻画高分辨率昼夜地表温度变化的能力。研究在正午、傍晚和夜间获取热数据，生成厘米级辐射校准热正射镶嵌图，并用同步地面测量进行验证。对十类表面材料的比较表明，不透水和深色表面白天升温强且夜间冷却滞后，而植被和水体表面表现出不同的热调节行为。
