This position paper argues that machine unlearning is overused as a term in LLM research and should be reserved for dataset-defined deletion: removing the training influence of a precisely specified forget set such that the resulting model is approximately indistinguishable from retraining without that data. We contend that many tasks currently labeled "unlearning" (e.g., refusal for harmful requests, entity/knowledge removal, or targeted suppression) pursue different, often policy-dependent objectives and therefore require different terminology and baselines (e.g., alignment, suppression, editing, obfuscation). We further argue that this confusion is not cosmetic: because papers make different implicit guarantees under the same label, metrics and benchmarks are frequently reused outside their intended scope, rewarding surface-level non-disclosure (e.g., low ROUGE/forget accuracy) even when retraining-equivalence is not tested and derived capabilities remain. We conclude by calling for stricter terminology tied to explicit guarantees and reference models, and for evaluations that match the claimed objective.
articles.abstract_zh: 该立场论文认为，大语言模型研究中“机器遗忘”一词被过度泛化，应该保留给数据集定义的删除任务：移除精确定义的遗忘集对训练的影响，使所得模型近似等同于在不含该数据时重新训练得到的模型。作者指出，许多当前被称为遗忘的任务，如有害请求拒答、实体或知识移除、定向抑制等，实际目标不同且常依赖策略，应分别称为对齐、抑制、编辑或混淆等。概念混用会导致不同论文在同一术语下隐含不同保证，并误用指标与基准，奖励表层的不披露而非真正的重训练等价性。
authors: Sangyeon Yoon, Yeachan Jun, Albert No

articles.title: Odyssey: Constructing Verifiable Local Truth-Preserving Foundation Models
articles.title_zh: Odyssey：构建可验证的局部保真基础模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27593v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a categorical framework called ODYSSEY for constructing verifiable, local truth-preserving foundation models as compositions of foundries: building-block architectural components that specify a cover of local contexts, local representation families, restriction maps, gluing rules, obstruction policies, update obligations, and human-facing views. A foundry is an organized sheaf of knowledge that carries within it an argumentation component. Concrete foundries are built from generic foundries such as evidence/argument, operational decision, institutional/financial, market meaning, scientific challenge, research-program, assistant-build, and evaluation-harness foundries. Universal Foundry Learning (UFL) formalizes foundry construction as a composition of left and right Kan extensions, with left Kan extension rolling local artifacts into candidate foundries and right Kan extension enforcing the restriction, gluing, obstruction, and argumentation conditions required for promotion. Foundry SQL (FSQL) is a small typed query surface for slicing maintained foundry artifacts that uses TICKET (Topos Integration using Causal Kan Extension Transformers) certification for admitting external or pre-built models into durable ODYSSEY state. ODYSSEY is fully implemented and tested across a wide spectrum of concrete foundries, showing that the same categorical machinery supports domain construction, artifact replay, sheaf diagnostics, grounded Toulmin/local-LLM scrutiny, residual-obstruction ledgers, and optimized TICKET-compatible causal-claim extraction across heterogeneous sources. This paper is to be presented as a 2.5 hour tutorial at ICML 2026. The tutorial home page is at https://bit.ly/4ajS0nA.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 ODYSSEY 范畴论框架，将基础模型构造为多个“foundry”组件的组合，以显式规定局部语境覆盖、表示族、限制映射、粘合规则、阻碍处理、更新义务和面向人的视图。作者将 foundry 视为带有论证机制的知识层，并用 Universal Foundry Learning 将其学习形式化为左右 Kan 扩张的组合：左 Kan 扩张汇聚局部产物，右 Kan 扩张执行一致性、粘合、阻碍和论证条件。文中还提出 Foundry SQL 作为类型化查询接口，用于切片和维护这些可验证知识构件。

articles.title: Physics-Guided Robotic Radiation Source Localization along Arbitrary Measurement Paths in Unstructured Environments
articles.title_zh: 非结构化环境中沿任意测量路径的物理引导机器人辐射源定位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27624v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Using robots to estimate the location of the radiation source is an effective way to improve efficiency and safety. Existing methods focus on planning the robot's path to achieve precise estimation, typically approaching the source. However, approaching the source increases the risk of radiation damage to a robot. In addition, a path-planning algorithm designed solely for radiation source localization (RSL) limits the flexibility of missions that deploy robots into radioactive environments. This study presents an automation framework for robotic RSL that leverages a physics-informed machine learning (PIML) model to precisely estimate the source location, regardless of measurement paths, in unknown environments. Physics-inspired model tensors have been designed for PIML to handle attenuated gamma-ray flux signals from unknown obstacles, and multiple models are computed in parallel to improve the robustness and precision of the RSL. The proposed method is evaluated in high-fidelity simulation environments using Monte Carlo particle transport across diverse randomized domains, including spatial scales, radiation source types, obstacle materials and geometries, and robot trajectories. The method is also validated through physical experiments on configurations that are not included in the simulation-based evaluation. The continuous learning technique is applied in real-robot deployment to enhance the practical applicability of the online robotic RSL system. The proposed method advances robot radiation perception from pointwise flux detection to spatial intelligence.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种机器人辐射源定位自动化框架，目标是在未知、非结构化环境中不要求机器人接近辐射源或遵循专用路径规划。方法采用物理信息机器学习模型，设计受物理启发的张量表示以处理未知障碍物导致的伽马射线通量衰减，并并行计算多个模型以增强鲁棒性和定位精度。作者在包含随机空间尺度、源类型和障碍物配置的高保真蒙特卡罗粒子输运仿真环境中评估了该方法。
authors: Hojoon Son, Kai Tan, Fan Zhang

articles.title: Distributed Air-Gap Flux and Rotor-Current Fusion for Operating-Regime Identification in a 10-MW Kaplan Hydrogenerator
articles.title_zh: 用于10 MW Kaplan水轮发电机工况识别的分布式气隙磁通与转子电流融合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27800v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reliable monitoring of hydroelectric generators requires descriptors that capture both electrical loading and electromagnetic field behavior. This work investigates operating-regime identification in the Porjus U9 10-MW Kaplan hydrogenerator using synchronized measurements from ten stator-mounted Hall probes and six rotor-current channels. Seven steady guide-vane-opening settings are considered, and each 300s record is divided into 1s windows. The resulting windows are represented by spatial Fourier descriptors of the circumferential air-gap field, probe-wise temporal flux indicators, and channel-wise RMS rotor-current features. Correlation analysis and principal component analysis are used to examine how the feature groups vary with the operating point, and Random Forest, radial-basis-function support vector classification, and multilayer perceptron models are evaluated for supervised identification of the guide-vane-opening state. The analysis shows that RMS rotor-current features mainly track the loading axis, while the magnetic-flux features reveal complementary information associated with spatial imbalance, waveform distortion, and weak low-frequency modulation. Spatial descriptors alone provide limited separability, yielding test accuracies below 27%, whereas rotor-current features alone reach about 84-85%. Combining flux and current information gives the most discriminative representation; the SVC-RBF model achieves 99.5% test accuracy and macro-F1 score. The results indicate that distributed air-gap magnetic sensing, when fused with rotor-current measurements, can support accurate and interpretable data-driven monitoring of Kaplan hydrogenerator operating regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究 Porjus U9 10 MW Kaplan 水轮发电机的工况识别，利用10个定子霍尔探头和6路转子电流的同步测量数据，对7种稳态导叶开度进行分类。每段300 s记录被划分为1 s窗口，并提取气隙周向磁场空间傅里叶描述符、各探头时域磁通指标和各通道转子电流 RMS 特征。相关性分析和主成分分析表明，转子电流 RMS 主要反映负载轴，而磁通特征提供与空间不平衡和波形畸变相关的互补信息；随机森林、RBF-SVC和多层感知机用于监督识别导叶开度状态。
authors: Eduardo Jr Piedad, Rafel Roig, Xavier Escaler, Eduardo Prieto-Araujo, Oriol Gomis-Bellmunt

articles.title: Parameter-Efficient Quantum-Inspired Fast Weight Programmers for Traffic-Matrix Forecasting
articles.title_zh: 用于流量矩阵预测的参数高效量子启发快速权重程序器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Traffic matrices (TMs) capture network-wide origin-destination demand and are central to traffic engineering, yet accurate whole-matrix forecasting remains challenging when prediction must be performed under the memory, update, and training-budget constraints of online network control. This paper investigates whether compact quantum-inspired recurrent models can provide effective TM forecasts without relying on dedicated graph, transformer, or diffusion modules. We adapt gated quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold network fast-weight programmers (QKAN-FWPs) to direct multi-step Abilene TM forecasting, where each model predicts the next 20 five-minute frames of a 144-channel origin-destination (OD) matrix from a two-hour history. We benchmark three QKAN placement variants against a matched-size long short-term memory (LSTM) network, a larger LSTM, and a classical gated fast-weight programmer under a shared fixed-budget training protocol. Among the evaluated recurrent models, G-QKANFWP achieves the best pooled root-mean-square error (RMSE), while using only 22.4% of the larger LSTM. It also outperforms both the matched-size LSTM and the classical G-FWP baseline, indicating that the gain is not due to gated fast-weight framework alone. Convergence and channel-wise analyses further show that the quantum-inspired variants obtain lower validation-loss area under the learning curve (AULC) than matched-size recurrent baselines, while G-QKANFWP and GQKAN-FWP achieve substantially more OD-channel wins. These results identify a classical slow programmer with a quantum-inspired fast programmer as a promising accuracy-efficiency design for resource-conscious network traffic-matrix forecasting.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究紧凑型量子启发循环模型是否能在在线网络控制的内存、更新和训练预算约束下实现有效的全流量矩阵预测。作者将门控量子启发 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络快速权重程序器用于 Abilene 流量矩阵多步预测，从两小时历史中直接预测未来20个5分钟帧的144通道 OD 矩阵。与匹配规模 LSTM、更大 LSTM 和经典门控快速权重程序器相比，G-QKANFWP 在所评估循环模型中获得最佳汇总 RMSE，同时参数量仅为较大 LSTM 的22.4%。
authors: Kuo-Chung Peng, Jiun-Cheng Jiang, Chun-Hua Lin, Tai-Yue Li, Nan-Yow Chen, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen

articles.title: Bridging Ab Initio Symmetries and Global Nuclear Masses with Interpretable Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 用可解释神经网络连接从头算对称性与全局核质量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28287v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ab initio modeling has established Wigner's SU(4) and Elliott's SU(3) as dominant symmetries of the nuclear force in light and intermediate-mass nuclei. We ask whether they also govern nuclear binding across the entire chart. Our aim is not high-precision prediction but physical insight, through interpretable, symmetry-based models. From the SU(3) and SU(4) Casimir operators we construct three neural-network (NN) mass models: Feature-Informed NN (FINN) for point predictions, Gaussian-Informed NN (GINN) adding uncertainty quantification, and Wigner-Informed NN (WINN) -- a mass formula using the Casimirs as an operator basis. All are trained on AME2016 and validated on nuclei new to AME2020. The SU(4) operators alone cut the root-mean-square error (RMSE) by nearly half on train and test data, and by about a fifth on extrapolation, relative to the liquid-drop baseline -- showing that Wigner's symmetry carries predictive information beyond bulk properties. Despite its compact form, WINN reaches the lowest validation RMSE, 0.430 MeV -- competitive with state-of-the-art mass models -- which we read less as a benchmark than as evidence that its symmetry basis captures important physics. WINN further reveals i) an enhancement of the quadratic SU(4) Casimir near the neutron dripline, signaling restoration of Wigner's symmetry, and ii) an unexpected gain of the quartic operator in the superheavy region. We thereby elevate emergent symmetries from the hidden order within individual nuclei to a governing principle of the whole nuclear chart.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文考察轻核和中等质量核从头算中占主导的 Wigner SU(4) 与 Elliott SU(3) 对称性是否也支配整个核素图的结合能规律。作者基于 SU(3) 和 SU(4) Casimir 算符构建三类可解释质量模型：点预测 FINN、带不确定性量化的 GINN，以及以 Casimir 算符为基的质量公式 WINN，并在 AME2016 上训练、用 AME2020 新增核素验证。结果显示，仅 SU(4) 算符即可显著降低相对液滴模型的 RMSE，紧凑的 WINN 在验证集上达到0.430 MeV，说明 Wigner 对称性包含超越体性质的预测信息。
authors: Phong Dang, Evander Espinoza, Xiaoliang Wan, Michela Negro, Jerry P. Draayer, Feng Pan, Tomas Dytrych, Daniel Langr, David Kekejian

articles.title: Which Nash Equilibrium? Solver-Dependent Selection on Zero-Sum Nash Polytopes
articles.title_zh: 哪个纳什均衡？零和纳什多面体上的求解器依赖选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28308v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many two-player zero-sum games admit not a unique Nash equilibrium but a convex set of them: a polytope of profiles that all share the minimax value V* yet prescribe different behaviour. Standard solvers each converge to some equilibrium and are treated as interchangeable. We ask whether they instead select different members of the Nash set, systematically as a function of the algorithm rather than the seed. Using a tabular, exactly solvable testbed of six games with analytically known Nash sets -- including a two-dimensional Nash polytope and Kuhn poker -- we find that (i) selection is determined by the algorithm, not the seed, but families differ only on asymmetric Nash sets; (ii) regularized last-iterate methods (R-NaD, magnetic mirror descent) select the maximum-entropy member, the information projection of their uniform reference onto the Nash set -- exactly on the 2-D polytope and at 99.7% of maximum entropy in Kuhn -- while regret-averaging methods (CFR, CFR+, fictitious play) drift to a lower-entropy face; we confirm this on a randomized 180-game ensemble, where R-NaD attains the maximum-entropy member in 100% of converged games while CFR+ sits strictly below it in 94% (paired Wilcoxon p < 10⁻²⁷⁾; (iii) the selected member has downstream consequences against sub-optimal opponents that scale with sequential/hidden-information structure but stay bounded -- in Kuhn the max-entropy member is a strictly better hedge, whereas on the matrix games the members differ without either dominating. We also report two negative results correcting common intuitions: removing CFR's positive-orthant (max(R,0)) projection does not eliminate boundary drift; and R-NaD's selection is anchor-following, not initialization-independent. We state the maximum-entropy / I-projection characterization as a strongly data-supported conjecture, checked throughout against analytic ground truth.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究在存在凸纳什均衡集合的二人零和博弈中，不同标准求解器是否会系统性地选择不同均衡点。基于6个具有解析纳什集合的表格式测试博弈，包括二维纳什多面体和 Kuhn 扑克，作者发现选择主要由算法而非随机种子决定，且算法族差异主要出现在非对称纳什集合上。正则化末迭代方法如 R-NaD 和磁镜下降倾向选择最大熵均衡，而遗憾平均方法如 CFR、CFR+ 和虚拟博弈会漂移到较低熵面；随机180个博弈的集合实验进一步支持这一结论。

articles.title: Quenched large deviations for Monte Carlo integration with Coulomb gases
articles.title_zh: 库仑气蒙特卡罗积分的淬火大偏差分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.01392v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Gibbs measures, such as Coulomb gases, are popular in modelling systems of interacting particles. Recently, we proposed to use Gibbs measures as randomized numerical integration algorithms with respect to a target measure π on mathbb R^d, following the heuristics that repulsiveness between particles should help reduce integration errors. A major issue in this approach is to tune the interaction kernel and confining potential of the Gibbs measure, so that the equilibrium measure of the system is the target distribution π. Doing so usually requires another Monte Carlo approximation of the emphpotential, i.e. the integral of the interaction kernel with respect to π. Using the methodology of large deviations from Garcia--Zelada (2019), we show that a random approximation of the potential preserves the fast large deviation principle that guarantees the proposed integration algorithm to outperform independent or Markov quadratures. For non-singular interaction kernels, we make minimal assumptions on this random approximation, which can be the result of a computationally cheap Monte Carlo preprocessing. For the Coulomb interaction kernel, we need the approximation to be based on another Gibbs measure, and we prove in passing a control on the uniform convergence of the approximation of the potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究将 Gibbs 测度、特别是库仑气用于相对于目标测度的随机数值积分，并关注相互排斥粒子降低积分误差的机制。由于需要调节相互作用核和约束势以使平衡测度等于目标分布，通常必须再用蒙特卡罗近似势函数，即相互作用核对目标测度的积分。作者利用 Garcia-Zelada 的大偏差方法证明，势函数的随机近似仍可保持快速大偏差原理，从而保证该积分算法优于独立或马尔可夫求积；对非奇异核给出较弱假设，并讨论库仑相互作用情形。
authors: Martin Rouault, Rémi Bardenet, Mylène Maïda

articles.title: ConTact: Contact-First Antibody CDR Design via Explicit Interface Reasoning
articles.title_zh: ConTact：通过显式界面推理实现接触优先的抗体 CDR 设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.21600v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Computational antibody CDR design methods condition on antigen structure to generate binding loops. Yet, the existing architectures conflate two fundamentally distinct sub-problems: identifying which CDR positions will contact the antigen, and selecting amino acids at those positions. This forces models to learn contact reasoning implicitly through uniform message passing, diluting antigen signal across all positions equally. We introduce ConTact, a contact-then-act architecture that explicitly decomposes CDR design into three cascaded stages: learning surface complementarity fingerprints, predicting CDR-antigen contacts, and injecting contact-gated antigen features into the prediction head. A distance-biased cross-attention module encodes geometric priors favoring spatial neighbors, while a contact-weighted cross-entropy loss concentrates gradient signal on binding-critical positions. On the CHIMERA-Bench dataset, ConTact achieves the lowest backbone RMSD on every split (a 5 to 6% improvement over the best baseline) and the best fraction of native contacts, interface RMSD, and epitope F1 on the antigen-fold and temporal splits, while remaining competitive on the harder epitope-group split. The source code is available at: https://github.com/mansoor181/ConTact.git
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出现有抗体 CDR 设计模型常将“哪些 CDR 位点接触抗原”和“这些位点选什么氨基酸”混合建模，导致接触推理只能隐式学习。ConTact 采用 contact-then-act 架构，将设计分为表面互补性指纹学习、CDR-抗原接触预测和接触门控抗原特征注入三阶段，并引入距离偏置交叉注意力和接触加权交叉熵损失。CHIMERA-Bench 实验显示，该方法在各划分上获得最低骨架 RMSD，并在抗原折叠和时间划分上提升天然接触比例、界面 RMSD 和表位 F1 等界面指标。
authors: Mansoor Ahmed, Spencer VonBank, Nadeem Taj, Sujin Lee, Naila Jan, Murray Patterson

articles.title: Web2Grasp: Learning Functional Grasps from Web Images of Hand-Object Interactions
articles.title_zh: Web2Grasp：从网络手-物交互图像学习功能性抓取
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.05517v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Functional grasping is essential for enabling dexterous multi-finger robot hands to manipulate objects effectively. Prior work largely focuses on power grasps, which only involve holding an object, or relies on in-domain demonstrations for specific objects. We propose leveraging human grasp information extracted from web images, which capture natural and functional hand-object interactions (HOI). Using a pretrained 3D reconstruction model, we recover 3D human HOI meshes from RGB images. To train on these noisy HOI data, we propose to use: (1) an interaction-centric model to learn the functional interaction pattern between hand and object, and (2) geometry-based filtering to remove the infeasible grasps and physical simulation to retain grasps who can resist disturbance. In IssacGym simulation, our model trained on reconstructed HOI grasps achieves a 75.8% success rate on objects from the web dataset and generalizes to unseen objects, outperforming baseline methods in both grasp success and functional quality. In real-world experiments with the LEAP hand and Inspire hand, it attains a 77.5% success rate across 12 objects, including challenging ones such as a syringe, spray bottle, knife, and tongs. Project website is at: https://web2grasp.github.io/.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出从网络图像中的自然手-物交互学习多指机器人手的功能性抓取，而非仅依赖物体特定示教或以持握为主的 power grasp。方法使用预训练三维重建模型从 RGB 图像恢复三维人手-物体交互网格，并通过交互中心模型学习手与物体的功能性交互模式，同时用几何过滤去除不可行抓取、用物理仿真保留抗扰动抓取。在 IsaacGym 中，该模型在网络数据物体上达到75.8%成功率并可泛化到未见物体；在 LEAP hand 和 Inspire hand 的真实实验中，12个物体上的成功率为77.5%。
authors: Hongyi Chen, Yunchao Yao, Yufei Ye, Zhixuan Xu, Homanga Bharadhwaj, Jiashun Wang, Arthur Jakobsson, Ruihan Zhao, Shubham Tulsiani, Zackory Erickson, Jeffrey Ichnowski

articles.title: A Non-asymptotic Analysis for Learning and Applying a Preconditioner in MCMC
articles.title_zh: MCMC 中学习并应用预条件子的非渐近分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.10714v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Preconditioning is a common method applied to modify Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms with the goal of making them more efficient. In practice it is often extremely effective, even when the preconditioner is learned from the chain. We analyse and compare the finite-time computational costs of schemes which learn a preconditioner based on the target covariance or the expected Hessian of the target potential with that of a corresponding scheme that does not use preconditioning. We apply our results to various algorithms including the Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (ULA) and the proximal sampler for an appropriately regular target, establishing non-asymptotic guarantees for versions of these algorithms that learn and use preconditioners. To do so, we establish non-asymptotic guarantees on the time taken to collect N approximately independent samples from the target for schemes that learn their preconditioners under the assumption that the underlying Markov chain satisfies a contraction condition in the Wasserstein-2 distance. This approximate independence condition, that we formalize, allows us to bridge the non-asymptotic bounds of modern MCMC theory and classical heuristics of effective sample size and mixing time, and is needed to amortise the costs of learning a preconditioner across the many samples it will be used to produce.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文对在马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗中学习并使用预条件子的方案进行有限时间计算成本分析，并与不使用预条件的对应算法比较。作者研究基于目标协方差或目标势期望 Hessian 学习预条件子的情形，并将结果应用于未校正 Langevin 算法和适当正则目标下的近端采样器。核心技术是在底层 Markov 链满足 Wasserstein-2 收缩条件时，给出收集 N 个近似独立目标样本所需时间的非渐近保证，从而连接预条件学习误差与采样效率。
authors: Max Hird, Florian Maire, Jeffrey Negrea

articles.title: ToE: A Hierarchical and Explainable Claim Verification Framework with Dynamic Multi-source Evidence Retrieval and Aggregation
articles.title_zh: ToE：具有动态多源证据检索与聚合的层次化可解释声明验证框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27736v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid spread of fake news poses increasing threats to information ecosystems, especially as AI-generated misinformation under Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) poisoning allows adversarially crafted content to be systematically surfaced by retrieval systems, contaminating LLM reasoning. In this paper, we propose Tree of Evidence (ToE), a hierarchical evidence reasoning framework for automated fact-checking that models each claim as a dynamically expanding argument tree. ToE integrates a reinforcement learning-driven multi-source retrieval agent, an evidence evaluation agent, and an argument tree aggregation algorithm to iteratively decompose, retrieve, and verify claims through an explainable evidence chain. We further provide a theoretical analysis of the retrieval process, deriving a formal error bound that guarantees the learned policy converges to a neighborhood of the information-theoretically optimal policy. Experiments across multiple datasets and backbone LLMs demonstrate that ToE achieves improvements ranging from 4 to 24 percentage points over competitive baselines, with particularly pronounced gains on adversarially poisoned inputs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Tree of Evidence，用于自动事实核查，尤其针对生成式搜索优化投毒造成的 AI 生成虚假信息被检索系统放大并污染 LLM 推理的问题。ToE 将待验证声明建模为动态扩展的论证树，结合强化学习驱动的多源检索代理、证据评估代理和论证树聚合算法，迭代分解、检索并验证声明。作者还给出检索过程的理论误差界，证明学习策略收敛到信息论最优策略邻域；多数据集和多骨干 LLM 实验中，相对强基线提升4到24个百分点，在对抗性场景中收益尤为明显。
authors: Zhaoqi Wang, Zijian Zhang, Kun Zheng, Zhen Li, Xin Li, Chunlei Li, Jiamou Liu

articles.title: SidConArena: An Environment Evaluating Agents in Open-Ended,Positive-Sum Bargaining Game
articles.title_zh: SidConArena：面向开放式正和议价博弈的智能体评测环境
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27397v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Evaluating LLM agents requires dynamic environments that go beyond static reasoning and zero-sum games. Real-world economic interaction is often open-ended and mixed-motive: agents must negotiate, create positive-sum surplus, compete for scarce assets, and plan under delayed returns. We introduce SidConArena, a new benchmark framework for evaluating LLM agents in open-ended, positive-sum bargaining. SidConArena formalizes a multi-player economy as a finite-horizon partially observable stochastic game with three coupled phases: natural-language negotiation with binding trades, deterministic converter-based production, and sealed-bid auctions for long-term assets. The framework combines structured observations, phase-aware agent dispatching, a neural-symbolic action interface, and asynchronous execution, enabling free-form interaction while preserving rule-grounded evaluation. Across homogeneous and heterogeneous tournaments, stronger frontier models achieve higher economic outcomes, yet agents still misvalue resources, bargain passively, and remain limited in long-horizon investment planning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 SidConArena，用于评估 LLM 智能体在开放式、正和、多方经济议价中的能力，弥补静态推理和零和博弈评测的不足。该框架将多玩家经济形式化为有限时域部分可观测随机博弈，包含自然语言谈判与约束性交易、确定性转换器生产、长期资产密封竞价拍卖三个耦合阶段。系统结合结构化观测、阶段感知智能体调度、神经符号动作接口和异步执行，在保留自由交互的同时实现规则化评测；实验显示更强前沿模型通常获得更高经济收益，但仍存在资源估值错误、议价被动和长期投资规划不足等问题。
authors: Yeqi Feng, Yuxin Chen, Tianxing He

articles.title: SceneBot: Contact-Prompted General Humanoid Whole Body Tracking with Scene-Interaction
articles.title_zh: SceneBot：由接触提示驱动、支持场景交互的通用类人机器人全身运动跟踪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27581v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Current humanoid reinforcement-learning policies excel at free-space motions but struggle with contact-rich tasks, as pure kinematic tracking cannot resolve the physical ambiguities of interacting with objects and uneven terrain. To address this, we introduce SceneBot, a unified motion-tracking framework capable of handling freespace locomotion, terrain traversal, and whole-body manipulation. SceneBot conditions a single policy on both reference motions and per-link contact labels, explicitly defining expected environmental interactions. To overcome the lack of annotated interaction data, we propose a hindsight scene reconstruction approach that infers scene-interaction graphs from retargeted human motion. Trained on 7.5 hours of this reconstructed, contact-rich data, SceneBot successfully generalizes to unseen motions and environments. Our results demonstrate that SceneBot is the first general framework to seamlessly unify free-space and contact-rich behaviors executing complex, long-horizon tasks like carrying a box upstairs and establishing contact conditioning as a powerful interface for humanoid control. All code and data will be open-sourced. More demos and information are available at: https://ericcsr.github.io/scenebot/
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 SceneBot，一个统一的类人机器人运动跟踪框架，可同时处理自由空间运动、地形穿越和全身操作任务。其核心是在参考动作之外引入逐连杆接触标签，显式指定机器人预期与环境发生的接触交互，并通过事后场景重建从重定向人体运动中推断场景—交互图以弥补标注数据不足。基于7.5小时重建的富接触数据训练后，SceneBot 可泛化到未见动作和环境，完成搬箱上楼等长时程复杂任务。
authors: Sirui Chen, Shibo Zhao, Zhen Wu, Jiaman Li, Guanya Shi, C. Karen Liu

articles.title: Learning Topology-Aware Representations via Test-Time Adaptation for Anomaly Segmentation
articles.title_zh: 通过测试时自适应学习拓扑感知表征用于异常分割
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28268v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a promising paradigm for mitigating distribution shifts in deep models. However, existing TTA approaches for anomaly segmentation remain limited by their reliance on pixel-level heuristics, such as confidence thresholding or entropy minimisation, which fail to preserve structural consistency under noise and texture variation. Moreover, they typically treat anomaly maps as flat intensity fields, ignoring the higher-order spatial relationships that characterise complex defect geometries. We introduce TopoTTA (Topological Test-Time Adaptation), a novel framework that integrates persistent homology, a tool from topological data analysis, into the TTA pipeline to enforce geometric and structural coherence during adaptation. By applying multi-level cubical complex filtration to anomaly score maps, TopoTTA derives robust topological pseudo-labels that guide a lightweight test-time classifier, enhancing segmentation quality without retraining the backbone model. The approach avoids reliance on method-specific raw-score thresholding for mask binarisation, preserves connectivity, and generalises across both 2D and 3D modalities. Extensive experiments across six standard benchmarks (MVTec AD, VisA, Real-IAD, MVTec 3D-AD, AnomalyShapeNet, and MVTec LOCO) demonstrate an average 15% F1 improvement over state-of-the-art unsupervised anomaly detection and segmentation methods, with the largest gains on anomalies exhibiting complex geometric or structural variations. These findings suggest that integrating topological reasoning into test-time adaptation provides a principled route to structure-aware generalisation, bridging the gap between geometric learning and robust adaptation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 TopoTTA，将持久同调引入异常分割的测试时自适应，以克服现有方法依赖像素级置信度阈值或熵最小化、难以保持结构一致性的问题。方法对异常得分图进行多层立方复形滤波，生成具有几何鲁棒性的拓扑伪标签，用于指导轻量级测试时分类器，而无需重新训练骨干网络。该框架旨在避免方法特定的原始分数二值化阈值，保持连通性，并提升噪声和纹理变化下的分割质量。
authors: Ali Zia, Usman Ali, Abdul Rehman, Umer Ramzan, Kang Han, Muhammad Faheem, Shahnawaz Qureshi, Wei Xiang

articles.title: Potential flow reconstruction of plunging breaking wave measured with PIV
articles.title_zh: 基于 PIV 测量的卷破波势流重构
articles.abstract: Recent studies of steep and breaking waves have shown the importance of crest properties, and that there may be a quasi-universal breaking onset criterion based on the ratio ((B=u_c/c_c)). In the context of nonlinear potential flow models, such a precursor to breaking may be important for long-term simulations, which requires specifying energy dissipation, but in simulations, results are very sensitive to model parameters.In order to better understand this process, we study this question both numerically and experimentally. For a potential flow reconstruction, a fully nonlinear potential flow (FNPF) model that accurately reproduces the free-surface motion, even beyond wave overturning, is applied. Conditions reproduce experimentally generated plunging waves, with the water surface measured with wave gauges and a video camera, allowing for a particle image velocimetry (PIV) analysis. This PIV system provides fluid velocities close to the wave crest, at breaking onset, compare well with model results.It is observed that this ((B=0.85)) criterion may be satisfied only when a wave has already started overturning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合实验和数值模拟，考察陡峭波与破碎波中波峰性质及基于 B=u_c/c_c 的破碎起始判据。作者采用全非线性势流模型重构自由表面运动，并与波高仪、视频和粒子图像测速获得的卷破波波峰附近速度场进行比较。结果显示，B=0.85 的判据可能只有在波浪已经开始翻卷后才满足，这对势流模型中破碎预报和耗散参数化具有启示。

articles.title: Integrated photon-pair sources on periodically poled thin-film lithium tantalate
articles.title_zh: 基于周期极化薄膜钽酸锂的片上光子对源
articles.abstract: Chip-integrated photon-pair sources based on spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) have emerged as a promising solution for scalable quantum light generation. Thin-film lithium tantalate (TFLT) is a compelling ḩi⁽²⁾ platform, combining strong nonlinearity with a high optical-damage threshold, weak photorefractive response, and ferroelectricity that enables quasi-phase matching. However, SPDC-based photon-pair generation on TFLT has not yet been demonstrated. Here, we combine high-quality periodic poling with low-loss nanophotonic waveguides to realize photon-pair sources on TFLT in both traveling-wave and resonant configurations. In periodically poled straight waveguides, we achieve broadband photon-pair generation with high efficiency (2.1~GHz~mW⁻¹) and coincidence-to-accidental ratio (up to 3.8×10⁵). We further confirm high-purity single-photon operation via heralded second-order correlation (g⁽²⁾_H(0) = 0.0018 ± 0.0002) and high-fidelity time-energy entanglement through Franson interference (visibility of 98.9 ± 0.5%). In periodically poled racetrack resonators, we map out a broad quantum frequency comb spanning the telecom C- and L-bands. By isolating individual frequency-correlated pairs, we measure a high spectral brightness of 11~GHz~mW⁻¹~GHz⁻¹. These results are competitive with the state of the art across ḩi⁽²⁾ integrated platforms, positioning TFLT as a strong contender for integrated quantum light sources, with applications in wavelength-multiplexed quantum communications and photonic quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在薄膜钽酸锂平台上结合高质量周期极化和低损耗纳米光波导，首次展示了基于自发参量下转换的片上光子对源，包括行波和谐振结构。周期极化直波导实现了高效率宽带光子对产生、高符合—偶然比，并通过 heralded 二阶关联和 Franson 干涉验证了高纯度单光子与高保真时间—能量纠缠。周期极化跑道谐振器进一步产生覆盖电信 C/L 波段的量子频率梳，显示该平台在可扩展量子光源中的潜力。

articles.title: A New Insight into Cutting and Chip Formation Mechanisms in Ultrasonic Vibration-Assisted Drilling via Kinematic Modeling, Experiments, and Finite Element Analysis
articles.title_zh: 通过运动学建模、实验与有限元分析重新理解超声振动辅助钻削中的切削和成屑机制
articles.abstract: Ultrasonic vibration-assisted drilling (UVAD) significantly enhances machining performance by reducing cutting forces, extending tool life, and improving chip evacuation. While parameter optimization is well-documented, a fundamental gap remains in understanding how processing parameters drive underlying mechanisms at the elemental scale. This study addresses this gap by establishing a novel kinematic framework of the elemental cutting edge to model alternating cutting velocities, penetration angles, and tool-chip contact interfaces, subsequently deriving the machined surface topology and varying effective uncut chip thickness caused by micro-hammering mechanism. Furthermore, an explicit dynamics finite element analysis (FEA) utilizing Arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian (ALE) adaptive meshing reveals that performance gains stem from alternating effective rake angles, reduced contact lengths, increased chip curvature, and compressive residual stresses, yielding sawtooth-like chip profiles and a four-fold improvement in chip breakage. Crucially, the study results challenge the widely accepted interrupted cutting mechanism in UVAD. It is demonstrated that at ultra-low feeds, complete tool-workpiece separation is inhibited by a physical loading effect that dampens vibration amplitudes, alongside the inherent stickiness of ductile materials, proving that the improvements resulted within continuous tool-chip interface modulation rather than macro-separation. Under applicable feeds, these mechanisms are experimentally validated through reduced cutting forces and comprehensive chip topology analysis. The presence of unique oscillation traces, thinner chips, and a lower chip compression ratio confirms a marked reduction in chip evacuation forces. Ultimately, these insights provide a new paradigm for validating and optimizing vibration-assisted machining systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对超声振动辅助钻削中工艺参数如何影响微观切削机制的问题，建立了元素切削刃运动学模型，用于描述交替切削速度、切入角、刀—屑接触界面、表面形貌和有效未切削屑厚变化。显式动力学有限元分析表明，性能提升源于交替有效前角、接触长度缩短、切屑曲率增大和压缩残余应力，从而形成锯齿状切屑并显著改善断屑。结果还挑战了 UVAD 中广泛接受的间断切削机制，指出在超低进给下完全刀具脱离并非普遍成立。

articles.title: Statistical and Kinematic Analysis of the Coupling between Coronal Mass Ejections and Solar Flares during the Solar Cycles 23–25
articles.title_zh: 第23—25太阳周期间日冕物质抛射与太阳耀斑耦合的统计和运动学分析
articles.abstract: The physical relationship between coronal mass ejections (CMEs) and solar flares remains an active area of research in solar physics because of uncertainties in event association and the limited treatment of flare evolution in previous statistical studies. In this work, we develop an improved statistical and kinematic framework to investigate CME–flare coupling during Solar Cycles 23–25. The proposed approach combines temporal filtering with spatial matching through the transformation of geometric coordinates into a common position-angle coordinate system, reducing ambiguous associations and improving the reliability of CME–flare pairing. Phase-resolved classification and geometric correction of CME velocities are also employed to provide a more complete description of CME evolution. The association algorithm was applied to more than 27,000 CMEs and 15,000 flares, resulting in 2175 uniquely associated events. Results show a strong temporal correlation between CME launch and flare onset, with most of the associated events occurring within a few hours of the flare initiation. The geometric correction raises the estimated CME speeds by an average of 64.5%, which shows how important projection effects are in CME kinematics. Higher CME mass, kinetic energy, and positive acceleration are associated with the impulsive phase, whereas the largest CME speeds and angular widths occur during the declining phase. Flare-associated CMEs are systematically faster, more massive, and more energetic than non-associated events. These findings support a unified picture in which CMEs and flares represent coupled manifestations of magnetic reconnection and demonstrate the value of phase-resolved analysis for understanding solar eruptive processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出改进的统计与运动学框架，用于研究第23至25太阳周期间日冕物质抛射与太阳耀斑的关联。方法结合时间筛选和空间匹配，将几何坐标转换到统一的位置角坐标系，并对 CME 速度进行相位分辨分类和几何校正，从而降低事件配对的不确定性。对超过27000个 CME 和15000个耀斑的分析得到2175个唯一关联事件，显示 CME 发射与耀斑起始存在强时间相关性，且几何校正使 CME 速度估计平均提高64.5%。

articles.title: Architectural Engineering and Mathematical Modeling of the Hybrid Fusion Metal Detector (H-FMD) for Deep-Subsurface Extraction and High-Resolution Target Discrimination
articles.title_zh: 用于深层地下探测与高分辨目标判别的混合融合金属探测器架构工程与数学建模
articles.abstract: Deep-subsurface electromagnetic target acquisition at depths spanning 3.0 to 4.0 metres presents severe physical constraints due to exponential signal attenuation governed by the inverse sixth-power law and structural soil mineralisation boundaries. Traditional single-topology electromagnetic detection systems impose a fundamental technological compromise: Very Low Frequency (VLF) induction balance configurations yield high-resolution phase discrimination but are limited by eddy-current absorption within mineralised soil layers, while Pulse Induction (PI) systems deliver exceptional depth penetration at the cost of metallic classification capability. This paper introduces the Hybrid Fusion Metal Detector (H-FMD), engineered under PROJECT HYBRID-X. Optimised for the 3.0-4.0 m subsurface envelope, the H-FMD couples a high-voltage transient magnetic generator with a continuous sub-VLF synchronous pilot-wave injection framework within a 1.0×1.0 m dual-coil search array. A 32-bit ARM Cortex-M7 DSP executes real-time multi-gate time-domain extraction alongside synchronous digital phase demodulation. Empirical validation in volcanic magnetite soil (Fe3O4 content >15%) reveals 94.2% discrimination accuracy for non-ferrous structures at 3.5 m depth and 98.5% iron rejection accuracy at 3.8 m.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Hybrid Fusion Metal Detector（H-FMD），旨在突破3.0—4.0米深层地下电磁目标探测中信号快速衰减、土壤矿化和传统单一拓扑探测器性能折衷的限制。系统将高压瞬态磁场发生器与连续亚甚低频同步导频注入结合，并采用1.0×1.0米双线圈阵列和 ARM Cortex-M7 DSP 进行多门控时域提取及同步相位解调。火山磁铁矿土壤中的验证显示其在深层目标判别方面具有较高识别能力，具体完整结果需参阅原文。

articles.title: Model Risk Unmasked: An Empirical Reckoning with IRB Capital Requirements
articles.title_zh: 模型风险显现：对内部评级法资本要求的实证检验
articles.abstract: When it comes to credit capital requirements, there are two key things to consider: the probability of default and the loss given default. These are crucial in the Internal Rating Based framework. But there's a problem that's often overlooked: the uncertainty of these parameters, also known as estimation risk. This study looks at how to measure this uncertainty and include it in calculations for regulatory capital. Using a model required by Basel II, we figured out the right way to calculate regulatory capital when there's estimation noise. We compared this to the simpler method that many practitioners use. To make sure our assumptions were correct, we tested them using data from Moody's Investor Service. This data covered 37 years of corporate defaults and recovery rates, and we looked at two types of portfolios: all-rated issuers and speculative-grade issuers. We did some statistical tests and found that the distributions of the key parameters were normal. More importantly, we discovered a strong link between the probability of default and the loss given default. This link was the main driver of model risk. We used Monte Carlo simulations to understand this better. Our study shows that it's essential to consider the uncertainty of parameters when calculating regulatory capital. By doing so, we can get a more accurate picture of the risks involved. This is crucial for financial institutions to make informed decisions and manage their capital effectively. The link between the probability of default and the loss given default is particularly important, and our findings can help institutions better understand and manage this risk. In the end, our research aims to provide a more comprehensive approach to calculating regulatory capital. By taking into account the uncertainty of parameters and the link between default and loss, we can create a more robust and accurate system. This can help prevent financial crises and promote stability in the financial sector. Some key points to consider are: - The importance of accounting for parameter uncertainty in regulatory capital calculations - The strong link between the probability of default and the loss given default - The need for a more comprehensive approach to calculating regulatory capital - The potential benefits of our research for financial institutions and the broader financial sector. Overall, our study highlights the need for a more nuanced understanding of credit capital requirements and the importance of considering multiple factors when calculating regulatory capital. By doing so, we can create a more stable and resilient financial system. JEL Classification: C51 · G21 · G28 · G32
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察信用资本监管中违约概率和违约损失率估计不确定性对内部评级法资本要求的影响，并将参数估计风险纳入 Basel II 框架下的资本计算。作者利用 Moody's Investor Service 覆盖37年的企业违约和回收率数据，对全评级发行人和投机级发行人组合进行统计检验与蒙特 Carlo 模拟。结果表明，违约概率与违约损失率之间的相关性是模型风险的重要来源，简单实践算法可能低估由估计噪声引起的资本需求变化。

articles.title: Numerical Realization on a Personal Computer of the Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulation of the Two-Dimensional Dirac Oscillator
articles.title_zh: 在个人计算机上数值实现囚禁离子二维狄拉克振子的量子模拟
articles.abstract: We provide a self-contained classical (digital) simulation, runnable on an ordinary personal computer, of the trapped-ion quantum-simulation proposal for the 2 + 1 Dirac oscillator. The simulator is built entirely from Kronecker products of a spin- 1 2 system and truncated bosonic modes, requiring only numpy, scipy and matplotlib. We construct the e�ective Hamil- tonian in two independent ways�the full two-mode form and the chiral Jaynes�Cummings (JC) sector�and con�rm that both reproduce the relativistic square-root spectrum E± n = ±mc2√1 + 4ξn, with the JC sector agreeing with the analytic ladder to machine precision and the full two-mode model to Fock-truncation precision. We then compute the observables proposed for laboratory readout: Zitterbewegung in the spin population P↑(t) in both closed and open (Lindblad) dynamics, the real-space trembling ⟨x(t)⟩, and the chirality reversal ob- tained by �ipping the relative laser phase. Finally we restore physical units for a 171Yb+ ion and recover the planning estimates of the proposal (x0 ≈ 3.84 nm, ceff ≈ 2.42 mm/s, Zitterbewegung period ≈ 20 μs). Beyond the idealized model we implement the proposal's leading correction terms�o�-resonant carrier driving, the Debye�Waller curvature, and mode cross-talk�and turn them into feasibility curves, �nding that the Lamb�Dicke/Debye�Waller systematic, rather than decoherence, is the binding constraint on how far up the relativistic ladder the experiment can reach. We also show analytically and numerically that the full Cartesian Hamiltonian reduces exactly to a single-mode anti-Jaynes�Cummings model, so that the square-root ladder is the complete Villalba spectrum carrying an in�nite angular- momentum degeneracy. The complete code is included
articles.abstract_zh: 该文给出一个可在普通个人电脑上运行的经典数字模拟程序，用于复现囚禁离子平台上 2+1 维狄拉克振子的量子模拟方案。模拟基于自旋1/2系统与截断玻色模的 Kronecker 积构造，分别实现完整双模哈密顿量和手征 Jaynes–Cummings 扇区，并验证二者可再现实验方案中的相对论平方根能谱。作者还计算自旋布居中的 Zitterbewegung、实空间颤动、手征反转和 Lindblad 开放动力学，并恢复171Yb+离子的物理量级以支持实验规划。

articles.title: Intelligent packaging solutions for fish and meat products: volatile gas detection via GC- MS, microbial analysis and colorimetric monitoring
articles.title_zh: 鱼肉产品智能包装方案：基于 GC-MS 挥发性气体检测、微生物分析与比色监测
articles.abstract: A pH-sensitive anthocyanin dye was used as a freshness indicator to detect color changes in fish products due to volatile amine formation and microbial activity during storage at 4 ºC. Incremental color changes of the pH indicator response accurately tracked an increase in the total volatile basic nitrogen (TVB-N) content in the packaging headspace of fish products along with increases in total viable count (TVC). Ammonia (NH3) and trimethylamine (TMA) production trend were evaluated during the fish storage using headspace analysis with gas chromatography-mass spectroscopy (GC-MS) detection. No laborious pre-treatment, clean-up, or derivatization was required. The GC-MS method optimization yielded linear calibration curves for the targeted analytes, with detection limits in the range of ppm in pure solvent and good method precision, allowing for the analysis of trends in the molecule concentrations formed during real fish sample storage. Scan-mode injections identified methanol (MeOH), ethanol (EtOH), dimethyl sulfide (DMS), butane and pentane (untargeted species) during fish spoilage with high scores (> 89%). In parallel, gas detection tubes were used to quantify NH3 and Triethylamine (TEA) concentrations in the headspace of homogeneous fish samples across different vial storage conditions and microbial analyses. Correlation analysis between colorimetric results and GC-MS data illustrated a strong relationship in TMA detection, reinforcing the colorimetric sensor's practicality as an efficient monitoring tool for seafood freshness. The experimental outcomes not only highlight the responsiveness of our sensing approach but also suggest potential applications as an intelligent package for ensuring food safety and quality.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用 pH 敏感花青素染料作为新鲜度指示剂，通过颜色变化监测鱼类产品在4 ºC储藏期间因挥发性胺和微生物活动导致的腐败过程。指示剂颜色响应与包装顶空气相中总挥发性盐基氮和菌落总数增加相对应，并通过 GC-MS 分析氨和三甲胺等挥发物的产生趋势。该方法无需复杂预处理，同时还识别出甲醇、乙醇、二甲硫醚、丁烷和戊烷等腐败相关挥发物，展示了智能包装实时监测鱼肉新鲜度的可行性。

articles.title: AI for Maritime Security: Comparative Evaluation of Convolutional Neural Network and Vision Transformer Architectures for Maritime Object Detection
articles.title_zh: 面向海事安全的人工智能：用于海上目标检测的卷积神经网络与视觉 Transformer 架构比较评估
articles.abstract: This study aims to enhance maritime security by using advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Computer Vision (CV) techniques. For this purpose, it was designed and assessed intelligent object detection systems that can detect the presence of ships on the sea surface under different real-time environments. To achieve this goal, a maritime image dataset with 6,468 images was used, covering different weather conditions like cloudy, foggy, rainy, and sunny environments. Six deep learning architectures were evaluated, including a base Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model, four transfer learning models (Xception, VGG16, MobileNetV2, and EfficientNetV2L), and a Vision Transformer (ViT) model. The models were compared using multiple performance indicators, including accuracy, Type I and Type II errors, model size, and video processing time. The results show that model performance varies depending on computational constraints and deployment conditions. While lightweight architectures are suitable for resource-limited devices, the ViT achieved the best overall performance, reaching 100% accuracy with the lowest error rates and the fastest video processing time. The findings highlight the potential of AI-driven computer vision systems for maritime surveillance, border protection, and autonomous navigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向海事安全，评估多种人工智能和计算机视觉模型在不同天气条件下检测海面船舶的能力。作者使用包含6468张图像的数据集，比较基础 CNN、Xception、VGG16、MobileNetV2、EfficientNetV2L 和 Vision Transformer 等六类模型，并从准确率、I/II类错误、模型大小和视频处理时间等指标进行分析。结果显示模型性能受计算资源和部署条件影响，轻量模型适合受限设备，而 ViT 在总体性能、误差率和视频处理速度方面表现最佳。

articles.title: Babinet Preserved Inter-Resonator Coupling in Complementary Split-Ring Resonators
articles.title_zh: 互补开口环谐振器中由 Babinet 原理保持的谐振器间耦合
articles.abstract: The coupling between a split-ring resonator (SRR) and its complementary counterpart (CSRR) is theoretically investigated. Based on Babinet's principle, we demonstrate that the electric and magnetic coupling energy densities are uniquely short-ranged for these complementary structures. Consequently, this coupling is inherently protected from the influence of nearby defects. We derive that the coupling energy of an SRR-CSRR pair can be expressed by summing structure factors dictated by their orientation configurations, which analytically validates previous finite-element simulation results. Furthermore, the remarkable robustness of the SRR-CSRR coupling against environmental perturbations is verified through comprehensive finite-element simulations. These results suggest that coupling between a microwave structure and its complementary counterpart receives a unique level of geometric protection, making this architecture highly suitable for high-density microwave circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从理论上研究开口环谐振器及其互补结构之间的耦合，并基于 Babinet 原理说明二者的电、磁耦合能量密度具有独特的短程特性。作者推导出 SRR-CSRR 对的耦合能可由取向构型决定的结构因子求和表示，从解析上支持此前有限元模拟结果。进一步有限元模拟表明，该耦合对邻近缺陷和环境扰动具有显著鲁棒性，适合用于高密度微波电路设计。

articles.title: Facilitating electrical and laser-induced skyrmion nucleation with a dipolar-field-enhanced effective Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction
articles.title_zh: 利用偶极场增强的有效Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用促进电流与激光诱导斯格明子成核
articles.abstract: Author(s): Mark C. H. de Jong, Dinar Khusyainov, Julian Hintermayr, Bart Sanders, Dmitry Kozodaev, Aleksei V. Kimel, Bert Koopmans, Theo H. M. Rasing, and Reinoud Lavrijsen Magnetic skyrmions are promising nanoscale information carriers, but creating them efficiently remains a central challenge. Here the authors show that a multilayer’s own dipolar field can be turned from a complication into a design tool. By reversing the Ir/Co/Pt stacking order in half of the film, the layer-resolved Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interaction is made to work with, rather than against, the dipolar field. This dipolar-field-enhanced effective DMI enables both nanosecond current pulses and femtosecond laser pulses to generate up to twenty times denser, more stable skyrmion populations—without substantially changing the nucleation threshold. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 064415] Published Mon Jun 29, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出将多层膜自身偶极场由不利因素转化为斯格明子设计工具。通过在一半薄膜中反转Ir/Co/Pt堆垛顺序，使层分辨Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用与偶极场协同，从而增强有效DMI。该机制使纳秒电流脉冲和飞秒激光脉冲能够产生密度最高提升约20倍且更稳定的斯格明子群体，同时成核阈值未发生显著变化。
authors: Mark C. H. de Jong, Dinar Khusyainov, Julian Hintermayr, Bart Sanders, Dmitry Kozodaev, Aleksei V. Kimel, Bert Koopmans, Theo H. M. Rasing, and Reinoud Lavrijsen

articles.title: Kondo effect in ferromagnetic quantum critical CeRh₆Ge₄
articles.title_zh: 铁磁量子临界CeRh₆Ge₄中的Kondo效应
articles.abstract: Author(s): Martin Sundermann, Joe D. Thompson, Eric D. Bauer, Chun-Fu Chang, Sheng-Huai Chen, Chang-Yang Kuo, Liu Hao Tjeng, Gertrud Zwicknagl, and Andrea Severing The nature of cerium’s 4 f electron is key to understanding the mechanism of pressure-induced quantum criticality in the heavy-fermion ferromagnet CeRh 6 Ge 4 . Combining core-level photoemission and polarized x-ray absorption spectroscopy with simulations based on the single-impurity Anderson model, the authors demonstrate here that Kondo hybridization admixes higher-lying crystal field states into a multiorbital ground state with a 4 f occupancy n f ~ 0.9, which also accounts for the dynamical spin response. The results establish the importance of Kondo hybridization and the resulting multiorbital ground state as essential components for a model of quantum criticality. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 245149] Published Mon Jun 29, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究聚焦重费米子铁磁体CeRh₆Ge₄中铈4f电子的性质，以理解压力诱导量子临界性的微观机制。作者结合芯能级光电子能谱、偏振X射线吸收谱和单杂质Anderson模型模拟，表明Kondo杂化会将较高能晶场态混入多轨道基态，并得到约0.9的4f占据数。结果强调，Kondo杂化及由此形成的多轨道基态是构建该体系量子临界模型的关键要素。
authors: Martin Sundermann, Joe D. Thompson, Eric D. Bauer, Chun-Fu Chang, Sheng-Huai Chen, Chang-Yang Kuo, Liu Hao Tjeng, Gertrud Zwicknagl, and Andrea Severing

articles.title: Simulating quantum turbulence with matrix-product states
articles.title_zh: 用矩阵乘积态模拟量子湍流
articles.abstract: Author(s): Felipe Gómez-Lozada, Nicolas Perico-García, Nikita Gourianov, Hayder Salman, and Juan José Mendoza-Arenas Quantum turbulence is a hallmark of nonequilibrium quantum dynamics, arising in systems ranging from superfluid helium to Bose-Einstein condensates. Its simulation is hindered by the high computational cost due to the vast range of length scales involved. The authors employ matrix-product states to efficiently capture the interscale correlation structure of quantum turbulent flows, reducing memory requirements by several orders of magnitude compared to conventional algorithms. These advances extend the capabilities in simulating phenomena involving multiscale physics, and have the potential to facilitate the discovery of properties of very large systems that are far from equilibrium. [Phys. Rev. Applied 25, 064069] Published Mon Jun 29, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将矩阵乘积态用于量子湍流模拟，以高效捕捉湍流流动中的跨尺度关联结构。相比常规算法，该方法可将内存需求降低数个数量级，从而缓解多尺度长度结构带来的计算瓶颈。该进展有望扩展远离平衡的大规模量子系统模拟能力。
authors: Felipe Gómez-Lozada, Nicolas Perico-García, Nikita Gourianov, Hayder Salman, and Juan José Mendoza-Arenas
