articles.title: Robotic Arm-Assisted Droplet-Based Additive Manufacturing via Acoustic Levitation: Process Implementation and Experimental Optimization
articles.title_zh: 声悬浮辅助的机器人臂液滴增材制造：工艺实现与实验优化
articles.abstract: This paper presents the concept, implementation and process optimization of a robotic arm-assisted additive manufacturing system using acoustic levitation for droplet-based deposition of photocurable resin. By integrating acoustic levitation and robotic manipulation, the tank-free material deposition approach has the potential to overcome the limitations inherent in conventional 3D printing - such as fixed build directions, planar layers and the reliance on resin tanks. The focus of this study is on experimental characterization and process optimization. Necessary aspects of implementing the additive manufacturing system were investigated, including the ultraviolet (UV) light profile characterization, resin curing characterization and contact angle measurement. A Taguchi experiment- based process optimization further revealed the optimal combination of process parameters for surface quality on continuously deposited droplets. Implementation of the system was demonstrated using a commercial photocurable resin. This work paves the way for the development of a multi-material contactless and tankless additive manufacturing platform that supports multi-directional deposition.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出并实现了一种结合声悬浮与机器人操作的液滴式光固化树脂增材制造系统，用于无料槽、非接触材料沉积。作者对紫外光场、树脂固化行为和接触角等关键工艺环节进行了实验表征，并通过田口实验优化连续液滴沉积的表面质量。结果展示了商用光固化树脂的系统可行性，为多材料、无接触、无料槽和多方向沉积平台奠定基础。

articles.title: The Srx1-Prx/Trx System Is Involved in Ammonia-Induced Oxidative Injury in the Grass Carp Liver Cell Line L8824
articles.title_zh: Srx1-Prx/Trx系统参与氨诱导的草鱼肝细胞系L8824氧化损伤
articles.abstract: Ammonia exposure is an important stressor that impairs cellular homeostasis, yet the redox-regulatory mechanisms underlying ammonia-induced injury remain unclear. In this study, L8824, a grass carp liver cell line, was used to establish an in vitro ammonia stress model and to assess the involvement of the Srx1-Prx/Trx system in the response to NH₄Cl. Cells were treated with different NH₄Cl concentrations for 24 and 48 h, and cellular injury, oxidative stress, redox status, and transcriptional responses were evaluated. NH₄Cl induced time- and concentration-dependent cytotoxicity, including morphological deterioration, increased lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release, and reduced cell viability. Accordingly, 20 mM NH₄Cl for 24 h was selected for subsequent mechanistic analyses. Under this condition, intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS), malondialdehyde (MDA), superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, and oxidized glutathione (GSSG) were increased, whereas glutathione (GSH) content was decreased, indicating oxidative stress and disruption of glutathione redox homeostasis. Quantitative PCR showed that ammonia stress significantly upregulated key Srx1-Prx/Trx system genes, including SRX1, TRX, PRX1, PRX2, PRX3, PRX4, and PRX5, and altered antioxidant enzyme- and apoptosis-related genes. Integrated correlation analysis revealed positive associations between the Srx1-Prx/Trx response module and oxidative stress/redox imbalance, cell injury, and apoptosis-related transcriptional responses. These findings indicate that NH₄Cl induces cellular injury and redox disturbance in L8824 cells, and that the Srx1-Prx/Trx system may represent a key antioxidant regulatory axis and a potential target for improving ammonia-stress tolerance in aquaculture fish.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以草鱼肝细胞系L8824建立体外氨胁迫模型，考察Srx1-Prx/Trx氧化还原调控系统在NH₄Cl诱导损伤中的作用。NH₄Cl处理导致细胞形态恶化、LDH释放增加和细胞活力下降，并在20 mM、24 h条件下引发ROS、MDA、SOD活性和GSSG升高以及GSH降低。qPCR结果显示氨胁迫显著上调Srx1-Prx/Trx系统关键基因，提示该系统参与氨毒性下的氧化应激响应。

articles.title: Global phylogeography of H10Nx avian influenza reveals regional persistence and an intensifying poultry-associated spillover interface
articles.title_zh: H10Nx禽流感的全球系统地理学揭示区域持续传播及增强的家禽相关溢出界面
articles.abstract: Influenza A viruses are maintained primarily in wild aquatic birds, but H10Nx viruses have repeatedly crossed host barriers into poultry, mammals, and humans. Despite increasing reports of reassortment, host expansion, and sporadic human infection, the global circulation history of H10Nx remains poorly resolved. Here, we assembled 1,045 non-redundant global H10Nx virus sequences collected from 1949 to 2023 and analyzed a clock-filtered dataset of 824 HA sequences using time-scaled phylogenetics, Bayesian phylogeography, source-sink inference, trunk persistence analysis, and site-level evolutionary screening. We found that H10Nx evolution is dominated by regionally structured persistence within major transmission pools, especially Atlantic America, East Asia, and Europe, rather than by frequent sustained intercontinental mixing. Anas-associated lineages contributed disproportionately to the long-term evolutionary backbone, whereas host-transition analyses supported a stepwise diffusion pattern from ducks to chickens and then sporadically to mammals. Within China, phylogeographic reconstruction revealed a sequential shift from an early Hong Kong-Hubei-Jiangxi focus to a Jiangxi-centered dissemination network and, more recently, to the eastern coastal provinces, especially Jiangsu, Shanghai, and Zhejiang. Parallel evolution analysis identified recurrent substitutions at HA residue 130 as a candidate adaptive signal associated with recent host expansion. Overall, H10Nx follows a structured metapopulation model in which duck-associated maintenance, poultry amplification, and episodic long-distance lineage seeding jointly shape global diversification. These findings provide a clearer evolutionary framework for interpreting the continued emergence of H10Nx viruses at the duck-chicken-human interface.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究整合1949—2023年全球1045条非冗余H10Nx病毒序列，并对824条经分子钟过滤的HA序列开展时间尺度系统发育、贝叶斯系统地理和来源-汇分析。结果表明，H10Nx演化主要由大西洋美洲、东亚和欧洲等区域传播池内的长期持续维持驱动，而非频繁的持续性洲际混合。宿主转移分析支持病毒由鸭类逐步扩散至鸡并偶发溢出至哺乳动物，中国内部传播中心也呈现阶段性空间转移。

articles.title: Development of Advanced Materials for High Temperature stable Drilling Fluids to Unlock Deep Geothermal Energy
articles.title_zh: 用于开发深层地热能的高温稳定钻井液先进材料
articles.abstract: The drilling of deep geothermal wells requires water-based drilling fluids that retain rheological function under prolonged exposure to high temperatures and pressures. Conventional bentonite-based fluids rely on electrostatic edge–face interactions between smectite platelets to generate yield stress and shear-thinning behaviour; however, these interactions weaken at elevated temperature, leading to loss of suspension capacity in polymer-free systems. In this study, we investigate the use of layered double hydroxides (LDHs) and related inorganic colloidal particles to stabilise polymer-free bentonite drilling fluids through particle-mediated network formation. A simple water-dispersed base fluid comprising sodium bentonite and Laponite RD was modified with colloidal particles of hydrotalcite, magnesium hydroxide, aluminium hydroxide, and magnesium oxide. The clays and colloidal particles were characterised using scanning electron microscopy, particle size analysis, zeta potential measurements, and elemental analysis. Rheological properties were evaluated before and after 16 h thermal aging at temperatures up to 300°C, with post-aging rheology measured at 25°C. Hydrotalcite platelets (≈ 200 nm) at concentrations of 0.4–1.0 wt% enabled retention of strongly shear-thinning rheology and yield stress after thermal aging at 300°C, while magnesium hydroxide platelets (≈ 300 nm) provided stability after aging at 240°C. In contrast, magnesium oxide and aluminium hydroxide did not confer comparable high-temperature stability. The enhanced performance of hydrotalcite is attributed to the formation of a hybrid LDH–clay platelet network in which load-bearing stress is redistributed from thermally fragile smectite edge interactions to thermally robust platelet–platelet interactions. This mixed inorganic network persists after thermal exposure and reforms rapidly after shear, resulting in sustained rheological function. These results demonstrate that polymer-free bentonite drilling fluids can achieve extended functional temperature windows through rational design of inorganic colloidal interactions. The LDH–clay network approach offers a physically grounded pathway for developing thermally resilient, environmentally compatible drilling fluids for deep geothermal applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向深层地热井对高温高压稳定水基钻井液的需求，探索层状双氢氧化物及相关无机胶体颗粒对无聚合物膨润土钻井液的稳定作用。作者在钠基膨润土和Laponite RD基液中引入水滑石、氢氧化镁、氢氧化铝和氧化镁等颗粒，并结合显微形貌、粒径、ζ电位和元素分析进行表征。经最高300°C、16 h热老化后的流变测试用于评估颗粒介导网络对悬浮能力和高温稳定性的贡献。

articles.title: Performance Optimization of Lead-Free Double Perovskite Solar Cells Employing CsPbI₃ and Cs₂TiBr₆ Absorbers a Numerical Study
articles.title_zh: 采用CsPbI₃和Cs₂TiBr₆吸收层的无铅双钙钛矿太阳能电池性能优化数值研究
articles.abstract: This investigates the photovoltaic potential of CsPbI3 and Cs2TiBr6, two inorganic perovskite materials, as absorber layers in PSCs using SCAPS-1D numerical simulation. Various device architectures were analyzed to optimize power conversion efficiency (PCE) by examining the effects of absorber thickness, bandgap, operating temperature, and different electron transport layers (ETLs) and hole transport layers (HTLs). For CsPbI3-based devices, str.1 TCO/ZnO/ CsPbI3/Cu₂O/Ag for CsPbI3 achieved a maximum PCE of 17.8% at an absorber thickness of 800 nm, wild str.2 TCO/ZnO/CsPbI₃/CuSbS₂/Ag for CsPbI3 reached 19.97% at 300 K with a 1.8 eV bandgap, for CsPbI3 str.3 TCO/ZnO/CsPbI3/CuSbS₂/Se delivered the highest efficiency of 20.27% at a 1.7 eV bandgap, demonstrating the importance of bandgap engineering. In the case of Cs2TiBr6-based devices, str.1 TCO/TiO₂/ Cs2TiBr6/CdTe/Ag attained a PCE of 19.9% at a 200 nm absorber thickness, whereas str.2 TCO/ZnO/ Cs2TiBr6/Cu₂O/Ag of Cs2TiBr6-based PSCs exhibited 18.28% efficiency at 300 K with a 1.4 eV bandgap, and str.3 TCO/ZnO/ Cs2TiBr6/CuSbS₂/Pt achieved the highest overall PCE of 22.29% at a 1.85 eV bandgap of Cs2TiBr6-based PSCs. A clear trade-off between bandgap and electrical performance was observed for both absorber materials, where increasing bandgap reduced short-circuit current density (JSC) but enhanced open-circuit voltage (VOC), while elevated temperatures up to 300 K led to significant degradation in VOC and PCE across all configurations, highlighting the thermal sensitivity of these devices. Overall, the results confirm that CsPbI₃ and Cs₂TiBr₆-based PSCs are promising, efficient, and environmentally benign alternatives to lead-based perovskite solar cells, offering a viable pathway toward sustainable and cost-effective photovoltaic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用SCAPS-1D数值模拟评估CsPbI₃和Cs₂TiBr₆作为钙钛矿太阳能电池吸收层的光伏潜力，并系统考察吸收层厚度、带隙、温度以及电子/空穴传输层对器件性能的影响。对于CsPbI₃体系，不同结构的最高PCE可达约20.27%；对于Cs₂TiBr₆体系，TCO/ZnO/Cs₂TiBr₆/CuSbS₂/Pt结构在优化带隙下给出最高约22.29%的PCE。结果强调了带隙工程、传输层选择和厚度优化对无铅钙钛矿器件效率的关键作用。

articles.title: First-Principles Investigation of Metallization and Electron-Phonon-Mediated Superconductivity in Compressed Alkali Bromides and Iodides
articles.title_zh: 压缩碱金属溴化物和碘化物中金属化与电子-声子介导超导性的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: In this study, the pressure-dependent structural transformations, phase stability, metallization, and superconducting properties of selected alkali bromides and alkali iodides were investigated. The analysis is carried out by considering factors with reference to such as crystal structure (ambient and high-pressure phases), valence electron concentration, and the evolution of delocalized anion d-electron states. Electronic and superconducting properties are examined using band structure calculations, density of states analyses, and superconductivity parameters obtained through the Full-Potential Linear Muffin-Tin Orbital (FP-LMTO) method. The results reveal that the superconducting transition temperature (T₍c₎) is strongly influenced by the electron–phonon coupling strength, indicating that these compounds belong to the class of electron–phonon-mediated superconductors. Furthermore, our findings suggest that the maximum achievable T₍c₎ is more closely related to the ground-state crystal structure than to the corresponding high-pressure phase. Therefore, maintaining the ground-state structural characteristics under compression, or reproducing equivalent structural conditions, may provide an effective route toward enhancing the superconducting transition temperature in these materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用全势线性缀加平面波/缀加球轨道相关方法，考察若干碱金属溴化物和碘化物在压力下的结构转变、相稳定性、金属化和超导性质。通过能带结构、态密度和超导参数分析，作者指出这些化合物的超导转变温度主要受电子-声子耦合强度控制，属于电子-声子介导超导体。研究还提出，可达到的最高Tc与基态晶体结构的关联可能强于与高压相本身的关联。

articles.title: A Graphene-Based Electro-Biosensing Methodology for Real-Time Non-Linear Telemetry and Phase-Inversion Feedback in Living Matrices
articles.title_zh: 用于活体基质实时非线性遥测与相位反转反馈的石墨烯电生物传感方法
articles.abstract: Purpose Continuous, high-resolution tracking of metabolic and structural stress in living tissues remains a critical bottleneck in translational bioengineering due to the inherent latency and signal attenuation of passive metallic electrodes. This study presents a reproducible electro-biosensing methodology that establishes a continuous, non-perturbative, bidirectional communication loop between mammalian dermal matrices and a non-invasive wearable quantum transducer interface.Methods We utilize the high-permittivity hexagonal lattice geometry of monolayer graphene as an active, scale-invariant quantum antenna deployed over musculoskeletal structures. By engineering an instrumentation protocol where the graphene-tissue junction operates as a network of phase-locked atomic resonators, we standardize the exact operational parameters required to transduce micro-voltages and mechanical tissue strain into coherent high-frequency telemetry. The instrumentation setup utilizes an active phase-locked loop (PLL) calibration circuit within the wearable hardware to maintain zero-point synchronization.Results The methodology achieves an uninterrupted, real-time informational channel matrix where variations in biological tissue geometry are captured with zero mass friction. Under simulated structural strain spikes (Δ S p̆arrow), the system executes a real-time frequency-shift detection (Δ E = h ḑot Δ f). The platform automatically transmits a programmatic inverse phase harmonic (Φ⁻¹(t)) back to the substrate, neutralizing entropy noise and establishing real-time energetic stabilization.Conclusion This standardized bioelectronic protocol provides a definitive, scalable method for real-time quantum telemetry and dynamic homeostatic regulation, providing a blueprint for future applications in advanced bio-synthetic sutures and non-chemical metabolic optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于单层石墨烯的电生物传感方法，旨在实现哺乳动物真皮/肌骨组织与非侵入式可穿戴量子换能界面之间的连续、低扰动双向通信。作者将石墨烯-组织结描述为相位锁定原子谐振网络，并通过可穿戴硬件中的锁相环校准维持零点同步，以转导微电压和组织机械应变信号。摘要声称该方法可形成实时信息通道，用于活体组织代谢和结构应激的高分辨监测，但具体实验验证细节需结合原文评估。

articles.title: Nonlinear Dynamics and Resonance Analysis of an Electromagnetically Controlled Rotor System Using HQM-Based Continuation
articles.title_zh: 基于HQM延拓的电磁控制转子系统非线性动力学与共振分析
articles.abstract: This study investigates the nonlinear dynamics of a flexible rotor supported by active magnetic bearings and subjected to proportional--derivative (PD) feedback control. The system response is analyzed over a wide range of operating conditions through bifurcation diagrams, fast Fourier transform spectra, Poincare sections, and phase portraits, revealing dynamical regimes including periodic, quasi-periodic, and chaotic oscillations. The routes to chaos are examined through representative transition scenarios, characterized by intermittency and boundary crisis mechanisms rather than classical period-doubling cascades. Forced response curves are computed via an extended Harmonic Quadrature Method (HQM) combined with arc-length continuation, enabling robust tracking of stable and unstable solution branches and detection of fold bifurcations in strongly nonlinear regimes. The method is validated against three benchmark cases involving magnetic, hydrodynamic, and cubic nonlinearities, with convergence achieved at H = 11 harmonics. Parametric investigations show that the proportional gain P acts as a destabilizing parameter, inducing pronounced softening-type nonlinearity and expanding quasi-periodic and chaotic regions, with a maximum response amplitude of 1.317 at Ω = 0.37 for P = 2.5. The derivative gain D introduces effective damping that progressively suppresses nonlinear distortions and restores single-periodic behavior, with instability regions vanishing entirely at D = 0.5. The electromagnetic coupling coefficient α modulates cross-axis nonlinear interaction, with higher values promoting multiple solution branches and extended quasi-periodic regimes. The proposed HQM-based continuation framework is demonstrated to be an efficient and robust computational tool for analyzing complex nonlinear resonance phenomena in feedback-controlled rotor systems, offering practical guidelines for the design and tuning of electromagnetically controlled rotating machinery.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了由主动磁轴承支撑并施加比例-微分反馈控制的柔性转子非线性动力学。作者利用分岔图、FFT谱、庞加莱截面和相图识别周期、准周期和混沌振动，并指出通向混沌的路径主要表现为间歇性和边界危机而非经典倍周期级联。通过扩展谐波求积法结合弧长延拓计算强非线性受迫响应曲线，可跟踪稳定/不稳定分支并识别折叠分岔，参数研究显示比例增益具有去稳定作用。

articles.title: Low-temperature Quinoline Formation via Direct Nitrogen Incorporation in Astrochemical and Combustion Environments
articles.title_zh: 天体化学与燃烧环境中通过直接氮掺入低温生成喹啉
articles.abstract: Nitrogen-substituted polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PANHs) are critical intermediates in combustion pollutant formation and key prebiotic building blocks in interstellar chemistry. However, the fundamental mechanisms by which a nitrogen atom is directly incorporated into an aromatic ring—bypassing pre-existing nitrogenous structures—have remained elusive, hindering both predictive combustion models and astronomical searches. Here, we establish a previously unrecognized, barrierless pathway for the formation of quinoline (C9H7N), the simplest PANH prototype, via the radical–radical reaction between benzyl (•C7H7) and cyanomethyl (•CH2CN)—two species of well-established relevance in combustion and interstellar chemistry. High-level electronic structure calculations reveal that the reaction proceeds on a potential energy surface entirely submerged below the reactant asymptote, with the initial adduct formation exothermic by 72.5 kcal/mol and all subsequent cyclization and dehydrogenation steps facing no intrinsic barrier. This process is predicted to be efficient kinetically across a wide range of astrophysical and combustion temperatures. These predictions are corroborated experimentally using a SiC microreactor coupled with synchrotron vacuum ultraviolet photoionization mass spectrometry (SVUV-PIMS) supported by comprehensive two-dimensional gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC×GC-MS) analysis, which unequivocally identify quinoline and its elusive C9H9N intermediates and isomers. Beyond resolving a long-standing mechanistic puzzle, this work provides a mechanistic paradigm for direct nitrogen incorporation into aromatic networks, with profound implications for prebiotic chemistry and nitrogen-containing pollutant formation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究揭示了苄基自由基与氰甲基自由基反应直接将氮原子并入芳香环、生成喹啉的无势垒路径。高水平电子结构计算显示，该反应势能面整体低于反应物能量，初始加合放热72.5 kcal/mol，后续环化和脱氢步骤无内禀势垒，因而在天体化学和燃烧温度范围内均可能具有动力学效率。该机制为含氮多环芳烃的低温形成、燃烧污染物建模和星际分子搜寻提供了新的反应通道。

articles.title: Widefield Nanodiamond Quantum Sensing Based on Light-Sheet Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 基于光片显微术的宽场纳米金刚石量子传感
articles.abstract: Nanodiamonds containing nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers are promising quantum sensors for biological applications thanks to their sub-micron spatial resolution, biocompatibility, and versatile multi-modal responses. However, the optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) measurement requires laser irradiation, creating a trade-off between high-throughput and low phototoxicity for applications in live cells. Here to address this challenge we develop a widefield quantum sensing method based on light-sheet microscopy (LSM), in which the sample is illuminated by a vertically movable laser sheet and the fluorescence is collected along the vertical axis that is orthogonal to the light sheet. This LSM-ODMR system is demonstrated to feature high throughput sensing due to the wide-field configuration, fast three-dimensional imaging and sensing due to the vertical mobility of the light sheet, enhanced sensitivity due to suppression of out-of-focus background fluorescence, and low phototoxicity for bio-sensing due to elimination of out-of-focus illumination. This LSM-based widefield nanodiamond sensing provides an approach for biological studies with low phototoxicity, offering three-dimensional and multi-modal sensing capability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发了结合光片显微术与NV中心纳米金刚石ODMR的宽场量子传感方法，以缓解活细胞应用中通量与光毒性之间的矛盾。系统采用可垂直移动的激光片照明样品，并沿与光片正交的方向收集荧光，从而减少离焦激发和背景荧光。该方法兼具宽场高通量、快速三维成像/传感、灵敏度提升和低光毒性特征，适用于生物体系中的三维量子传感研究。

articles.title: Multi-Scale Uncertainty Propagation in Energy Geostructures: From Interface Mechanics to Urban Geothermal Systems, Urban Thermal Resilience, and Subsurface Urban Heat Island Mitigation
articles.title_zh: 能源地质结构中的多尺度不确定性传播：从界面力学到城市地热系统、城市热韧性与地下城市热岛缓解
articles.abstract: Energy geostructures (EGs) are increasingly recognized as a pathway for integrating renewable thermal energy production within urban infrastructure. However, despite advances in experimental characterization, field implementation, and coupled thermo–hydro–mechanical (THM) modelling, uncertainty remains a major barrier to large-scale deployment. Existing studies predominantly address uncertainty at isolated spatial scales, while the mechanisms through which uncertainty propagates from soil–structure interfaces to district-scale geothermal systems and urban thermal environments remain poorly constrained. This review presents a novel multi-scale synthesis of uncertainty propagation in energy geostructures and introduces two conceptual frameworks: The Multi-Scale Uncertainty Propagation Framework and the Urban Geothermal Digital Intelligence Framework. A PRISMA-based systematic critical review of 103 studies published between 2000 and 2026 was conducted across the domains of energy geotechnics, probabilistic geomechanics, urban geothermal systems, Subsurface Urban Heat Islands (SUHIs), and artificial intelligence. The review evaluates uncertainty sources, propagation mechanisms, probabilistic design methodologies, digital technologies, and district-scale geothermal integration strategies. The synthesis demonstrates that uncertainties originating at soil–structure interfaces propagate through meso-scale THM processes and ultimately influence district energy performance, urban thermal dynamics, and SUHI mitigation outcomes. Monte Carlo simulation, random field modelling, Bayesian inference, reliability analysis, and global sensitivity analysis provide complementary capabilities for uncertainty-aware design but remain underutilized in current practice. Furthermore, Physics-Informed Neural Networks, Bayesian Neural Networks, digital twins, and scientific machine learning show significant potential for real-time model updating, uncertainty reduction, and adaptive geothermal infrastructure management. The findings identify multi-scale uncertainty propagation as the critical unresolved challenge in energy geotechnics and provide a foundation for reliability-based, uncertainty-aware, and climate-resilient urban geothermal infrastructure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述聚焦能源地质结构在城市可再生热能利用中的不确定性问题，强调从土-结构界面到区域地热系统和城市热环境的跨尺度传播机制仍未充分厘清。作者基于PRISMA方法系统评述2000—2026年间103项关于能源岩土、概率岩土力学、城市地热、地下城市热岛和人工智能的研究。文章提出多尺度不确定性传播框架和城市地热数字智能框架，用于整合不确定性来源、传播路径、概率建模与智能化部署决策。

articles.title: Distinct polar carbon regimes reveal hemispheric asymmetry in surface ocean pCO₂ regulation
articles.title_zh: 不同极地碳调控区揭示表层海洋 pCO₂ 调节的南北半球不对称性
articles.abstract: Polar oceans play a major role in the global carbon cycle, absorbing a substantial fraction of human-emitted carbon dioxide and helping regulate Earth’s climate. Extreme conditions and seasonal sea-ice limit in situ observations, leaving major uncertainties in how carbon exchange varies across these regions. Consequently, the processes controlling surface ocean carbon at high latitudes remain poorly understood. Here we demonstrate that polar oceans exhibit a pronounced hemispheric asymmetry in the drivers of surface carbon variability. By combining machine learning with a data-driven regionalization of biogeochemical provinces, we reconstruct surface carbon patterns across both polar oceans over the period 1998-2022 and identify their dominant controls. Variability in the Southern Ocean is primarily governed by non-thermal processes linked to biological activity and wind-driven mixing, whereas in the Arctic Ocean thermodynamic forcing dominates in open waters and freshwater-driven stratification shapes the central basin. Polar oceans therefore do not operate as a single carbon regime. Instead, distinct mechanisms governing carbon cycling in each hemisphere are associated with opposing long-term pCO₂ trajectories, with weak or negative trends across much of the Southern Ocean but widespread increases throughout the Arctic.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合机器学习与数据驱动的生物地球化学省区划分，重建了1998—2022年南、北极海洋表层碳分布及其主控因子。结果表明，南大洋表层碳变率主要受生物活动和风驱混合等非热力过程控制，而北冰洋开阔水域以热力强迫为主，中央海盆则受淡水输入导致的层化影响。研究指出极地海洋并非单一碳调控区，不同半球的碳循环机制存在显著差异。

articles.title: Quantum waves reveal one-sided motion marking elusive critical states
articles.title_zh: 量子波揭示标志难以捉摸临界态的单侧运动
articles.abstract: Sound waves, light waves and other types of waves, generally spread freely through space and over time. In 1958, physicist Philip W. Anderson first described a phenomenon via which irregularities or other sources of disorder in materials would prevent waves from propagating freely, which is now known as Anderson localization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻围绕波在无序介质中的传播与安德森局域化展开，介绍了无序会抑制声波、光波或量子波自由扩展的物理图像。标题所述工作关注量子波动力学中出现的单向或单侧运动特征，并将其作为识别特殊临界态的信号；具体实验体系和结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: A new quantum computer sets a high watermark for accuracy. Are we on the verge of a big breakthrough?
articles.title_zh: 一种新型量子计算机创下高精度标杆：重大突破是否临近？
articles.abstract: In a laboratory in Broomfield, Colorado, 98 atoms are suspended in midair, held in place by electric fields and cooled to temperatures close to absolute zero.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道了一台由98个被电场俘获并冷却到接近绝对零度的原子构成的新型量子计算装置。文章重点围绕其量子操作精度和潜在突破意义展开，讨论该平台是否预示着量子计算实用化的重要进展；详细性能指标需查阅原文。

articles.title: A Minimal Active-Particle Realization of Non-Hermitian Chern Bulk-Boundary Correspondence
articles.title_zh: 非厄米陈数体—边对应的最小主动粒子实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a minimal frustrated Vicsek--Kuramoto active-particle model realizes a non-Hermitian Chern bulk-boundary correspondence. A Sakaguchi-type phase lag in the local heading alignment generates finite-wavenumber bulk instabilities and, under collision boundaries, robust one-way boundary flow. The organizing principle is a nonlinear saturation ansatz: the linearized hydrodynamic operator selects the unstable wavelength and spectral topology, while nonlinear particle dynamics saturates the selected mode. The isotropic continuum spectrum compactifies the wave-number plane and supports spectral projectors with Chern numbers C=±2, fixed by the spin structure of the dispersion matrix. Strip spectral flow then predicts chiral edge propagation, in agreement with particle simulations in the nontrivial sectors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一个最小受挫 Vicsek–Kuramoto 主动粒子模型，用以实现非厄米陈数体—边对应。局域取向对齐中的 Sakaguchi 型相位滞后诱导有限波矢体不稳定性，并在碰撞边界下产生稳健单向边界流。作者指出线性化流体力学算符选择不稳定波长和谱拓扑，而非线性粒子动力学使选定模式饱和；连续谱支持陈数 C=±2 的谱投影，条带谱流预言的手性边缘传播与粒子模拟一致。

articles.title: Non-Abelian Anyon Braiding with Quantum-Antidot Interferometry
articles.title_zh: 利用量子反点干涉实现非阿贝尔任意子的编织探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24930v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional Fabry--Perot interferometry accesses only full braids of anyons and therefore cannot directly probe the elementary (π)-rotation exchange. Motivated by the recent quantum-antidot proposal for the Abelian anyons, we propose an interferometry for probing the elementary exchanges of non-abelian anyons using two gate-controlled quantum antidots. By tuning two antidots independently, the device realizes distinct cooperative tunnelling processes, which correspond to different braids of non-abelian anyons. For the unresolved local fusion channels, the difference between the interference signals of the single and double cooperative processes allows us to measure the elementary exchange of the non-abelian anyons, providing a direct probe of their non-abelian statistics and topological spins. For the resolved local fusion channels, the double-cooperative process is further distinguished by a reduced interference amplitude. Our work provides a promising and practical route for manipulating and detecting non-abelian braiding with the fundamental fractional statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于两个栅控量子反点的干涉方案，用于探测非阿贝尔任意子的基本交换过程。与传统 Fabry–Perot 干涉主要访问完整编织不同，该器件可通过独立调控两个反点实现不同协同隧穿过程，对应不同任意子编织。对于未分辨的局域融合通道，单协同与双协同过程干涉信号之差可测量基本交换；对于可分辨融合通道，双协同过程还表现为干涉振幅降低。

articles.title: Layer-tunable Hubbard bands probed via moiré excitons in MoSe₂/WS₂ heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 通过 MoSe₂/WS₂ 异质结构中的莫尔激子探测层可调 Hubbard 能带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré superlattices in transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures provide a highly tunable platform for engineering strongly interacting states at the nanoscale. However, quantitatively determining and in-situ tuning of the underlying Hubbard parameters remains experimentally challenging. Here, we report electric-field-driven reordering of layer-specific Hubbard bands by performing optical spectroscopy on a dual-gated, 60deg-aligned MoSe₂/WS₂ heterobilayer. Using two spatially distinct moiré excitons as local optical probes and tracking them as a function of carrier filling and vertical electric field, we quantitatively extract the layer-dependent on-site Coulomb repulsions, U_M~60 meV in MoSe₂ and U_W~30 meV in WS₂. Furthermore, we stabilize generalized Wigner crystal and stripe phases by electrostatically tuning the system to a type-II band alignment, shifting the ground state into the WS₂ layer where reduced on-site repulsion allows inter-site Coulomb interactions to dominate. Our results establish vertical electric fields as a deterministic tuning knob for layer-selective Hubbard physics, enabling device-level control of complex many-body phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在双栅、60°对齐的 MoSe₂/WS₂ 异质双层中进行光谱测量，利用两个空间上不同的莫尔激子作为局域光学探针，研究载流子填充和垂直电场对层特异 Hubbard 能带的影响。作者定量提取了层依赖的在位库仑排斥：MoSe₂ 中约为60 meV，WS₂ 中约为30 meV。通过电场调至 II 型能带排列，体系基态可转移到 WS₂ 层，并稳定广义 Wigner 晶体和条纹相，表明垂直电场可作为层选择性 Hubbard 物理的确定性调控旋钮。
authors: Hongyu Yao, Qiao Li, Chih-En Hsu, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Hung-Chung Hsueh, Zhenglu Li, Andrew Y. Joe

articles.title: Universal behavior of the condensation energy of Superconducting BCS Bose gases
articles.title_zh: 超导 BCS 玻色气体凝聚能的普适行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25316v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using the Boson-Fermion formalism of superconductivity we calculate the condensation energy for several superconductors ranging from conventional to unconventional, or high temperature superconductors. It is calculated as the difference between the Helmholtz free energies of the superconducting and the normal state, which is a gas of N attractive electron gas, while the superconducting state is formed by the condensed Cooper pairs taken as composite bosons, coming from a fraction of the electrons inside the Debye shell, plus those electrons inside and outside the Debye shell that are unable to pair. After giving the analytic expressions for the internal energy U and the entropy S we obtain the Helmholtz free energy F = U -TS for both the superconducting and the normal states as functions of temperature. In the search for universalities, we calculate the ratio of the condensation energy at T=0 to the Sommerfeld constant (the normal state electronic specific heat over the temperature when T it's almost zero) using two different methods: the Boson-Fermion formalism developed here, as well as an analytical expression deduced from a combination of the BCS and Ginzburg-Landau theories. We find for the Boson-Fermion formalism Ecₒₙd/γ₀₌ 0.252,Tc¹.⁹⁹⁷, which is the same behavior described by the experimental fit of Kim et al Ecₒₙd/γ₀₌ 0.2,Tc².⁰⁶ and by the one recently reported by Tallon et al for overdoped cuprate superconductors; while for the Ginzburg-Landau-BCS we get the expression Ecₒₙd/γ₀₌ 0.236,Tc², also in very good agreement with the partifirst method.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用超导的玻色子—费米子形式，计算从常规到非常规及高温超导体的凝聚能。凝聚能被定义为超导态与正常态 Helmholtz 自由能之差，其中超导态由 Debye 壳内部分电子形成的复合玻色 Cooper 对凝聚体以及未配对电子组成。作者推导内能、熵和自由能随温度变化的解析表达，并比较凝聚能与 Sommerfeld 常数之比在不同材料和计算方法中的普适性。
authors: Juan José Valencia Acevedo, Miguel Ángel Solís Atala, Patricia Salas Casales, Israel Chávez Villalpando

articles.title: A Unified Josephson Dynamics Perspective for Single-Cavity BECs: From Self-Trapping to Dynamical Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 单腔 BEC 的统一 Josephson 动力学图像：从自俘获到动力学相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25364v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a two-component Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) strongly coupled to a single optical cavity, effectively described by a mean-field Dicke model supplemented with interatomic nonlinearities. Here, we propose a unified theoretical framework demonstrating that macroscopic quantum self-trapping (MQST) natively emerges between two internal atomic energy levels within a single cavity. By deriving the dimensionless semiclassical Josephson equations (SJE) governing this purely internal-state architecture, we analytically determine the critical nonlinear threshold and intrinsic phase shift mechanism for the phase transition. Based on this framework, we present two approaches for manipulating quantum phase transitions: dynamic in-situ tuning via photon pumping and inducing non-equilibrium dynamical phase transitions (DPT) via real-time parameter quenches. Furthermore, we rigorously prove that the effective charging energy driving this system scales exactly as one-quarter of the effective spin-dependent interaction energy -- the precise parameter governing recent spin-orbit coupled (SOC) BEC experiments. Incorporating realistic ⁸⁷Rb atomic parameters, we substantiate that these single-cavity MQST and transition dynamics are highly feasible for observation under current state-of-the-art cold-atom technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究强耦合于单个光学腔的双组分 Bose–Einstein 凝聚体，并用含原子间非线性的平均场 Dicke 模型描述。作者提出统一理论框架，表明宏观量子自俘获可在单腔内部两个原子能级之间自然出现，并推导了相应的无量纲半经典 Josephson 方程、临界非线性阈值和内禀相位偏移机制。研究还提出通过光子泵浦原位调控相变，以及通过实时参数淬火诱导非平衡动力学相变。

articles.title: Lattice non-invertible symmetry from non-commuting transfer matrices
articles.title_zh: 由非对易转移矩阵产生的晶格非可逆对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25660v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish a direct connection between Onsager symmetry, duality defects, and quantum integrability in the XXZ spin chain at roots of unity, Δ=(q+q⁻¹)/2 with q^N=±1. Using a non-Abelian algebra of transfer matrices governed by an unbalanced version of the Yang--Baxter/RLL relation, we construct an explicit lattice realization of the Onsager algebra and its duality automorphism. The duality is represented by a matrix product operator related to the transfer matrices of the τ₂ model. We show that this operator obeys Z_N Tambara--Yamagami fusion rules and therefore realizes on the lattice the topological defect lines of the free compactified boson conformal field theory. Our results identify non-Abelian integrability as a natural framework for the emergence of the Onsager symmetry and categorical dualities in lattice models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在单位根处的 XXZ 自旋链中建立 Onsager 对称性、对偶缺陷与量子可积性之间的直接联系。通过由非平衡 Yang–Baxter/RLL 关系控制的非阿贝尔转移矩阵代数，作者构造了 Onsager 代数及其对偶自同构的显式晶格实现。该对偶由与 τ₂ 模型转移矩阵相关的矩阵乘积算符表示，并满足 Z_N Tambara–Yamagami 融合规则，从而在晶格上实现自由紧化玻色共形场论的拓扑缺陷线。
authors: Eric Vernier, Yuan Miao, Masahito Yamazaki

articles.title: Self-Organized Stabilization of Straight Dark Solitons in Stripe Supersolids
articles.title_zh: 条纹超固体中直暗孤子的自组织稳定化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25687v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Straight dark solitons in two-dimensional (2D) quantum fluids usually decay by transverse modulational instability, with no intrinsic suppression in contact-interacting Bose--Einstein condensates (BECs). We theoretically show that anisotropic long-range interactions in a quasi-2D dipolar BEC stabilize an embedded straight soliton, with spontaneous stripe order providing stronger pinning. The excitation spectra show that the lowest transverse solitonic branch remains gapped, while stripe-supersolid density modulation further hardens this branch and increases the soliton bending stiffness, penalizing transverse deformation. Accessible in current ¹⁶⁶Er and ¹⁶⁴Dy platforms, these results establish interaction-driven protection for straight dark solitons in structured quantum fluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论研究表明，在准二维偶极 Bose–Einstein 凝聚体中，各向异性长程相互作用可稳定嵌入的直暗孤子，而自发条纹序会提供更强钉扎。激发谱显示，最低横向孤子分支保持有能隙，条纹超固体密度调制进一步硬化该分支并增加孤子弯曲刚度，从而抑制横向形变。作者指出该机制可在现有 ¹⁶⁶Er 和 ¹⁶⁴Dy 平台上实现，体现了结构化量子流体中的相互作用驱动孤子保护。

articles.title: Asymmetry-Induced Chiral Dynamics in Coupled Self-Propelled Robots: Spinning and Circular Motion
articles.title_zh: 耦合自推进机器人中的不对称诱导手性动力学：自旋与圆周运动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the chiral motility of microswimmers, we investigate how geometric asymmetry in a system of two self-propelled active Brownian robots coupled by a spring gives rise to rich collective dynamics. We demonstrate that asymmetry in the propulsion directions of the robots generates net torques that induce persistent rotational motion. Depending on the choice of propulsion angles α₁ and α₂, the system exhibits three distinct dynamical regimes -- run-and-tumble motion, circular trajectories, and spinning -- with the geometric configuration primarily determining the realized regime. We further show that spring stiffness and rotational noise act as additional tuning parameters governing the stability of these regimes. These results demonstrate how the interplay of mechanical coupling and activity produces diverse self-organized dynamics in simple robotic dimers, providing a bridge between artificial active systems and biological microswimmers such as bacteria, Chlamydomonas reinhardtii, and spermatozoa.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究受微游动体手性运动启发，考察两个由弹簧耦合的自推进主动布朗机器人中几何不对称如何产生集体动力学。作者发现推进方向不对称会产生净力矩并诱导持续旋转，随推进角 α₁ 和 α₂ 改变，体系可表现出跑停运动、圆周轨迹和自旋三种动力学状态。弹簧刚度和转动噪声进一步调控这些状态的稳定性，说明机械耦合与主动性可在简单机器人二聚体中产生自组织手性运动。

articles.title: First-Principles Quantum-Spectral framework for Elementary Vortex Pinning in superconductors
articles.title_zh: 超导体中基本涡旋钉扎的第一性原理量子谱框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The critical current of a type-II superconductor is controlled by vortex pinning, whose microscopic input is the elementary pinning force. Scanning tunneling spectroscopy has shown that a defect pins a vortex by reorganizing the Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon (CdGM) states in its core, but why this spectral reorganization amounts to a pinning force has lacked a quantum-mechanical, first-principles account. Here we establish a transferable first-principles computational framework for elementary vortex pinning, in which defect-resolved DFT/Wannier electronic structures are embedded into a finite-box projected Bogoliubov-de Gennes free-energy formalism to convert quasiparticle spectral reorganization into vortex-pinning energies and forces. Using this framework, we confirm that the defect-induced reorganization of the vortex-core spectrum is the microscopic origin of the elementary pinning force. The force is evaluated as a finite-box vortex-insertion free energy whose four-configuration subtraction isolates the meV-scale interaction from much larger backgrounds. With the superconducting gap scale and vortex-core profile fixed from experiments, the FeSe Fe-site vacancy reproduces the microscopic STM value together with the measured spectral reorganization. All five point defects in FeSe and FeTe pin attractively, with FeTe Te-site vacancy strongest. Elementary vortex pinning thereby becomes a computable electronic-structure quantity, opening the first-principles screening of point defects toward higher critical currents.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作建立了一个可迁移的第一性原理计算框架，用于从微观量子谱角度计算 II 型超导体中的基本涡旋钉扎。框架将含缺陷的 DFT/Wannier 电子结构嵌入有限盒投影 Bogoliubov–de Gennes 自由能形式，把准粒子谱重组转化为涡旋钉扎能和钉扎力。结果确认缺陷诱导的涡旋芯 Caroli–de Gennes–Matricon 态重组是基本钉扎力的微观来源，并通过四构型相减从大背景中分离 meV 量级相互作用。
authors: Haozhe Shi, Yuncheng Xie, Tong Zhang, Weibin Chu, Xin-Gao Gong

articles.title: Telecom-band site-controlled quantum dots with engineered low fine-structure splitting
articles.title_zh: 具有工程化低精细结构劈裂的通信波段位置可控量子点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deterministic quantum light sources emitting at telecom wavelengths with vanishing fine-structure splitting (FSS) are essential components for scalable quantum communication. While self-assembled Stranski-Krastanov (SK) quantum dots (QDs) are high-quality emitters, their random positioning and shape-induced anisotropy typically limit their use in entangled-photon applications. In this work, we demonstrate site-controlled SK growth where InAs/InP QDs nucleate at the symmetric apexes of truncated InP nanopyramids. Confining adatom diffusion to a small, symmetric nucleation area suppresses anisotropic growth, promoting the nucleation of highly symmetric QDs with FSS reduced to values below our statistically validated resolution limit of 9.2~μeV. At the same time, lithographically defined nucleation sites enable deterministic control of the QD position, overcoming the limitations of conventional SK growth. The high structural quality of single symmetric QDs is evidenced by the single-photon character of the emission (g⁽²⁾(0)=0.07⁺⁰.²⁷₋₀.₀₇) spanning the S, C, and L telecom bands, with no evidence of lithography-induced defects affecting emission dynamics. These results demonstrate that tailoring QD symmetry through nanopyramid growth engineering provides a route toward site-controlled emitters suitable for entangled photon generation and integrated quantum photonics devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作实现了在截顶 InP 纳米金字塔对称顶端进行位置可控的 InAs/InP Stranski–Krastanov 量子点生长，用于通信波段确定性量子光源。通过将吸附原子扩散限制在小而对称的成核区域，作者抑制各向异性生长，使量子点精细结构劈裂降至统计验证的 9.2 μeV 分辨极限以下。器件发射覆盖 S、C、L 通信波段，并表现出单光子特性 g²(0)=0.07⁺⁰·²⁷₋₀·₀₇，未见明显光刻诱导缺陷影响发光。
authors: Christian C. Ruiz Madera, Paweł Holewa, Paweł Wyborski, Meng Xiong, Battulga Munkhbat, Elizaveta Semenova

articles.title: Constraint-Aware Quantum Optimization of Defect Configurations in Doped ZrO2: XY-Mixer QAOA and Grover Adaptive Search
articles.title_zh: 掺杂 ZrO₂ 中缺陷构型的约束感知量子优化：XY 混合器 QAOA 与 Grover 自适应搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24922v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum optimization offers a route to searching the large defect-configuration spaces that arise in materials design. We develop an end-to-end, constraint-aware quantum optimization workflow for composition-defect search in a doped ZrO2 thermal-barrier-coating (TBC) material system, using a MACE-MPA-0 energy dataset to fit a 24-variable QUBO over 8 cation-occupation and 16 oxygen-vacancy variables with exactly two rare-earth substitutions and one oxygen vacancy, yielding 448 feasible configurations. The QUBO surrogate reproduces the MACE energies with held-out R2 = 0.997 (full-data R2 = 0.999, RMSE = 17 meV). We validate two complementary quantum pathways against exact enumeration: a constraint-preserving XY-mixer QAOA that confines sampling to the feasible subspace and places 86% of probability mass within 1 meV of the MACE optimum at depth p = 3, and a fault-tolerant constrained Grover Adaptive Search oracle with explicit fixed-point arithmetic, branch-safe comparison, feasibility checking, and phase kickback. Across threshold cases, the validated oracle uses 324 high-level logical qubits, or 352 to 358 with conservative clean-ancilla v-chain accounting, and requires 3.6 to 4.3 x 104 Toffoli gates per Grover (GAS) iteration. An idealized feasible-space amplification estimate suggests up to a 240x reduction in total Toffoli cost relative to the full 224 occupation space, providing a resource-estimation bridge between materials-informed QUBO modeling, constraint-aware QAOA, and fault-tolerant threshold search.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出面向掺杂 ZrO₂ 热障涂层材料的端到端约束感知量子优化流程，用于搜索满足组成与缺陷数约束的构型空间。作者基于 MACE-MPA-0 能量数据拟合含 24 个变量的 QUBO 代理模型，在 448 个可行构型上实现对能量的高精度再现，保留集 R²=0.997。两条量子路径均经精确枚举验证：约束保持的 XY-mixer QAOA 在 p=3 时将 86% 概率质量集中到 MACE 最优值 1 meV 内；容错约束 Grover 自适应搜索则给出含定点算术、可行性检查和相位回踢的显式 oracle 资源估计。

articles.title: Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes and duality webs of fermionic topological phases
articles.title_zh: Majorana–Pauli 稳定子码与费米子拓扑相的对偶网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25048v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Stabilizer codes provide exact lattice realizations of bosonic topological orders. In contrast, systematic stabilizer descriptions of intrinsically fermionic topological phases remain much less developed. In this work, we introduce Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes, a class of exactly solvable fermionic lattice models whose stabilizers are built from both generalized Pauli operators and Majorana operators. As a main example, we construct an exactly solvable stabilizer realization of the fermionic toric code: an intrinsically fermionic mathbb Z₂ topological order in (2+1) dimensions, using mathbb Z₈ Pauli operators coupled to Majorana modes. Within this stabilizer framework, the anyons, string operators, fusion rules, and braiding statistics all follow naturally from the stabilizer algebra. More broadly, we show that the fermionic toric code belongs to a duality web generated by anyon condensation and by gauging bosonic or fermion-parity symmetries. This web connects bosonic topological orders, symmetry-enriched topological phases, and both bosonic and fermionic symmetry-protected topological phases, all within a common stabilizer description. We further show that the construction extends to all Abelian fermionic topological orders with gapped boundaries and to all supercohomology fermionic SPT phases in (2+1) dimensions. Going beyond Majorana operators, we introduce fermionic versions of the clock and shift operators and use them to construct an exact bosonization map for mathbb Z_D^F symmetries for D even. Using this, we realize a stabilizer model for a nontrivial mathbb Z₈^F fermionic SPT phase with no free-fermion analog. Altogether, these results extend the stabilizer-code paradigm to a broad class of intrinsically fermionic phases bridging fermionic quantum many-body physics to quantum error correction.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出 Majorana–Pauli 稳定子码，用广义 Pauli 算符与 Majorana 算符共同构造严格可解的费米子晶格模型。作为核心例子，文中用耦合 Majorana 模式的 Z₈ Pauli 算符实现了二维内禀费米子的 Z₂ 拓扑序，即费米子 toric code，并从稳定子代数自然导出任意子、弦算符、融合规则和编织统计。进一步地，该费米子 toric code 被嵌入由任意子凝聚以及玻色/费米子宇称对称性规范化生成的对偶网络，连接多类玻色与费米子拓扑相。
authors: Meng Sun, Zongyuan Wang, Nathanan Tantivasadakarn, Yu-An Chen

articles.title: Nonlocal Quantum Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 非局域量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25061v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Phase transitions are paradigmatic examples of emergent phenomena, in which symmetries present at the microscopic level can be spontaneously broken in the thermodynamic limit. Two primary physical mechanisms can drive this symmetry breaking: thermal fluctuations in classical phase transitions and quantum fluctuations in quantum critical phenomena. Here, we introduce nonlocal quantum fluctuations as a new fundamental mechanism to drive phase transitions. We show that entanglement shared between environmental modes can induce a correlated symmetry breaking in remote systems, independent of their spatial separation. Using the framework of driven-dissipative phase transitions, we theoretically investigate a system composed of two nonlinear quantum resonators placed at arbitrarily large spatial separations, each coupled to independent local Markovian baths. We consider the regime in which remote environmental modes are prepared in broadband entangled states. We show that near the critical point, where the susceptibility to weak perturbations diverges, quantum correlations in the environments govern the system critical behavior. While these correlations manifest locally only as effective thermal fluctuations, at the global level they give rise to an emergent nonlocal phase transition, marked by the spontaneous symmetry breaking of a collective mode shared by the two remote systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出“非局域量子涨落”作为驱动相变和对称性破缺的新机制：环境模式之间的纠缠可在空间上相距任意远的系统中诱导相关的对称性破缺。作者在驱动耗散相变框架下研究两个非线性量子谐振器，每个谐振器耦合独立局域 Markov 浴，而远端环境模式被制备为宽带纠缠态。结果表明，在临界点附近系统对微扰的易感性发散，环境量子关联可支配临界行为，从而产生不依赖空间距离的协同相变效应。
authors: Alessandro Coppo, Aanal Jayesh Shah, Hadiseh Alaeian, Valentina Brosco, Roberto Di Candia, Simone Felicetti

articles.title: Preparing two-mode magnonic Schrödinger cat states in a cavity-magnon-qubit system
articles.title_zh: 在腔–磁振子–量子比特系统中制备双模磁振子薛定谔猫态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25511v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The cavity-magnon-qubit system has recently been demonstrated as a new platform for preparing macroscopic quantum states in magnonic systems. Here, we propose to prepare a two-mode magnonic cat state, which is also a non-Gaussian entangled state, based on this practical system involving two yttrium-iron-garnet (YIG) spheres and a superconducting qubit coupled to a common microwave cavity. By adiabatically eliminating the cavity and resonantly driving the qubit, an effective magnon-qubit conditional-displacement interaction is achieved. Further working in the magnon-magnon strong-coupling regime and considering two identical magnon frequencies and coupling strengths to the cavity, two hybridized magnon modes are formed, of which the bright mode is prepared in a cat state after a projective measurement on the qubit, while the dark mode remains in its initial vacuum state. Such a state corresponds to a two-mode cat state of two original magnon modes, which share strong non-Gaussian entanglement. We also discuss practical dissipation and dephasing effects on the cat state. The results indicate that strong nonclassicality and non-Gaussian entanglement are present in the two-mode cat state using fully feasible parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出在包含两个钇铁石榴石球、一个超导量子比特和公共微波腔的腔–磁振子–量子比特平台中制备双模磁振子猫态。通过绝热消去腔模并共振驱动量子比特，可得到有效的磁振子–量子比特条件位移相互作用；在磁振子强耦合、频率和腔耦合相同的条件下，杂化后的亮模经量子比特投影测量形成猫态，暗模保持真空。映射回原始两个磁振子模式后，该态表现为具有强非高斯纠缠的双模猫态，文中还分析了耗散和退相干对其非经典性的影响。
authors: Gen Li, Gang Liu, Rong-Can Yang, Jie Li

articles.title: Long-lasting Topological Entanglement in a Monitored Rashba Nanowire
articles.title_zh: 受监测 Rashba 纳米线中的长寿命拓扑纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25653v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the topological properties of a monitored Rashba chain along quantum-jump trajectories, investigating the persistence of the initial topological value of the disconnected entanglement entropy (DEE). We find that the DEE persists in its topological value for a time linear in the system size, even if the dissipation acts on the boundary and affects the topological Majorana modes. The reason for this phenomenon lies in the absence of particle conservation and in the degeneracy of the topological manifold, allowing the monitoring to let the system switch between different topological states -- alternatively creating and annihilating a Majorana mode -- while producing a poisoning of finite-energy ballistically propagating quasiparticles that eventually destroy the topological entanglement structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究沿量子跳跃轨迹考察受监测 Rashba 链的拓扑性质，重点分析断连纠缠熵的初始拓扑值能维持多久。作者发现，即使耗散作用于边界并直接影响拓扑 Majorana 模式，断连纠缠熵仍能在与系统尺寸成线性关系的时间尺度内保持其拓扑值。其机制来自粒子数不守恒和拓扑流形简并性：监测可使系统在不同拓扑态间切换、交替产生和湮灭 Majorana 模式，同时有限能准粒子的弹道传播最终会毒化并破坏拓扑纠缠结构。
authors: Emanuele Guida, Giulia Salatino, Gianluca Passarelli, Angelo Russomanno, Procolo Lucignano

articles.title: Exact Leg-Cut Influence Functional and Emergence of Gaussian Entanglement Theory in a Statistical-Dressing Ladder Model
articles.title_zh: 统计修饰梯模型中的精确腿切影响泛函与高斯纠缠理论的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25669v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The emergence of Gaussian effective field theories in low-dimensional quantum systems is traditionally understood through top-down frameworks such as bosonization and Luttinger-liquid theory. However, these approaches typically focus on the long-wavelength degrees of freedom in ways that do not directly track how non-Gaussian lattice-scale correlations are progressively discarded under coarse-graining. In this work, we present an exact lattice formulation from which this phenomenon emerges analytically. We analyze a two-leg hard-core ladder under a leg bipartition, where non-local statistical strings cross the entanglement cut. We construct an exact lattice influence-functional representation showing that the reduced state factorizes strictly into a product-state amplitude and a full-counting-statistics functional. By introducing a commuting linked-cluster superoperator hierarchy that bypasses Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff ordering ambiguities, we prove that the first mixedness-generating sector is strictly density-density in character. Under a specific systematic coarse-graining procedure, we analytically derive the suppression of higher-order corrections, providing a controlled, closed-form framework showing how highly non-Gaussian lattice states evolve toward their quadratic continuum form under coarse-graining. We corroborate these analytical predictions through finite-size exact diagonalization and entanglement-spectrum diagnostics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从精确晶格表述出发，研究二维硬核梯在沿腿二分时非局域统计弦穿过纠缠切面的影响，旨在解析说明高斯有效理论如何在粗粒化中涌现。作者构造了精确的晶格影响泛函表示，证明约化态可严格分解为乘积态振幅与全计数统计泛函。通过引入对易的连通集团超算符层级，文中避免 Baker–Campbell–Hausdorff 排序歧义，并证明首个产生混合度的部门具有严格的密度–密度性质；在特定系统粗粒化下，高阶非高斯关联被解析压制，从而得到高斯纠缠理论。

articles.title: Quasiparticle interference in LiFeAs: Signature of inelastic tunneling through spin fluctuations
articles.title_zh: LiFeAs 中的准粒子干涉：通过自旋涨落发生非弹性隧穿的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.11755v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quasiparticle interference (QPI) is a powerful tool to characterize the symmetry of the superconducting order parameter in unconventional superconductors, by mapping the spatial dependence of elastic tunneling of electrons between the tip of a scanning tunneling microscope and a sample. Here, we consider the influence of inelastic tunneling on quasi-particle interference, exemplarily for the iron-based superconductor LiFeAs. We clearly observe replica features in both experimental QPI maps and the dispersion extracted from QPI, which from comparison with theoretical model calculations can be attributed to inelastic tunneling. Analysis of the QPI dispersion shows that the inelastic mode that gives rise to these replica features exhibits a resonance between 8 and 10 meV. Comparison of the energy scale of the resonance energy estimated from QPI with inelastic neutron scattering indicates that the replica features arise from interaction with spin fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究非弹性隧穿对铁基超导体 LiFeAs 准粒子干涉的影响。实验 QPI 图和由 QPI 提取的色散中均观察到复制特征，结合理论模型计算可归因于非弹性隧穿。对 QPI 色散的分析显示相关非弹性模式在 8–10 meV 之间存在共振；与非弹性中子散射能标比较表明，这些复制特征源于电子与自旋涨落的相互作用。
authors: Shun Chi, Carolina A. Marques, Walter N. Hardy, Ruixing Liang, Pinder Dosanjh, Doug A. Bonn, Sarah A. Burke, Peter Wahl

articles.title: Similarities and differences of typicality in quantum and classical systems
articles.title_zh: 量子与经典系统中典型性的相似性与差异
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.06795v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Typicality is a well-established and very general property of quantum many-body systems, referring to the phenomenon that the expectation values of any given observable are practically indistinguishable for the overwhelming majority of all pure states (normalized vectors) in a sufficiently high-dimensional Hilbert (sub-)space. Here, we provide very simple and general arguments that analogous typicality properties of pure states (phase space points) in classical many-body systems are still expected to hold true for macroscopic observables, but not any more for microscopic (few-body) observables.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文比较量子多体系统与经典多体系统中“典型性”的适用范围。量子情形下，在足够高维 Hilbert 子空间中，绝大多数纯态对给定可观测量给出几乎不可区分的期望值；作者给出简单而一般的论证，说明经典多体系统中相空间点的类似典型性预计仍适用于宏观可观测量。不同之处在于，对微观或少体可观测量，经典纯态一般不再表现出同样的典型性。

articles.title: Emergent spacetime supersymmetry at 2D fractionalized quantum criticality
articles.title_zh: 二维分数量子临界性中的涌现时空超对称
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.07383v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While experimental evidence for spacetime supersymmetry (SUSY) in particle physics remains elusive, condensed matter systems offer a promising arena for its emergence at quantum critical points (QCPs). Although there have been a variety of proposals for emergent SUSY at symmetry-breaking QCPs, the emergence of SUSY at fractionalized QCPs remains largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate emergent space-time SUSY at a fractionalized QCP in the Kitaev honeycomb model with Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) spin-phonon coupling. Specifically, through numerical computations and analytical analysis, we show that the anisotropic SSH-Kitaev model hosts a fractionalized QCP between a Dirac spin liquid and an incommensurate/commensurate valence-bond-solid phase coexisting with Z₂ topological order. A low-energy field theory incorporating phonon quantum fluctuations reveals that this fractionalized QCP features an emergent N=2 spacetime SUSY. We further discuss their universal experimental signatures in thermal transport and viscosity, highlighting the concrete lattice realization of emergent SUSY at a fractionalized QCP in 2D.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出在具有 Su–Schrieffer–Heeger 自旋–声子耦合的 Kitaev 蜂窝模型中，分数量子临界点可涌现时空超对称。数值计算与解析分析表明，各向异性 SSH–Kitaev 模型存在从 Dirac 自旋液体到非公度/公度价键固体相的分数量子临界点，后者与 Z₂ 拓扑序共存。包含声子量子涨落的低能场论显示该临界点具有涌现 N=2 时空超对称，作者还讨论了其在热输运和黏滞响应中的普适实验信号。
authors: Zhengzhi Wu, Zhou-Quan Wan, Shao-Kai Jian, Hong Yao

articles.title: Modeling the dynamics of trapped electrons in quantum dots
articles.title_zh: 量子点中俘获电子动力学建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.09470v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analyze the effects of electron-electron and electron-phonon interactions in the dynamics of a system of two or three electrons that can be trapped to a localized state and detrapped to ab extended band states of a quantum dot using a simple model. In spite of its simplicity the time dependent problem has no analytical solution but a numerically exact one can be found at a relatively low computational cost. Within this model, we study the time evolution of the electron occupancies of conduction and valence bands and the trap state, as well as the statistical factors influencing light emission of different energies. In most of the analyzed cases, the system dynamics has a very short transient determined by the hopping parameters, that can be of tens of femptoseconds,followed by a quasi-stationary regime in which the electron occupancies either oscillate periodically around their time-averaged values or remain nearly constant. We find signatures of strong electronic correlations in the electronic motion for negative values of the effective electron-electron Coulomb interaction that are not translated to the statistical factors for light emission. Our calculations show that light emission of different energies is always possible except in the especial cases in which the valence band is initially filled with two electrons. In these cases the valence band can lose and recover electrons periodically but exciton emission is negligible at any time. We use this fact to attempt to give a possible explanation for the increase in the intensity of exciton emission with the concomitant decrease in the intensity of the green emission lines upon continuous illumination with ultraviolet radiation, experimentally observed for ZnO nanoparticles suspended in an alcohol.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者用一个简化但可数值精确求解的模型，分析量子点中两个或三个电子在局域陷阱态与扩展能带态之间俘获/脱俘时，电子–电子和电子–声子相互作用对动力学的影响。研究跟踪导带、价带和陷阱态占据数的时间演化，以及影响不同能量发光的统计因子。多数情形下，系统先经历由跃迁参数决定的极短瞬态，时间尺度可为数十飞秒，随后进入占据数围绕平均值周期振荡或近似恒定的准稳态；在有效电子–电子库仑作用为负时，电子运动中出现强关联迹象，但这些迹象并不总是反映到发光统计因子中。

articles.title: First-principles identification of optically efficient erbium centers in GaAs
articles.title_zh: 光学高效 GaAs 中铒中心的第一性原理识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.07925v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Gallium arsenide (GaAs) doped with erbium (Er), a material of interest for optoelectronics and quantum information, has been studied for decades. Yet the formation of Er luminescence centers in the semiconductor host and their properties are still not well understood. Here we present a systematic investigation of Er-related defects in GaAs, including defect complexes consisting of Er and native point defects or oxygen impurities, using first-principles hybrid-functional defect calculations. We find that these defects have electronic structure and energetics that are generally asymmetric with respect to n- and p-type doping and tend to favor electron trapping. On the basis of the calculated defect levels, formation energies, and nonradiative carrier capture coefficients, we identify Er-related defects that are efficient as trap-assisted nonradiative recombination centers for Er³⁺ excitation under host photoexcitation or via minority carrier injection. Our results provide an understanding for why a particular defect center with Er coupled to two oxygen atoms is most efficient, and for the effects of n- and p-type doping and of the Er/O ratio on the formation of optically active Er centers and on the Er luminescence observed in experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用混合泛函第一性原理缺陷计算，系统研究 GaAs 中与 Er 相关的缺陷，包括 Er 与本征点缺陷或氧杂质形成的复合体。结果显示，这些缺陷的电子结构和形成能对 n 型与 p 型掺杂通常不对称，并倾向于俘获电子。基于缺陷能级、形成能和非辐射载流子俘获系数，作者识别了在基体光激发或少数载流子注入下可高效辅助 Er³⁺ 激发的陷阱辅助非辐射复合中心，并解释了含两个氧原子的 Er 复合中心为何特别高效及掺杂条件的影响。

articles.title: Coherent Control of Quantum-Dot Spins with Cyclic Optical Transitions
articles.title_zh: 利用循环光学跃迁相干控制量子点自旋
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.14445v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Solid-state spins are promising as interfaces from stationary qubits to single photons for quantum communication technologies. Semiconductor quantum dots have excellent optical coherence, exhibit near unity collection efficiencies when coupled to photonic structures, and possess long-lived spins for quantum memory. However, the incompatibility of performing optical spin control and single-shot readout simultaneously has been a challenge faced by almost all solid-state emitters. To overcome this, we leverage light-hole mixing to realize a highly asymmetric lambda system in a negatively charged heavy hole exciton in Faraday configuration. By compensating GHz-scale differential Stark shifts, induced by unequal coupling to Raman control fields, and by performing nuclear-spin cooling, we achieve quantum control of an electron-spin qubit with a π-pulse contrast of 97.4% while preserving spin-selective optical transitions with a cyclicity of 471 (50). We demonstrate this scheme for both GaAs and InGaAs quantum dots, and show that it is compatible with the operation of a nuclear quantum memory. Our approach thus enables repeated emission of indistinguishable photons together with qubit control, as required for single-shot readout, photonic cluster-state generation, and quantum repeater technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用轻空穴混合，在法拉第构型下的负电荷重空穴激子中实现高度不对称的Λ体系，以缓解光学自旋控制与单次读出难以兼容的问题。通过补偿拉曼控制场不等耦合引起的GHz量级差分Stark位移并进行核自旋冷却，作者实现了电子自旋量子比特控制，π脉冲对比度达97.4%，同时保持自旋选择性光学跃迁循环度471(50)。方案在GaAs和InGaAs量子点中均得到展示，并被证明可与核量子存储器操作兼容。
authors: Zhe Xian Koong, Urs Haeusler, Jan M. Kaspari, Christian Schimpf, Benyam Dejen, Ahmed M. Hassanen, Daniel Graham, Yusuf Karli, Ailton J. Garcia Jr., Melina Peter, Edmund Clarke, Maxime Hugues, Michał Gawełczyk, Armando Rastelli, Doris E. Reiter, Mete Atatüre, Dorian A. Gangloff

articles.title: Universal Statistics of Measurement-Induced Entanglement in Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids
articles.title_zh: Tomonaga-Luttinger液体中测量诱导纠缠的普适统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.13809v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the statistics of measurement-induced entanglement (MIE) after partial measurement on a class of one-dimensional quantum critical states described by Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids at low energies. Using a replica trick to average over measurement outcomes in the charge basis and tools from conformal field theory (CFT), we derive closed-form expressions for the cumulants of MIE. We show that exact Born-averaging over microscopic measurement outcomes becomes equivalent at low energy to averaging over conformal boundary conditions weighted by their corresponding partition functions. Our results yield distinctive critical behavior across all cumulants in the regime where the unmeasured parts of the system are maximally separated. We also obtain the full distribution of MIE, finding that it is generically bimodal and exhibits fat-tails. We corroborate our analytical predictions by numerical calculations and find good agreement between them.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究一类低能由Tomonaga-Luttinger液体描述的一维量子临界态在部分测量后的测量诱导纠缠统计。作者结合复制技巧与共形场论，在电荷基测量结果的Born平均下推导出纠缠累积量的闭式表达式，并指出低能下微观测量结果平均等价于按配分函数加权的共形边界条件平均。结果给出所有累积量的特征临界行为，并发现纠缠分布通常呈双峰且具有厚尾，数值计算与解析预言符合良好。

articles.title: Short-distance production of three particles with large scattering length
articles.title_zh: 大散射长度三粒子体系的短程产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.19408v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The short-distance production of multi-particle states in high-energy nuclear reactions provides a unique way to study the low-energy properties of few-body systems. In particular, the production amplitude of multineutron systems is strongly constrained by an approximate conformal symmetry of the underlying theory. We calculate the full amplitude for the short-distance production of three particles with large scattering length in leading order pionless EFT, focusing on the cases of three neutrons and three spinless bosons. We investigate the signature of low-energy resonances and other correlations in the relative energy distributions. For the case of neutrons, we compare to the predictions from approximate conformal symmetry close to the unitary limit and calculate the range corrections up to next-to-next-to leading order.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论高能核反应中多粒子态的短程产生如何揭示少体系统的低能性质，特别关注近似共形对称性对多中子产生振幅的约束。作者在领头阶无 pion 有效场论中计算大散射长度三粒子短程产生的完整振幅，重点考察三中子和三个无自旋玻色子的情形。文中分析低能共振及相关性在相对能量分布中的信号，并对中子体系与接近幺正极限的近似共形对称性预言进行比较，同时计算至次次领头阶的有限力程修正。
authors: Timothy G. Backert, Sebastian Dietz, Hans-Werner Hammer, Sebastian König, Dam Thanh Son

articles.title: How to improve the accuracy of semiclassical and quasiclassical dynamics with and without generalized quantum master equations
articles.title_zh: 有无广义量子主方程时提高半经典与准经典动力学精度的方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.04563v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Semi- and quasi-classical (SC) theories can handle arbitrary interatomic interactions and are thus well-suited to predict quantum dynamics in condensed phases that encode energy and charge transport, spectroscopic responses, and chemical reactivity. However, SC theories can be computationally expensive and inaccurate. When combined with generalized quantum master equations (GQMEs), the resulting SC-GQMEs have been observed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of SC dynamics. Yet, while the mechanism responsible for improved efficiency is clear, the underlying improved accuracy remains elusive. What is worse, SC-GQMEs can yield unphysical dynamics in challenging parameter regimes -- a shortcoming that might be avoided if the mechanism of accuracy improvement were understood. Here, we uncover this mechanism. We leverage short-time analyses to prove that exact, "left-handed" time-derivatives delay the onset of SC inaccuracy, and show that their numerical integration yields dynamics with improved accuracy, even without the GQME. We find, however, that these derivatives are a double-edged sword: while offering greater short-time accuracy, they become unphysical in challenging parameter regimes. Because short-lived memory kernels can leverage short-time accuracy while circumventing long-time instability, we develop a protocol to unambiguously determine the memory kernel cutoff, even in challenging regimes where previous treatments had failed. Our insights into accuracy improvement and kernel cutoff protocol can be expected to apply to complex systems that go beyond simple models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究半经典和准经典动力学在凝聚相量子动力学模拟中的精度提升机制，尤其关注其与广义量子主方程结合后为何常能同时提高效率和准确性。作者通过短时分析证明，精确的“左作用”时间导数能够推迟半经典误差的出现，其数值积分即使不使用广义量子主方程也可提升动力学精度。研究同时指出这类导数具有双刃剑效应：它们改善短时行为，但在困难参数区间也可能导致不物理动力学，因此有助于理解并规避SC-GQME方法的失效。
authors: Matthew R. Laskowski, Srijan Bhattacharyya, Andrés Montoya-Castillo

articles.title: Modeling and Analysis of Phase Instability in Photonic Processor
articles.title_zh: 光子处理器中相位不稳定性的建模与分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving both reconfigurability and stable output signals is a critical challenge in the development of integrated photonic circuits for large-scale optical quantum information processing. This has led to the creation of multimode photonic processors, also known as reconfigurable multimode interferometers, which have wide-ranging applications in quantum and classical information processing. However, maintaining phase stability in multi-port input signals remains a significant hurdle, particularly due to the phase instabilities introduced by active cooling systems and temperature drifts in the photonic processor. In this study, we propose theoretical models to simulate phase instability in photonic processors and validate them against experimental results. Two distinct modeling approaches were employed: a Brownian random walk and phase reconstruction based on experimentally observed oscillating harmonics. Additionally, we verified and applied our model to a specific application for input phase correction using self-feedback control within the photonic processor.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对大规模光量子信息处理中可重构集成光子电路的相位稳定性问题，建立用于模拟光子处理器相位不稳定性的理论模型并与实验结果比较。作者采用两种建模策略：布朗随机游走模型，以及基于实验观测振荡谐波的相位重构模型。研究还将模型用于光子处理器内部的自反馈输入相位校正，验证其在补偿温漂和主动冷却引起相位扰动方面的适用性。
authors: Gökhan Elmas, Igor Litvin, Paul Kohl, Janis Nötzel

articles.title: Leveraging Population Dynamics to Steer Efficient Search in Large-Scale Combinatorial Optimization
articles.title_zh: 利用种群动力学引导大规模组合优化中的高效搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Combinatorial optimization problems pose substantial computational challenges because their feasible solution spaces grow exponentially with problem size. This paper presents a GPU-accelerated augmented Population Annealing Monte Carlo (PAMC) framework for large-scale graph-partitioning problems, with emphasis on Max-Cut and Max-K-Cut. The proposed framework extends conventional PAMC by coupling population-based resampling with two stagnation-driven mechanisms: adaptive temperature control and energy-preserving nonlocal cluster moves. By using population-level optimization history as feedback, these mechanisms regulate the balance between exploration and refinement by reheating stalled populations and enabling collective transitions across locally confined regions of the solution space. Experiments on G-set benchmark instances show that the augmented PAMC framework achieves competitive or lower time-to-solution than reported state-of-the-art baselines on several large Max-Cut instances, while matching or improving solution quality under comparable runtime budgets. The solver also discovers a new best-known solution for the G63 Max-Cut instance and scales to a fully connected 100,000-spin Ising instance. For Max-3-Cut, the same framework establishes new best-known solutions on 36 G-set instances, demonstrating its applicability beyond binary Ising formulations. These results indicate that feedback-controlled population dynamics provide an effective and scalable strategy for steering stochastic search in large-scale combinatorial optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种GPU加速的增强型种群退火蒙特卡罗框架，用于大规模图划分问题，重点包括Max-Cut和Max-K-Cut。方法在传统PAMC基础上引入由停滞触发的自适应温度控制和能量保持非局域簇移动，利用种群层面的优化历史在探索与局部细化之间调节平衡。G-set基准测试表明，该框架在若干大型Max-Cut实例上达到与先进方法相当或更低的求解时间，并在相近运行预算下匹配或改善解质量，还为G63实例发现了新的已知最佳解。
authors: Nikhat Khan, Ridge Redding, Nikhil Shukla

articles.title: Diffeomorphism-Invariant Quantities in Phase Space: More than Correlations
articles.title_zh: 相空间中的微分同胚不变量：不止是关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25072v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A popular view in the foundations of diffeomorphism-invariant theories is that their physical content is encoded in correlations or `observables': a set of phase space functions that have vanishing Poisson brackets with the constraints related to diffeomorphisms. In this article I study the phase space structure of models with a temporal diffeomorphism invariance and prove a series of formal results that challenge this view in a few ways. First, I show how this view is not applicable to all the phase space trajectories of every diffeomorphism-invariant theory. Second, I show how correlations can be proved to be invariant only in a way that generalizes the standard definition of invariance and in a way that does not provide smooth phase space functions. Third, I prove that spatiotemporal relations are also invariant. Fourth, I prove that spatiotemporal structures are indispensable for defining the invariant content of diffeomorphism-invariant models. Finally, I comment that these results are expected to be generalizable for models invariant under d-dimensional diffeomorphisms, which represents a challenge for some views in the foundations of general relativity and quantum gravity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论微分同胚不变理论基础中一种常见观点，即物理内容由与微分同胚约束泊松括号为零的关联或可观测量编码。作者分析具有时间微分同胚不变性的模型相空间结构，并证明这一观点并不适用于所有微分同胚不变理论的全部相空间轨道。文章进一步指出，关联的不变性需要推广标准不变性定义且通常不产生光滑相空间函数；同时，时空关系和时空结构本身也是定义不变内容不可或缺的组成部分。

articles.title: Rapid and robust laser-frequency auto-locking using Bayesian-optimization and discrete-wavelet-transformation algorithms
articles.title_zh: 基于贝叶斯优化和离散小波变换的快速鲁棒激光频率自动锁定
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25267v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rapid and robust laser-frequency auto-locking is essential for the field deployment of quantum communications, quantum computing, and precision-measurement technologies; however, achieving this remains a considerable challenge. Here, we propose and demonstrate an auto-locking scheme employing Bayesian optimization and discrete biorthogonal wavelet transformation. First, the reference is rapidly sought by making intelligent use of historical observations, eliminating the inherent blindness of the traditional parameter-scanning method. Second, the frequency reference is robustly identified by pinpointing transition signals with the discrete biorthogonal wavelet transformation and analyzing their immutable frequency differences and relative magnitudes, which are determined by the inherent atomic structure and remain resistant to environmental disturbances. This proposed approach achieves a fivefold acceleration in reference searching compared to conventional scanning methods in the case where the laser frequency drifts far away from the reference. Crucially, it achieves an identification accuracy of more than 99.5 %, even under severe 50 % laser-intensity fluctuations, 9.95ⁱ̧rc photodiode misalignment, and 18ⁱ̧rcC Rb cell temperature elevation. Finally, locking the laser frequency to the identified reference with a lead zirconate titanate-current double-servo loop narrows the linewidth to 20 kHz. We believe that this rapid, robust, and high-performance auto-locking technique will be pivotal towards the deployment of the next generation of practical quantum technologies in demanding field environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出并演示一种结合贝叶斯优化与离散双正交小波变换的激光频率自动锁定方案，面向量子通信、量子计算和精密测量的外场应用需求。贝叶斯优化利用历史观测快速寻找频率参考，避免传统参数扫描的盲目性；小波变换则通过识别跃迁信号及其由原子结构决定的稳定频率差和相对幅度来增强鲁棒性。实验显示，在激光频率远离参考时参考搜索速度相比常规扫描提高约5倍，并在强扰动条件下保持超过99.5%的识别准确率。
authors: Min Jiang, Xiao-Li Chen, Si-Bin Lu, Jia-Hao Fu, Zhan-Wei Yao, Shao-Kang Li, Min Ke, San-Ming Song, Run-Bing Li, Jin Wang, Ming-Sheng Zhan

articles.title: Quantum tomography of free electrons
articles.title_zh: 自由电子的量子层析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25397v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Determining the quantum state of a given quantum-mechanical system is a fundamental task in physics. Quantum-state tomography has been pivotal for establishing quantum optics [1-4] and for revealing the properties of bound charges in materials [5-7]. An emerging other object for studying and utilizing quantum effects are free electrons, elementary particles that are central to high-resolution microscopy [8,9], electron-based quantum optics [10-17], ul-trafast electron microscopy [18-24] and particle accelerators [25-27]. However, free electrons are intrinsically incoherent, and we lack a broadly applicable method to measure and control their quantum state beyond special cases with discrete energy sidebands [28,29]. Here, we report a universal approach to measure arbitrary free-electron quantum states in continuous variables. Two monochromatic but spectrally shifted laser waves produce interfering quan-tum paths that directly reveal the density matrix and thus all essential properties of the pure wavepackets, the ensemble, and their interlinks. As a first application, we show how the quantum state of a single electron is modified by many-body Coulomb interactions of a sur-rounding electron gas. The reported concepts and results provide insight into otherwise hid-den correlations in electron beams and enable the controlled optimization of exceptional quantum states for free-electron quantum optics or quantum electron microscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种测量连续变量中任意自由电子量子态的通用量子层析方法，以突破以往主要限于离散能量边带情形的限制。作者利用两束单色但频谱偏移的激光波产生相干干涉量子路径，直接重构密度矩阵，从而获得纯波包、系综及其相互联系的关键性质。作为应用，论文展示了单个电子的量子态如何被外场作用所改变，为自由电子量子光学和超快电子显微提供了新的表征手段。
authors: Y. Fang, J. Kuttruff, Z. Zhao, L. Moehrle, P. Hommelhoff, P. Baum

articles.title: Towards Robust Optimal Measurements Against Noise in Quantum Metrology
articles.title_zh: 面向量子计量中抗噪声鲁棒最优测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25638v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum parameter estimation utilizes quantum mechanical effects to attain higher measurement precision than classical schemes. In practical implementations, however, noise is inevitably present during the measurement process, causing a decrease in precision. Quantifying the impact of noise on different measurements is of considerable significance. Here, we experimentally investigate robust optimal measurements based on the theory of Fisher information measurement noise susceptibility (FI MENOS), which quantifies how susceptible a measurement is to noise. By constructing a polarizing Mach-Zehnder interferometer, we implement phase estimation under controlled noise. Our results indicate that different measurements exhibit distinct sensitivities to noise. To assess the influence of diverse noise types on precision, we further construct an experimental setup capable of introducing various forms of noise. The experimental results affirm that FI MENOS represents the worst-case scenario for estimation precision, enabling us to evaluate the noise immunity of optimal measurements.
